  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Loop);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *SPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  llvm::Value *Idx[] = {B.getInt32(0), IPhi};
  auto *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Arr, Idx);
  auto *Cur = B.CreateLoad(I32, EP);
  auto *NewV = B.CreateAdd(Cur, IPhi);
  B.CreateStore(NewV, EP);
  auto *NewS = B.CreateXor(SPhi, NewV);
  auto *NextI = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Cond = B.CreateICmpSLT(NextI, B.getInt32(8));
  B.CreateCondBr(Cond, Loop, Exit);
  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(NextI, Loop);
  SPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  SPhi->addIncoming(NewS, Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  auto *AccV = B.CreateLoad(I32, Acc);
  auto *AccN = B.CreateAdd(AccV, NewS);
  B.CreateStore(AccN, Acc);
  B.CreateRet(AccN);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int warith(int a, int b) {  // 64-bit operators (split into add/adc, sub/sbb
//   long la=(long)a, lb=(long)b;          // etc. on 32-bit ISAs)
//   long r = ((la + lb) ^ (la & lb)) | ((la - lb) & (la ^ lb));
//   return (int)(r ^ (r >> 31));
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideArithIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "warith", M.get());
  auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
  auto *LA = B.CreateSExt(F->getArg(0), I64);
  auto *LB = B.CreateSExt(F->getArg(1), I64);
  auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(LA, LB);
  auto *An = B.CreateAnd(LA, LB);
  auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(LA, LB);
  auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(LA, LB);
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  auto *Folded = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateAShr(R, B.getInt64(31)));
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateTrunc(Folded, I32));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit *variable* shift (shl/lshr/ashr i64 by a runtime amount) — warith only
// does i64 add/and/sub/xor/or + a *constant* shift, and wfrot is a funnel-shift
// (rotate); a plain i64 shift by a runtime amount that can be >= 32 is a
// distinct, fragile lowering on the 32-bit ISAs: i386 uses shld/shrd plus a
// branch/cmov-or-mask to handle "amount >= 32 swaps the halves", ARM32 a
// shift+compare+select sequence — x86-64/AArch64 are a single shl/lsr/asr.  The
// i64 value has *both* halves populated (high = a, low = b) so a cross-32
// shift is observable, and the amount is masked to [0,63] so every shift is
// well-defined and crosses the 32-bit boundary for half the inputs.  No libcall
// (shifts are inline on every ISA).  Substitutable add/sub/and/or/xor +
// constants drive --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes structure.
//
//   int wshift(int a, int b) {
//     uint64_t la = ((uint64_t)a << 32) | (uint32_t)b;
//     unsigned s = b & 63, s2 = a & 63;          // 0..63, may be >= 32
//     uint64_t acc = (la << s) ^ (la >> s) ^ ((int64_t)la >> s) ^ (la << s2);
//     int red = (int)acc ^ (int)(acc >> 32);
//     int base = red ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideShiftIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wshift", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // la = (a << 32) | (uint32_t)b  -> both 64-bit halves populated.
  auto *La = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(A, I64), B.getInt64(32)),
                        B.CreateZExt(C, I64));
  auto *Amt = B.CreateZExt(B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(63)), I64);  // 0..63
  auto *Amt2 = B.CreateZExt(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(63)), I64); // 0..63
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(La, Amt);
  auto *LShr = B.CreateLShr(La, Amt);
  auto *AShr = B.CreateAShr(La, Amt);
  auto *Shl2 = B.CreateShl(La, Amt2);
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Shl, LShr), B.CreateXor(AShr, Shl2));
  auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(Acc, I32);
  auto *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Acc, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
  auto *Red = B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int narith(int a, int b) {  // 8- and 16-bit operators
//   char ca=(char)a, cb=(char)b; short sa=(short)a, sb=(short)b;
//   char  c = (ca + cb) ^ (ca & cb);
//   short s = (sa - sb) | (sa ^ sb);
//   return (int)c + (int)s;
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildNarrowArithIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "narith", M.get());
  auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
  auto *CA = B.CreateTrunc(F->getArg(0), I8);
  auto *CB = B.CreateTrunc(F->getArg(1), I8);
  auto *C = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(CA, CB), B.CreateAnd(CA, CB));
  auto *SA = B.CreateTrunc(F->getArg(0), I16);
  auto *SB = B.CreateTrunc(F->getArg(1), I16);
  auto *S = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(SA, SB), B.CreateXor(SA, SB));
  auto *R = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateSExt(C, I32), B.CreateSExt(S, I32));
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Cross-function: both helper and caller carry substitutable operators.
//   static int cadd(int x,int y){ return (x+y) ^ (x&y); }
//   int ccaller(int a,int b){ return cadd(a,b) - cadd(b,a) + (a|b); }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildCallChainIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *HTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *H = llvm::Function::Create(HTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage, "cadd",
                                   M.get());
  H->setDSOLocal(true);
  {
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", H);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
    auto *X = H->getArg(0), *Y = H->getArg(1);
    B.CreateRet(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(X, Y), B.CreateAnd(X, Y)));
  }
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(HTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "ccaller", M.get());
  {
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
    auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
    auto *R1 = B.CreateCall(H, {A, C});
    auto *R2 = B.CreateCall(H, {C, A});
    B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateSub(R1, R2), B.CreateOr(A, C)));
  }
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Multiple distinct callees: a caller that directly calls three different
// defined helpers across five call sites, plus a data-dependent branch + PHI.
// Exercises the indirect-call pass resolving several distinct function
// addresses indirectly within one function.
//   static int mc_add(int x,int y){ return x+y; }
//   static int mc_sub(int x,int y){ return x-y; }
//   static int mc_mul(int x,int y){ return x*y; }
//   int mcallee(int a,int b){
//     int s=mc_add(a,b), d=mc_sub(a,b), p=mc_mul(s,d);
//     if ((a^b)&1) return mc_add(p,a);
//     return mc_sub(p,b);
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMultiCalleeIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *HTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);

  auto *Add = llvm::Function::Create(HTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage,
                                     "mc_add", M.get());
  Add->setDSOLocal(true);
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Add));
    B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(Add->getArg(0), Add->getArg(1)));
  }
  auto *Sub = llvm::Function::Create(HTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage,
                                     "mc_sub", M.get());
  Sub->setDSOLocal(true);
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Sub));
    B.CreateRet(B.CreateSub(Sub->getArg(0), Sub->getArg(1)));
  }
  auto *Mul = llvm::Function::Create(HTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage,
                                     "mc_mul", M.get());
  Mul->setDSOLocal(true);
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Mul));
    B.CreateRet(B.CreateMul(Mul->getArg(0), Mul->getArg(1)));
  }

  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(HTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "mcallee", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *S = B.CreateCall(Add, {A, Bb});
  auto *D = B.CreateCall(Sub, {A, Bb});
  auto *P = B.CreateCall(Mul, {S, D});
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateCall(Add, {P, A});
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateCall(Sub, {P, Bb});
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Phi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Phi->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Phi->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Phi);

  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Integer-vector substitution (the pass handles isIntOrIntVectorTy
// element-wise).
//   int vred(int a, int b) {
//     <4 x i32> va = splat(a), vb = splat({b,b+1,b+2,b+3});
//     <4 x i32> r = ((va + vb) ^ (va & vb)) | ((va - vb) & (va ^ vb));
//     return r[0] ^ r[1] ^ r[2] ^ r[3];
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecArithIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vred",
                                   M.get());
  auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
  auto *VA = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, F->getArg(0));
  // vb lanes = b, b+1, b+2, b+3 (so lanes differ)
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    auto *L = B.CreateAdd(F->getArg(1), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, L, B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
  auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
  auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
  auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
    Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(i)));
  B.CreateRet(Acc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// ===========================================================================
// Extra IR samples for the constant-encryption transform — each carries
// integer constant operands of binary operators / comparisons (the operands
// ConstantEncryptionPass rewrites).  The arithmetic samples above (amix /
// aseq / ...) are reused too; these add constant-dense and multi-width cases.
// ===========================================================================

// int cmix(int a) {  // many distinct i32 constants
//   int x = (a + 0x11223344) ^ 0x55667788;
//   x = (x - 0x0BADF00D) & 0x7FFFFFFF;
//   return x | 0x40;
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildConstMixIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "cmix",
                                   M.get());
  auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
  llvm::Value *X = B.CreateAdd(F->getArg(0), B.getInt32(0x11223344));
  X = B.CreateXor(X, B.getInt32(0x55667788));
  X = B.CreateSub(X, B.getInt32(0x0BADF00D));
  X = B.CreateAnd(X, B.getInt32(0x7FFFFFFF));
  X = B.CreateOr(X, B.getInt32(0x40));
  B.CreateRet(X);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int mwc(int a, int b) {  // i8 / i16 / i32 / i64 constants
//   char  c = (char)a  + 0x12;
//   short s = (short)b ^ 0x3456;
//   int   i = a & 0x789ABCDE;
//   long  l = (long)a - 0x1122334455667788;
//   return (int)c + (int)s + i + (int)l;
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMultiWidthConstIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "mwc",
                                   M.get());
  auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
  auto *C = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateTrunc(F->getArg(0), I8),
                        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, 0x12));
  auto *S = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(F->getArg(1), I16),
                        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, 0x3456));
  auto *I = B.CreateAnd(F->getArg(0), B.getInt32(0x789ABCDEu));
  auto *L = B.CreateSub(B.CreateSExt(F->getArg(0), I64),
                        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 0x1122334455667788ULL));
  llvm::Value *R = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateSExt(C, I32), B.CreateSExt(S, I32));
  R = B.CreateAdd(R, I);
  R = B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateTrunc(L, I32));
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// ===========================================================================
// Multi-block IR samples for the control-flow flattening transform.  Flattening
// only fires on functions with >= 2 blocks, so the single-block arithmetic
// samples above are not reused here; these carry diamonds, loops with inner
// branches, and multiple return blocks — the control flow the dispatcher must
// faithfully reproduce.
// ===========================================================================

// int bsel(int a, int b) {  // diamond + PHI
//   int r = (a > b) ? ((a - b) ^ a) : ((b - a) | b);
//   return r + (a & b);
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBranchSelIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "bsel",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSGT(A, C), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(A, C), A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(C, A), C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  R->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateAnd(A, C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int lbr(int n) {  // loop with an inner branch (header/body/then/else/latch)
//   int s = 0;
//   for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (i & 1) s += i; else s ^= (i + 1); }
//   return s;
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildLoopBranchIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "lbr",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Head = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "head", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Odd = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "odd", F);
  auto *Even = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "even", F);
  auto *Latch = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "latch", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  auto *N = F->getArg(0);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Head);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *SPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(IPhi, N), Body, Exit);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Body);
  auto *Bit = B.CreateAnd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Bit, B.getInt32(0)), Odd, Even);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Odd);
  auto *SOdd = B.CreateAdd(SPhi, IPhi);
  B.CreateBr(Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Even);
  auto *SEven = B.CreateXor(SPhi, B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1)));
  B.CreateBr(Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Latch);
  auto *SNext = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "snext");
  SNext->addIncoming(SOdd, Odd);
  SNext->addIncoming(SEven, Even);
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(INext, Latch);
  SPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  SPhi->addIncoming(SNext, Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(SPhi);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int mret(int a) {  // multiple return blocks (ret terminators stay put)
//   if (a < 0)  return 0 - a;
//   if (a == 0) return 42;
//   return a * a;
// }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMultiRetIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "mret",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *RNeg = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "rneg", F);
  auto *Cont = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "cont", F);
  auto *RZero = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "rzero", F);
  auto *RPos = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "rpos", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(A, B.getInt32(0)), RNeg, Cont);
  B.SetInsertPoint(RNeg);
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateSub(B.getInt32(0), A));
  B.SetInsertPoint(Cont);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpEQ(A, B.getInt32(0)), RZero, RPos);
  B.SetInsertPoint(RZero);
  B.CreateRet(B.getInt32(42));
  B.SetInsertPoint(RPos);
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateMul(A, A));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int nloop(int n, int m) {  // nested counted loops (outer + inner PHIs)
//   int s = 0;
//   for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
//     for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) s = (s + (i ^ j)) & 0x3fffffff;
//     s = (s - i) | 1;
//   }
//   return s;
// }
// Two-level loop nest: exercises nested back-edges + an inner-loop PHI live in
// the outer latch — the hardest shape for control-flow flattening / opaque /
// bogus passes (every value must survive reg2mem and the dispatcher rebuild).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildNestedLoopIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "nloop", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *OHead = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "ohead", F);
  auto *OBody = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "obody", F);
  auto *IHead = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "ihead", F);
  auto *IBody = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "ibody", F);
  auto *OLatch = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "olatch", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  auto *N = F->getArg(0), *Mm = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(OHead);

  B.SetInsertPoint(OHead);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *SOuter = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "souter");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(IPhi, N), OBody, Exit);

  B.SetInsertPoint(OBody);
  B.CreateBr(IHead);

  B.SetInsertPoint(IHead);
  auto *JPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "j");
  auto *SInner = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "sinner");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(JPhi, Mm), IBody, OLatch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(IBody);
  auto *Add1 = B.CreateAdd(SInner, B.CreateXor(IPhi, JPhi));
  auto *Masked = B.CreateAnd(Add1, B.getInt32(0x3fffffff));
  auto *JNext = B.CreateAdd(JPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(IHead);

  // SInner (an inner-loop PHI) is live here: IHead is OLatch's sole
  // predecessor.
  B.SetInsertPoint(OLatch);
  auto *Sub1 = B.CreateSub(SInner, IPhi);
  auto *Ored = B.CreateOr(Sub1, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(OHead);

  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(INext, OLatch);
  SOuter->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  SOuter->addIncoming(Ored, OLatch);
  JPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), OBody);
  JPhi->addIncoming(JNext, IBody);
  SInner->addIncoming(SOuter, OBody);
  SInner->addIncoming(Masked, IBody);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(SOuter);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int swdisp(int a, int b) {  // dense switch -> jump table; every op in a case
//   int r;
//   switch (a & 7) {
//     case 0:  r = a + b;          break;  // add
//     case 1:  r = a - b;          break;  // sub
//     case 2:  r = a ^ b;          break;  // xor
//     case 3:  r = a | b;          break;  // or
//     case 4:  r = a & b;          break;  // and
//     case 5:  r = (a + b) ^ b;    break;
//     case 6:  r = (a - b) | a;    break;
//     default: r = b ^ 0x5a5a5a5a;        // case 7
//   }
//   return r + (a ^ b);
// }
// A SwitchInst with dense cases 0..7 lowers to a jump table parked in read-only
// data whose entries relocate to .text case blocks — exercises the rewrite
// backend's jump-table relocation under instruction substitution / constant
// encryption (no other patch-full sample uses a switch).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildSwitchIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "swdisp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  static const char *CN[8] = {"c0", "c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "c5", "c6", "c7"};
  llvm::BasicBlock *Cs[8];
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Cs[i] = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, CN[i], F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *SW = B.CreateSwitch(Sel, Cs[7], 7); // case 7 handled by the default
  for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i)
    SW->addCase(B.getInt32(i), Cs[i]);

  llvm::Value *V[8];
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[0]);
    V[0] = b.CreateAdd(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[1]);
    V[1] = b.CreateSub(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[2]);
    V[2] = b.CreateXor(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[3]);
    V[3] = b.CreateOr(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[4]);
    V[4] = b.CreateAnd(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[5]);
    V[5] = b.CreateXor(b.CreateAdd(A, C), C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[6]);
    V[6] = b.CreateOr(b.CreateSub(A, C), A);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[7]);
    V[7] = b.CreateXor(C, b.getInt32(0x5a5a5a5a));
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 8, "r");
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    R->addIncoming(V[i], Cs[i]);
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateXor(A, C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Large dense jump-table switch (64 contiguous cases).  swdisp above is only an
// 8-way switch over a [0,7] range — small enough that the ARM Thumb backend
// encodes it as a `tbb` (byte-offset table branch, max span 510 B).  swbig
// packs 64 dense cases, each a multi-op body, so the jump-table span exceeds
// the tbb range and the only Thumb cell (COFF ARM32) must widen to a `tbh`
// (halfword table branch) — a distinct Thumb dispatch/encoding path no existing
// shape reaches — while x86/x64/AArch64 emit a 64-entry jump table in read-only
// data (far more relocated table entries than any other sample).  Contains a
// SwitchInst, so the flatten / indirect passes intentionally bail; swbig joins
// the same five suites as swdisp (Subst / ConstEnc / Opaque / Bogus / All).
// Every case mixes the five substitutable operators with distinct non-folding
// constants so --subst / --const-enc have material and the bodies stay a
// function of both arguments.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildSwitchBigIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "swbig", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  const int N = 64;
  llvm::BasicBlock *Cs[N];
  for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    Cs[i] = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "c", F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(N - 1)); // dense [0,63]
  auto *SW = B.CreateSwitch(Sel, Cs[N - 1], N - 1); // case 63 -> default
  for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; ++i)
    SW->addCase(B.getInt32(i), Cs[i]);

  llvm::Value *V[N];
  for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[i]);
    uint32_t K = 0x9E3779B9u * (uint32_t)(i + 1) + 0x7F4A7C15u;
    llvm::Value *x = b.CreateAdd(A, b.getInt32(K));
    switch (i % 5) {
    case 0:
      x = b.CreateAnd(x, C);
      break;
    case 1:
      x = b.CreateOr(x, C);
      break;
    case 2:
      x = b.CreateXor(x, C);
      break;
    case 3:
      x = b.CreateSub(x, C);
      break;
    default:
      x = b.CreateAdd(x, C);
      break;
    }
    x = b.CreateXor(x, b.getInt32(K ^ 0x55555555u));
    x = b.CreateSub(x, b.getInt32(0x01010101u * (uint32_t)(i + 1)));
    V[i] = x;
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, N, "r");
  for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    R->addIncoming(V[i], Cs[i]);
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateAdd(A, C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Function-pointer table dispatch: a const array of code pointers indexed at
// run time and called indirectly.  Exercises the rewrite backend's handling of
// absolute code-pointer relocations parked in read-only data — the table holds
// the in-image VAs of fp0..fp3 — plus an indexed indirect call.  No other
// patch-full sample puts a relocated code pointer in a data section.  The table
// is `const` so it lands in rodata (RODATA_VA) and is excluded from the
// data-section comparison: its entries legitimately differ between the original
// and obfuscated builds because obfuscation changes each function's code layout
// (and thus its VA).  A 2-way branch in fptab lets the flatten / indirect
// passes fire on it too.
//   static int fp0(int a,int b){ return (a + b) ^ (a & b); }
//   static int fp1(int a,int b){ return (a - b) | (a ^ b); }
//   static int fp2(int a,int b){ return (a & b) + (a | b); }
//   static int fp3(int a,int b){ return (a ^ b) - (a & b); }
//   static int (*const tab[4])(int,int) = { fp0, fp1, fp2, fp3 };
//   int fptab(int a,int b){
//     int r = tab[a & 3](a, b);
//     if ((a ^ b) & 1) r = (r + a) ^ b; else r = (r - b) | a;
//     return r;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFnPtrTableIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);

  // Four leaf functions, each a distinct substitutable expression.
  llvm::Function *Leaf[4];
  static const char *LN[4] = {"fp0", "fp1", "fp2", "fp3"};
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Leaf[i] = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage,
                                     LN[i], M.get());
    Leaf[i]->setDSOLocal(true);
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Leaf[i]);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
    auto *X = Leaf[i]->getArg(0), *Y = Leaf[i]->getArg(1);
    llvm::Value *R = nullptr;
    switch (i) {
    case 0:
      R = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(X, Y), B.CreateAnd(X, Y));
      break;
    case 1:
      R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(X, Y), B.CreateXor(X, Y));
      break;
    case 2:
      R = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(X, Y), B.CreateOr(X, Y));
      break;
    default:
      R = B.CreateSub(B.CreateXor(X, Y), B.CreateAnd(X, Y));
      break;
    }
    B.CreateRet(R);
  }

  // const tab[4] = { fp0, fp1, fp2, fp3 };  (function pointers -> rodata
  // relocs)
  auto *PtrTy = llvm::PointerType::get(Ctx, 0);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(PtrTy, 4);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init = {Leaf[0], Leaf[1], Leaf[2], Leaf[3]};
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/true, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init), "fp_tab");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fptab", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Idx = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  llvm::Value *GepIdx[] = {B.getInt32(0), Idx};
  auto *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, GepIdx);
  auto *Fn = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, EP);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateCall(FnTy, Fn, {A, Bb});
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(R1, A), Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(R1, Bb), A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int badisp(int a, int b) {            // GCC computed-goto
//   static const void *tab[4] = {&&L0,&&L1,&&L2,&&L3};
//   goto *tab[a & 3];
//   L0: return a + b;  L1: return a - b;  L2: return a ^ b;  L3: return a & b;
// }
// Unlike fptab (function pointers), the table holds *block* addresses: data
// relocations to .text labels that are NOT function symbols (Asm->isThumbFunc
// is false for them), so on Thumb (COFF ARM32) the interworking bit must be set
// by a different rule than the function-pointer case — this stresses that path.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBlockAddrTableIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "badisp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *L0 = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "L0", F);
  auto *L1 = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "L1", F);
  auto *L2 = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "L2", F);
  auto *L3 = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "L3", F);
  auto *End = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "end", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  auto *PtrTy = llvm::PointerType::get(Ctx, 0);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(PtrTy, 4);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init = {
      llvm::BlockAddress::get(F, L0), llvm::BlockAddress::get(F, L1),
      llvm::BlockAddress::get(F, L2), llvm::BlockAddress::get(F, L3)};
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/true, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init), "ba_tab");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Idx = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  llvm::Value *GepIdx[] = {B.getInt32(0), Idx};
  auto *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, GepIdx);
  auto *Target = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, EP);
  auto *IBr = B.CreateIndirectBr(Target, 4);
  IBr->addDestination(L0);
  IBr->addDestination(L1);
  IBr->addDestination(L2);
  IBr->addDestination(L3);

  B.SetInsertPoint(L0);
  auto *R0 = B.CreateAdd(A, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(End);
  B.SetInsertPoint(L1);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateSub(A, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(End);
  B.SetInsertPoint(L2);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(A, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(End);
  B.SetInsertPoint(L3);
  auto *R3 = B.CreateAnd(A, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(End);

  B.SetInsertPoint(End);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 4, "r");
  R->addIncoming(R0, L0);
  R->addIncoming(R1, L1);
  R->addIncoming(R2, L2);
  R->addIncoming(R3, L3);
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int g_buf[8]; int *g_dp = &g_buf[2];   // a *data* pointer in the data
// section int gptr(int a, int b) {
//   int s = *g_dp;
//   int r = ((a ^ b) & 1) ? (s + (a & b)) : (s - (a | b));
//   *g_dp = r ^ a;       // write back through the pointer (mutates data
//   section) return r;
// }
// Exercises an absolute *data* pointer relocation (the data section holds the
// VA of another data global) — distinct from fptab (data->code).  Doubles as a
// regression guard that the Thumb interworking fix sets bit 0 only on
// thumb-func code pointers, never on data pointers (which must stay even).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildGlobalPtrIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *PtrTy = llvm::PointerType::get(Ctx, 0);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 8);

  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> BufInit;
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    BufInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, (i + 1) * 11));
  auto *Buf = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, BufInit), "g_buf");
  Buf->setDSOLocal(true);
  // g_dp = &g_buf[2]  — an absolute data->data pointer relocation.
  auto *DpInit = llvm::ConstantExpr::getInBoundsGetElementPtr(
      ArrTy, Buf,
      llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::Constant *>{llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 0),
                                       llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 2)});
  auto *Dp = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, PtrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                      llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                      DpInit, "g_dp");
  Dp->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "gptr", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *P = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, Dp);
  auto *S = B.CreateLoad(I32, P);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateAnd(A, Bb));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateSub(S, B.CreateOr(A, Bb));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  auto *P2 = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, Dp);
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateXor(R, A), P2);
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// struct MpEnt { int (*fn)(int,int); int *dp; };
// static int mp_buf[4] = {11,22,33,44};
// static int mp_leaf(int x,int y){ return (x + y) ^ (x & y); }
// static const struct MpEnt mp_tab = { mp_leaf, &mp_buf[1] };
// int mixptr(int a, int b) {
//   int r = mp_tab.fn(a, b);          // data->code ptr: Thumb slot needs bit 0
//   int s = *mp_tab.dp;               // data->data ptr: must stay even
//   int out = ((a ^ b) & 1) ? (r + (a & b) + s) : (r - (a | b) - s);
//   *mp_tab.dp = out ^ a;             // mutate data section (compared by
//   Unicorn) return out;
// }
// A function pointer (data->code) AND a data pointer (data->data) live in ONE
// const struct in the same read-only data section — two adjacent absolute
// pointer relocations of different kinds.  This is the sharpest test that the
// Thumb interworking fix discriminates *per symbol*: the code-pointer slot must
// get bit 0 set (or the indirect call faults on Thumb COFF ARM32), while the
// data-pointer slot must stay even (or the load reads a misaligned address).
// Fuses fptab (data->code) and gptr (data->data) into a single relocation run.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMixedPtrTableIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *PtrTy = llvm::PointerType::get(Ctx, 0);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);

  // Mutable data global the data pointer aims into.
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 4);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> BufInit;
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    BufInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, (i + 1) * 11));
  auto *Buf = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, BufInit), "mp_buf");
  Buf->setDSOLocal(true);

  // Leaf function the code pointer aims at (substitutable body).
  auto *Leaf = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage,
                                      "mp_leaf", M.get());
  Leaf->setDSOLocal(true);
  {
    auto *LBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Leaf);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> LB(LBB);
    auto *X = Leaf->getArg(0), *Y = Leaf->getArg(1);
    LB.CreateRet(LB.CreateXor(LB.CreateAdd(X, Y), LB.CreateAnd(X, Y)));
  }

  // const struct MpEnt mp_tab = { mp_leaf, &mp_buf[1] };
  auto *StructTy = llvm::StructType::get(Ctx, {PtrTy, PtrTy});
  auto *DpInit = llvm::ConstantExpr::getInBoundsGetElementPtr(
      ArrTy, Buf,
      llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::Constant *>{llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 0),
                                       llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 1)});
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> TabFields = {Leaf, DpInit};
  auto *TabInit = llvm::ConstantStruct::get(StructTy, TabFields);
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, StructTy, /*isConstant=*/true,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       TabInit, "mp_tab");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "mixptr", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // r = mp_tab.fn(a, b)  — indirect call through the code pointer.
  auto *FnSlot = B.CreateStructGEP(StructTy, Tab, 0);
  auto *Fn = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, FnSlot);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateCall(FnTy, Fn, {A, Bb});
  // s = *mp_tab.dp  — dereference the data pointer.
  auto *DpSlot = B.CreateStructGEP(StructTy, Tab, 1);
  auto *Dp = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, DpSlot);
  auto *S = B.CreateLoad(I32, Dp);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(R1, B.CreateAnd(A, Bb)), S);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateSub(B.CreateSub(R1, B.CreateOr(A, Bb)), S);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  // Write back through the data pointer (mutates the compared data section).
  auto *DpSlot2 = B.CreateStructGEP(StructTy, Tab, 1);
  auto *Dp2 = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, DpSlot2);
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateXor(R, A), Dp2);
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// struct Rec { signed char b; short h; int w; long long q; };  //
// {i8,i16,i32,i64} static struct Rec g_recs[4] = { {1,100,1000,100000},
// {2,200,2000,200000},
//                                 {3,300,3000,300000}, {4,400,4000,400000} };
// int srec(int a, int b) {                  // array-of-structs, mixed-width
// RMW
//   int acc = 0;
//   for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
//     struct Rec *r = &g_recs[i];
//     int v = (int)r->b + (int)r->h + r->w + (int)r->q;   // i8/i16/i32/i64
//     loads int t = ((a ^ i) & 1) ? (v + a) ^ (b & i) : (v - b) | (a ^ i); r->w
//     = r->w ^ t;                       // i32 store-back (compared by emu)
//     r->b = (signed char)((int)r->b + i);   // i8 store-back
//     acc = acc + t;
//   }
//   return acc;
// }
// A code shape no other sample covers: an array of mixed-width-field structs
// indexed by a variable, with sub-word (i8/i16) and double-word (i64) loads AND
// store-backs into the *same* mutable data section (Unicorn compares it byte
// for byte).  Struct-field GEP and array-element GEP combine, so the backend
// must materialise base + i*sizeof(Rec) + field_offset; the mixed store widths
// (strb/strh/str, mov byte/word ptr) write back through the relocated global
// address.  Multi-block (an inner diamond inside a counted loop) so every pass
// fires; no switch/indirectbr so none bail — included in all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildStructArrayIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *RecTy = llvm::StructType::get(Ctx, {I8, I16, I32, I64});
  const unsigned N = 4;
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(RecTy, N);

  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Recs;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
    int k = static_cast<int>(i) + 1;
    Recs.push_back(llvm::ConstantStruct::get(
        RecTy,
        {llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, k), llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, k * 100),
         llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, k * 1000),
         llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, k * 100000)}));
  }
  auto *G = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Recs), "g_recs");
  G->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "srec", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Loop = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "loop", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Latch = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "latch", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Loop);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *AccPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "acc");
  llvm::Value *EIdx[] = {B.getInt32(0), IPhi};
  auto *Rp = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, G, EIdx);
  auto *Bp = B.CreateStructGEP(RecTy, Rp, 0);
  auto *Hp = B.CreateStructGEP(RecTy, Rp, 1);
  auto *Wp = B.CreateStructGEP(RecTy, Rp, 2);
  auto *Qp = B.CreateStructGEP(RecTy, Rp, 3);
  auto *Cb = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateLoad(I8, Bp), I32);
  auto *Ch = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateLoad(I16, Hp), I32);
  auto *Cw = B.CreateLoad(I32, Wp);
  auto *Cq = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLoad(I64, Qp), I32);
  auto *V = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Cb, Ch), B.CreateAdd(Cw, Cq));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, IPhi), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *TT = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(V, A), B.CreateAnd(Bb, IPhi));
  B.CreateBr(Latch);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *TE = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(V, Bb), B.CreateXor(A, IPhi));
  B.CreateBr(Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Latch);
  auto *T = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "t");
  T->addIncoming(TT, Then);
  T->addIncoming(TE, Else);
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateXor(Cw, T), Wp);                       // r->w ^= t
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(Cb, IPhi), I8), Bp); // r->b += i
  auto *NextAcc = B.CreateAdd(AccPhi, T);
  auto *NextI = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Cond = B.CreateICmpSLT(NextI, B.getInt32(N));
  B.CreateCondBr(Cond, Loop, Exit);
  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(NextI, Latch);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(NextAcc, Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(NextAcc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// static int g_z[8];                    // zero-initialized -> .bss / __common
// int bzrmw(int a, int b) {             // read-modify-write a .bss global
// array
//   int acc = 7;
//   for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
//     int prev = g_z[i];                          // load from .bss (init 0)
//     int t = ((prev + a) ^ (b & i)) | ((a - b) & i);
//     g_z[i] = ((i ^ a) & 1) ? (t ^ acc) : (t + (a | b));   // store to .bss
//     acc = acc + g_z[i];                         // reload from .bss
//   }
//   return acc;
// }
// Exercises a section type no other sample covers: a zero-initialized global
// (.bss / COFF .bss / MachO __common) has *no bytes in the object*
// (SHT_NOBITS), only a size.  The B2 rewrite backend must still give it a VA
// and resolve every relocation that references it; if it mishandled NOBITS
// sections the symbol would come back Unresolved or at the wrong VA and the
// emulation would fault or return the wrong value.  Multi-block (inner diamond
// inside a counted loop) so every pass fires; no switch/indirectbr so none bail
// — included in all suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBssRmwIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned N = 8;
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, N);
  // zeroinitializer -> lands in .bss (no bytes in the object, just a size).
  auto *G = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantAggregateZero::get(ArrTy), "g_z");
  G->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "bzrmw", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Loop = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "loop", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Latch = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "latch", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Loop);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *AccPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "acc");
  llvm::Value *EIdx[] = {B.getInt32(0), IPhi};
  auto *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, G, EIdx);
  auto *Prev = B.CreateLoad(I32, EP);
  auto *T = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(Prev, A), B.CreateAnd(Bb, IPhi)),
                       B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(A, Bb), IPhi));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(IPhi, A), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *VT = B.CreateXor(T, AccPhi);
  B.CreateBr(Latch);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *VE = B.CreateAdd(T, B.CreateOr(A, Bb));
  B.CreateBr(Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Latch);
  auto *NewV = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "nv");
  NewV->addIncoming(VT, Then);
  NewV->addIncoming(VE, Else);
  B.CreateStore(NewV, EP);              // g_z[i] = ...
  auto *Reload = B.CreateLoad(I32, EP); // acc += g_z[i]
  auto *NextAcc = B.CreateAdd(AccPhi, Reload);
  auto *NextI = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Cond = B.CreateICmpSLT(NextI, B.getInt32(N));
  B.CreateCondBr(Cond, Loop, Exit);
  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(NextI, Latch);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(7), Entry);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(NextAcc, Latch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(NextAcc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int wide128(int a, int b) {           // 128-bit operators (2-word on 64-bit
//   unsigned __int128 la = ((u128)(unsigned)a << 64) | (unsigned)b;  // ISAs,
//   unsigned __int128 lb = ((u128)(unsigned)b << 64) | (unsigned)a;  // 4-word
//   unsigned __int128 s = (la + lb) ^ (la & lb);            // on 32-bit ISAs)
//   unsigned __int128 d = (la - lb) & (la ^ lb);
//   unsigned __int128 r = ((a ^ b) & 1) ? (s | d) : ((s ^ d) + lb);
//   unsigned long long hi = (u64)(r >> 64), lo = (u64)r;
//   return (int)(hi ^ lo ^ (hi >> 32) ^ (lo >> 32)) + 0x5A5A;
// }
// The substitution pass claims every integer width via isIntOrIntVectorTy, but
// the widest sample so far is i64 (warith).  i128 splits into 2 words on 64-bit
// ISAs and 4 words on 32-bit ISAs, so the MBA carry/borrow forms (a&b)<<1 /
// (~a&b)<<1 become multi-word shift+carry chains — a far heavier exercise of
// both the pass (does the identity hold at 128 bits?) and the backend's
// wide-int lowering (no libcalls: add/sub/and/or/xor/shl/lshr by constants are
// all inline).  Multi-block (a diamond) so every pass fires; folds to i32 so
// the emulator's 32-bit return capture observes the full 128-bit result.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWide128IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I128 = llvm::IntegerType::get(Ctx, 128);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wide128", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Az = B.CreateZExt(A, I128);
  auto *Bz = B.CreateZExt(Bb, I128);
  auto *C64 = llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, 64);
  auto *La = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(Az, C64), Bz);
  auto *Lb = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(Bz, C64), Az);
  auto *S = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(La, Lb), B.CreateAnd(La, Lb));
  auto *D = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(La, Lb), B.CreateXor(La, Lb));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateOr(S, D);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(S, D), Lb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I128, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  auto *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(R, C64), I64);
  auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(R, I64);
  auto *C32 = llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32);
  auto *F1 = B.CreateXor(Hi, Lo);
  auto *F2 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(Hi, C32), B.CreateLShr(Lo, C32));
  auto *Fold = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(F1, F2), I32);
  auto *Res = B.CreateAdd(Fold, B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vbyte(int a, int b) {             // <16 x i8> byte-lane vector MBA
//   <16 x i8> va = splat((i8)a) + <0,1,..,15>;   // lanes differ
//   <16 x i8> vb = splat((i8)b) ^ <0,1,..,15>;
//   <16 x i8> r  = ((va + vb) ^ (va & vb)) | ((va - vb) & (va ^ vb));
//   i8 acc = r[0] + r[1] + ... + r[15];
//   return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? (int)(signed char)acc + a : (int)(signed char)acc ^
//   b;
// }
// vred covers <4 x i32>; this covers <16 x i8>.  The element width matters: the
// MBA carry form turns `va + vb` into `(va^vb) + ((va&vb)<<1)`, and x86/SSE has
// *no* 8-bit vector shift instruction — so `<16 x i8> << 1` forces LLVM down a
// non-trivial lowering (shift as i16 + mask, or add-to-self) that no other
// sample exercises.  Multi-block (a diamond on the reduced scalar) so every
// pass fires.  Reduces to i32 so the emulator's return capture observes all 16
// lanes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecByteIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned W = 16;
  auto *V16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, W);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vbyte", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 16> IotaElems;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < W; ++i)
    IotaElems.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, i));
  auto *Iota = llvm::ConstantVector::get(IotaElems);
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8);
  auto *Bb8 = B.CreateTrunc(Bb, I8);
  auto *VA = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Ab), Iota);
  auto *VB = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Bb8), Iota);
  auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
  auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
  auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
  auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < W; ++i)
    Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *AccI = B.CreateSExt(Acc, I32);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(AccI, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(AccI, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vhalf(int a, int b) {            // <8 x i16> halfword-lane vector MBA
//   <8 x i16> va = splat((i16)a) + <0,1,..,7>;
//   <8 x i16> vb = splat((i16)b) ^ <0,1,..,7>;
//   <8 x i16> r  = ((va + vb) ^ (va & vb)) | ((va - vb) & (va ^ vb));
//   i16 acc = r[0] + ... + r[7];
//   return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? (int)(short)acc + a : (int)(short)acc ^ b;
// }
// Completes the integer vector-width sweep (i8 vbyte / i32 vred / i64 vquad).
// <8 x i16> has a native halfword shift (x86 psllw, NEON vshl.i16) so the MBA
// carry `(va&vb)<<1` lowers cleanly — the value is confirming the rewrite
// backend's mergeable-constant handling (.rodata.cst16 / COFF COMDAT .rdata)
// generalizes across element widths, not just the i8 no-shift quirk.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecHalfIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned W = 8;
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vhalf", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> IotaElems;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < W; ++i)
    IotaElems.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, i));
  auto *Iota = llvm::ConstantVector::get(IotaElems);
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16);
  auto *Bb16 = B.CreateTrunc(Bb, I16);
  auto *VA = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Ab), Iota);
  auto *VB = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Bb16), Iota);
  auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
  auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
  auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
  auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < W; ++i)
    Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *AccI = B.CreateSExt(Acc, I32);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(AccI, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(AccI, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vquad(int a, int b) {            // <2 x i64> quadword-lane vector MBA
//   <2 x i64> va = splat((i64)(int)a) + <0,1>;
//   <2 x i64> vb = splat((i64)(int)b) ^ <0,1>;
//   <2 x i64> r  = ((va + vb) ^ (va & vb)) | ((va - vb) & (va ^ vb));
//   i64 acc = r[0] + r[1];
//   i32 fold = (i32)acc ^ (i32)(acc >> 32);
//   return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? fold + a : fold ^ b;
// }
// Completes the width sweep with the widest lane (i64). On 32-bit targets
// (i386/ARM32) each 64-bit lane splits into multiple 32-bit ops and the MBA
// carry `(va&vb)<<1` becomes a multi-word vector shift — stressing wide-lane
// vector lowering and its constant pool across all 12 combos. Both lanes fold
// back to i32 so the emulator's return captures the full 128-bit result.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecQuadIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned W = 2;
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vquad", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 2> IotaElems;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < W; ++i)
    IotaElems.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, i));
  auto *Iota = llvm::ConstantVector::get(IotaElems);
  auto *Aw = B.CreateSExt(A, I64);
  auto *Bw = B.CreateSExt(Bb, I64);
  auto *VA = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Aw), Iota);
  auto *VB = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Bw), Iota);
  auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
  auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
  auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
  auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(0));
  Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(1)));
  auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(Acc, I32);
  auto *Hi =
      B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Acc, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)), I32);
  auto *AccI = B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(AccI, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(AccI, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vw8(int a, int b) {                 // first vector wider than 128-bit
//   for k in 0..3:  Rk = MBA(splat(a)+Kk, splat(b)^Kk);   // <8 x i32> per
//   chain <8 x i32> r = (R0 ^ R1) + (R2 - R3); int acc = sum of all 8 i32 lanes
//   of r; return ((a^b)&1) ? acc + a : acc ^ b;
// }
// Two purposes in one sample:
//  (1) First >128-bit vector coverage. vred/vbyte/vhalf/vquad/vmix are all
//      exactly 128-bit; <8 x i32> is 256-bit and forces vector-type
//      legalization to split into 2x <4 x i32> + a 32-byte constant pool.
//  (2) Regression guard for the all-ones-constant-pool (FT_Fill) miscompile.
//      The four parallel MBA chains keep many <8 x i32> values live at once;
//      on i386 (8 XMM regs, each <8 x i32> needs 2) this spills heavily, and
//      the substitution pass's De Morgan `~x` (= `xor x, all-ones`) forces the
//      all-ones <8 x i32> mask into the constant pool (instead of
//      rematerializing it with `pcmpeqd`, as x86-64/AArch64/ARM32 do). LLVM
//      emits that all-ones pool entry via emitFill (isRepeatedByteSequence ->
//      MCFillFragment), which the rewrite image writer previously zero-filled —
//      turning `pxor x,[pool]` into a no-op (x ^ 0) and silently miscompiling.
//      orig (no all-ones pool entry) stayed correct, so the orig-vs-subst diff
//      catches the subst-only divergence. Only the i386 Subst/All combos
//      exercise the bug; the other ISAs/transforms ride along as ordinary
//      >128-bit coverage.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWideIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned W = 8;
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vw8",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Four well-spread 256-bit constant vectors (SHA-256 / SHA-512 init words):
  // full-width per-lane values make the MBA carry/borrow `<<1` chains propagate
  // across bit 31, and four parallel chains push i386 past its 8 XMM registers.
  static const uint32_t Ks[4][W] = {
      {0x9E3779B9u, 0xBB67AE85u, 0x3C6EF372u, 0xA54FF53Au, 0x510E527Fu,
       0x9B05688Cu, 0x1F83D9ABu, 0x5BE0CD19u},
      {0xCBBB9D5Du, 0x629A292Au, 0x9159015Au, 0x152FECD8u, 0x67332667u,
       0x8EB44A87u, 0xDB0C2E0Du, 0x47B5481Du},
      {0x428A2F98u, 0x71374491u, 0xB5C0FBCFu, 0xE9B5DBA5u, 0x3956C25Bu,
       0x59F111F1u, 0x923F82A4u, 0xAB1C5ED5u},
      {0xD807AA98u, 0x12835B01u, 0x243185BEu, 0x550C7DC3u, 0x72BE5D74u,
       0x80DEB1FEu, 0x9BDC06A7u, 0xC19BF174u}};
  auto chain = [&](unsigned K) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *KV =
        llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint32_t>(Ks[K], W));
    auto *VA = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, A), KV);
    auto *VB = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Bb), KV);
    auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
    auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
    auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
    auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
    return B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  };
  auto *R0 = chain(0), *R1 = chain(1), *R2 = chain(2), *R3 = chain(3);
  auto *R = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(R0, R1), B.CreateSub(R2, R3));
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < W; ++i)
    Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Acc, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Acc, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vw512(int a, int b) {               // widest vector in the suite:
// 512-bit
//   for k in 0..3:  Rk = MBA(splat(a)+Kk, splat(b)^Kk);   // <16 x i32> per
//   chain <16 x i32> r = (R0 ^ R1) + (R2 - R3); int acc = sum of all 16 i32
//   lanes of r; return ((a^b)&1) ? acc + a : acc ^ b;
// }
// The widest vector anywhere in this suite: vw8 is 256-bit (<8 x i32>) and
// vw256b is 256-bit (<32 x i8>); <16 x i32> is 512-bit, so on EVERY target here
// (no 512-bit register file — x86/i386 SSE2, AArch64/ARM32 NEON are all
// 128-bit) vector-type legalization must split it FOUR ways into 4x <4 x i32>,
// with a 64-byte constant pool per K vector.  Four parallel MBA chains keep
// many <16 x i32> values live at once (each occupies 4 vector registers), which
// maximises register pressure and read-only constant-pool traffic — the
// heaviest stress yet on the rewrite backend's per-name read-only data layout.
// This is the 2x-wider continuation of the vw8 lineage that exposed the
// all-ones-constant-pool FT_Fill zero-fill miscompile: the substitution pass's
// De Morgan `~x` (= `xor x, all-ones`) forces an all-ones <16 x i32> mask into
// the constant pool under the heavy spilling, so the orig-vs-subst diff guards
// that the writer materialises non-zero fills correctly at this width too.
// Pure integer vector arithmetic — zero libcall on all 4 ISAs.  Substitutable
// add/sub/and/or/xor make --subst rewrite the .text and a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes (--opaque/--bogus/--flatten/
// --indirect) real structure to transform.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWide512IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned W = 16;
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vw512", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Four 512-bit constant vectors (the 64 SHA-256 round constants, arranged
  // 4x16): full-width per-lane values make the MBA carry/borrow `<<1` chains
  // propagate across bit 31, and four parallel <16 x i32> chains push every ISA
  // far past its vector register file.
  static const uint32_t Ks[4][W] = {
      {0x428A2F98u, 0x71374491u, 0xB5C0FBCFu, 0xE9B5DBA5u, 0x3956C25Bu,
       0x59F111F1u, 0x923F82A4u, 0xAB1C5ED5u, 0xD807AA98u, 0x12835B01u,
       0x243185BEu, 0x550C7DC3u, 0x72BE5D74u, 0x80DEB1FEu, 0x9BDC06A7u,
       0xC19BF174u},
      {0xE49B69C1u, 0xEFBE4786u, 0x0FC19DC6u, 0x240CA1CCu, 0x2DE92C6Fu,
       0x4A7484AAu, 0x5CB0A9DCu, 0x76F988DAu, 0x983E5152u, 0xA831C66Du,
       0xB00327C8u, 0xBF597FC7u, 0xC6E00BF3u, 0xD5A79147u, 0x06CA6351u,
       0x14292967u},
      {0x27B70A85u, 0x2E1B2138u, 0x4D2C6DFCu, 0x53380D13u, 0x650A7354u,
       0x766A0ABBu, 0x81C2C92Eu, 0x92722C85u, 0xA2BFE8A1u, 0xA81A664Bu,
       0xC24B8B70u, 0xC76C51A3u, 0xD192E819u, 0xD6990624u, 0xF40E3585u,
       0x106AA070u},
      {0x19A4C116u, 0x1E376C08u, 0x2748774Cu, 0x34B0BCB5u, 0x391C0CB3u,
       0x4ED8AA4Au, 0x5B9CCA4Fu, 0x682E6FF3u, 0x748F82EEu, 0x78A5636Fu,
       0x84C87814u, 0x8CC70208u, 0x90BEFFFAu, 0xA4506CEBu, 0xBEF9A3F7u,
       0xC67178F2u}};
  auto chain = [&](unsigned K) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *KV =
        llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint32_t>(Ks[K], W));
    auto *VA = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, A), KV);
    auto *VB = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(W, Bb), KV);
    auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
    auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
    auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
    auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
    return B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  };
  auto *R0 = chain(0), *R1 = chain(1), *R2 = chain(2), *R3 = chain(3);
  auto *R = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(R0, R1), B.CreateSub(R2, R3));
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < W; ++i)
    Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Acc, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Acc, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res2 = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res2->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res2->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res2);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vmix(int a, int b) {             // two vector widths in one function
//   <16 x i8> r8  = MBA(splat((i8)a)+iota8,  splat((i8)b)^iota8);
//   <4 x i32> r32 = MBA(splat(a)+iota32,     splat(b)^iota32);
//   return ((a^b)&1) ? (sext acc8 + acc32) + a : (sext acc8 + acc32) ^ b;
// }
// Stresses the COFF same-name COMDAT packing beyond vbyte's N=2: the i8 path
// emits iota8 + a byte-shift mask, the i32 path emits iota32 — three DISTINCT
// 16-byte mergeable constants. ELF/Mach-O merge them into one .rodata.cst16 /
// __literal16, but COFF parks each in its own COMDAT ".rdata" (N=3 same-named
// sections), exercising sectionImageVA's contiguous packing + the writer's
// N-way merge across all 12 combos.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMixIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vmix",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto mba = [&](llvm::Value *VA, llvm::Value *VB) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *Sum = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
    auto *An = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
    auto *Dif = B.CreateSub(VA, VB);
    auto *Xr = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
    return B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(Sum, An), B.CreateAnd(Dif, Xr));
  };

  // <16 x i8> path: iota8 + byte-shift mask constants.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 16> Iota8E;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    Iota8E.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, i));
  auto *Iota8 = llvm::ConstantVector::get(Iota8E);
  auto *VA8 = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(16, B.CreateTrunc(A, I8)), Iota8);
  auto *VB8 =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(16, B.CreateTrunc(Bb, I8)), Iota8);
  auto *R8 = mba(VA8, VB8);
  llvm::Value *Acc8 = B.CreateExtractElement(R8, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < 16; ++i)
    Acc8 = B.CreateAdd(Acc8, B.CreateExtractElement(R8, B.getInt32(i)));

  // <4 x i32> path: iota32 constant.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Iota32E;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Iota32E.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, i * 7 + 1));
  auto *Iota32 = llvm::ConstantVector::get(Iota32E);
  auto *VA32 = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateVectorSplat(4, A), Iota32);
  auto *VB32 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(4, Bb), Iota32);
  auto *R32 = mba(VA32, VB32);
  llvm::Value *Acc32 = B.CreateExtractElement(R32, B.getInt32(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
    Acc32 = B.CreateAdd(Acc32, B.CreateExtractElement(R32, B.getInt32(i)));

  auto *V = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateSExt(Acc8, I32), Acc32);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(V, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(V, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int frot(int a, int b) {             // narrow (i8/i16) funnel shifts + MBA
//   i8  x = fshl.i8 (a, a, b&7);   i8  y = fshr.i8 (b, b, a&7);   // rotates
//   i16 z = fshl.i16(a, b, 5);     i16 w = fshr.i16(b, a, a&15);  // true
//   funnels int r = ((sx ^ sy) + (sz & a)) | ((sw - sx) ^ (a + b)); return
//   ((a^b)&1) ? r + a : r ^ b;
// }
// Targets compileForRewrite's expandNarrowFunnelShifts module mutation, which
// rewrites @llvm.fshl.iN / @llvm.fshr.iN for N<32 into explicit i32
// shift-mask-or sequences (and widens i8/i16 returns). No other patch-full
// sample emits funnel-shift intrinsics, so this is the only coverage of that
// rewrite-path mutation; the surrounding MBA ops drive the substitution pass.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFunnelIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
