  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "frot",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Fshl8 = llvm::Intrinsic::getOrInsertDeclaration(
      M.get(), llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {I8});
  auto *Fshr8 = llvm::Intrinsic::getOrInsertDeclaration(
      M.get(), llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {I8});
  auto *Fshl16 = llvm::Intrinsic::getOrInsertDeclaration(
      M.get(), llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {I16});
  auto *Fshr16 = llvm::Intrinsic::getOrInsertDeclaration(
      M.get(), llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {I16});

  auto *A8 = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *B8 = B.CreateTrunc(Bb, I8);
  auto *A16 = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *B16 = B.CreateTrunc(Bb, I16);
  auto *Amt8a = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAnd(Bb, B.getInt32(7)), I8);
  auto *Amt8b = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7)), I8);
  auto *Amt16 = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(15)), I16);
  auto *X = B.CreateCall(Fshl8, {A8, A8, Amt8a}); // i8 rotate-left
  auto *Y = B.CreateCall(Fshr8, {B8, B8, Amt8b}); // i8 rotate-right
  auto *Z = B.CreateCall(Fshl16, {A16, B16, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, 5)});
  auto *Wv = B.CreateCall(Fshr16, {B16, A16, Amt16});
  auto *Xs = B.CreateSExt(X, I32), *Ys = B.CreateSExt(Y, I32);
  auto *Zs = B.CreateSExt(Z, I32), *Ws = B.CreateSExt(Wv, I32);
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(Xs, Ys), B.CreateAnd(Zs, A)),
                       B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(Ws, Xs), B.CreateAdd(A, Bb)));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(R, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(R, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// static int g_init[6] = {3,5,7,11,13,17};   // initialized -> .data / __data
// static int g_zero[6];                       // zeroinit    -> .bss  /
// __common int dbmix(int a, int b) {
//   int acc = 0;
//   for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
//     int v = g_init[i];
//     int t = ((v + a) ^ (b & i)) | ((a - b) & i);
//     g_zero[i] = ((i ^ a) & 1) ? (t ^ acc) : (t + v);   // write .bss
//     g_init[i] = v ^ (t & 0xff);                        // write .data
//     acc = acc + g_zero[i] + g_init[i];
//   }
//   return acc;
// }
// Two *writable* sections in one function: an initialized .data global and a
// zero-init .bss/__common global, both read and written. Every prior writable
// sample (daccum/gptr/srec = .data only; bzrmw = .bss only) touched a single
// writable section; dbmix is the first to need both at DISTINCT VAs at once —
// the writable-section analogue of the read-only multi-section coverage. The
// real patch path lays distinct section names at distinct VAs, and so must the
// test harness (its getSectionVA now assigns each writable name its own slot).
// The return value sums both globals' final state, so a misplaced section VA
// (overlap) is caught even though .bss is NOBITS and not byte-compared.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildDataBssIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned N = 6;
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, N);
  const int Seed[N] = {3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17};
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    Init.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, Seed[i]));
  auto *GInit = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init), "g_init");
  GInit->setDSOLocal(true);
  auto *GZero = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantAggregateZero::get(ArrTy), "g_zero");
  GZero->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "dbmix", M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Loop = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "loop", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Cont = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "cont", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Loop);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *AccPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "acc");
  llvm::Value *Idx[] = {B.getInt32(0), IPhi};
  auto *EPi = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, GInit, Idx);
  auto *V = B.CreateLoad(I32, EPi);
  auto *T = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(V, A), B.CreateAnd(Bb, IPhi)),
                       B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(A, Bb), IPhi));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(IPhi, A), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *ZT = B.CreateXor(T, AccPhi);
  B.CreateBr(Cont);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *ZE = B.CreateAdd(T, V);
  B.CreateBr(Cont);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Cont);
  auto *ZPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "z");
  ZPhi->addIncoming(ZT, Then);
  ZPhi->addIncoming(ZE, Else);
  auto *EPz = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, GZero, Idx);
  B.CreateStore(ZPhi, EPz);
  auto *NewInit = B.CreateXor(V, B.CreateAnd(T, B.getInt32(0xff)));
  B.CreateStore(NewInit, EPi);
  auto *NextAcc = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(AccPhi, ZPhi), NewInit);
  auto *NextI = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(NextI, B.getInt32(N)), Loop, Exit);
  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(NextI, Cont);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(NextAcc, Cont);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(NextAcc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Multi-section relocation stress: one function simultaneously references a
// data-dependently indexed read-only const int table (.rodata / __const /
// .rdata), an initialized int array (.data / __data), AND a zero-init int array
// (.bss / __common / __bss) — forcing codegen to emit text + rodata + data +
// bss and the rewrite backend's compileImageForPatch multi-section convergence
// loop (BinaryRewriter.cpp) to lay out THREE distinct non-text sections, each
// the target of cross-section fixups from .text (AArch64 ADRP+ADD per section,
// x86 RIP-relative, ARM32 PC-relative literal pool).  The const-table index is
// data-dependent so the load cannot fold (a genuine text->rodata load); the
// .data array is read AND written (its bytes are byte-compared) and the .bss
// array is read AND written (it feeds the return value).  This is the dual of
// `dbmix` (data+bss) with a third, read-only section added — the heaviest
// single-function multi-section layout in the suite.  The add/sub/and/or/xor
// mix + integer constants drive --subst / --const-enc and the data-dependent
// diamond + loop give the control-flow passes (opaque / bogus / flatten /
// indirect) real structure.  No obfuscation pass perturbs the section layout,
// so the original and obfuscated copies must agree byte-for-byte on the .data
// section and bit-for-bit on the return value across every input — any
// divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend (multi-section layout / cross-section
// relocation) or fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMultiSecIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned N = 8;
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, N);

  // Read-only const table -> .rodata / __const / .rdata.
  const int RoSeed[N] = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19};
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> RoInit;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    RoInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, RoSeed[i]));
  auto *GRo = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/true, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, RoInit), "g_ms_ro");
  GRo->setDSOLocal(true);

  // Initialized array -> .data / __data.
  const int DataSeed[N] = {3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23};
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> DInit;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    DInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, DataSeed[i]));
  auto *GData = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, DInit), "g_ms_data");
  GData->setDSOLocal(true);

  // Zero-init array -> .bss / __common / __bss.
  auto *GBss = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantAggregateZero::get(ArrTy), "g_ms_bss");
  GBss->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "msec",
                                   M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Loop = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "loop", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Cont = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "cont", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Loop);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *AccPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "acc");

  // Data-dependent index into the read-only table: idx = (a ^ i) & 7.
  auto *RoIdx = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, IPhi), B.getInt32(N - 1));
  llvm::Value *RoGep[] = {B.getInt32(0), RoIdx};
  auto *RoEP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, GRo, RoGep);
  auto *RoV = B.CreateLoad(I32, RoEP);

  // .data linear read.
  llvm::Value *Idx[] = {B.getInt32(0), IPhi};
  auto *DataEP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, GData, Idx);
  auto *DV = B.CreateLoad(I32, DataEP);

  // Substitutable integer mix over both loaded values.
  auto *T = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(DV, A), B.CreateAnd(Bb, RoV)),
                       B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(A, Bb), IPhi));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(IPhi, A), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *ZT = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(T, AccPhi), RoV);
  B.CreateBr(Cont);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *ZE = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(T, DV), RoV);
  B.CreateBr(Cont);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Cont);
  auto *ZPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "z");
  ZPhi->addIncoming(ZT, Then);
  ZPhi->addIncoming(ZE, Else);

  // Write .bss[i] = z; .data[i] ^= (T & 0xff) + RoV.
  auto *BssEP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, GBss, Idx);
  B.CreateStore(ZPhi, BssEP);
  auto *NewData =
      B.CreateXor(DV, B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(T, B.getInt32(0xff)), RoV));
  B.CreateStore(NewData, DataEP);

  auto *NextAcc =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(AccPhi, ZPhi), B.CreateAdd(NewData, RoV));
  auto *NextI = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(NextI, B.getInt32(N)), Loop, Exit);
  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(NextI, Cont);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  AccPhi->addIncoming(NextAcc, Cont);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(NextAcc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int recur(int n) {                 // bounded direct self-recursion (n=depth)
//   if (n == 0) return 7;
//   int prev = recur(n - 1);
//   return ((prev + n) ^ (prev & n)) | (n - 1);   // substitutable operators
// }
// The recursive call relocates against the function's OWN symbol — distinct
// from ccaller's caller->callee cross-function call.  Exercises the rewrite
// backend resolving a self-referential call across all 12 combos, and every
// obfuscation pass preserving a recursive CFG (flatten reg2mem / opaque+bogus
// block splits / indirect branch rewrite all wrapping a self-call).  Depth is
// bounded (kRecDepths, <=12) so the emulator's 64 KiB stack and 5s budget
// comfortably hold every frame even with all passes stacked.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildRecursiveIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "recur", M.get());
  F->setDSOLocal(true); // resolve the self-call as a direct PC-relative call
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *BaseBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "base", F);
  auto *RecBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "rec", F);
  auto *N = F->getArg(0);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpEQ(N, B.getInt32(0)), BaseBB, RecBB);

  B.SetInsertPoint(BaseBB);
  B.CreateRet(B.getInt32(7));

  B.SetInsertPoint(RecBB);
  auto *Sub = B.CreateSub(N, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Prev = B.CreateCall(FnTy, F, {Sub});
  auto *T1 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(Prev, N), B.CreateAnd(Prev, N));
  auto *R = B.CreateOr(T1, Sub);
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Floating-point scalar arithmetic — the patch-full grid had ZERO FP coverage
// before this (every prior sample is integer or integer-vector).  Exercises the
// full scalar `double` codegen path end to end: sitofp, fadd/fsub/fmul, an
// fcmp-driven branch with a PHI merge, FP-constant materialization, and fptosi.
// The 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.2 constants are NOT encodable as an AArch64 `fmov` (or ARM
// `vmov.f64`) immediate, so they force a literal-pool / .rodata|__const|
// .literal8 load — stressing the rewrite backend's read-only-constant placement
// + relocation (RIP-relative movsd on x86, ADRP+LDR on AArch64, PC-relative
// vldr on ARM) for every container.  The harness only seeds GP argument
// registers and reads the GP return register, so the contract stays integer-in
// / integer-out.
//
// Every FP op here lowers to a hardware instruction on all four ISAs —
// crucially the result is converted back with fptosi to *i32* (vcvt.s32.f64 on
// ARM VFP), NOT i64: ARM32 VFP has no double->i64 instruction, so fptosi-to-i64
// would lower to an __aeabi_d2lz / __dtoi64 libcall the emulation harness can
// neither resolve (no symbol VA) nor execute (the libcall body is not in the
// image).  The hi/lo arms scale |q| below 2^31 so the i32 conversion never
// overflows and is deterministic across both copies.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor with integer constants are mixed in so the
// operator-rewriting (--subst) and constant- encryption (--const-enc) passes
// both fire and visibly change .text; the fcmp branch + PHI give the
// control-flow passes (--flatten/--bogus/--indirect/
// --opaque) real structure to transform.  No pass touches FP / FCmp /
// ConstantFP, so the FP sub-graph is identical in both copies — any divergence
// is a genuine rewrite-backend bug.
//
//   int ffp(int a, int b) {
//     double x = (double)a, y = (double)b;
//     double s = x * 1.5 + y * 0.1;
//     double q = (s > 1000.0) ? (x - y) * 0.3 + 2.75
//                             : (x + y) * 0.2 - 3.25;
//     int i = (int)q;                 // |q| < 2^31 -> no fptosi overflow
//     int t = ((a + b) ^ (a - b)) ^ 0x5A5A;
//     int u = (a & b) | (t + 12345);
//     return i + u;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatArithIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "ffp",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Hi = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "hi", F);
  auto *Lo = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "lo", F);
  auto *Join = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "join", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *X = B.CreateSIToFP(A, Dbl);
  auto *Y = B.CreateSIToFP(C, Dbl);
  auto *S = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(X, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 1.5)),
                         B.CreateFMul(Y, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 0.1)));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateFCmpOGT(S, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 1000.0)), Hi,
                 Lo);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Hi);
  auto *Qh = B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateFSub(X, Y), llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 0.3)),
      llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 2.75));
  B.CreateBr(Join);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Lo);
  auto *Ql = B.CreateFSub(
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateFAdd(X, Y), llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 0.2)),
      llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 3.25));
  B.CreateBr(Join);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Join);
  auto *Q = B.CreatePHI(Dbl, 2);
  Q->addIncoming(Qh, Hi);
  Q->addIncoming(Ql, Lo);
  // fptosi to i32 (not i64): ARM32 VFP has vcvt.s32.f64 in hardware but no
  // double->i64 instruction, which would become an __aeabi_d2lz / __dtoi64
  // libcall the harness cannot resolve or execute.  |q| < 2^31 (scaled in the
  // hi/lo arms) so the conversion never overflows and stays deterministic.
  auto *II = B.CreateFPToSI(Q, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(II, U));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Half-precision (_Float16) scalar arithmetic — the first *cross-ISA Unicorn
// equivalence* coverage of the `half` type (the only prior fp16 coverage is the
// Apple-host-only e2e kHostF16Program; every integer/float Unicorn shape uses
// f32/f64, never `half`).  int -> half via sitofp, half add/sub/mul/div + a
// half fcmp+select, then fptosi half -> i32, mixed with integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) so --subst /
// --const-enc fire, and a data-dependent diamond + PHI so the control-flow
// passes (opaque/bogus/flatten/indirect) fire.  `half` lowers to a *distinct*
// per-ISA path with ZERO libcall: x86/x64/i386 promote through float via the
// F16C VCVTPH2PS/VCVTPS2PH conversions (detectTargetFeaturesX86 adds +avx,+f16c
// when a module uses half; the default Unicorn x86 CPU is Haswell, which has
// F16C), ARM32 promotes through float via the +fp16 conversion instructions
// VCVTB.F16 (detectTargetFeaturesARM adds +fp16; the Unicorn "max" CPU has
// MVFR1.FPHP=2, the fp16 conversion extension), and AArch64 uses native fp16
// arithmetic (fadd h, from the existing +fullfp16; the Unicorn "max" CPU has
// FEAT_FP16).  No obfuscation pass touches the half sub-graph, so it is
// byte-identical in both copies and any Unicorn divergence is a real backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Inputs are masked to [0,31] (half holds integers exactly
// up to 2048) with a divisor forced >= 1, so every intermediate stays in range
// and the fptosi is deterministic.
//
//   int fhalf(int a, int b) {
//     _Float16 ha = (_Float16)(a & 31), hb = (_Float16)((b & 31) | 1);
//     _Float16 s = ha + hb, d = ha - hb, m = ha * hb, q = ha / hb;
//     _Float16 c = (ha > hb) ? (_Float16)3.0 : (_Float16)1.0;
//     int ii = (int)(s + d + m + q + c);
//     int t = ((a + b) ^ (a - b)) ^ 0x5A5A;
//     int u = (a & b) | (t + 12345);
//     int base = ii + u;
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;   // diamond -> CF passes
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatHalfIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Hf = llvm::Type::getHalfTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fhalf", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(31));
  auto *Cm = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(31)), B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Ha = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, Hf);
  auto *Hb = B.CreateSIToFP(Cm, Hf);
  auto *S = B.CreateFAdd(Ha, Hb);
  auto *D = B.CreateFSub(Ha, Hb);
  auto *Mul = B.CreateFMul(Ha, Hb);
  auto *Q = B.CreateFDiv(Ha, Hb);
  auto *Sel =
      B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOGT(Ha, Hb), llvm::ConstantFP::get(Hf, 3.0),
                     llvm::ConstantFP::get(Hf, 1.0));
  auto *Sum =
      B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFAdd(S, D), B.CreateFAdd(Mul, Q)), Sel);
  auto *II = B.CreateFPToSI(Sum, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(II, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector half-precision (_Float16) — the *vector* dual of scalar fhalf and the
// half-lane sibling of fvec (<4 x float>) / vn64 (<8 x i8>).  Covers BOTH the
// 64-bit D-register <4 x half> and the 128-bit Q-register <8 x half>, each
// lowering to a *distinct* per-ISA path with ZERO libcall: AArch64 native fp16
// vector arithmetic (fadd.4h/.8h, from +fullfp16; harness runs UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX
// for FEAT_FP16), ARM32 promotes the half lanes to <N x float> via the +fp16
// NEON conversion VCVT.F32.F16 then does float SIMD, and x86/x64/i386 promote
// via the F16C VCVTPH2PS/VCVTPS2PH conversions (detectTargetFeaturesX86 adds
// +avx,+f16c when a module uses half; the fork-Unicorn i386 target now decodes
// F16C).  Every half value is a small integer (exact in half up to 2048) and
// the constants are small integers too, so fmul/fadd/fsub are exact and the
// vector fptosi half->i32 is deterministic and in range — orig and obfuscated
// copies are byte-identical over the FP sub-graph (no pass touches it), so any
// Unicorn divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Both vectors are
// reduced to a scalar (lane sum) for the harness's integer return, mixed with
// integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) so --subst
// / --const-enc fire, and a data-dependent diamond + PHI gives the control-flow
// passes real structure.
//
//   int vfhalf(int a, int b) {
//     half8 va, vb;                                  // va[i]=(a&3)+i,
//     vb[i]=(b&3)+(i&3) half8 q8 = va * {1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2} + vb -
//     {3,1,4,1,5,2,6,1}; int   s8 = sum((int8)q8);                      //
//     exact small ints half4 wa = {(a&3)+0..3}, wb = {(b&3)+0..3}; half4 q4 =
//     (wa + wb) * {2,1,2,1}; int   s4 = sum((int4)q4); int   t  = ((a + b) ^ (a
//     - b)) ^ 0x5A5A; int   u  = (a & b) | (t + 12345); int   base = s8 + s4 +
//     u; return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;    // diamond -> CF passes
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatHalfVecIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Hf = llvm::Type::getHalfTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Hf, 8);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V4h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Hf, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfhalf", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto HalfVec = [&](std::initializer_list<double> Vals) -> llvm::Constant * {
    llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Es;
    for (double V : Vals)
      Es.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Hf, V));
    return llvm::ConstantVector::get(Es);
  };
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(3));

  // <8 x half> path (128-bit Q-register / x86 xmm / ARM32 paired-D).
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8h);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8h);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    auto *Ha = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Hf);
    auto *Hb = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I & 3)), Hf);
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, Ha, uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Hb, uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *Q8 = B.CreateFSub(
      B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(VA, HalfVec({1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2})), VB),
      HalfVec({3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 1}));
  auto *Q8i = B.CreateFPToSI(Q8, V8i);
  llvm::Value *S8 = B.CreateExtractElement(Q8i, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 8; ++I)
    S8 = B.CreateAdd(S8, B.CreateExtractElement(Q8i, uint64_t(I)));

  // <4 x half> path (64-bit D-register; distinct lowering from the Q path).
  llvm::Value *WA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4h);
  llvm::Value *WB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4h);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    auto *Ha = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Hf);
    auto *Hb = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Hf);
    WA = B.CreateInsertElement(WA, Ha, uint64_t(I));
    WB = B.CreateInsertElement(WB, Hb, uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *Q4 = B.CreateFMul(B.CreateFAdd(WA, WB), HalfVec({2, 1, 2, 1}));
  auto *Q4i = B.CreateFPToSI(Q4, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S4 = B.CreateExtractElement(Q4i, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S4 = B.CreateAdd(S4, B.CreateExtractElement(Q4i, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(S8, S4), U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit vector half-precision (<16 x half>) — the 256-bit dual of vfhalf
// (<8 x half> / <4 x half>).  A <16 x half> is 256 bits, so arithmetic promotes
// it to <16 x float> (512 bits) which on AVX (no AVX-512) splits into two
// <8 x float> ymm.  This stresses, at 256-bit scale and all at once: the F16C
// 256-bit VCVTPH2PS/VCVTPS2PH conversions (the forms just decoded for vfhalf),
// 256-bit AVX FP arithmetic (vmulps/vaddps ymm), and the 256-bit lane-cross
// moves (vextractf128/vinsertf128) that splice the half vector into / out of
// its two 128-bit halves — a fresh fork-Unicorn surface beyond the 128-bit
// vfhalf.  On AArch64 it is two <8 x half> Q-register native fp16 (fadd.8h), on
// ARM32 two paired-D promoted via VCVT.F32.F16.  Every lane is a small integer
// (exact in half up to 2048) and the constants are small integers too, so
// fmul/fadd/fsub are exact and the vector fptosi half->i32 is deterministic and
// in range — orig and obfuscated copies are byte-identical over the FP
// sub-graph (no pass touches it), so any Unicorn divergence is a genuine
// backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  The 16 lanes are reduced to a scalar for the
// harness's integer return, mixed with integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) so --subst / --const-enc fire, and a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vfhalf2(int a, int b) {
//     half16 va, vb;                 // va[i]=(a&3)+(i&7), vb[i]=(b&3)+(i&3)
//     half16 q = va * {1,2,1,2,...} + vb - {3,1,4,1,5,2,6,1,...};
//     int s = sum((int16)q);
//     int t = ((a + b) ^ (a - b)) ^ 0x5A5A;
//     int u = (a & b) | (t + 12345);
//     int base = s + u;
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;   // diamond -> CF passes
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatHalf256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Hf = llvm::Type::getHalfTy(Ctx);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Hf, 16);
  auto *V16i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfhalf2", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto HalfVec = [&](std::initializer_list<double> Vals) -> llvm::Constant * {
    llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 16> Es;
    for (double V : Vals)
      Es.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Hf, V));
    return llvm::ConstantVector::get(Es);
  };
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(3));

  // <16 x half> path (256-bit: two Q-registers / two xmm spliced via
  // vextractf128/vinsertf128 + F16C 256-bit on x86).
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    auto *Ha = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I & 7)), Hf);
    auto *Hb = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I & 3)), Hf);
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, Ha, uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Hb, uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *Q16 = B.CreateFSub(
      B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(VA, HalfVec({1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2,
                                             1, 2, 1, 2})),
                   VB),
      HalfVec({3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 1, 3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 1}));
  auto *Q16i = B.CreateFPToSI(Q16, V16i);
  llvm::Value *S16 = B.CreateExtractElement(Q16i, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 16; ++I)
    S16 = B.CreateAdd(S16, B.CreateExtractElement(Q16i, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S16, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit <8 x float> cross-lane shuffles — the 256-bit floating-point dual of
// vshuf (<4 x i32>, 128-bit).  A <8 x float> spans two 128-bit lanes, so masks
// that move data ACROSS the 128-bit boundary lower (on generic AVX tuning) to
// the 256-bit lane-cross permutes vperm2f128 / vpermilps — instructions beyond
// the vinsertf128/vextractf128 + 128-bit-shuffle path that vfhalf2 exercised,
// so a fresh fork-Unicorn surface.  Four masks are used: a 128-bit half-swap
// ({4,5,6,7,0,1,2,3} -> vperm2f128), a within-lane pair-swap ({1,0,3,2,5,4,7,6}
// -> vpermilps), a full reverse ({7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0} -> vperm2f128 + vpermilps),
// and a two-input interleave ({0,9,2,11,4,13,6,15}).  Each lane is a small
// integer (exact in float), the four permutations are summed and then scaled by
// a per-position weight {1..8} so the reduction is position-sensitive (a
// shuffle that lands a value in the wrong lane changes the result), then
// fptosi'd to <8 x i32> and lane-summed for the harness's integer return.  No
// obfuscation pass touches the FP shuffle sub-graph, so orig and obfuscated
// copies are byte-identical over it; an undecoded permute makes the Unicorn
// baseline itself fault (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID), and any value divergence is a
// genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vfshuf256(int a, int b) {
//     float8 va = {(a&7)+i}, vb = {(b&7)+i};
//     float8 s1 = shuffle(va, {4,5,6,7,0,1,2,3});   // vperm2f128 half-swap
//     float8 s2 = shuffle(va, {1,0,3,2,5,4,7,6});   // vpermilps pair-swap
//     float8 s3 = shuffle(va, vb, {0,9,2,11,4,13,6,15});
//     float8 s4 = shuffle(va, {7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0});   // reverse (cross-lane)
//     float8 w  = (s1 + s2 + s3 + s4) * {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8};
//     int s = sum((int8)w);
//     ... mix + diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFloatShuffle256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                        const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfshuf256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *Poison = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8f);
  auto *S1 = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, Poison, {4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2, 3});
  auto *S2 = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, Poison, {1, 0, 3, 2, 5, 4, 7, 6});
  auto *S3 = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, VB, {0, 9, 2, 11, 4, 13, 6, 15});
  auto *S4 = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, Poison, {7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0});
  auto *Combo = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFAdd(S1, S2), B.CreateFAdd(S3, S4));
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, double(I + 1)));
  auto *W = B.CreateFMul(Combo, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws));
  auto *Wi = B.CreateFPToSI(W, V8i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX floating-point compare/select/min-max/shuffle on YMM.  The FP
// vector shapes above (vfwide / vfshuf256) use a plain <8 x float>, which on
// the SSE2 baseline (no +avx unless the module also uses fma/half) splits into
// two 128-bit halves and never reaches a YMM register.  This shape adds an
// llvm.fma, which forces +fma,+avx and an AVX-capable CPU model (exactly as the
// scalar ffma shape does), so every <8 x float> op below now lowers to a
// 256-bit YMM instruction: vfmadd ymm (fma), vperm2f128 ymm (the 128-bit
// half-swap shuffle), vmaxps/vminps ymm + vcmpps + vblendvps ymm (maxnum/minnum
// and the fcmp+select, whose NaN-correct lowering also blends) — the genuine
// 256-bit AVX FP surface that the non-fma FP shapes cannot reach.  Every lane
// is a small integer in [0,14]; va*vb+vc <= 210 is exactly representable so the
// single-rounded fma equals a separate multiply+add, the permute/min/max/select
// keep values exact, a per-position weight {1..8} makes the lane-sum reduction
// position-sensitive, and the fptosi to <8 x i32> stays in range.  No
// obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph, so orig and obfuscated copies are
// byte-identical over it; an undecoded YMM instruction makes the Unicorn
// baseline itself fault (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a
// genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxFloat256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vavx256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *VC = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
    VC = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VC, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so all the <8 x float> ops below use 256-bit YMM.
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V8f}, {VA, VB, VC});
  auto *Poison = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8f);
  auto *Sh = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, Poison, {4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2, 3});
  auto *Sh2 = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, VA, {1, 8, 3, 10, 5, 12, 7, 14});
  auto *Mx = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum, Sh, Sh2);
  auto *Mn = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minnum, Sh, Sh2);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOGT(Sh, Sh2), Mx, Mn);
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(Sel, B.CreateFMul(Mx, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws)));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateFPToSI(Combo, V8i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX floating-point divide + square root on YMM.  vavx256 above forces
// +fma,+avx (via llvm.fma) so its <8 x float> ops reach YMM, but it only
// exercises fma / max / min / cmp+select / vperm2f128 — never the two heaviest
// AVX FP ops, divide (vdivps ymm) and sqrt (vsqrtps ymm).  The existing vector
// divide / sqrt shapes (vfdiv / vfsqrt) are <4 x float> (128-bit XMM), so the
// 256-bit forms have zero coverage.  This shape keeps one llvm.fma to force
// +fma,+avx and an AVX-capable CPU model, then adds an <8 x float> fdiv and an
// <8 x float> llvm.sqrt, so both now lower to genuine 256-bit YMM instructions
// (vdivps ymm, vsqrtps ymm) alongside the vfmadd ymm.  Every value is an exact
// small integer: the dividend lane (alo+i+1)*(i+1) divided by (i+1) is exactly
// alo+i+1 (a correctly-rounded IEEE divide of two small representable floats is
// exact when the quotient is), the sqrt operand (alo+i)^2 is a perfect square
// so the root is exactly alo+i, and the fma q*s+c <= 71*70+70 < 2^24 is exactly
// representable so the single rounding equals a separate multiply+add — so the
// whole FP sub-graph is bit-exact and the fptosi to <8 x i32> stays in range
// with no NaN/Inf (divisors are >= 1, sqrt operands are >= 0).  A per-position
// weight {1..8} makes the lane-sum reduction position-sensitive.  No
// obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph, so orig and obfuscated copies are
// byte- identical over it; an undecoded 256-bit vdivps/vsqrtps makes the
// Unicorn baseline itself fault (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence
// is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxDivSqrt256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vdivsqrt256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(63));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(63));
  llvm::Value *Vnum = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *Vden = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *Vc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *Vsq = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    // dividend (alo+i+1)*(i+1) / divisor (i+1) == alo+i+1, exact.
    auto *Qi = B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I + 1));
    Vnum = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vnum, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateMul(Qi, B.getInt32(I + 1)), Flt),
        uint64_t(I));
    Vden = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vden, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, double(I + 1)), uint64_t(I));
    // sqrt operand (alo+i)^2 -> root alo+i, an exact perfect square.
    auto *Ri = B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I));
    Vsq = B.CreateInsertElement(Vsq, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateMul(Ri, Ri), Flt),
                                uint64_t(I));
    Vc = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vc, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // vdivps ymm + vsqrtps ymm — the llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so both 256-bit.
  auto *Vq = B.CreateFDiv(Vnum, Vden);
  auto *Vs = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sqrt, Vsq);
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V8f}, {Vq, Vs, Vc});
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(Vf, B.CreateFMul(Vs, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws)));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateFPToSI(Combo, V8i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX double-precision arithmetic / compare / select / min-max /
// shuffle on YMM — the <4 x double> dual of vavx256 (which is <8 x float>).  A
// <4 x double> is exactly one 256-bit YMM register, but the existing <4 x
// double> shape (vfwide) is non-fma, so on the SSE2 baseline (no +avx) it
// splits into two 128-bit halves (2x addpd / mulpd xmm) and never touches a YMM
// register.  vavx256 and vdivsqrt256 do force +fma,+avx but are
// single-precision (vmaxps / vdivps ... ps), so 256-bit *double-precision* YMM
// had zero coverage. This shape adds one llvm.fma over <4 x double>, forcing
// +fma,+avx and the AVX CPU model (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on
// the llvm.fma intrinsic regardless of element type), so every op lowers to a
// genuine 256-bit double YMM instruction: vfmadd...pd ymm (fma), vperm2f128 ymm
// (the 128-bit half-swap shuffle), vmaxpd / vminpd ymm (maxnum / minnum) and
// vcmppd + vblendvpd ymm (the NaN-correct fcmp+select blend) — a fully distinct
// helper set from the
// ...ps single-precision forms.  Every lane is a small integer in [0,10];
// va*vb+vc <= 110 is exactly representable in binary64 so the single-rounded
// fma equals a separate multiply+add, the permute / min / max / select keep
// values exact, a per-position weight {1..4} makes the lane-sum reduction
// position-sensitive, and the fptosi to <4 x i32> stays in range.  No
// obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph, so orig and obfuscated copies are
// byte-identical over it; an undecoded double YMM instruction makes the Unicorn
// baseline itself fault (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a
// genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxDouble256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vavxd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VC = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VC = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VC, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so all the <4 x double> ops below use 256-bit
  // YMM.
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VC});
  auto *Poison = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V4d);
  auto *Sh = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, Poison, {2, 3, 0, 1});
  auto *Sh2 = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, VA, {1, 4, 3, 6});
  auto *Mx = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum, Sh, Sh2);
  auto *Mn = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minnum, Sh, Sh2);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOGT(Sh, Sh2), Mx, Mn);
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(Sel, B.CreateFMul(Mx, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws)));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateFPToSI(Combo, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX double-precision divide + square root on YMM — the <4 x double>
// dual of vdivsqrt256 (which is <8 x float>).  vavxd256 above forces +fma,+avx
// (via an <4 x double> llvm.fma) so its ops reach a genuine double YMM, but it
// only exercises fma / max / min / cmp+select / vperm2f128 — never the two
// heaviest AVX FP ops in double precision: divide (vdivpd ymm) and sqrt
// (vsqrtpd ymm).  vdivsqrt256 does cover divide / sqrt but is single-precision
// (vdivps / vsqrtps ... ps), and the existing <2 x double> divide / sqrt shapes
// (vfdiv / vfsqrt) are 128-bit XMM, so 256-bit *double-precision* divide / sqrt
// had zero coverage.  This shape keeps one <4 x double> llvm.fma to force
// +fma,+avx and the AVX CPU model (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on
// the llvm.fma intrinsic regardless of element type), then adds a <4 x double>
// fdiv and a <4 x double> llvm.sqrt, so both lower to genuine 256-bit double
// YMM (vdivpd ymm, vsqrtpd ymm) alongside the vfmadd...pd ymm — a fully
// distinct helper set from the ...ps forms.  Every value is an exact small
// integer: the dividend lane (alo+i+1)*(i+1) over divisor (i+1) is exactly
// alo+i+1 (a correctly-rounded IEEE divide of two small representable doubles
// is exact when the quotient is), the sqrt operand (alo+i)^2 is a perfect
// square so the root is exactly alo+i, and the fma q*s+c (<= 67*66+66) is far
// below 2^53 so the single rounding equals a separate multiply+add — the whole
// FP sub-graph is bit-exact and the fptosi to <4 x i32> stays in range with no
// NaN/Inf (divisors are >= 1, sqrt operands are >= 0).  A per-position weight
// {1..4} makes the lane-sum reduction position-sensitive.  No obfuscation pass
// touches the FP sub-graph, so orig and obfuscated copies are byte-identical
// over it; an undecoded 256-bit vdivpd/vsqrtpd makes the Unicorn baseline
// itself fault (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine
// backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module>
buildVecAvxDivSqrtDouble256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx, const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vdivsqrtd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(63));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(63));
  llvm::Value *Vnum = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *Vden = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *Vc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *Vsq = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    // dividend (alo+i+1)*(i+1) / divisor (i+1) == alo+i+1, exact.
    auto *Qi = B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I + 1));
    Vnum = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vnum, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateMul(Qi, B.getInt32(I + 1)), Dbl),
        uint64_t(I));
    Vden = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vden, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)), uint64_t(I));
    // sqrt operand (alo+i)^2 -> root alo+i, an exact perfect square.
    auto *Ri = B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I));
    Vsq = B.CreateInsertElement(Vsq, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateMul(Ri, Ri), Dbl),
                                uint64_t(I));
    Vc = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vc, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // vdivpd ymm + vsqrtpd ymm — the llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so both 256-bit.
  auto *Vq = B.CreateFDiv(Vnum, Vden);
  auto *Vs = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sqrt, Vsq);
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {Vq, Vs, Vc});
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(Vf, B.CreateFMul(Vs, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws)));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateFPToSI(Combo, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX floating-point rounding on YMM — the VROUNDPS family
// (llvm.floor / llvm.ceil / llvm.trunc), a fork-Unicorn helper set no prior
// shape reaches.  vavx256 / vdivsqrt256 exercise <8 x float> fma / max / min /
// cmp+select / divide / sqrt on YMM, but never the rounding ops; the only
// rounding coverage anywhere (vfround scalar / 128-bit) is XMM-width, so
// 256-bit rounding had zero coverage.  This shape forces +fma,+avx with one
// <8 x float> llvm.fma (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on llvm.fma
// regardless of the surrounding ops) and feeds each lane a half-integer
// (2*(alo+i)+1)*0.5 == (alo+i)+0.5 — exactly representable in binary32 since
// 2*(alo+i)+1 is an odd integer well below 2^24 and *0.5 only shifts the
// exponent — so floor lowers to vroundps ymm,$9 == alo+i, ceil to vroundps
// ymm,$10 == alo+i+1, and trunc to vroundps ymm,$11 == alo+i, all exact and
// value-distinct between floor/ceil.  The fma floor*ceil+trunc ==
// (alo+i)*(alo+i+1)+(alo+i) <= 70*71+70 < 2^24 is single-rounded == a separate
// multiply+add, a per-position weight {1..8} makes the lane-sum reduction
// position-sensitive, and the fptosi to <8 x i32> stays in range with no
// NaN/Inf.  No obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph, so orig and
// obfuscated copies are byte-identical over it; an undecoded 256-bit vroundps
// makes the Unicorn baseline itself fault (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value
// divergence (e.g. a swapped rounding-mode immediate) is a genuine backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5A5A/12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a data-dependent diamond +
// PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxRound256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vround256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(63));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(63));
  llvm::Value *Vodd = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *Vc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    // odd integer 2*(alo+i)+1, so *0.5 is the exact half-integer (alo+i)+0.5.
    auto *K = B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I));
    auto *Odd = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(K, B.getInt32(2)), B.getInt32(1));
    Vodd = B.CreateInsertElement(Vodd, B.CreateSIToFP(Odd, Flt), uint64_t(I));
    Vc = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vc, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Halves(
      8, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, 0.5));
  auto *Vx = B.CreateFMul(Vodd, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Halves));
  // vroundps ymm $9/$10/$11 — the llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so all 256-bit.
  auto *Vfl = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::floor, Vx);
  auto *Vce = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ceil, Vx);
  auto *Vtr = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::trunc, Vx);
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V8f}, {Vfl, Vce, Vtr});
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(Vf, B.CreateFMul(Vce, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws)));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateFPToSI(Combo, V8i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX double-precision rounding on YMM — the VROUNDPD dual of vround256
// (<8 x float> vroundps).  Validates the vroundpd ymm path the same
// fork-Unicorn fix added (helper_roundpd_xmm per 128-bit lane), which vround256
// (single- precision) never reaches.  One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces
// +fma,+avx; each lane is the half-integer (2*(alo+i)+1)*0.5 == (alo+i)+0.5
// (exact in binary64), so floor=vroundpd $9==alo+i, ceil=$10==alo+i+1,
// trunc=$11==alo+i, all exact. The fma floor*ceil+trunc <= 66*67+66 << 2^53 is
// single-rounded; a {1..4} weight makes the lane-sum position-sensitive; fptosi
// to <4 x i32> stays in range.  No pass touches the FP sub-graph (orig/obf
// byte-identical); an undecoded 256-bit vroundpd faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID). Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5A5A/12345) + a data- dependent diamond + PHI drive the obfuscation
// passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module>
buildVecAvxRoundDouble256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx, const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vroundd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(63));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(63));
  llvm::Value *Vodd = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *Vc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    // odd integer 2*(alo+i)+1, so *0.5 is the exact half-integer (alo+i)+0.5.
    auto *K = B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I));
    auto *Odd = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(K, B.getInt32(2)), B.getInt32(1));
    Vodd = B.CreateInsertElement(Vodd, B.CreateSIToFP(Odd, Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    Vc = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vc, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Halves(
      4, llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, 0.5));
  auto *Vx = B.CreateFMul(Vodd, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Halves));
  // vroundpd ymm $9/$10/$11 — the llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so all 256-bit.
  auto *Vfl = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::floor, Vx);
  auto *Vce = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ceil, Vx);
  auto *Vtr = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::trunc, Vx);
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {Vfl, Vce, Vtr});
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(Vf, B.CreateFMul(Vce, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws)));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateFPToSI(Combo, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ci, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX float<->double width conversion on YMM — the headline pair is
// vcvtps2pd ymm,xmm (fpext <4 x float> -> <4 x double>: reads a 128-bit XMM,
// writes a 256-bit YMM) and vcvtpd2ps xmm,ymm (fptrunc <4 x double> ->
// <4 x float>: reads a 256-bit YMM, writes a 128-bit XMM).  The only vector
// fpext/fptrunc coverage anywhere (vconv) is 128-bit: with no +avx its
// <4 x double> splits into two 128-bit halves, so the converts are cvtps2pd /
// cvtpd2ps on XMM and never reach a YMM-width convert; the existing 256-bit
// shapes only convert via sitofp/fptosi at <8 x i32>/<8 x float> width
// (vcvtdq2ps / vcvttps2dq ymm), never float<->double width.  So the YMM-width
// vcvtps2pd / vcvtpd2ps encodings (with their unusual XMM<->YMM operand-width
// asymmetry) are a fresh fork-Unicorn decode surface.  One <4 x double>
// llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on
// llvm.fma regardless of element type), so the converts and every <4 x double>
// op land on YMM.  Each lane is a small integer (va=alo+i, vb=clo+i in [0,34]),
// fpext is always exact, and the doubles flow through a NON-float-exact
// constant KD={0.3,0.6,0.1,0.9} (vmulpd ymm) + an fma (vfmadd ymm): KD cannot
// be shrunk to float, so instcombine cannot narrow the binops back to f32 and
// fold the fpext/fptrunc away — the two converts provably survive to machine
// code.  All values stay in [0,~245] so the final fptosi to <4 x i32> never
// overflows and there is no NaN/Inf; the FP result need not be a clean integer
// because checkEquiv compares the original vs the obfuscated copy (which share
// a byte-identical FP sub-graph), not against a hand value.  No obfuscation
// pass touches the FP sub-graph; an undecoded 256-bit convert faults the
// Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine
// backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the
// obfuscation passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxCvtFD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 4);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vcvtfd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(31));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(31));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4f);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // fpext <4 x float> -> <4 x double>: vcvtps2pd ymm, xmm (the 128->256 widen).
  auto *Da = B.CreateFPExt(VA, V4d);
  auto *Db = B.CreateFPExt(VB, V4d);
  // Non-float-exact KD blocks instcombine from shrinking the double binops back
  // to f32, so the fpext above and the fptrunc below provably survive.
  double Kd[4] = {0.3, 0.6, 0.1, 0.9};
  auto *KD = llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<double>(Kd, 4));
  auto *Vmul = B.CreateFMul(Da, KD); // vmulpd ymm
  // <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so every double op (and the two
  // converts) lands on YMM; result = Db*KD + Da*KD = (Da+Db)*KD.
  auto *Vfma = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {Db, KD, Vmul});
  // fptrunc <4 x double> -> <4 x float>: vcvtpd2ps xmm, ymm (the 256->128
  // narrow).
  auto *Ftr = B.CreateFPTrunc(Vfma, V4f);
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, double(I + 1)));
  auto *W = B.CreateFMul(Ftr, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws));
  auto *Wi = B.CreateFPToSI(W, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX double-precision cross-lane shuffle on YMM — the <4 x double>
// dual of vfshuf256 (<8 x float>), completing the float/double symmetry every
// other 256-bit shape already has (vavx256/vavxd256, vdivsqrt256/vdivsqrtd256,
// vround256/vroundd256).  A <4 x double> spans two 128-bit lanes (two doubles
// each); the existing double shapes only ever shuffle with the {2,3,0,1}
// half-swap (vperm2f128) + one 2-input interleave (vavxd256), so the
// within-lane permute (vpermilpd / vshufpd) and a full reverse are an
// untouched fork-Unicorn surface.  One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx
// (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on llvm.fma), so every <4 x double>
// op — including the shuffles — lowers to a 256-bit YMM instruction rather than
// splitting into two 128-bit halves.  Four masks: {1,0,3,2} within-lane swap ->
// vpermilpd, {3,2,1,0} full reverse -> vperm2f128 + vpermilpd, {2,3,0,1}
// half-swap -> vperm2f128, and a 2-input interleave {0,5,2,7}.  Each lane is a
// small integer ((alo+i)*(clo+i)+(alo+i) <= 10*10+10 = 110, exact, single-
// rounded fma == multiply+add); shuffles only move lanes so stay exact; the
// four permutations are summed and scaled by a per-position weight {1..4} so
// the reduction is position-sensitive (a value in the wrong lane changes the
// sum), then fptosi'd to <4 x i32> (in range, no NaN/Inf).  No obfuscation pass
// touches the FP sub-graph (orig/obf byte-identical over it); an undecoded
// 256-bit permute faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any
// value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the obfuscation passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxShufDouble256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                         const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfshufd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so the <4 x double> shuffles below use 256-bit
  // YMM permutes instead of splitting into two 128-bit halves.
  auto *Vf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  auto *Poison = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V4d);
  auto *S1 = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, Poison, {1, 0, 3, 2}); // vpermilpd
  auto *S2 = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, Poison, {3, 2, 1, 0}); // reverse
  auto *S3 = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, Poison, {2, 3, 0, 1}); // vperm2f128
  auto *S4 = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vf, VB, {0, 5, 2, 7});     // interleave
  auto *Combo = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFAdd(S1, S2), B.CreateFAdd(S3, S4));
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *W = B.CreateFMul(Combo, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws));
  auto *Wi = B.CreateFPToSI(W, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX negated-FMA variants on YMM — every prior FMA shape (vavx256 /
// vavxd256 / vdivsqrt*256 / vround*256) uses only the plain llvm.fma, which
// lowers to vfmadd...  This shape adds the three *negated* fused forms via
// llvm.fma with fneg'd operands, which lower to the distinct opcodes
// vfnmadd213pd (-(a*b)+c), vfmsub213pd (a*b-c) and vfnmsub213pd (-(a*b)-c) on
// YMM — separate decode/sign paths from vfmadd that no shape has exercised.
// One <4 x double> llvm.fma already forces +fma,+avx, so all four land on
// 256-bit YMM.  Each lane is a small integer (va/vb/vc in [0,10], a*b <= 100),
// so every fused result is an exact integer (single-rounded == multiply+add);
// the four are combined with non-cancelling weights (m0 + 2*m1 + 3*m2 + 4*m3,
// magnitude <= 1050) so the result genuinely depends on each variant, then a
// per-position weight {1..4} keeps the lane-sum position-sensitive and fptosi
// to <4 x i32> stays in range (no NaN/Inf).  No obfuscation pass touches the FP
// sub-graph (orig/obf byte-identical over it); an undecoded 256-bit FMA variant
// faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is
// a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the obfuscation passes.
