std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxFmaVar256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfnma256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VC = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VC = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VC, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *NVA = B.CreateFNeg(VA);
  auto *NVC = B.CreateFNeg(VC);
  // The four fused forms: vfmadd / vfnmadd / vfmsub / vfnmsub on ymm.
  auto *M0 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VC});
  auto *M1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {NVA, VB, VC});
  auto *M2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, NVC});
  auto *M3 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {NVA, VB, NVC});
  auto wd = [&](double K) {
    return llvm::ConstantVector::getSplat(llvm::ElementCount::getFixed(4),
                                          llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, K));
  };
  // Non-cancelling combine: m0 + 2*m1 + 3*m2 + 4*m3.
  auto *Combo =
      B.CreateFAdd(M0, B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(M1, wd(2.0)),
                                    B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(M2, wd(3.0)),
                                                 B.CreateFMul(M3, wd(4.0)))));
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Ws;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Ws.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *W = B.CreateFMul(Combo, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Ws));
  auto *Wi = B.CreateFPToSI(W, V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Wi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *P = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  P->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  P->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(P);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX duplicate/splat moves on YMM — every prior 256-bit shuffle shape
// (vfshuf256 / vfshufd256) used only *two-source* permutes (vshufps / vshufpd /
// vperm2f128 / vblendps) or the cross-lane vpermpd; none exercised the *single-
// source duplicate* family vmovddup (even f64 lanes), vmovsldup (even f32 lanes)
// and vmovshdup (odd f32 lanes) — a distinct VEX.256 decode group (0F 12 with
// F2/F3, 0F 16 with F3) that the generic in-lane table path leaves SSE_SPECIAL
// (so an undecoded ymm form would #UD).  One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces
// +fma,+avx (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on llvm.fma), so both the
// <4 x double> and the <8 x float> duplicate shuffles lower to a 256-bit YMM
// move rather than splitting into two 128-bit halves.  Each lane is a small
// integer (fma (alo+i)*(clo+i)+(alo+i) <= 10*10+10 = 110, exact single-rounded;
// floats xlo+i in [0,14]); duplicates only move lanes so they stay exact.  The
// duplicated f64 vector is reduced with a per-position weight {1..4}, and the
// two f32 duplicates are summed and reduced with a per-position weight {1..8},
// so a lane landing in the wrong place changes the sum; both fptosi'd in range
// (no NaN/Inf).  No obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph (orig/obf byte-
// identical over it); an undecoded 256-bit duplicate faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-
// Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/
// 12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the obfuscation passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxDup256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vdup256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so the <4 x double> and <8 x float> duplicate
  // shuffles below lower to 256-bit YMM moves instead of 128-bit-lane splits.
  auto *Vd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  auto *PoisonD = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V4d);
  auto *PoisonF = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8f);
  auto *Dd = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vd, PoisonD, {0, 0, 2, 2}); // vmovddup
  auto *Sl = B.CreateShuffleVector(VF, PoisonF,
                                   {0, 0, 2, 2, 4, 4, 6, 6}); // vmovsldup
  auto *Sh = B.CreateShuffleVector(VF, PoisonF,
                                   {1, 1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 7, 7}); // vmovshdup

  // f64 reduction: position-weighted {1..4}.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Wd;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Wd.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Di = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(Dd, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Wd)), V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Di, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Di, uint64_t(I)));

  // f32 reduction: (vmovsldup + vmovshdup) position-weighted {1..8}.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Wf;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Wf.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 1)));
  auto *Fi = B.CreateFPToSI(
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateFAdd(Sl, Sh), llvm::ConstantVector::get(Wf)), V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Fi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pd = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pd->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pd->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pd);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX ordered-not-equal compare on YMM — the only prior FP compares are
// scalar (ffp) or 128-bit; no shape has produced a 256-bit vcmpps/vcmppd, and
// crucially none has hit an AVX *extended* predicate (imm >= 8).  An ordered
// fcmp one lowers to vcmpneq_oqps / vcmpneq_oqpd with predicate 0x0C — the
// fork-Unicorn decoder's `if (val >= 8) return false` rejects every extended
// predicate (only 0-7 had helpers), so an undecoded extended-predicate compare
// would #UD.  The compared operands are genuine FP computations (an llvm.fma
// result and an fmul result) rather than bare sitofp values, so instcombine
// cannot fold the fcmp into an integer icmp — the vcmpneq_oq really reaches the
// machine layer.  One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so both compares
// and their vblendv selects land on 256-bit YMM.  Lanes are small integers
// (fma <= 110, fmul <= 196, all exact); the masks pick between two distinct
// vectors (vblendvpd / vblendvps) so the compare result genuinely matters
// (instcombine cannot drop it); position weights {1..4}/{1..8} keep the lane
// sums position-sensitive and fptosi stays in range (no NaN/Inf).  No
// obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph (orig/obf byte-identical over it);
// an undecoded extended-predicate compare faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-
// Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/
// 12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the obfuscation passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxCmpNe256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vcmpne256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx; comparing fma/fmul results (not bare sitofp)
  // keeps the fcmp one from folding into an integer icmp.
  auto *Vd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  auto *Vff = B.CreateFMul(VF, VF);
  auto *CmpD = B.CreateFCmpONE(Vd, VB);  // vcmpneq_oqpd (predicate 0x0C)
  auto *CmpF = B.CreateFCmpONE(Vff, VF); // vcmpneq_oqps (predicate 0x0C)
  auto *SelD = B.CreateSelect(CmpD, Vd, VB);   // vblendvpd
  auto *SelF = B.CreateSelect(CmpF, Vff, VF);  // vblendvps

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Wd;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Wd.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Di =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(SelD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Wd)), V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Di, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Di, uint64_t(I)));

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Wf;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Wf.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 1)));
  auto *Fi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(SelF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Wf)), V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Fi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX alternating subtract/add on YMM — no prior shape has produced a
// vaddsubps/vaddsubpd.  Every 256-bit FP shape so far used plain packed add/
// sub/mul/div/sqrt/fma/round/convert/compare/shuffle/duplicate; none hit the
// ADDSUBP family that subtracts the even lanes and adds the odd lanes in one
// instruction.  LLVM's x86 backend folds (shuffle (fsub X,Y), (fadd X,Y),
// <0,N+1,2,N+3,...>) into a single vaddsubps/vaddsubpd (verified with llc
// -mattr=+avx: <8 x float> -> vaddsubps ymm, <4 x double> -> vaddsubpd ymm).
// One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so both addsubs land on 256-bit
// YMM.  Each fsub/fadd pair shares the SAME two operands (so the addsub combine
// fires) and those operands are real FP computations (an llvm.fma result and an
// fmul result), not bare sitofp, so instcombine cannot fold the sub-graph away.
// Lanes are small integers (fma <= 110, fmul <= 196, sub/add exact); distinct
// {1..4}/{1..8} position weights keep the lane sums position-sensitive and
// fptosi stays in range (no NaN/Inf).  No obfuscation pass touches the FP
// sub-graph (orig/obf byte-identical over it); an undecoded vaddsubp would fault
// the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a
// genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxAddSub256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vaddsub256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx; the addsub operands are fma/fmul results (not
  // bare sitofp) so the shuffle(fsub,fadd) addsub combine fires on real values.
  auto *Vd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  auto *Vff = B.CreateFMul(VF, VF);
  // vaddsubpd: even lanes = Vd - VB, odd lanes = Vd + VB.
  auto *SubD = B.CreateFSub(Vd, VB);
  auto *AddD = B.CreateFAdd(Vd, VB);
  auto *AsD = B.CreateShuffleVector(SubD, AddD, {0, 5, 2, 7});
  // vaddsubps: even lanes = Vff - VF, odd lanes = Vff + VF.
  auto *SubF = B.CreateFSub(Vff, VF);
  auto *AddF = B.CreateFAdd(Vff, VF);
  auto *AsF = B.CreateShuffleVector(SubF, AddF, {0, 9, 2, 11, 4, 13, 6, 15});

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> Wd;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    Wd.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
  auto *Di =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(AsD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Wd)), V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Di, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Di, uint64_t(I)));

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> Wf;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    Wf.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 1)));
  auto *Fi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(AsF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(Wf)), V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Fi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX horizontal add/subtract on YMM — the sibling of vaddsub256 and a
// distinct VEX.256 decode group not yet exercised.  Every prior 256-bit FP
// shape used vertical lane-wise ops (add/sub/mul/div/sqrt/fma/round/convert/
// compare/shuffle/duplicate, and the alternating addsub); none produced the
// *horizontal* family that pairs adjacent lanes within each 128-bit half:
// vhaddps/vhsubps (<8 x float>) and vhaddpd/vhsubpd (<4 x double>).  LLVM's x86
// backend (isHorizontalBinOp) folds (fadd/fsub (shuffle X,Y <evens>),
// (shuffle X,Y <odds>)) into a single vhaddp{s,d}/vhsubp{s,d} (verified with
// llc -mattr=+avx: <8 x float> -> vhaddps/vhsubps ymm, <4 x double> ->
// vhaddpd/vhsubpd ymm, even when the even/odd shuffles are shared by both the
// add and the sub).  One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so all four
// horizontals land on 256-bit YMM.  The even/odd shuffle operands are real FP
// computations (an llvm.fma result and an fmul result), not bare sitofp, so
// instcombine cannot fold the sub-graph away; hadd and hsub share the SAME two
// shuffles per width so both a vhadd and a vhsub are emitted.  Lanes are small
// integers (fma <= 110, fmul <= 196, hadd/hsub exact); distinct ascending /
// descending position weights keep the lane sums position-sensitive (a misplaced
// lane or a swapped hadd/hsub changes the sum) and fptosi stays in range (no
// NaN/Inf).  No obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph (orig/obf byte-
// identical over it); an undecoded vhaddp would fault the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-
// Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/
// 12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the obfuscation passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxHAddSub256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vhaddsub256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Xlo = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Alo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Clo, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Xlo, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx; the horizontal operands are fma/fmul results (not
  // bare sitofp) so the fadd/fsub(shuffle,shuffle) horizontal combine fires on
  // real values.
  auto *Vd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  auto *Vff = B.CreateFMul(VF, VF);
  // vhaddpd / vhsubpd: pair adjacent lanes within each 128-bit half of (Vd, VB).
  auto *EvD = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vd, VB, {0, 4, 2, 6});
  auto *OdD = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vd, VB, {1, 5, 3, 7});
  auto *HAddD = B.CreateFAdd(EvD, OdD);
  auto *HSubD = B.CreateFSub(EvD, OdD);
  // vhaddps / vhsubps: pair adjacent lanes within each 128-bit half of (Vff, VF).
  auto *EvF = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vff, VF, {0, 2, 8, 10, 4, 6, 12, 14});
  auto *OdF = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vff, VF, {1, 3, 9, 11, 5, 7, 13, 15});
  auto *HAddF = B.CreateFAdd(EvF, OdF);
  auto *HSubF = B.CreateFSub(EvF, OdF);

  // Reduce each horizontal result with a distinct ascending/descending position
  // weight so a misplaced lane (or a swapped hadd/hsub) changes the sum.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> WdA, WdB;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    WdA.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
    WdB.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(4 - I)));
  }
  auto *AddDi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(HAddD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdA)), V4i);
  auto *SubDi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(HSubD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdB)), V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(AddDi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(AddDi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(SubDi, uint64_t(I)));

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> WfA, WfB;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    WfA.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 1)));
    WfB.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(8 - I)));
  }
  auto *AddFi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(HAddF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfA)), V8i);
  auto *SubFi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(HSubF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfB)), V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(AddFi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(SubFi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX floating-point sign-bit / bitwise-logical family on YMM — the
// first true 256-bit coverage of fneg/fabs/copysign.  Every prior sign-bit
// shape was either scalar (ffp-adjacent) or 128-bit <4 x float>
// (vandps/vxorps xmm); none produced the *256-bit YMM* FP-logical ops, which on
// x86 are a distinct VEX.256 decode group: fneg -> vxorp{s,d} (flip the sign
// bit by XOR with the sign mask), fabs -> vandp{s,d} (clear the sign bit by AND
// with the abs mask), and copysign -> vandp/vandnp/vorp (mask abs(a) with the
// sign of b).  One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx so the <4 x double>
// (pd) and <8 x float> (ps) sign ops all land on 256-bit YMM (vxorpd/vandpd/...
// and vxorps/vandps/...), not split into 2x128.  The operands carry a
// runtime-varying sign — D = (A&7)-(C&7) ranges over [-7,7] and the lanes are
// sitofp(D+i)/sitofp(-D+i) — so instcombine cannot prove the sign and fold any
// fabs/fneg/copysign away (a non-negative x*x would let it fold fabs, so the ps
// side uses the signed sitofp values directly, NOT a square).  Lanes are small
// integers (fma <= 110, |sign ops| exact); distinct ascending/descending
// position weights keep the lane sums position-sensitive (a swapped and/or/xor
// mask or a misplaced lane changes the sum) and fptosi stays in range (no
// NaN/Inf; copysign's -0.0 fptosi's to 0 identically on both copies).  No
// obfuscation pass touches the FP sub-graph (orig/obf byte-identical over it,
// including the sign-mask constant-pool loads); an undecoded 256-bit vxorp/vandp
// would fault the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value
// divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/
// xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI
// drive the obfuscation passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxFLogic256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vflogic256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  // D = (A&7)-(C&7) in [-7,7]: a runtime-varying sign so the lanes below cannot
  // be proven non-negative and the fabs/fneg/copysign survive instcombine.
  auto *D = B.CreateSub(Alo, Clo);
  auto *Dn = B.CreateSub(Clo, Alo);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(D, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Dn, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *VG = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(D, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
    VG = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VG, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Dn, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx; Vd is a real fma value with runtime-varying sign
  // so its fabs/fneg/copysign all reach the machine layer on 256-bit YMM.
  auto *Vd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  // <4 x double>: fneg -> vxorpd, fabs -> vandpd, copysign -> vandpd/vandnpd/vorpd.
  auto *NegD = B.CreateFNeg(Vd);
  auto *AbsD = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fabs, Vd);
  auto *CsD = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::copysign, Vd, VB);
  // <8 x float>: same family on YMM (vxorps/vandps/vandnps/vorps) over the
  // signed sitofp values directly (a square would be foldable by fabs).
  auto *NegF = B.CreateFNeg(VF);
  auto *AbsF = B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fabs, VF);
  auto *CsF = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::copysign, VF, VG);

  // Reduce each sign-op result with a distinct position weight so a swapped
  // and/or/xor mask or a misplaced lane changes the sum.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> WdA, WdB, WdC;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    WdA.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
    WdB.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(4 - I)));
    WdC.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 2)));
  }
  auto *NegDi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(NegD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdA)), V4i);
  auto *AbsDi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(AbsD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdB)), V4i);
  auto *CsDi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(CsD, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdC)), V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(NegDi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(NegDi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(AbsDi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(CsDi, uint64_t(I)));

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> WfA, WfB, WfC;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    WfA.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 1)));
    WfB.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(8 - I)));
    WfC.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 2)));
  }
  auto *NegFi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(NegF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfA)), V8i);
  auto *AbsFi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(AbsF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfB)), V8i);
  auto *CsFi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(CsF, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfC)), V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(NegFi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(AbsFi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(CsFi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX floating-point unpack / interleave on YMM — the FP-shuffle family
// no prior 256-bit shape produced.  vfshuf256 used cross-lane permute / pairwise
// swap / blend / reverse masks (and, lacking an fma, never even reached a YMM
// register), and vfshufd256 did vshufpd; none emitted the *unpack interleave*
// shuffles, which on a 256-bit register interleave the two 128-bit lanes
// independently:
//   vunpcklps ymm: dst = {a0,b0,a1,b1, a4,b4,a5,b5}  (mask 0,8,1,9,4,12,5,13)
//   vunpckhps ymm: dst = {a2,b2,a3,b3, a6,b6,a7,b7}  (mask 2,10,3,11,6,14,7,15)
//   vunpcklpd ymm: dst = {a0,b0, a2,b2}              (mask 0,4,2,6)
//   vunpckhpd ymm: dst = {a1,b1, a3,b3}              (mask 1,5,3,7)
// (verified with `clang -mavx -S`: each mask lowers to exactly one YMM unpack.)
// One <4 x double> llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx and the AVX CPU model
// (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys on llvm.fma), so every <8 x float> /
// <4 x double> shuffle below lands on a genuine 256-bit YMM unpack rather than
// two 128-bit SSE unpcklps.  The unpack sources are real FP computations (an fma
// result and runtime-varying sitofp vectors), not bare sitofp, so instcombine
// cannot fold the interleave away, and the per-128-lane behaviour means a
// lane-agnostic (single-128) unpack lowering would diverge.  Lanes are small
// integers (fma <= 110, products exact) so every shuffle keeps values exact;
// distinct {1..4}/{1..8} position weights make the lane-sum reduction
// order-sensitive and the fptosi stays in range (no NaN/Inf).  No obfuscation
// pass touches the FP sub-graph, so orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically over
// it; an undecoded YMM unpack faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID)
// and any value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxUnpack256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vunpack256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Alo = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Clo = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  // D = (A&7)-(C&7) in [-7,7]: runtime-varying so the unpack sources cannot be
  // constant-folded and the interleave survives to the machine layer.
  auto *D = B.CreateSub(Alo, Clo);
  auto *Dn = B.CreateSub(Clo, Alo);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(D, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Dn, B.getInt32(I)), Dbl), uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *VG = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(D, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
    VG = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VG, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Dn, B.getInt32(I)), Flt), uint64_t(I));
  }
  // llvm.fma forces +fma,+avx; Vd is a real <4 x double> value so the double
  // unpacks run on YMM, and +avx makes the <8 x float> unpacks YMM too.
  auto *Vd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4d}, {VA, VB, VA});
  // <4 x double>: vunpcklpd / vunpckhpd (per-128-lane interleave).
  auto *Ld = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vd, VB, {0, 4, 2, 6});
  auto *Hd = B.CreateShuffleVector(Vd, VB, {1, 5, 3, 7});
  // <8 x float>: vunpcklps / vunpckhps (per-128-lane interleave).
  auto *Lf = B.CreateShuffleVector(VF, VG, {0, 8, 1, 9, 4, 12, 5, 13});
  auto *Hf = B.CreateShuffleVector(VF, VG, {2, 10, 3, 11, 6, 14, 7, 15});

  // Reduce each unpack result with a distinct position weight so a swapped lane
  // or a lane-agnostic (single-128) unpack changes the sum.
  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 4> WdA, WdB;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    WdA.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(I + 1)));
    WdB.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Dbl, double(4 - I)));
  }
  auto *Ldi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(Ld, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdA)), V4i);
  auto *Hdi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(Hd, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WdB)), V4i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateExtractElement(Ldi, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned I = 1; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Ldi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Hdi, uint64_t(I)));

  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Constant *, 8> WfA, WfB;
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    WfA.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(I + 1)));
    WfB.push_back(llvm::ConstantFP::get(Flt, float(8 - I)));
  }
  auto *Lfi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(Lf, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfA)), V8i);
  auto *Hfi =
      B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFMul(Hf, llvm::ConstantVector::get(WfB)), V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Lfi, uint64_t(I)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Hfi, uint64_t(I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 integer unpack / interleave on YMM -- vpunpcklbw/hbw (<32 x i8>),
// vpunpcklwd/hwd (<16 x i16>), vpunpckldq/hdq (<8 x i32>), vpunpcklqdq/hqdq
// (<4 x i64>): the integer interleave family no prior 256-bit shape produced.
// vunpack256 covered only the FP unpacks (vunpcklps/pd), which reuse the
// punpckldq/punpcklqdq helpers -- so the byte- and word-granularity integer
// unpacks (punpcklbw/punpcklwd, with no FP equivalent) were never exercised, and
// even the dword/qword forms are distinct opcodes (0F 62/6C vs the FP 0F 14/15).
// On a 256-bit register each unpack interleaves the two 128-bit lanes
// independently, so a lane-agnostic (single-128) lowering would diverge.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 a dead llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors +avx2 (256-bit
// integer needs AVX2, not just AVX) so every interleave lowers to a genuine
// vpunpck* ymm rather than two 128-bit SSE unpacks; every other cell lowers the
// identical shufflevector to NEON zip1/zip2 (or split SSE), libcall-free.  The
// two <32 x i8> sources are arg-derived and sign-mixed, bit-cast to each width
// for the word/dword/qword interleaves; each result lane is folded with a
// distinct ascending/descending weight so a swapped lane -- or a lane-agnostic
// unpack -- changes the sum (qword lanes folded lo^hi to observe both dwords).
// No L1 pass touches the shuffle sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies
// stay byte-identical over it; an undecoded YMM unpack faults the Unicorn
// baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x6E6E/40787) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIUnpack256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viunpack256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <32 x i8> sources, each byte arg-derived and sign-mixed.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Av = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B + 3)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16) * 0x25))),
        I8);
    llvm::Value *Bv = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x2F + 7)),
                    B.CreateSub(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x13))),
        I8);
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, Av, uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Bv, uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor (x86-64): keep the 256-bit YMM domain so the integer unpacks
  // lower to vpunpck* ymm rather than two split 128-bit SSE unpacks.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VAa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VSa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VAa =
          B.CreateInsertElement(VAa, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VSa = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VSa, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {},
                            {VAa, VSa});
  }

  // Per-128-lane interleave masks (both 128-bit halves interleaved indep.).
  llvm::SmallVector<int, 32> BLo, BHi;
  for (unsigned Lane = 0; Lane < 2; ++Lane)
    for (unsigned K = 0; K < 8; ++K) {
      unsigned Base = Lane * 16;
      BLo.push_back(Base + K);
      BLo.push_back(32 + Base + K);
      BHi.push_back(Base + 8 + K);
      BHi.push_back(32 + Base + 8 + K);
    }
  llvm::SmallVector<int, 16> WLo, WHi;
  for (unsigned Lane = 0; Lane < 2; ++Lane)
    for (unsigned K = 0; K < 4; ++K) {
      unsigned Base = Lane * 8;
      WLo.push_back(Base + K);
      WLo.push_back(16 + Base + K);
      WHi.push_back(Base + 4 + K);
      WHi.push_back(16 + Base + 4 + K);
    }
  llvm::SmallVector<int, 8> DLo, DHi;
  for (unsigned Lane = 0; Lane < 2; ++Lane)
    for (unsigned K = 0; K < 2; ++K) {
      unsigned Base = Lane * 4;
      DLo.push_back(Base + K);
      DLo.push_back(8 + Base + K);
      DHi.push_back(Base + 2 + K);
      DHi.push_back(8 + Base + 2 + K);
    }
  llvm::SmallVector<int, 4> QLo, QHi;
  for (unsigned Lane = 0; Lane < 2; ++Lane) {
    unsigned Base = Lane * 2;
    QLo.push_back(Base);
    QLo.push_back(4 + Base);
    QHi.push_back(Base + 1);
    QHi.push_back(4 + Base + 1);
  }

  auto *Lb = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, VB, BLo); // vpunpcklbw
  auto *Hb = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, VB, BHi); // vpunpckhbw
  auto *WA = B.CreateBitCast(VA, V16w);
  auto *WB = B.CreateBitCast(VB, V16w);
  auto *Lw = B.CreateShuffleVector(WA, WB, WLo); // vpunpcklwd
  auto *Hw = B.CreateShuffleVector(WA, WB, WHi); // vpunpckhwd
  auto *DA = B.CreateBitCast(VA, V8d);
  auto *DB = B.CreateBitCast(VB, V8d);
  auto *Ld = B.CreateShuffleVector(DA, DB, DLo); // vpunpckldq
  auto *Hd = B.CreateShuffleVector(DA, DB, DHi); // vpunpckhdq
  auto *QA = B.CreateBitCast(VA, V4q);
  auto *QB = B.CreateBitCast(VB, V4q);
  auto *Lq = B.CreateShuffleVector(QA, QB, QLo); // vpunpcklqdq
  auto *Hq = B.CreateShuffleVector(QA, QB, QHi); // vpunpckhqdq

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Lb, uint64_t(L)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Hb, uint64_t(L)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(32 - L)));
  }
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Lw, uint64_t(L)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Hw, uint64_t(L)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Ld, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Hd, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(8 - L)));
  }
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 4; ++L) {
    auto *Ql = B.CreateExtractElement(Lq, uint64_t(L));
    auto *Qh = B.CreateExtractElement(Hq, uint64_t(L));
    auto *LFold = B.CreateXor(
        B.CreateTrunc(Ql, I32),
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Ql, B.getInt64(32)), I32));
    auto *HFold = B.CreateXor(
        B.CreateTrunc(Qh, I32),
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Qh, B.getInt64(32)), I32));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(LFold, B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(HFold, B.getInt32(4 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x6E6E));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(40787)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 per-element variable shifts on YMM — vpsllvd/vpsrlvd/vpsravd
// (<8 x i32>) and vpsllvq/vpsrlvq (<4 x i64>), the per-lane-amount shift family
// no prior PatchFull shape produced.  vfunnel256 used a *uniform* splat shift
// amount (one vpslld/vpsrld by imm), so the AVX2 variable-shift opcodes — where
// each lane shifts by its own runtime count — were never emitted, and in fact NO
// PatchFull sample ever turned on +avx2 before (the integer-256 samples split
// into 2x128 SSE / scalarize).  This is the first PatchFull test to drive the
// +avx2 256-bit-YMM rewrite-codegen path through compileForRewrite.
//
// Cross-ISA: only x86-64 has the VEX.256 variable-shift encodings, and
// CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off an "avx2"-named intrinsic,
// so the x86-64 cell uses the llvm.x86.avx2.psllv/psrlv/psrav intrinsics
// directly (which both request +avx2 and pin the exact YMM opcode).  Every other
// cell (i386, AArch64, ARM32) uses the generic shl/lshr/ashr of <8 x i32> by a
// vector, which lowers to NEON ushl/sshl or a scalarized per-lane 32-bit shift —
// a path no narrower sample reaches, and (unlike a <4 x i64> variable shift,
// which 32-bit ISAs turn into __aeabi_ll*/__ashldi3 libcalls the rewrite image
// cannot resolve) one that stays libcall-free; the i64-lane shifts are therefore
// kept x86-64-only (single vpsllvq/vpsrlvq, no libcall).  Shift counts are masked
// to [0,width) so no lane is poison; the i32 data mixes sign so vpsravd
// (arithmetic) diverges from vpsrlvd (logical).  Per cell the original and
// obfuscated copies share the identical shift sub-graph (no L1 pass rewrites
// vector shifts), so they stay byte-identical over it; an undecoded YMM variable
// shift faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any divergence is
// a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Distinct position weights keep the
// lane-sum reduction order-sensitive; integer add/sub/mul/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxVarShift256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vvshift256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> data (sign-mixed) and per-lane shift count masked to [0,31].
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Dl =
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateXor(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x9E37 + 1)));
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(VD, Dl, uint64_t(I));
    llvm::Value *Sl = B.CreateAnd(
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 5 + 1)), B.getInt32(31));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(VS, Sl, uint64_t(I));
  }

  // <8 x i32> per-lane variable shifts: x86-64 pins the VEX.256 opcodes (and
  // requests +avx2) via the x86 intrinsics; other ISAs use the generic form.
  llvm::Value *Shl, *Lshr, *Ashr;
  if (IsX64) {
    Shl = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
    Lshr =
        B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psrlv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
    Ashr =
        B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psrav_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  } else {
    Shl = B.CreateShl(VD, VS);
    Lshr = B.CreateLShr(VD, VS);
    Ashr = B.CreateAShr(VD, VS);
  }

  // Reduce the three <8 x i32> results with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Shl, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Lshr, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 3)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Ashr, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 5)));

  // i64-lane variable shifts (vpsllvq/vpsrlvq) are x86-64-only: a generic
  // <4 x i64> variable shift would emit unresolved 64-bit shift libcalls on the
  // 32-bit ISAs.
  if (IsX64) {
    auto *Aq = B.CreateSExt(A, I64);
    auto *Cq = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
    llvm::Value *VQ = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
    llvm::Value *VSQ = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *Dq = B.CreateAdd(
          B.CreateMul(Aq, llvm::ConstantInt::getSigned(I64, (int64_t)I * 2 - 3)),
          B.CreateXor(Cq, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, I * 0x1234567ULL + 1)));
      VQ = B.CreateInsertElement(VQ, Dq, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *Sq =
          B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(Aq, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, I * 9 + 1)),
                      llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 63));
      VSQ = B.CreateInsertElement(VSQ, Sq, uint64_t(I));
    }
    auto *ShlQ =
        B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_q_256, {}, {VQ, VSQ});
    auto *LshrQ =
        B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psrlv_q_256, {}, {VQ, VSQ});
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *E = B.CreateExtractElement(ShlQ, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(E, I32);
      llvm::Value *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(E, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
      S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi), B.getInt32(I + 2)));
    }
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *E = B.CreateExtractElement(LshrQ, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(E, I32);
      llvm::Value *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(E, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
      S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi), B.getInt32(I + 4)));
    }
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword integer arithmetic on YMM — vpmulld / vpaddd /
// vpsubd (<8 x i32>), the dword-lane arithmetic family no PatchFull shape ever
// emitted.  vvshift256 first lit up +avx2 (variable shifts); this adds the
// packed dword multiply / add / subtract.  Like vvshift256 it stays
// dword-granularity throughout — the width the fork-Unicorn gen_sse_256 and
// every L1 pass (including the bit-masking pass that only runs under Xform::All)
// handle cleanly.
//
// Cross-ISA: a dword AVX2 op only reaches a YMM register once +avx2 is on, and
// CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off an "avx2"-named intrinsic.
// The packed add/sub/mul opcodes have no x86 intrinsic in this LLVM (they are
// generic IR), so the x86-64 cell pins one llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 (a real
// per-lane shift that also requests +avx2); with +avx2 live the generic
// mul/add/sub of <8 x i32> then lower to vpmulld/vpaddd/vpsubd ymm.  Every other
// cell uses the plain generic shift + arithmetic (NEON / scalarized), all
// libcall-free.  Per cell the original and obfuscated copies share the identical
// arithmetic sub-graph (no L1 pass changes its value), so they stay
// byte-identical over it under emulation; an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn
// baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any divergence is a real backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Sign-mixed dword data + distinct position weights keep the
// lane-sum reduction order-sensitive; integer add/sub/mul/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIArith256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viarith256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) and a per-lane shift count [0,7].
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1)),
                        B.getInt32(7)),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // x86-64 pins vpsllvd (and requests +avx2); other ISAs use the generic shift.
  llvm::Value *Sh;
  if (IsX64)
    Sh = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  else
    Sh = B.CreateShl(VD, VS);

  // Packed dword multiply / add / subtract -> vpmulld / vpaddd / vpsubd ymm.
  auto *Mul = B.CreateMul(Sh, VE);
  auto *Add = B.CreateAdd(Sh, VE);
  auto *Sub = B.CreateSub(VD, VE);

  // Reduce with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Mul, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Add, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 3)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Sub, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 5)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed signed/unsigned dword integer min/max on YMM —
// vpminsd / vpmaxsd / vpminud / vpmaxud (<8 x i32>), the dword-lane min/max
// family no PatchFull shape ever emitted.  viarith256 first lit up the +avx2
// dword arithmetic path (vpmulld/vpaddd/vpsubd); this adds the signed and
// unsigned packed dword min/max siblings.  The only prior min/max coverage was
// floating-point (maxnum/minnum in Float256/Double256) or scalar/128-bit
// integer, so the 256-bit YMM integer min/max opcodes were never produced.
//
// Cross-ISA: a dword AVX2 op only reaches a YMM register once +avx2 is on, and
// CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off an "avx2"-named intrinsic.
// The packed min/max opcodes have no x86 intrinsic in this LLVM (they are the
// generic llvm.smin/smax/umin/umax), so the x86-64 cell pins one
// llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 (a real per-lane shift that also requests +avx2)
// and feeds its result into the min/max; with +avx2 live the generic
// smin/smax/umin/umax of <8 x i32> then lower to
// vpminsd/vpmaxsd/vpminud/vpmaxud ymm.  Every other cell uses the plain generic
// shift + min/max (NEON smin/umin / scalarized), all libcall-free.  Per cell
// the original and obfuscated copies share the identical min/max sub-graph (no
// L1 pass changes its value), so they stay byte-identical over it under
// emulation; an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any divergence is a real backend / fork-Unicorn
// bug.  Sign-mixed dword data + distinct position weights keep the lane-sum
// reduction order-sensitive (so a swapped signed/unsigned min/max changes the
// sum); integer add/sub/mul/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) +
// a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMinMax256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viminmax256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) and a per-lane shift count [0,7].
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1)),
                        B.getInt32(7)),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // x86-64 pins vpsllvd (and requests +avx2); other ISAs use the generic shift.
  llvm::Value *Sh;
  if (IsX64)
    Sh = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  else
    Sh = B.CreateShl(VD, VS);

  // Packed signed/unsigned dword min/max ->
  // vpminsd/vpmaxsd/vpminud/vpmaxud ymm.
  auto *Smin = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, Sh, VE);
  auto *Smax = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, Sh, VE);
  auto *Umin = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, Sh, VE);
  auto *Umax = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, Sh, VE);

  // Reduce with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Smin, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Smax, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 3)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Umin, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 5)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Umax, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 7)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword integer compare on YMM — vpcmpeqd / vpcmpgtd
// (<8 x i32>), the dword-lane integer-compare family no PatchFull shape ever
// emitted.  The only prior 256-bit compare coverage was floating-point
// (vcmpne256's extended-predicate VCMPPS), so the integer YMM compare opcodes
// (equal + signed greater-than) were never produced.  viminmax256 added packed
// dword min/max; this adds the packed dword compares that underlie every
// branchless select/mask idiom.
//
// Cross-ISA: a dword AVX2 op only reaches a YMM register once +avx2 is on, and
// CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off an "avx2"-named intrinsic.
// The packed compare opcodes have no x86 intrinsic in this LLVM (they are the
// generic icmp + sext), so the x86-64 cell pins one llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256
// (a real per-lane shift that also requests +avx2) and feeds its result into the
// compares; with +avx2 live the generic sext(icmp eq/sgt) of <8 x i32> then
// lower to vpcmpeqd / vpcmpgtd ymm (the all-ones/zero lane mask the compare
// already yields, so the sext folds away; signed less-than reuses vpcmpgtd with
// swapped operands).  The masks are reduced directly — no vector select — so the
// shape stays pure dword compare + ALU and never emits the byte-granular
// variable blend (vpblendvb) the fork-Unicorn 256-bit decoder would have to
// model separately.  Every other cell uses the plain generic shift + icmp/sext
// (NEON cmeq/cmgt / scalarized), all libcall-free.  Per cell the original and
// obfuscated copies share the identical compare sub-graph (no L1 pass touches
// icmp/sext), so they stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an undecoded
// YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any divergence is
// a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Sign-mixed dword data + distinct position
// weights keep the lane-sum reduction order-sensitive (so a flipped eq/gt lane
// changes the sum); integer add/sub/mul/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxICmp256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vicmp256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) and a per-lane shift count [0,7].
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1)),
                        B.getInt32(7)),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // x86-64 pins vpsllvd (and requests +avx2); other ISAs use the generic shift.
  llvm::Value *Sh;
  if (IsX64)
    Sh = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  else
    Sh = B.CreateShl(VD, VS);

  // Packed dword compares -> vpcmpeqd / vpcmpgtd ymm.  sext the <8 x i1> result
  // back to <8 x i32> (the all-ones/zero mask the compare already yields) and
  // reduce the masks directly, so no vector select / variable blend is emitted.
  auto *Eq = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpEQ(Sh, VE), V8i);
  auto *Gt = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpSGT(Sh, VE), V8i);
  auto *Lt = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpSGT(VE, Sh), V8i);

  // Reduce with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Eq, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Gt, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 3)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Lt, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 5)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 byte / word / qword integer compares on YMM — vpcmpeqb/gtb
// (<32 x i8>), vpcmpeqw/gtw (<16 x i16>), vpcmpeqq/gtq (<4 x i64>): the compare
// widths vicmp256 (dword vpcmpeqd/gtd only) never produced.  Each width is a
// distinct opcode, and vpcmpgtq is AVX2's *signed 64-bit* compare with no SSE2
// equivalent; on the 32-bit ISAs (i386/ARM32) the <4 x i64> compare scalarizes
// into multi-register 64-bit compares -- a lowering no prior 256-bit shape
// reached.  On a 256-bit register each compare acts within its two 128-bit lanes
// independently, so a lane-agnostic (single-128) lowering would diverge.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 a dead llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors +avx2 (256-bit
// integer needs AVX2, not just AVX) so every compare lowers to a genuine
// vpcmpeq*/vpcmpgt* ymm rather than two 128-bit SSE compares; every other cell
// lowers the identical icmp+sext to NEON cmeq/cmgt (or scalarized 64-bit
// compares), libcall-free.  Each compare's <N x i1> result is sign-extended to
// the lane width (the all-ones/zero mask the compare already yields) and the
// mask lanes are reduced directly with distinct ascending/descending weights, so
// no vector select / variable blend is emitted and a swapped lane -- or a
// lane-agnostic compare -- changes the sum.  No L1 pass touches the compare
// sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it;
// an undecoded YMM compare faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and
// any value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Sign-mixed data
// + integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x7A7A/28541) + a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten /
// bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxICmpBWQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vicmpbwq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <32 x i8> operands (sign-mixed, runtime-derived).
  llvm::Value *VBa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VBb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VBa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VBa,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B + 3)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16) *
                                                  0x25))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VBb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VBb,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x2F + 7)),
                                  B.CreateSub(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x13))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  // <16 x i16> operands.
  llvm::Value *VWa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
  llvm::Value *VWb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    VWa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VWa,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x137 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8) *
                                                  0x2AB))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
    VWb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VWb,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                                  B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x511 + 9))),
                      I16),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  // <4 x i64> operands (full 64-bit, sign-varied high halves for vpcmpgtq).
  auto MkQ = [&](llvm::Value *Hi, llvm::Value *Lo) {
    return B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(Hi, I64), B.getInt64(32)),
                      B.CreateZExt(Lo, I64));
  };
  llvm::Value *VQa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
  llvm::Value *VQb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    VQa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VQa,
        MkQ(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x9E37 + 1)),
            B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x1234 + 7))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VQb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VQb,
        MkQ(B.CreateSub(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x55 + 3)),
            B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 11))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor (x86-64): keep the 256-bit YMM domain so the compares lower to
  // vpcmpeq*/vpcmpgt* ymm rather than two split 128-bit SSE compares.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VAa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VSa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VAa =
          B.CreateInsertElement(VAa, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VSa = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VSa, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {},
                            {VAa, VSa});
  }

  // Packed compares, sign-extended to the lane width (all-ones/zero mask).
  auto *EqB = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpEQ(VBa, VBb), V32b);  // vpcmpeqb
  auto *GtB = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpSGT(VBa, VBb), V32b); // vpcmpgtb
  auto *EqW = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpEQ(VWa, VWb), V16w);  // vpcmpeqw
  auto *GtW = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpSGT(VWa, VWb), V16w); // vpcmpgtw
