  auto *EqQ = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpEQ(VQa, VQb), V4q);   // vpcmpeqq
  auto *GtQ = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateICmpSGT(VQa, VQb), V4q);  // vpcmpgtq

  // Reduce mask lanes with distinct ascending/descending position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(EqB, uint64_t(I)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(I + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(GtB, uint64_t(I)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(32 - I)));
  }
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(EqW, uint64_t(I)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(I + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(GtW, uint64_t(I)),
                                    I32),
                       B.getInt32(16 - I)));
  }
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateExtractElement(EqQ, uint64_t(I)),
                                     I32),
                       B.getInt32(I + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateExtractElement(GtQ, uint64_t(I)),
                                     I32),
                       B.getInt32(4 - I)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x7A7A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(28541)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 VSIB gather on YMM — vpgatherdd via llvm.x86.avx2.gather.d.d.256:
// the first PatchFull shape to exercise a real hardware gather (per-lane load
// from base + <8 x i32> index * scale).  No prior 256-bit shape touched gather;
// it uniquely stresses (a) the rewrite backend relocating the gather base
// global's address (a RIP-relative lea into the GP base register that feeds the
// VSIB operand) and (b) fork-Unicorn's from-scratch VSIB gather emulation
// (gen_vsib_gather) end-to-end -- so far only decoded, never validated through
// the rewrite/patch path.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx2 gather intrinsic (its name carries "avx2" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx2) pins vpgatherdd ymm; every other
// cell open-codes the identical per-lane scalar gather (extractelement index ->
// GEP -> load -> insertelement), libcall-free.  The eight indices are
// runtime-derived from the inputs and masked in-bounds [0,15]; the gather mask
// is all-ones (every lane gathered), matching the emulator's "all lanes loaded,
// in-bounds" contract, so the passthrough src is irrelevant.  Each gathered lane
// is folded with distinct ascending and descending weights so a mis-routed lane
// changes the sum.  No L1 pass touches the gather sub-graph, so the original and
// obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it; an undecoded gather faults the
// Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine
// backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst /
// const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxGatherD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 16);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init;
  for (int I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    Init.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I32, (uint32_t)((I * 0x9E37 + 0x1234) ^ (I << 12) ^ 0x55AA)));
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init),
                                       "g_gtab");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vgatherd256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Eight runtime indices, each masked in-bounds [0,15].
  llvm::Value *Idx = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Iv =
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 7 + 1)),
                                B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x3B + 5))),
                    B.getInt32(15));
    Idx = B.CreateInsertElement(Idx, Iv, uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Gather g_gtab[idx[i]] for every lane (mask all-ones).
  llvm::Value *Res;
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *TabBase =
        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
    Res = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_gather_d_d_256, {},
                            {llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V8i), TabBase, Idx,
                             llvm::Constant::getAllOnesValue(V8i),
                             B.getInt8(4)});
  } else {
    Res = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *Ix = B.CreateExtractElement(Idx, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *EP =
          B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), Ix});
      Res = B.CreateInsertElement(Res, B.CreateLoad(I32, EP), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Res, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Res, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(8 - I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 VSIB *qword* gather on YMM — vpgatherdq via
// llvm.x86.avx2.gather.d.q.256: dword indices (<4 x i32>) gather qword values
// (<4 x i64>).  Sibling of vgatherd256 (dword->dword); the *qword-element*
// gather is a distinct VSIB element size (8-byte loads, scale 8) never
// exercised, and on 32-bit ISAs the <4 x i64> gather scalarizes to
// multi-register 64-bit loads.  Same dual value as vgatherd256: (a) the rewrite
// backend relocating the gather base global's address and (b) fork-Unicorn's
// gen_vsib_gather with an 8-byte element stride, end-to-end through the
// rewrite/patch path.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx2 gather intrinsic (its name carries "avx2" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx2) pins vpgatherdq ymm; every other
// cell open-codes the identical per-lane scalar i64 gather (extractelement
// index -> GEP -> load i64 -> insertelement), libcall-free.  The four indices
// are runtime-derived and masked in-bounds [0,15]; the gather mask is all-ones
// (every lane gathered), matching the emulator's "all lanes loaded, in-bounds"
// contract, so the passthrough src is irrelevant.  Each i64 lane is folded
// lo^hi to i32 (observing both dwords) with distinct ascending and descending
// weights so a mis-routed lane changes the sum.  No L1 pass touches the gather
// sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it;
// an undecoded gather faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any
// value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus /
// indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxGatherDQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4i32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V4i64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I64, 16);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init;
  for (int I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    Init.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I64, ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)(I * 0x9E3779B9u + 0x1234u) << 32) ^
                 (uint64_t)(uint32_t)((I * 0x2545F491u) ^ 0x55AA37C3u)));
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init),
                                       "g_gtabq");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vgatherdq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Four runtime indices, each masked in-bounds [0,15].
  llvm::Value *Idx = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i32);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Iv =
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 7 + 1)),
                                B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x3B + 5))),
                    B.getInt32(15));
    Idx = B.CreateInsertElement(Idx, Iv, uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Gather g_gtabq[idx[i]] (qword values) for every lane (mask all-ones).
  llvm::Value *Res;
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *TabBase =
        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
    Res = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_gather_d_q_256, {},
                            {llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V4i64), TabBase, Idx,
                             llvm::Constant::getAllOnesValue(V4i64),
                             B.getInt8(8)});
  } else {
    Res = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *Ix = B.CreateExtractElement(Idx, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), Ix});
      Res = B.CreateInsertElement(Res, B.CreateLoad(I64, EP), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Fold each i64 lane to i32 (lo ^ hi observes both dwords) with distinct
  // ascending / descending weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *L = B.CreateExtractElement(Res, uint64_t(I));
    llvm::Value *W = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(L, I32),
                                 B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, B.getInt64(32)),
                                               I32));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(W, B.getInt32(I + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(W, B.getInt32(4 - I)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 VSIB *qword-index narrowing* gather on YMM — vpgatherqd via
// llvm.x86.avx2.gather.q.d.256: qword indices (<4 x i64>, a full YMM index
// register) gather dword values (<4 x i32>, a 128-bit result whose upper lanes
// the hardware zeroes).  Sibling of vgatherd256 / vgatherdq256, which both use
// *dword* indices (VSIB idx_sz=4, opcode 0f38 90); the qword-index gather is
// opcode 0f38 91 (idx_sz=8) and is the *narrowing* case (n*val_sz < VL=32), so
// it exercises fork-Unicorn gen_vsib_gather's upper-lane zeroing path that the
// full-width dword-index gathers never reach.  On 32-bit ISAs the <4 x i64>
// index scalarizes to multi-register 64-bit index math.  Same dual value as the
// other gathers: (a) the rewrite backend relocating the gather base global's
// address and (b) fork-Unicorn's gen_vsib_gather, now with an 8-byte index
// stride plus result-zeroing, end-to-end through the rewrite/patch path.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx2 gather intrinsic (its name carries "avx2" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx2) pins vpgatherqd; every other cell
// open-codes the identical per-lane scalar i32 gather (extractelement i64 index
// -> GEP -> load i32 -> insertelement), libcall-free.  The four qword indices
// are runtime-derived and masked in-bounds [0,15]; the gather mask is all-ones
// (every lane gathered), matching the emulator's "all lanes loaded, in-bounds"
// contract, so the passthrough src is irrelevant.  Each i32 lane is folded with
// distinct ascending and descending weights so a mis-routed lane changes the
// sum.  No L1 pass touches the gather sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated
// copies stay byte-identical over it; an undecoded gather faults the Unicorn
// baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value divergence is a genuine backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxGatherQD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4i32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V4i64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 16);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init;
  for (int I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    Init.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I32, (uint32_t)(I * 0x9E3779B9u + 0x1234u) ^
                 (uint32_t)((I * 0x2545F491u) ^ 0x55AA37C3u)));
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init),
                                       "g_gtabqd");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vgatherqd256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Four runtime qword indices, each masked in-bounds [0,15].
  llvm::Value *Idx = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Iv =
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 7 + 1)),
                                B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x3B + 5))),
                    B.getInt32(15));
    Idx = B.CreateInsertElement(Idx, B.CreateZExt(Iv, I64), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Gather g_gtabqd[idx[i]] (dword values) for every lane (mask all-ones).
  llvm::Value *Res;
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *TabBase =
        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
    Res = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_gather_q_d_256, {},
                            {llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V4i32), TabBase, Idx,
                             llvm::Constant::getAllOnesValue(V4i32),
                             B.getInt8(4)});
  } else {
    Res = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i32);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *Ix = B.CreateExtractElement(Idx, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), Ix});
      Res = B.CreateInsertElement(Res, B.CreateLoad(I32, EP), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Fold each i32 lane with distinct ascending / descending weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *W = B.CreateExtractElement(Res, uint64_t(I));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(W, B.getInt32(I + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(W, B.getInt32(4 - I)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 VSIB *full-width* qword-index qword-value gather on YMM —
// vpgatherqq via llvm.x86.avx2.gather.q.q.256: qword indices (<4 x i64>, a full
// YMM index register) gather qword values (<4 x i64>, a full YMM result).  This
// completes the 256-bit VSIB gather matrix: vgatherd256 (d.d, dword idx -> dword
// val), vgatherdq256 (d.q, dword idx -> qword val), vgatherqd256 (q.d, qword idx
// -> dword val, the *narrowing* case with upper-lane zeroing), and now this q.q
// *full-width* case (opcode 0f38 91, idx_sz=8, val_sz=8, n*val_sz == VL=32, no
// narrowing).  Unlike vgatherqd256 it produces a full 256-bit result with no
// upper-lane zeroing, so it drives fork-Unicorn gen_vsib_gather with both an
// 8-byte index stride and an 8-byte value stride over every lane.  On 32-bit
// ISAs both the <4 x i64> index and value scalarize to multi-register 64-bit
// math and loads.  Same dual value as the rest of the gather family: (a) the
// rewrite backend relocating the gather base global's address and (b)
// fork-Unicorn's gen_vsib_gather end-to-end through the rewrite/patch path.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx2 gather intrinsic (its name carries "avx2" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx2) pins vpgatherqq; every other cell
// open-codes the identical per-lane scalar i64 gather (extractelement i64 index
// -> GEP -> load i64 -> insertelement), libcall-free.  The four qword indices
// are runtime-derived and masked in-bounds [0,15]; the gather mask is all-ones
// (every lane gathered), matching the emulator's "all lanes loaded, in-bounds"
// contract, so the passthrough src is irrelevant.  Each i64 lane is folded to
// i32 (lo ^ hi observes both dwords) with distinct ascending and descending
// weights so a mis-routed lane changes the sum.  No L1 pass touches the gather
// sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it;
// an undecoded gather faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any
// value divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus /
// indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxGatherQQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4i64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I64, 16);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Init;
  for (int I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    Init.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I64, ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)(I * 0x9E3779B9u + 0x1234u) << 32) ^
                 (uint64_t)(uint32_t)((I * 0x2545F491u) ^ 0x55AA37C3u)));
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Init),
                                       "g_gtabqq");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vgatherqq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Four runtime qword indices, each masked in-bounds [0,15].
  llvm::Value *Idx = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Iv =
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 7 + 1)),
                                B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x3B + 5))),
                    B.getInt32(15));
    Idx = B.CreateInsertElement(Idx, B.CreateZExt(Iv, I64), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Gather g_gtabqq[idx[i]] (qword values) for every lane (mask all-ones).
  llvm::Value *Res;
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *TabBase =
        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
    Res = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_gather_q_q_256, {},
                            {llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V4i64), TabBase, Idx,
                             llvm::Constant::getAllOnesValue(V4i64),
                             B.getInt8(8)});
  } else {
    Res = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
      llvm::Value *Ix = B.CreateExtractElement(Idx, uint64_t(I));
      llvm::Value *EP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, {B.getInt32(0), Ix});
      Res = B.CreateInsertElement(Res, B.CreateLoad(I64, EP), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Fold each i64 lane to i32 (lo ^ hi observes both dwords) with distinct
  // ascending / descending weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *L = B.CreateExtractElement(Res, uint64_t(I));
    llvm::Value *W = B.CreateXor(
        B.CreateTrunc(L, I32),
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, B.getInt64(32)), I32));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(W, B.getInt32(I + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(W, B.getInt32(4 - I)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 masked contiguous load + store on YMM — vpmaskmovd via
// llvm.x86.avx2.maskload.d.256 / maskstore.d.256: a per-lane sign-bit mask
// (bit31 of each <8 x i32> lane) selects which lanes are loaded from / stored to
// a *contiguous* global base — masked-off load lanes read 0, masked-off store
// lanes leave memory unchanged.  This is the *masked contiguous* memory-op
// sibling of the VSIB *scattered* gather family (vgather*256): both are
// conditional, mask-register-driven memory ops, but maskmov addresses a single
// contiguous base with no index vector (VEX.256.66.0F38.8C load / 8E store, W0
// dword) — a decode/codegen path no gather or other 256-bit shape ever reached.
// On 32-bit ISAs the intrinsics are x86-only; every other cell open-codes the
// exact same semantics (full 256-bit load + select for maskload; load + select
// + store for maskstore), so all lanes are in-bounds and the open-code is
// equivalent to the hardware masked op.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx2 intrinsic (its name carries "avx2" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx2) pins vpmaskmovd ymm for both the
// load and the store; every other cell open-codes select(mask<0, ...) over a
// plain contiguous <8 x i32> load/store, libcall-free.  Two runtime per-lane
// masks (M1 for the load, M2 for the store) are derived from the args so their
// bit31 flags vary at run time and the backend cannot fold the masked ops to
// constants.  The store target g_mmdst is a writable global read back and
// byte-compared by the harness; g_mmsrc is a read-only source.  No L1 pass
// touches the masked-mov sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay
// byte-identical over it; an undecoded vpmaskmovd faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any value/data divergence is a genuine backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxMaskMov256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I1 = llvm::Type::getInt1Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 8);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> SrcInit, DstInit;
  for (int I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    SrcInit.push_back(
        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, (uint32_t)(I * 0x9E3779B9u + 0x51EDu)));
    DstInit.push_back(
        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, (uint32_t)(I * 0x2545F491u ^ 0x1357BDF9u)));
  }
  auto *Src = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, SrcInit),
                                       "g_mmsrc");
  Src->setDSOLocal(true);
  auto *Dst = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, DstInit),
                                       "g_mmdst");
  Dst->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmaskmov256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *SrcBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Src, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *DstBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Dst, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *Zero = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V8i32);

  // Two runtime per-lane sign-bit masks (bit31 set -> lane active).
  llvm::Value *M1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i32);
  llvm::Value *M2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i32);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    auto *B1 = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(A, B.getInt32(I % 5)),
                                         B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1))),
                             I1);
    auto *B2 = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                                         B.CreateLShr(C, B.getInt32((I + 2) % 5))),
                             I1);
    M1 = B.CreateInsertElement(M1, B.CreateSExt(B1, I32), uint64_t(I));
    M2 = B.CreateInsertElement(M2, B.CreateSExt(B2, I32), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Masked load g_mmsrc under M1 (masked-off lanes read 0).
  llvm::Value *Loaded;
  if (IsX64) {
    Loaded = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_maskload_d_256, {},
                               {SrcBase, M1});
  } else {
    auto *Full = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V8i32, SrcBase, llvm::Align(4));
    Loaded = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M1, Zero), Full, Zero);
  }

  // Transform, then masked store to g_mmdst under M2 (masked-off lanes keep the
  // existing memory contents).
  auto *Res = B.CreateAdd(Loaded, B.CreateVectorSplat(8, A));
  if (IsX64) {
    B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_maskstore_d_256, {},
                      {DstBase, M2, Res});
  } else {
    auto *Cur = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V8i32, DstBase, llvm::Align(4));
    auto *New = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M2, Zero), Res, Cur);
    B.CreateAlignedStore(New, DstBase, llvm::Align(4));
  }

  // Read back g_mmdst (full load) and fold all lanes with ascending weights.
  auto *Back = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V8i32, DstBase, llvm::Align(4));
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Back, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 *qword* masked contiguous load + store on YMM — vpmaskmovq via
// llvm.x86.avx2.maskload.q.256 / maskstore.q.256: the qword (VEX.W1) sibling of
// vmaskmov256.  A per-lane sign-bit mask (bit63 of each <4 x i64> lane) selects
// which lanes are loaded from / stored to a *contiguous* global base — masked-off
// load lanes read 0, masked-off store lanes leave memory unchanged.  This is the
// dedicated exercise for the W1 (qword) arm of the 0F38 8C/8E decode: vmaskmov256
// only drives the W0 (dword) arm, so without this shape the qword lane stride is
// never emulated end to end.  On 32-bit ISAs the <4 x i64> mask/value scalarize to
// multi-register 64-bit ops; every other cell open-codes the identical semantics
// (full 256-bit load + select for maskload; load + select + store for maskstore).
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx2 intrinsic (its name carries "avx2" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx2) pins vpmaskmovq ymm for both the
// load and the store; every other cell open-codes select(mask<0, ...) over a plain
// contiguous <4 x i64> load/store, libcall-free.  Two runtime per-lane masks (M1
// for the load, M2 for the store) are derived from the args so their bit63 flags
// vary at run time and the backend cannot fold the masked ops to constants.  The
// store target g_mmqdst is a writable global read back and byte-compared by the
// harness; g_mmqsrc is a read-only source.  No L1 pass touches the masked-mov
// sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it; an
// undecoded vpmaskmovq faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any
// value/data divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect
// L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxMaskMovQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I1 = llvm::Type::getInt1Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4i64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I64, 4);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> SrcInit, DstInit;
  for (int I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    SrcInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I64, (uint64_t)I * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull + 0x51EDull));
    DstInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I64, ((uint64_t)I * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dull) ^ 0x1357BDF9ACE24680ull));
  }
  auto *Src = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, SrcInit),
                                       "g_mmqsrc");
  Src->setDSOLocal(true);
  auto *Dst = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, DstInit),
                                       "g_mmqdst");
  Dst->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmaskmovq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *SrcBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Src, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *DstBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Dst, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *Zero = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V4i64);

  // Two runtime per-lane sign-bit masks (bit63 set -> lane active).
  llvm::Value *M1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
  llvm::Value *M2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    auto *B1 = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(A, B.getInt32(I % 5)),
                                         B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1))),
                             I1);
    auto *B2 = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateLShr(C, B.getInt32((I + 2) % 5))),
        I1);
    M1 = B.CreateInsertElement(M1, B.CreateSExt(B1, I64), uint64_t(I));
    M2 = B.CreateInsertElement(M2, B.CreateSExt(B2, I64), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Masked load g_mmqsrc under M1 (masked-off lanes read 0).
  llvm::Value *Loaded;
  if (IsX64) {
    Loaded = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_maskload_q_256, {},
                               {SrcBase, M1});
  } else {
    auto *Full = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V4i64, SrcBase, llvm::Align(8));
    Loaded = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M1, Zero), Full, Zero);
  }

  // Transform, then masked store to g_mmqdst under M2 (masked-off lanes keep the
  // existing memory contents).
  auto *Res = B.CreateAdd(Loaded, B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.CreateZExt(A, I64)));
  if (IsX64) {
    B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_maskstore_q_256, {},
                      {DstBase, M2, Res});
  } else {
    auto *Cur = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V4i64, DstBase, llvm::Align(8));
    auto *New = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M2, Zero), Res, Cur);
    B.CreateAlignedStore(New, DstBase, llvm::Align(8));
  }

  // Read back g_mmqdst (full load); fold each i64 lane's lo^hi with ascending
  // weights so a mis-routed lane changes the sum.
  auto *Back = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V4i64, DstBase, llvm::Align(8));
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(Back, uint64_t(I));
    auto *Folded = B.CreateXor(
        B.CreateTrunc(L, I32),
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, B.getInt64(32)), I32));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(Folded, B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX (VEX.256) *float* masked contiguous load + store on YMM —
// vmaskmovps via llvm.x86.avx.maskload.ps.256 / maskstore.ps.256: the FP sibling
// of vmaskmov256 (integer vpmaskmovd).  A per-lane sign-bit mask (bit31 of each
// <8 x i32> lane) selects which lanes are loaded from / stored to a contiguous
// global base — masked-off load lanes read 0, masked-off store lanes leave
// memory unchanged.  The FP maskmov is a *different opcode* from the integer one
// — VEX.256.66.0F38.W0 2C load / 2E store, vs the integer 0F38 8C/8E — so it
// drives a decode path the integer maskmov shapes never touched.  The moved data
// is treated as raw bit patterns (the globals are [8 x i32], read back as
// <8 x i32> and folded), so the check is byte-exact and libcall/rounding-free —
// maskmov is pure data movement, not FP arithmetic.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx intrinsic (its name carries "avx" ->
// detectTargetFeaturesX86 auto-enables +avx + an AVX CPU model) pins vmaskmovps
// ymm for both the load and the store; every other cell open-codes
// select(mask<0, ...) over a plain contiguous <8 x float> load/store,
// libcall-free.  Two runtime per-lane masks (M1 for the load, M2 for the store)
// are derived from the args so their bit31 flags vary at run time and the
// backend cannot fold the masked ops to constants.  The store target g_mmpsdst
// is a writable global read back and byte-compared by the harness; g_mmpssrc is
// a read-only source.  No L1 pass touches the masked-mov sub-graph, so the
// original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it; an undecoded
// vmaskmovps faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any
// value/data divergence is a genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxMaskMovPS256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                        const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I1 = llvm::Type::getInt1Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8i32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V8f32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 8);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 8);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> SrcInit, DstInit;
  for (int I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    SrcInit.push_back(
        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, (uint32_t)I * 0x9E3779B9u + 0x51EDu));
    DstInit.push_back(
        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, ((uint32_t)I * 0x2545F491u) ^ 0xACE24680u));
  }
  auto *Src = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, SrcInit),
                                       "g_mmpssrc");
  Src->setDSOLocal(true);
  auto *Dst = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, DstInit),
                                       "g_mmpsdst");
  Dst->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmaskmovps256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *SrcBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Src, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *DstBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Dst, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *ZeroI = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V8i32);
  auto *ZeroF = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V8f32);

  // Two runtime per-lane sign-bit masks (bit31 set -> lane active).
  llvm::Value *M1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i32);
  llvm::Value *M2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i32);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    auto *B1 = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(A, B.getInt32(I % 5)),
                                         B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1))),
                             I1);
    auto *B2 = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateLShr(C, B.getInt32((I + 2) % 5))),
        I1);
    M1 = B.CreateInsertElement(M1, B.CreateSExt(B1, I32), uint64_t(I));
    M2 = B.CreateInsertElement(M2, B.CreateSExt(B2, I32), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Masked load g_mmpssrc under M1 (masked-off lanes read 0).
  llvm::Value *Loaded; // <8 x float>
  if (IsX64) {
    Loaded = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx_maskload_ps_256, {},
                               {SrcBase, M1});
  } else {
    auto *Full = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V8f32, SrcBase, llvm::Align(4));
    Loaded = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M1, ZeroI), Full, ZeroF);
  }

  // Transform in the integer domain (byte-exact, no FP rounding), then masked
  // store to g_mmpsdst under M2 (masked-off lanes keep existing contents).
  auto *ResF = B.CreateBitCast(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateBitCast(Loaded, V8i32), B.CreateVectorSplat(8, A)),
      V8f32);
  if (IsX64) {
    B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx_maskstore_ps_256, {},
                      {DstBase, M2, ResF});
  } else {
    auto *Cur = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V8f32, DstBase, llvm::Align(4));
    auto *New = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M2, ZeroI), ResF, Cur);
    B.CreateAlignedStore(New, DstBase, llvm::Align(4));
  }

  // Read back g_mmpsdst as raw dwords; fold each lane with ascending weights so
  // a mis-routed lane changes the sum.
  auto *Back = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V8i32, DstBase, llvm::Align(4));
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(Back, uint64_t(I));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(L, B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX (VEX.256) *double* masked contiguous load + store on YMM —
// vmaskmovpd via llvm.x86.avx.maskload.pd.256 / maskstore.pd.256: the qword FP
// sibling of vmaskmovps256.  A per-lane sign-bit mask (bit63 of each <4 x i64>
// lane) selects which lanes are loaded from / stored to a contiguous global base
// — masked-off load lanes read 0, masked-off store lanes leave memory
// unchanged.  This drives the W1 (pd, qword-lane) FP maskmov opcodes
// VEX.256.66.0F38.W1 2D load / 2F store — distinct from both the integer 8C/8E
// and the ps 2C/2E arms.  As with the ps shape the moved data is raw bit
// patterns ([4 x i64] globals, read back as <4 x i64> and folded), so the check
// is byte-exact and libcall/rounding-free.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the avx intrinsic pins vmaskmovpd ymm for both the load
// and the store; every other cell open-codes select(mask<0, ...) over a plain
// contiguous <4 x double> load/store (the <4 x i64> mask/value scalarize to
// multi-register 64-bit ops on 32-bit ISAs), libcall-free.  Two runtime per-lane
// masks (M1 load, M2 store) keep bit63 varying at run time so the backend cannot
// fold the masked ops to constants.  g_mmpddst is a writable global read back and
// byte-compared; g_mmpdsrc is a read-only source.  No L1 pass touches the
// masked-mov sub-graph, so orig/obfuscated stay byte-identical over it; an
// undecoded vmaskmovpd faults the Unicorn baseline and any divergence is a
// genuine backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5C5C/33203) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxMaskMovPD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                        const char *Triple) {

  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);

  auto *I1 = llvm::Type::getInt1Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);

  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4i64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *V4f64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 4);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I64, 4);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> SrcInit, DstInit;
  for (int I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    SrcInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I64, (uint64_t)I * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull + 0x51EDull));
    DstInit.push_back(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
        I64, ((uint64_t)I * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dull) ^ 0x1357BDF9ACE24680ull));
  }
  auto *Src = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, SrcInit),
                                       "g_mmpdsrc");
  Src->setDSOLocal(true);
  auto *Dst = new llvm::GlobalVariable(*M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false,
                                       llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                       llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, DstInit),
                                       "g_mmpddst");
  Dst->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmaskmovpd256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *SrcBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Src, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *DstBase =
      B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Dst, {B.getInt32(0), B.getInt32(0)});
  auto *ZeroI = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V4i64);
  auto *ZeroF = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V4f64);

  // Two runtime per-lane sign-bit masks (bit63 set -> lane active).
  llvm::Value *M1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
  llvm::Value *M2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i64);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    auto *B1 = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(A, B.getInt32(I % 5)),
                                         B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1))),
                             I1);
    auto *B2 = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateLShr(C, B.getInt32((I + 2) % 5))),
        I1);
    M1 = B.CreateInsertElement(M1, B.CreateSExt(B1, I64), uint64_t(I));
    M2 = B.CreateInsertElement(M2, B.CreateSExt(B2, I64), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Masked load g_mmpdsrc under M1 (masked-off lanes read 0).
  llvm::Value *Loaded; // <4 x double>
  if (IsX64) {
    Loaded = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx_maskload_pd_256, {},
                               {SrcBase, M1});
  } else {
    auto *Full = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V4f64, SrcBase, llvm::Align(8));
    Loaded = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M1, ZeroI), Full, ZeroF);
  }

  // Transform in the integer domain (byte-exact, no FP rounding), then masked
  // store to g_mmpddst under M2 (masked-off lanes keep existing contents).
  auto *ResF = B.CreateBitCast(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateBitCast(Loaded, V4i64),
                  B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.CreateZExt(A, I64))),
      V4f64);
  if (IsX64) {
    B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx_maskstore_pd_256, {},
                      {DstBase, M2, ResF});
  } else {
    auto *Cur = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V4f64, DstBase, llvm::Align(8));
    auto *New = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(M2, ZeroI), ResF, Cur);
    B.CreateAlignedStore(New, DstBase, llvm::Align(8));
  }

  // Read back g_mmpddst; fold each i64 lane's lo^hi with ascending weights so a
  // mis-routed lane changes the sum.
  auto *Back = B.CreateAlignedLoad(V4i64, DstBase, llvm::Align(8));
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(Back, uint64_t(I));
    auto *Folded =
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(L, I32),
                    B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, B.getInt64(32)), I32));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(Folded, B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(33203)));
  auto *BaseV = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword integer *uniform* shift on YMM — vpslld / vpsrld /
// vpsrad ymm by a single xmm count (<8 x i32>), the dword-lane shift-by-scalar
// family no PatchFull shape ever emitted.  vvshift256 covered the *per-lane
// variable* shifts (vpsllvd/vpsrlvd/vpsravd); this covers the sibling uniform
// (splat) shifts where every lane shares one runtime count, which lower to the
// distinct vpslld/vpsrld/vpsrad-by-xmm-count opcodes — neither the per-lane VEX
// variable forms nor the imm8 forms.
//
// Cross-ISA: a dword AVX2 op only reaches a YMM register once +avx2 is on, and
// CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off an "avx2"-named intrinsic;
// a generic splat shift carries no such name, so the x86-64 cell pins one
// llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 (a real per-lane shift that also requests +avx2) and
// feeds its result into the uniform shifts; with +avx2 live the generic
// shl/lshr/ashr of <8 x i32> by a splat count then lower to vpslld/vpsrld/vpsrad
// ymm (xmm count).  Every other cell uses the plain generic shift (NEON
// ushl/sshl by a splat shift vector / scalarized), all libcall-free.  Per cell
// the original and obfuscated copies share the identical shift sub-graph (no L1
// pass changes its value), so they stay byte-identical over it under emulation;
// an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any
// divergence is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Sign-mixed dword data +
// distinct position weights keep the lane-sum reduction order-sensitive; the
// shared count is masked to [0,31] so every shift is well-defined; integer
// add/sub/mul/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxUShift256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vushift256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> data (sign-mixed) and a per-lane count [0,31] for the +avx2 anchor.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 5 + 1)),
                        B.getInt32(31)),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // x86-64 pins vpsllvd (and requests +avx2); other ISAs use the generic shift.
  llvm::Value *Sh;
  if (IsX64)
    Sh = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  else
    Sh = B.CreateShl(VD, VS);

  // One runtime count shared by every lane (splat) -> vpslld / vpsrld / vpsrad
  // ymm by xmm count (the uniform-shift opcodes, distinct from vvshift256's
  // per-lane vpsllvd/vpsrlvd/vpsravd).
  auto *Cnt = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(31));
  auto *Splat = B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Cnt);
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(Sh, Splat);
  auto *Lshr = B.CreateLShr(Sh, Splat);
  auto *Ashr = B.CreateAShr(Sh, Splat);

  // Reduce the three <8 x i32> results with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Shl, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Lshr, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 3)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Ashr, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 5)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed word multiply-add on YMM — vpmaddwd (<16 x i16> in,
// <8 x i32> out), the word-pair mul+horizontal-add family no PatchFull shape
// ever emitted.  All prior 256-bit integer-YMM coverage stayed at dword
// granularity (viarith256/viminmax256/vicmp256/vushift256); vpmaddwd is the
// first shape that reaches the 16-bit-lane multiply-add opcode on YMM.
//
// Cross-ISA: llvm.x86.avx2.pmadd.wd is a real avx2-named intrinsic on x86-64
// (requests +avx2 directly — no psllv anchor needed).  The operands are built
// as <8 x i32> (sign-mixed, runtime) and bitcast to <16 x i16> before the
// intrinsic: trunc+insert into i16 lanes is rewritten by ValueLaunder/BitMasking
// (Xform::All) into undecodable ops, while the i32 insert+bitcast subgraph is
// identical in both copies and survives every L1 pass.  Non-x64 cells expand the
// pair-wise i16 mul+add in scalar/generic form (NEON widening mul + add /
// scalarized), all libcall-free.  Per cell the original and obfuscated copies
// share the identical pmadd sub-graph (no L1 pass changes its value), so they
// stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an undecoded YMM op faults the
// Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID) and any divergence is a real backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Distinct position weights on the <8 x i32> reduction keep
// the lane-sum order-sensitive; integer add/sub/mul/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIPMadd256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vipmadd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) -> bitcast to <16 x i16> for pmadd.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *VA = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V16h);
  auto *VB = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V16h);

  // vpmaddwd ymm on x86-64; generic pair-wise i16 mul+add elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *Madd;
  if (IsX64)
    Madd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmadd_wd, {}, {VA, VB});
  else {
    Madd = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      auto *P0 = B.CreateMul(
          B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VA, 2 * I), I32),
          B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VB, 2 * I), I32));
      auto *P1 = B.CreateMul(
          B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VA, 2 * I + 1), I32),
          B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VB, 2 * I + 1), I32));
      Madd = B.CreateInsertElement(Madd, B.CreateAdd(P0, P1), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Reduce with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Madd, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword absolute value on YMM — vpabsd (<8 x i32>), the
// dword-lane abs family no PatchFull shape ever emitted at 256-bit width.
// vabsi covers <4 x i32> (SSE2 SWAR expand, no native pabsd); this is the first
// shape that reaches the 256-bit vpabsd ymm opcode once +avx2 is live.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpabsd has no x86 intrinsic in this LLVM (it is generic llvm.abs),
// so the x86-64 cell pins llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 (+avx2) and feeds its
// result into llvm.abs of <8 x i32>; with +avx2 live the abs then lowers to
// vpabsd ymm (not the SSSE3 SWAR psrad/pxor/psub expand vabsi uses at 128-bit).
// Every other cell uses generic shift + abs (NEON abs / scalarized), all
// libcall-free.  is_int_min_poison=false keeps abs(INT_MIN) well-defined.  No L1
// pass touches abs, so orig/obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over the abs
// sub-graph; an undecoded YMM op faults Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIAbs256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I1 = llvm::Type::getInt1Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viabs256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1)),
                        B.getInt32(7)),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  llvm::Value *Sh;
  if (IsX64)
    Sh = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  else
    Sh = B.CreateShl(VD, VS);

  auto *False = llvm::ConstantInt::get(I1, 0);
  auto *Ab = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8i}, {Sh, False});
  auto *Ad = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8i},
                               {B.CreateSub(Sh, VE), False});

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Ab, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Ad, uint64_t(I)),
                                   B.getInt32(I + 3)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed unsigned rounding average on YMM — vpavgw (<16 x i16>)
// and vpavgb (<32 x i8>), the packed-average family no PatchFull shape ever
// emitted.  Average is its own arithmetic class (dst = (a+b+1)>>1, unsigned,
// widened so the intermediate sum never overflows): distinct from the dword
// mul/add/sub of viarith256, the word multiply-add of vipmadd256, and the
// min/max/abs/logical siblings.  These are the first shapes to reach the
// 256-bit vpavgw / vpavgb ymm opcodes once +avx2 is live.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpavg{w,b} DO have x86 intrinsics (llvm.x86.avx2.pavg.{w,b}) that
// themselves request +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins them directly (no psllv pin
// needed) and they lower straight to vpavgw / vpavgb ymm.  Every other cell
// open-codes the identical unsigned rounding average — zext to the next width,
// add, +1, lshr 1, truncate back — which lowers to NEON urhadd / a scalarized
// widen-add-shift, all libcall-free and numerically equal to the hardware avg.
// No L1 pass rewrites the average sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated
// copies stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an undecoded YMM op faults
// the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  zext-then-weighted-sum with
// distinct per-lane weights (the 16 word lanes and the 32 byte lanes use
// different weight bases) keeps the reduction order-sensitive, while integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus /
// indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIAvg256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viavg256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime), reinterpreted as the word and
  // byte lane vectors the average opcodes consume.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *VAw = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V16h);
  auto *VBw = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V16h);
  auto *VAb = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V32b);
  auto *VBb = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V32b);

  // vpavgw / vpavgb ymm on x86-64; open-coded unsigned rounding average else.
  llvm::Value *AvgW, *AvgB;
  if (IsX64) {
    AvgW = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pavg_w, {}, {VAw, VBw});
    AvgB = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pavg_b, {}, {VAb, VBb});
  } else {
    AvgW = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
      auto *Av = B.CreateLShr(
          B.CreateAdd(
              B.CreateAdd(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VAw, I), I32),
                          B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VBw, I), I32)),
              B.getInt32(1)),
          B.getInt32(1));
      AvgW = B.CreateInsertElement(AvgW, B.CreateTrunc(Av, I16), uint64_t(I));
    }
    AvgB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
      auto *Av = B.CreateLShr(
          B.CreateAdd(
              B.CreateAdd(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VAb, I), I16),
                          B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VBb, I), I16)),
              B.getInt16(1)),
          B.getInt16(1));
      AvgB = B.CreateInsertElement(AvgB, B.CreateTrunc(Av, I8), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Reduce both averages (zext lanes to i32) with distinct per-lane weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(AvgW, uint64_t(I)), I32),
               B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(AvgB, uint64_t(I)), I32),
               B.getInt32(I + 3)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 byte multiply-add with signed saturation on YMM — vpmaddubsw
// (<32 x i8> unsigned * <32 x i8> signed -> <16 x i16> saturated).  This is the
// byte/saturating sibling of vipmadd256 (vpmaddwd: word*word -> dword, no
// saturation): it pairs UNSIGNED low-operand bytes with SIGNED high-operand
// bytes, multiplies, sums adjacent pairs, and clamps each word to
// [-32768, 32767].  No prior PatchFull shape emitted a saturating byte
// multiply-add, and none reached vpmaddubsw at 256-bit width.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpmaddubsw has a dedicated x86 intrinsic (llvm.x86.avx2.pmadd.ub.sw)
// that itself requests +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins it directly (no psllv pin
// needed) and it lowers straight to vpmaddubsw ymm.  Every other cell open-codes
// the identical operation — zext the unsigned bytes, sext the signed bytes,
// multiply, add the adjacent pair in i32, clamp with llvm.smin/llvm.smax to the
// i16 range, truncate — which lowers to NEON widening multiply + saturating
// narrow / a scalarized clamp, all libcall-free (i32-domain only; no i64
// multiply).  No L1 pass rewrites the multiply-add sub-graph, so the original and
// obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an undecoded YMM
// op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  sext-then-weighted-sum
// (the saturated words are signed) with distinct per-lane weights keeps the
// reduction order-sensitive, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst /
// const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMaddUB256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimaddub256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) -> bitcast to <32 x i8> byte lanes.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *VAb = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V32b); // unsigned operand
  auto *VBb = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V32b); // signed operand

  // vpmaddubsw ymm on x86-64; open-coded saturating byte madd elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *Madd;
  if (IsX64) {
    Madd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmadd_ub_sw, {},
                             {VAb, VBb});
  } else {
    Madd = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
      auto *P0 = B.CreateMul(
          B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VAb, 2 * I), I32),
          B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VBb, 2 * I), I32));
      auto *P1 = B.CreateMul(
          B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VAb, 2 * I + 1), I32),
          B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VBb, 2 * I + 1), I32));
      llvm::Value *Sum = B.CreateAdd(P0, P1);
      Sum = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {I32},
                              {Sum, B.getInt32(32767)});
      Sum = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {I32},
                              {Sum, B.getInt32(-32768)});
      Madd = B.CreateInsertElement(Madd, B.CreateTrunc(Sum, I16), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Reduce (sext signed words to i32) with distinct per-lane position weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Madd, uint64_t(I)), I32),
               B.getInt32(I + 1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
