  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed multiply-high signed/unsigned word on YMM -- vpmulhw
// (<16 x i16>, signed) and vpmulhuw (<16 x i16>, unsigned), the multiply-HIGH
// family no 256-bit PatchFull shape ever emitted.  Multiply-high keeps the top
// 16 bits of each 16x16 -> 32 product (dst = (a*b) >> 16): a distinct
// arithmetic class from the low dword multiply of viarith256 (vpmulld), the
// word/byte multiply-ADD of vipmadd256 (vpmaddwd) / vimaddub256 (vpmaddubsw),
// and the rounding average of viavg256.  The 128-bit vmulhi already covers
// <8 x i16> pmulhw/pmulhuw; this is the first shape to reach the 256-bit
// vpmulhw / vpmulhuw ymm opcodes once +avx2 is live.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpmulh{,u}w have dedicated x86 intrinsics (llvm.x86.avx2.pmulh.w /
// pmulhu.w) that themselves request +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins them
// directly (no psllv pin needed) and they lower straight to vpmulhw / vpmulhuw
// ymm.  Every other cell open-codes the identical multiply-high -- widen each
// i16 lane to i32 (sext for the signed half, zext for the unsigned half),
// multiply, ashr / lshr 16, truncate back -- which lowers to NEON smull/umull +
// shrn / a scalarized widen-mul-shift, all libcall-free (i32-domain only; no
// i64 multiply).  No L1 pass rewrites the multiply sub-graph, so the original
// and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an
// undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).
// sext/zext-then-weighted-sum (signed high sign-extended, unsigned high
// zero-extended) with distinct per-lane weights keeps the reduction
// order-sensitive, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMulH256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimulh256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) -> bitcast to <16 x i16> word lanes.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *VA = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V16h);
  auto *VB = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V16h);

  // vpmulhw / vpmulhuw ymm on x86-64; open-coded widen-mul-shift elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *MulHS, *MulHU;
  if (IsX64) {
    MulHS = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmulh_w, {}, {VA, VB});
    MulHU = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmulhu_w, {}, {VA, VB});
  } else {
    MulHS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
    MulHU = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
      auto *Ai = B.CreateExtractElement(VA, I);
      auto *Bi = B.CreateExtractElement(VB, I);
      auto *Ps = B.CreateAShr(
          B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(Ai, I32), B.CreateSExt(Bi, I32)),
          B.getInt32(16));
      MulHS = B.CreateInsertElement(MulHS, B.CreateTrunc(Ps, I16), uint64_t(I));
      auto *Pu = B.CreateLShr(
          B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(Ai, I32), B.CreateZExt(Bi, I32)),
          B.getInt32(16));
      MulHU = B.CreateInsertElement(MulHU, B.CreateTrunc(Pu, I16), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Reduce: signed high via sext, unsigned high via zext; distinct per-lane
  // position weights keep the sum order-sensitive.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(MulHS, uint64_t(I)), I32),
               B.getInt32(I + 1)));
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(MulHU, uint64_t(I)), I32),
               B.getInt32(I + 3)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed multiply-high with round and scale on YMM -- vpmulhrsw
// (<16 x i16>, signed), the rounding/scaling sibling of vimulh256's plain
// multiply-high.  Unlike vpmulhw (top 16 bits of a*b) this scales by 2^-15 with
// round-to-nearest: dst = ((((a*b) >> 14) + 1) >> 1) -- the fixed-point Q15
// multiply DSP code leans on.  No prior PatchFull shape emitted a rounding
// multiply-high, and the 128-bit family never reached the 256-bit vpmulhrsw ymm
// opcode.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpmulhrsw has a dedicated x86 intrinsic (llvm.x86.avx2.pmul.hr.sw)
// that itself requests +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins it directly (no psllv pin
// needed) and it lowers straight to vpmulhrsw ymm.  Every other cell open-codes
// the identical Q15 rounding multiply -- sext each i16 lane to i32, multiply,
// ashr 14, +1, ashr 1, truncate back -- which lowers to NEON sqrdmulh-style
// widen-mul-round / a scalarized sequence, all libcall-free (i32-domain only;
// no i64 multiply).  No L1 pass rewrites the multiply sub-graph, so the original
// and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an
// undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).
// sext-then-weighted-sum (the rounded high words are signed) with distinct
// per-lane weights keeps the reduction order-sensitive, while integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus /
// indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMulHRS256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimulhrs256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) -> bitcast to <16 x i16> word lanes.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *VA = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V16h);
  auto *VB = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V16h);

  // vpmulhrsw ymm on x86-64; open-coded Q15 rounding multiply-high elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *MulR;
  if (IsX64)
    MulR = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmul_hr_sw, {}, {VA, VB});
  else {
    MulR = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
      auto *P =
          B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VA, I), I32),
                      B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VB, I), I32));
      auto *R = B.CreateAShr(
          B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAShr(P, B.getInt32(14)), B.getInt32(1)),
          B.getInt32(1));
      MulR = B.CreateInsertElement(MulR, B.CreateTrunc(R, I16), uint64_t(I));
    }
  }

  // Reduce (sext signed rounded words to i32) with distinct per-lane weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(MulR, uint64_t(I)), I32),
               B.getInt32(I + 1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed sum-of-absolute-differences on YMM -- vpsadbw
// (<32 x i8> -> <4 x i64>), the SAD family no PatchFull shape ever emitted.
// For each 8-byte group it sums |a_k - b_k| over the 8 unsigned bytes into the
// low word of the matching 64-bit lane (other bits zero): the motion-estimation
// / block-match primitive video codecs lean on, a distinct reduction class from
// the per-lane multiply/add/average/min-max siblings, and the first shape to
// reach the 256-bit vpsadbw ymm opcode once +avx2 is live.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpsadbw has a dedicated x86 intrinsic (llvm.x86.avx2.psad.bw) that
// itself requests +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins it directly (no psllv pin
// needed) and it lowers straight to vpsadbw ymm.  Every other cell open-codes
// the identical SAD -- zext each byte to i16, take the unsigned abs-diff via
// umax-umin, sum the 8 per 64-bit lane, zext to i64 -- which lowers to NEON
// uabd/uadalp / a scalarized abs-diff-accumulate, all libcall-free (no i64
// multiply; only i16/i64 add).  No L1 pass rewrites the SAD sub-graph, so the
// original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it under emulation; an
// undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).
// zext-then-weighted-sum of the four 64-bit lane sums (truncated to i32; each
// SAD <= 2040 fits) with distinct per-lane weights keeps the reduction
// order-sensitive, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxISad256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "visad256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> operands (sign-mixed, runtime) -> bitcast to <32 x i8> byte lanes.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3))),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x77 + 5))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  auto *VAb = B.CreateBitCast(VD, V32b);
  auto *VBb = B.CreateBitCast(VE, V32b);

  // vpsadbw ymm on x86-64; open-coded sum-of-abs-diff elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *Sad;
  if (IsX64)
    Sad = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psad_bw, {}, {VAb, VBb});
  else {
    Sad = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 4; ++L) {
      llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
      for (unsigned K = 0; K < 8; ++K) {
        auto *Av = B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VAb, 8 * L + K), I16);
        auto *Bv = B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(VBb, 8 * L + K), I16);
        auto *Mx = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, Av, Bv);
        auto *Mn = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, Av, Bv);
        Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateSub(Mx, Mn));
      }
      Sad = B.CreateInsertElement(Sad, B.CreateZExt(Acc, I64), uint64_t(L));
    }
  }

  // Reduce the four 64-bit lane sums (trunc to i32) with distinct weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 4; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateExtractElement(Sad, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword sign application on YMM -- vpsignd
// (<8 x i32>, <8 x i32> -> <8 x i32>), the conditional-negate family no
// PatchFull shape has emitted.  For each dword lane the data lane takes on the
// sign of the matching control lane: negate when the control is negative, force
// zero when the control is zero, pass through when the control is positive.
// That is a distinct data-transform class from the per-lane arithmetic /
// multiply / average / min-max / sum-of-abs-diff siblings -- a per-lane
// conditional sign transfer -- and the first shape to reach the 256-bit vpsignd
// ymm opcode once +avx2 is live.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpsignd has a dedicated x86 intrinsic (llvm.x86.avx2.psign.d) that
// itself requests +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins it directly (no psllv pin
// needed) and it lowers straight to vpsignd ymm.  Every other cell open-codes
// the identical sign transfer -- negate the data lane, then a control==0 / <0
// select chain -- which lowers to NEON neg + cmlt/cmeq + bsl or a scalarized
// compare-select, all libcall-free (only i32 sub / compare / select; no multiply
// or divide of the sign result).  No L1 pass rewrites the select sub-graph, so
// the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it under
// emulation; an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  The eight sign-applied lanes are reduced with distinct
// per-lane weights (order-sensitive), while integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x3C3C/9973) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the
// subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxISign256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "visign256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Data <8 x i32> and a sign-mixed control <8 x i32>, both runtime-derived so
  // every lane spans negative / zero / positive across the inputs.
  llvm::Value *VData = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VCtl = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VData = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VData,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4)))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VCtl = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VCtl,
        B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4))),
                    B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3)))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // vpsignd ymm on x86-64; open-coded sign transfer elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *Sgn;
  if (IsX64)
    Sgn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psign_d, {},
                            {VData, VCtl});
  else {
    Sgn = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    auto *Zero = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L) {
      auto *Dv = B.CreateExtractElement(VData, uint64_t(L));
      auto *Sv = B.CreateExtractElement(VCtl, uint64_t(L));
      auto *Neg = B.CreateSub(Zero, Dv);
      auto *NZ = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(Sv, Zero), Zero, Dv);
      auto *R = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(Sv, Zero), Neg, NZ);
      Sgn = B.CreateInsertElement(Sgn, R, uint64_t(L));
    }
  }

  // Reduce the eight sign-applied lanes with distinct per-lane weights.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(Sgn, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x3C3C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(9973)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed integer horizontal add/subtract on YMM -- vphaddd /
// vphsubd (<8 x i32>, <8 x i32> -> <8 x i32>).  This is the *integer* dual of
// the floating-point horizontal vhaddsub256 (vhaddps/vhsubps): the whole
// integer-horizontal family (add/subtract adjacent lane pairs within each
// 128-bit half) had zero coverage -- every prior integer-YMM shape is a
// lane-aligned *vertical* op (arithmetic / multiply / average / min-max /
// compare / sum-of-abs-diff / sign).  vphaddd/vphsubd interleave src1's two
// pair-results then src2's two pair-results *within each 128-bit lane* (AVX2
// horizontal ops never cross the 128-bit lane boundary), so applying the
// 128-bit phaddd/phsubd helper to each 128-bit lane is the exact 256-bit
// semantics.
//
// Cross-ISA: vphaddd/vphsubd have dedicated x86 intrinsics
// (llvm.x86.avx2.phadd.d / phsub.d) that request +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins
// them directly and they lower straight to vphaddd / vphsubd ymm.  Every other
// cell open-codes the identical in-lane pairwise add/subtract (NEON addp / a
// shuffle+sub), all libcall-free (only i32 add / sub).  No L1 pass rewrites the
// shuffle/intrinsic sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay
// byte-identical over it; an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline
// (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Both vphaddd and vphsubd must be emitted -- their
// eight result lanes are reduced with distinct ascending/descending per-lane
// weights, so a swapped op or mis-placed lane changes the sum -- while integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5A5A/12345) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIHAdd256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vihadd256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <8 x i32> operands, runtime-derived so every lane spans the inputs.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4)))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                    B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 3)))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // In-lane pairwise horizontal op: output lane O (lane=O/4, p=O%4) takes src1's
  // pair for p<2 and src2's pair for p>=2 -- matching vphaddd/vphsubd ymm.
  auto Horiz = [&](bool IsAdd, llvm::Value *Va,
                   llvm::Value *Vb) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    for (unsigned O = 0; O < 8; ++O) {
      unsigned Lane = O / 4, P = O % 4;
      llvm::Value *Src = (P < 2) ? Va : Vb;
      unsigned E0 = Lane * 4 + 2 * (P & 1);
      auto *X0 = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E0));
      auto *X1 = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E0 + 1));
      auto *Vv = IsAdd ? B.CreateAdd(X0, X1) : B.CreateSub(X0, X1);
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Vv, uint64_t(O));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vphaddd / vphsubd ymm on x86-64; open-coded in-lane pairwise elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *HAdd, *HSub;
  if (IsX64) {
    HAdd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_phadd_d, {}, {VD, VE});
    HSub = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_phsub_d, {}, {VD, VE});
  } else {
    HAdd = Horiz(true, VD, VE);
    HSub = Horiz(false, VD, VE);
  }

  // Reduce both results with distinct ascending/descending weights so each op
  // and each lane position is observable (a swap or mis-placement changes S).
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(HAdd, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(HSub, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(8 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 cross-lane variable permute on YMM -- vpermd / vpermps
// (<8 x i32> / <8 x float> permuted by a runtime <8 x i32> index, each output
// lane independently selecting any of the eight input lanes:
// dst[i] = data[idx[i] & 7]).  This is the first *cross-128-bit-lane* shape in
// the equivalence suite: every prior YMM form is per-lane or per-128-bit-lane
// (arithmetic / multiply / average / min-max / compare / SAD / sign /
// horizontal), all of which the generic per-128-bit-lane emulation path covers,
// whereas vpermd/vpermps gather across the full 256-bit register and need the
// dedicated cross-lane decoder.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpermd/vpermps have dedicated x86 intrinsics
// (llvm.x86.avx2.permd / permps) that request +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins
// them directly and they lower straight to vpermd / vpermps ymm.  Every other
// cell open-codes the identical cross-lane gather (a select chain picking
// data[idx & 7] per lane), all libcall-free (only i32/float select+compare).
// The index is runtime-derived so LLVM cannot fold the permute into a constant
// shuffle -- the real variable-index instruction survives to the machine layer;
// an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Both
// vpermd and vpermps are observable -- the eight permuted dword lanes and eight
// permuted float lanes are reduced with distinct ascending/descending weights,
// so a mis-routed lane changes the sum -- while integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x6C6C/54321) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIPerm256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viperm256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> data, <8 x float> data, and a runtime <8 x i32> index -- all
  // derived from the inputs so the permute is a real variable-index gather the
  // backend cannot fold to a constant shuffle.  Float lanes are masked to
  // [0,2047] so they are exactly representable and fptosi stays in range.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VF = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  llvm::Value *VI = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4)))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VF = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VF,
        B.CreateSIToFP(
            B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I))),
                        B.getInt32(0x7FF)),
            F32),
        uint64_t(I));
    VI = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VI, B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 3)), uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Cross-lane gather dst[i] = data[idx[i] & 7]; vpermd/vpermps ymm on x86-64,
  // an open-coded select chain elsewhere (type-generic over <8 x i32>/f32).
  auto Perm = [&](llvm::Value *Data, llvm::Type *VTy) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(VTy);
    for (unsigned O = 0; O < 8; ++O) {
      auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateExtractElement(VI, uint64_t(O)),
                              B.getInt32(7));
      llvm::Value *Pick = B.CreateExtractElement(Data, uint64_t(0));
      for (unsigned J = 1; J < 8; ++J)
        Pick = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(Sel, B.getInt32(J)),
                              B.CreateExtractElement(Data, uint64_t(J)), Pick);
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Pick, uint64_t(O));
    }
    return R;
  };

  llvm::Value *PI, *PF;
  if (IsX64) {
    PI = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_permd, {}, {VD, VI});
    PF = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_permps, {}, {VF, VI});
  } else {
    PI = Perm(VD, V8i);
    PF = Perm(VF, V8f);
  }

  // Reduce both permuted results with distinct ascending/descending weights so
  // each lane's routing is observable (a mis-route changes S).
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(PI, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateExtractElement(PF, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(8 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x6C6C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(54321)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed integer *saturating* word horizontal add/subtract on YMM
// -- vphaddsw / vphsubsw (<16 x i16>, <16 x i16> -> <16 x i16>).  This is the
// saturating-word dual of the dword horizontal vihadd256 (vphaddd/vphsubd) and
// adds a dimension no prior 256-bit form exercises: *signed 16-bit saturation*.
// Within each 128-bit lane the four adjacent src1 word pairs are
// saturating-summed (then src2's four), so a pair whose sum overflows i16
// clamps to 32767/-32768 instead of wrapping -- the kPairs boundary inputs make
// full-range words whose pairwise sums routinely overflow, so the saturation is
// genuinely exercised (a plain wrapping add would give a different reduction).
//
// Cross-ISA: vphaddsw/vphsubsw have dedicated x86 intrinsics
// (llvm.x86.avx2.phadd.sw / phsub.sw) that request +avx2, so the x86-64 cell
// pins them directly and they lower straight to vphaddsw / vphsubsw ymm.  Every
// other cell open-codes the identical in-lane saturating pairwise add/subtract
// (llvm.sadd.sat.i16 / ssub.sat.i16, which lower to native saturating ops, no
// libcall).  No L1 pass touches the intrinsic/saturation sub-graph, so the
// original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it; an undecoded YMM
// op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Both vphaddsw and
// vphsubsw are observable -- their sixteen result lanes are reduced with
// distinct ascending/descending per-lane weights (sign-extended; words are
// signed) -- while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x3939/24680) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the
// subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIHAddSW256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vihaddsw256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <16 x i16> operands, full-range words (truncated from runtime i32) so
  // adjacent-pair sums overflow and the signed saturation is exercised.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                        B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 7)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // In-lane saturating pairwise horizontal op: output word O (lane=O/8, p=O%8)
  // takes src1's four pairs for p<4 and src2's four pairs for p>=4 -- matching
  // vphaddsw/vphsubsw ymm.
  auto Horiz = [&](bool IsAdd, llvm::Value *Va,
                   llvm::Value *Vb) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
    for (unsigned O = 0; O < 16; ++O) {
      unsigned Lane = O / 8, P = O % 8;
      llvm::Value *Src = (P < 4) ? Va : Vb;
      unsigned Pr = (P < 4) ? P : (P - 4);
      unsigned E0 = Lane * 8 + 2 * Pr;
      auto *X0 = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E0));
      auto *X1 = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E0 + 1));
      auto *Vv =
          IsAdd ? B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sadd_sat, X0, X1)
                : B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ssub_sat, X0, X1);
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Vv, uint64_t(O));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vphaddsw / vphsubsw ymm on x86-64; open-coded saturating pairwise elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *HAdd, *HSub;
  if (IsX64) {
    HAdd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_phadd_sw, {}, {VD, VE});
    HSub = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_phsub_sw, {}, {VD, VE});
  } else {
    HAdd = Horiz(true, VD, VE);
    HSub = Horiz(false, VD, VE);
  }

  // Reduce both results with distinct ascending/descending weights (sign-extend:
  // words are signed) so each op and lane position is observable.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(HAdd, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(HSub, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x3939));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(24680)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed word immediate blend on YMM -- vpblendw (<16 x i16>,
// <16 x i16> -> <16 x i16> by imm8).  This is the immediate word-blend family
// no prior 256-bit shape exercised: vfshufd256 hit vblendps/vpblendd (0F3A
// 0x0c, per-dword imm8[i]) and vicmp256 deliberately avoids any blend, while
// vpblendw (0F3A 0x0e) uses imm8[b] for b in 0..7 within EACH 128-bit lane
// (the same bit drives word b and word b+8).  A mis-decoded vpblendw would
// swap the wrong half-lane words and change the weighted reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64, +avx2 is pinned via llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 (same
// anchor as vicmp256) and the blends are expressed as CreateShuffleVector masks
// that Apple/fork LLVM ISel folds to vpblendw ymm (verified:
// shufflevector <16 x i16> with indices i / 16+i from imm8 bit (i&7) -> vpblendw
// at -O2).  Every other cell open-codes the identical per-word imm8 rule with
// extract/select (zero libcall).  Two complementary imm8 masks (0xAA / 0x55)
// keep both src1/src2 contributions observable; sign-extended ascending/descending
// per-lane weights make mis-blended words change the sum.  Integer add/sub/and/
// or/xor + non-folding constants (0x2E2E/13579) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI
// drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIBlendW256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viblendw256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x151 + 3)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 2)),
                        B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 6)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  auto WordBlend = [&](llvm::Value *V1, llvm::Value *V2,
                       uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 16> Idx;
      for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
        Idx.push_back(((Imm >> (I & 7)) & 1) ? int(16 + I) : int(I));
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(V1, V2, Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
      auto *PickB = B.getInt1(((Imm >> (I & 7)) & 1) != 0);
      auto *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V1, uint64_t(I));
      auto *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V2, uint64_t(I));
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, B.CreateSelect(PickB, E1, E0), uint64_t(I));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // +avx2 anchor so 256-bit YMM shuffles lower to vpblendw, not split xmm halves.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VD, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  }

  llvm::Value *B1 = WordBlend(VA, VB, 0xAA);
  llvm::Value *B2 = WordBlend(VB, VA, 0x55);

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(B1, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(B2, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x2E2E));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(13579)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed word->byte saturating pack on YMM -- vpacksswb / vpackuswb
// (<16 x i16>, <16 x i16> -> <32 x i8> with signed / unsigned saturation).  This
// is the first 256-bit shape to exercise a SATURATING NARROW (pack): prior
// shapes saturate on an add (vihaddsw256 via sadd.sat/ssub.sat) but none
// narrow-with-clamp, and -- the headline bug magnet -- the 256-bit pack does NOT
// concatenate the two sources; within EACH 128-bit lane it lays down src1's
// eight clamped bytes then src2's eight (result byte b: lane=b/16, p=b%16; src1
// for p<8 else src2; word = lane*8 + (p&7)).  A decoder that treated
// vpack{ss,us}wb ymm as a flat 256-bit concat would mis-place sixteen bytes and
// change the weighted reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.packsswb / packuswb carry
// +avx2, so they lower straight to vpacksswb / vpackuswb ymm.  Every other cell
// open-codes the identical clamp+truncate at the same interleaved positions --
// the source word is read SIGNED (sext to i32) for both, then clamped to
// [-128,127] (signed) or [0,255] (unsigned) via llvm.smin/smax (native
// saturating-narrow on NEON: sqxtn/sqxtun, no libcall).  Both packs are
// observable -- packsswb bytes are reduced sign-extended with ascending weights,
// packuswb bytes zero-extended with descending weights -- while integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x4B4B/31337) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIPack256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vipack256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <16 x i16> operands, full-range words (truncated from runtime i32) so the
  // i16->i8 clamps fire on both the signed and unsigned ends.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 3)),
                        B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 6)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Open-coded interleaved clamp+truncate matching vpack{ss,us}wb ymm layout:
  // output byte b (lane=b/16, p=b%16) takes src1's lane words for p<8 and src2's
  // for p>=8 (word = lane*8 + (p&7)), read signed, clamped, truncated to i8.
  auto Pack = [&](bool Signed, llvm::Value *V1,
                  llvm::Value *V2) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
    for (unsigned Bx = 0; Bx < 32; ++Bx) {
      unsigned Lane = Bx / 16, P = Bx % 16;
      llvm::Value *Src = (P < 8) ? V1 : V2;
      unsigned E = Lane * 8 + (P & 7);
      auto *X = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E)), I32);
      llvm::Value *Cl;
      if (Signed) {
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, X, B.getInt32(-128));
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, Cl, B.getInt32(127));
      } else {
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, X, B.getInt32(0));
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, Cl, B.getInt32(255));
      }
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, B.CreateTrunc(Cl, I8), uint64_t(Bx));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vpacksswb / vpackuswb ymm on x86-64; open-coded saturating pack elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *PS, *PU;
  if (IsX64) {
    PS = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_packsswb, {}, {VA, VB});
    PU = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_packuswb, {}, {VA, VB});
  } else {
    PS = Pack(true, VA, VB);
    PU = Pack(false, VA, VB);
  }

  // packsswb: signed bytes (sext, ascending weight); packuswb: unsigned bytes
  // (zext, descending weight) -- both observable and position-sensitive.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(PS, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(PU, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(32 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x4B4B));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(31337)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 in-lane variable byte shuffle on YMM -- vpshufb (<32 x i8> data,
// <32 x i8> control -> <32 x i8>).  This is the byte-granular, IN-LANE dual of
// the cross-lane dword viperm256 (vpermd/vpermps): where vpermd routes whole
// dwords across the full 256-bit register by a runtime index, vpshufb routes
// individual bytes WITHIN each 128-bit lane and -- the headline gotcha -- zeroes
// the output byte whenever the control byte's bit 7 is set
// (result[i] = (ctrl[i] & 0x80) ? 0 : data[lane*16 + (ctrl[i] & 0x0F)],
// lane = i/16).  No prior 256-bit shape exercises a runtime byte-granular gather
// or the zero-on-high-bit semantic; a decoder that crossed lanes (used the full
// 5-bit index instead of the in-lane low nibble) or skipped the bit-7 zeroing
// would mis-route bytes and change the reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.pshuf.b carries +avx2, so it
// lowers straight to vpshufb ymm; every other cell open-codes the identical
// in-lane select chain (index masked to the 16-byte lane, bit 7 -> 0), all i8
// select/compare, zero libcall.  Two distinct runtime control vectors drive two
// shuffles of the same data: one reduced sign-extended with ascending weights,
// the other zero-extended with descending weights, so every routed (or zeroed)
// byte is observable, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5959/24691) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the
// subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIShufB256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vishufb256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // One <32 x i8> data vector and two runtime <32 x i8> control vectors, all
  // derived from the inputs so the per-byte index (low nibble) and the bit-7
  // zero flag vary at runtime -- LLVM cannot fold to a constant shuffle, so the
  // real variable vpshufb survives to the machine layer.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VC1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VC2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VC1 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VC1,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                                  B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 2 + 3))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VC2 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VC2,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 7)),
                                  B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I + 1))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // In-lane byte gather with bit-7 zeroing, matching vpshufb ymm: result byte i
  // (lane = i/16) is data[lane*16 + (ctrl[i] & 0x0F)] unless ctrl[i] bit 7 is
  // set, in which case it is 0.
  auto Shuf = [&](llvm::Value *Ctrl) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
      unsigned Lane = I / 16;
      auto *Cb = B.CreateExtractElement(Ctrl, uint64_t(I));
      auto *Idx = B.CreateAnd(Cb, B.getInt8(0x0F));
      llvm::Value *Pick = B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(Lane * 16));
      for (unsigned J = 1; J < 16; ++J)
        Pick = B.CreateSelect(
            B.CreateICmpEQ(Idx, B.getInt8(J)),
            B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(Lane * 16 + J)), Pick);
      auto *Z = B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(Cb, B.getInt8(0x80)), B.getInt8(0));
      Pick = B.CreateSelect(Z, B.getInt8(0), Pick);
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Pick, uint64_t(I));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vpshufb ymm on x86-64 (dedicated +avx2 intrinsic; arg0 = data, arg1 =
  // control); open-coded in-lane gather elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *P1, *P2;
  if (IsX64) {
    P1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pshuf_b, {}, {VD, VC1});
    P2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pshuf_b, {}, {VD, VC2});
  } else {
    P1 = Shuf(VC1);
    P2 = Shuf(VC2);
  }

  // P1 bytes sign-extended (ascending weight), P2 bytes zero-extended
  // (descending weight) -- both shuffles observable and position-sensitive.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(P1, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(P2, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(32 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5959));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(24691)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed byte sign-mask extract on YMM -- vpmovmskb (<32 x i8> ->
// i32).  This is a genuinely new DIMENSION for the 256-bit equivalence suite:
// every prior YMM shape reduces its vector result to a scalar with an
// IR-level extractelement/reduce loop, but vpmovmskb is a single hardware
// SIMD->GPR instruction that collapses the sign (bit 7) of all 32 bytes into a
// 32-bit general-purpose register -- and that GPR then feeds the scalar return
// directly.  The 256-bit form is also NOT lane-wise in the usual sense: it does
// not write a YMM, it concatenates each 128-bit lane's 16-bit byte mask with
// the high lane's bits above the low lane's (result = lane0_mask | lane1_mask
// << 16); a decoder that read only the low lane (16-bit result) or used the
// wrong lane order would change every reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.pmovmskb carries +avx2, so
// it lowers straight to vpmovmskb r32, ymm; every other cell open-codes the
// identical mask (OR over i of zext(byte[i] <s 0) << i), all i8 compare + i32
// shift/or, zero libcall.  Two distinct runtime data vectors give two masks --
// both mixed into the base with odd multipliers so every one of the 64 sign
// bits is observable -- while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x6D6D/22229) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the
// subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMovMskB256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimovmskb256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two runtime <32 x i8> data vectors whose per-byte sign bit (bit 7) varies
  // with the inputs, so the 32-bit masks are real runtime values LLVM cannot
  // fold and the variable vpmovmskb survives to the machine layer.
  llvm::Value *VD1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VD2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VD1 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD1,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VD2 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD2,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 7)),
                                  B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I + 3))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Byte sign-mask: result = OR over i of (byte[i] sign bit) << i.
  auto MskB = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
      auto *Sb = B.CreateZExt(
          B.CreateICmpSLT(B.CreateExtractElement(V, uint64_t(I)), B.getInt8(0)),
          I32);
      R = B.CreateOr(R, B.CreateShl(Sb, B.getInt32(I)));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vpmovmskb r32, ymm on x86-64 (dedicated +avx2 intrinsic, <32 x i8> -> i32);
  // open-coded sign-bit gather elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *M1, *M2;
  if (IsX64) {
    M1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmovmskb, {}, {VD1});
    M2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pmovmskb, {}, {VD2});
  } else {
    M1 = MskB(VD1);
    M2 = MskB(VD2);
  }

  // Mix both masks into the base so every sign bit (all 64) is observable -- a
  // dropped high lane (top 16 bits) or swapped lanes changes S.
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateAdd(M1, B.CreateMul(M2, B.getInt32(0x10001)));
  S = B.CreateXor(S, B.CreateMul(M1, B.getInt32(3)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x6D6D));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(22229)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed byte VARIABLE blend on YMM -- vpblendvb (<32 x i8>).  The
// immediate word blend viblendw256 (vpblendw) selects per-word from a COMPILE-
// time imm8; vpblendvb is its RUNTIME, byte-granular dual: for each of 32 bytes
// it takes src2 when that byte's mask high bit (bit 7) is set, else src1 -- the
// per-byte select is driven by a runtime <32 x i8> mask vector, never an
// immediate, so it is the equivalence suite's first runtime 2-source byte
// select (vpshufb gathers within ONE source; vpblendvb chooses between TWO).
// The 4-operand VEX /is4 encoding (the mask register is named in imm8[7:4]) is
// a distinct decode path; a decoder that read the mask per-dword/qword (like
// vblendvps/pd) or dropped the high 128-bit lane would mis-select bytes and
// change every reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: x86-64 pins the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.pblendvb (name carries
// +avx2) -> vpblendvb ymm; every other cell open-codes the identical select
// (select (icmp slt mask, 0), src2, src1) over <32 x i8> -> NEON cmlt+bsl /
// scalarized, zero libcall.  Two blends with two distinct runtime masks and
// swapped source order keep both sources and both masks observable -- byte b of
// blend1 has ascending weight (sign-extended), blend2 descending (zero-
// extended), so a mis-selected byte changes the sum -- while integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x7A7A/30509) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIBlendVB256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viblendvb256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two runtime <32 x i8> data sources and two runtime <32 x i8> masks, all
  // derived from the inputs so the per-byte select (mask bit 7) varies at
  // runtime -- LLVM cannot fold to a constant blend, so the real variable
  // vpblendvb survives to the machine layer.
  llvm::Value *VS1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VS2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VM1 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VM2 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VS1 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS1,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 7 + 3)),
                                  B.getInt32(I * 0x11 + 1)),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS2 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS2,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 9)),
                                  B.getInt32(I * 0x0D + 2)),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VM1 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VM1,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VM2 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VM2,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 7)),
                                  B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I + 1))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // vpblendvb ymm: result byte i = (mask[i] bit 7 set) ? src2[i] : src1[i].
  auto Blend = [&](llvm::Value *S1, llvm::Value *S2,
                   llvm::Value *Mask) -> llvm::Value * {
    if (IsX64)
      return B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_pblendvb, {},
                               {S1, S2, Mask});
    auto *Cond = B.CreateICmpSLT(Mask, llvm::Constant::getNullValue(V32b));
    return B.CreateSelect(Cond, S2, S1);
  };
  llvm::Value *Bl1 = Blend(VS1, VS2, VM1);
  llvm::Value *Bl2 = Blend(VS2, VS1, VM2);

  // Bl1 bytes sign-extended (ascending weight), Bl2 zero-extended (descending
  // weight) -- both blends observable and position-sensitive.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Bl1, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Bl2, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(32 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x7A7A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(30509)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 widening dword->qword multiply on YMM -- vpmuldq / vpmuludq
// (<8 x i32> x <8 x i32> -> <4 x i64>, EVEN dwords only).  This is the first
// 256-bit shape to produce i64 lanes and the first full-width widening multiply:
// every prior integer-YMM shape reduces i8/i16/i32 lanes, and the only
// multiplies so far are the word high-half (vimulh256) and word multiply-add
// (vipmadd256/vimaddub256) that never exceed i32.  vpmuldq/vpmuludq read ONLY
// the even dword of each qword position (result qword j = src1.dword[2j] *
// src2.dword[2j], odd dwords discarded) and yield a full 64-bit product -- the
// headline bug magnet: a decoder that read the odd dwords, all eight dwords, or
// treated the source as already 64-bit would change every product.
//
// LLVM dropped the dedicated sse2/avx2 pmulu.dq / pmul.dq intrinsics
// (autoupgraded to generic IR), so the x86-64 cell pins +avx2 with a throwaway
// llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchor (whose result IS the first multiply operand,
// so it is never dead) and then the canonical generic patterns over <4 x i64> --
// mul(and(x,0xFFFFFFFF), and(y,0xFFFFFFFF)) for the unsigned product and
// mul(sext_inreg(x), sext_inreg(y)) for the signed product -- fold to vpmuludq /
// vpmuldq ymm (verified: clang -mavx2).  Every other cell open-codes the
// identical even-lane widening explicitly: zext/sext each even i32 dword to i64
// and multiply (NEON umull/smull, i386 widening imul -- a single instruction,
// zero libcall on every ISA).  Both products are observable: signed qwords
// reduced with ascending weights, unsigned with descending, and BOTH halves
// (low 32 + high 32) folded in so the sext-vs-zext split on negative dwords and
// the full 64-bit width stay order-sensitive, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x6363/25117) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMulDQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimuldq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <8 x i32> sources whose even dwords differ from the odd ones (so reading
  // the wrong dword changes the product) with mixed sign (so signed and unsigned
  // products differ), plus a per-lane [0,7] shift vector for the +avx2 anchor.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4)))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 3)),
                    B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 5)))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VS,
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(I * 3 + 1)),
                    B.getInt32(7)),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor: psllv.d.256 on x86-64 (its result is multiply operand 1, never
  // dead); a plain per-lane shl elsewhere.  In-range [0,7] shifts so psllv and
  // shl agree per cell and no lane is poisoned.
  llvm::Value *ShA;
  if (IsX64)
    ShA = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VA, VS});
  else
    ShA = B.CreateShl(VA, VS);

  // Four signed (PS) + four unsigned (PU) i64 even-dword products.
  llvm::Value *PS[4], *PU[4];
  if (IsX64) {
    // Generic <4 x i64> patterns the x86 backend folds to vpmuldq / vpmuludq.
    auto *QA = B.CreateBitCast(ShA, V4q);
    auto *QB = B.CreateBitCast(VB, V4q);
    auto *Mask = llvm::ConstantInt::get(V4q, 0xFFFFFFFFULL);
    auto *K32 = llvm::ConstantInt::get(V4q, 32);
    auto *UPv = B.CreateMul(B.CreateAnd(QA, Mask), B.CreateAnd(QB, Mask));
    auto *SPv = B.CreateMul(B.CreateAShr(B.CreateShl(QA, K32), K32),
                            B.CreateAShr(B.CreateShl(QB, K32), K32));
    for (unsigned J = 0; J < 4; ++J) {
      PU[J] = B.CreateExtractElement(UPv, uint64_t(J));
      PS[J] = B.CreateExtractElement(SPv, uint64_t(J));
    }
  } else {
    // Explicit even-lane widening: zext/sext each even i32 dword to i64 and
    // multiply (umull/smull / widening imul, zero libcall).
    for (unsigned J = 0; J < 4; ++J) {
      auto *Ae = B.CreateExtractElement(ShA, uint64_t(2 * J));
      auto *Be = B.CreateExtractElement(VB, uint64_t(2 * J));
      PU[J] = B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(Ae, I64), B.CreateZExt(Be, I64));
      PS[J] = B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(Ae, I64), B.CreateSExt(Be, I64));
    }
  }

  // Reduce: signed products ascending, unsigned descending; fold BOTH halves so
  // the full 64-bit width and the sext-vs-zext split on negative dwords are
  // observable and position-sensitive.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned J = 0; J < 4; ++J) {
    auto *SLo = B.CreateTrunc(PS[J], I32);
    auto *SHi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(PS[J], B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(SLo, B.getInt32(J + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(SHi, B.getInt32(J + 1)));
    auto *ULo = B.CreateTrunc(PU[J], I32);
    auto *UHi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(PU[J], B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(ULo, B.getInt32(4 - J)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(UHi, B.getInt32(4 - J)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x6363));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(25117)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword->word saturating pack on YMM -- vpackssdw /
// vpackusdw (<8 x i32>, <8 x i32> -> <16 x i16> with signed / unsigned
// saturation).  The dword->word sibling of vipack256 (vpack{ss,us}wb,
// word->byte): same headline bug magnet -- the 256-bit pack does NOT
// concatenate the two sources; within EACH 128-bit lane it lays down src1's
// four clamped words then src2's four (result word w: lane=w/8, p=w%8; src1 for
// p<4 else src2; dword = lane*4 + (p&3)).  A decoder that treated
// vpack{ss,us}dw ymm as a flat 256-bit concat would mis-place eight words and
// change the weighted reduction.  Distinct from vipack256: the source is i32
// (no sext before the clamp) and the clamp bounds are the word range
// ([-32768,32767] signed / [0,65535] unsigned), so the saturating-narrow fires
// one level wider.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.packssdw / packusdw carry
// +avx2, so they lower straight to vpackssdw / vpackusdw ymm.  Every other cell
// open-codes the identical clamp+truncate at the same interleaved positions --
// the source dword is read SIGNED for both, then clamped to [-32768,32767]
// (signed) or [0,65535] (unsigned) via llvm.smin/smax (native saturating-narrow
// on NEON: sqxtn/sqxtun, no libcall).  Both packs are observable -- packssdw
// words reduced sign-extended with ascending weights, packusdw words zero-
// extended with descending weights -- while integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x5D5D/28057) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIPackD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vipackd256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <8 x i32> operands, full-range dwords (so the i32->i16 clamps fire on
  // both the signed and unsigned ends).
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4)))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 3)),
                    B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 5)))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Open-coded interleaved clamp+truncate matching vpack{ss,us}dw ymm layout:
  // output word w (lane=w/8, p=w%8) takes src1's lane dwords for p<4 and src2's
  // for p>=4 (dword = lane*4 + (p&3)), read signed, clamped, truncated to i16.
  auto Pack = [&](bool Signed, llvm::Value *V1,
                  llvm::Value *V2) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
    for (unsigned Wx = 0; Wx < 16; ++Wx) {
      unsigned Lane = Wx / 8, P = Wx % 8;
      llvm::Value *Src = (P < 4) ? V1 : V2;
      unsigned E = Lane * 4 + (P & 3);
      auto *X = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E));
      llvm::Value *Cl;
      if (Signed) {
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, X,
                                     B.getInt32(-32768));
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, Cl,
                                     B.getInt32(32767));
      } else {
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, X, B.getInt32(0));
        Cl = B.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, Cl,
                                     B.getInt32(65535));
      }
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, B.CreateTrunc(Cl, I16), uint64_t(Wx));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vpackssdw / vpackusdw ymm on x86-64; open-coded saturating pack elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *PS, *PU;
  if (IsX64) {
    PS = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_packssdw, {}, {VA, VB});
    PU = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_packusdw, {}, {VA, VB});
  } else {
    PS = Pack(true, VA, VB);
    PU = Pack(false, VA, VB);
  }

  // packssdw: signed words (sext, ascending weight); packusdw: unsigned words
  // (zext, descending weight) -- both observable and position-sensitive.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
