  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(PS, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(PU, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5D5D));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(28057)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed word wrapping horizontal add/subtract on YMM -- vphaddw /
// vphsubw (<16 x i16>, <16 x i16> -> <16 x i16>).  The i16 WRAPPING sibling of
// the i32 vihadd256 (vphaddd/vphsubd) and the non-saturating counterpart of
// vihaddsw256 (vphaddsw/vphsubsw): within EACH 128-bit lane adjacent word pairs
// are added/subtracted with plain 2's-complement wrap (NOT signed saturation),
// src1's four pair results first then src2's four (output word O: lane=O/8,
// p=O%8; src1 for p<4 else src2; pair = lane*8 + 2*(p&3)).  With full-range
// inputs the pair sums overflow i16, so a decoder that confused vphaddw with the
// saturating vphaddsw (clamp vs wrap) -- or crossed the 128-bit lane -- would
// change the weighted reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.phadd.w / phsub.w carry
// +avx2, so they lower straight to vphaddw / vphsubw ymm.  Every other cell
// open-codes the identical in-lane pairwise wrapping add/sub (plain i16 add/sub,
// NEON addp / shuffle+sub, zero libcall).  Both results are observable -- sign-
// extended with ascending (phaddw) / descending (phsubw) per-lane weights --
// while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x1B1B/11171) + a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/
// indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIHAddW256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vihaddw256", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <16 x i16> operands, full-range words (truncated from runtime i32) so
  // adjacent-pair sums overflow and the 2's-complement wrap is exercised.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  llvm::Value *VE = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
    VE = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VE,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I + 1)),
                        B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 7)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // In-lane wrapping pairwise horizontal op: output word O (lane=O/8, p=O%8)
  // takes src1's four pairs for p<4 and src2's four pairs for p>=4 -- matching
  // vphaddw/vphsubw ymm.
  auto Horiz = [&](bool IsAdd, llvm::Value *Va,
                   llvm::Value *Vb) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i);
    for (unsigned O = 0; O < 16; ++O) {
      unsigned Lane = O / 8, P = O % 8;
      llvm::Value *Src = (P < 4) ? Va : Vb;
      unsigned Pr = (P < 4) ? P : (P - 4);
      unsigned E0 = Lane * 8 + 2 * Pr;
      auto *X0 = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E0));
      auto *X1 = B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(E0 + 1));
      auto *Vv = IsAdd ? B.CreateAdd(X0, X1) : B.CreateSub(X0, X1);
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Vv, uint64_t(O));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vphaddw / vphsubw ymm on x86-64; open-coded wrapping pairwise elsewhere.
  llvm::Value *HAdd, *HSub;
  if (IsX64) {
    HAdd = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_phadd_w, {}, {VD, VE});
    HSub = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_phsub_w, {}, {VD, VE});
  } else {
    HAdd = Horiz(true, VD, VE);
    HSub = Horiz(false, VD, VE);
  }

  // Reduce both results with distinct ascending/descending weights (sign-extend:
  // words are signed) so each op and lane position is observable.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(HAdd, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S,
        B.CreateMul(
            B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(HSub, uint64_t(L)), I32),
            B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x1B1B));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(11171)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed byte/word sign-transfer on YMM -- vpsignb / vpsignw
// (<32 x i8> / <16 x i16>: each lane dst = ctl<0 ? -data : (ctl==0 ? 0 : data)).
// The byte (32-lane) and word (16-lane) siblings of the dword visign256
// (vpsignd): identical sign-application semantics two and one element-widths
// narrower, so the far denser lane grid makes element-width confusion
// observable -- a decoder that treated vpsignb/vpsignw as the dword vpsignd
// would coalesce four / two lanes and mis-transfer the signs.  vpsign is a
// purely vertical (per-lane) op so the per-128-bit-lane emulation covers it,
// but at 32 / 16 lanes the position sensitivity is the densest of any sign/abs
// shape so far, and the i8/i16 negate exercises 2's-complement wraparound at
// the narrow width (-128 / -32768 negate back to themselves, exactly as
// vpsignb/vpsignw do).
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 the dedicated llvm.x86.avx2.psign.b / psign.w carry
// +avx2, so they lower straight to vpsignb / vpsignw ymm.  Every other cell
// open-codes the identical per-lane sign transfer (negate + two selects keyed
// on the control lane's sign / zero, all native i8/i16 sub/icmp/select, zero
// libcall).  Both results are observable -- the 32 byte lanes (ascending
// weights) and the 16 word lanes (descending weights) are sign-extended and
// reduced, so a mis-applied sign or mis-placed lane changes the sum -- while
// integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x2D2D/15749) + a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/
// indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxISignBW256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "visignbw256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Byte data/control <32 x i8> and word data/control <16 x i16>, all runtime-
  // derived (truncated from i32) so each lane spans negative / zero / positive
  // across the inputs and both the sign and the zero branch fire.
  llvm::Value *VBData = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VBCtl = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VBData = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VBData,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VBCtl = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VBCtl,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16))),
                        B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 15)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }
  llvm::Value *VWData = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
  llvm::Value *VWCtl = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    VWData = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VWData,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
    VWCtl = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VWCtl,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8))),
                        B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 7)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Per-lane sign transfer dst = ctl<0 ? -data : (ctl==0 ? 0 : data), matching
  // vpsignb / vpsignw exactly (the i8/i16 sub wraps, so -INT_MIN == INT_MIN).
  auto SignXfer = [&](llvm::Value *Data, llvm::Value *Ctl, llvm::Type *EltTy,
                      llvm::Type *VecTy, unsigned N) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(VecTy);
    auto *Zero = llvm::ConstantInt::get(EltTy, 0);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < N; ++L) {
      auto *Dv = B.CreateExtractElement(Data, uint64_t(L));
      auto *Sv = B.CreateExtractElement(Ctl, uint64_t(L));
      auto *NZ = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(Sv, Zero), Zero, Dv);
      auto *Rv = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(Sv, Zero),
                                B.CreateSub(Zero, Dv), NZ);
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Rv, uint64_t(L));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vpsignb / vpsignw ymm on x86-64; open-coded per-lane sign transfer else.
  llvm::Value *SB, *SW;
  if (IsX64) {
    SB = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psign_b, {},
                           {VBData, VBCtl});
    SW = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psign_w, {},
                           {VWData, VWCtl});
  } else {
    SB = SignXfer(VBData, VBCtl, I8, V32b, 32);
    SW = SignXfer(VWData, VWCtl, I16, V16w, 16);
  }

  // Reduce: 32 sign-applied bytes (ascending weights) + 16 sign-applied words
  // (descending weights), all sign-extended -- both ops and every lane position
  // observable.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(SB, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(SW, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(16 - L)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x2D2D));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(15749)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed dword in-lane immediate shuffle on YMM -- vpshufd
// (<8 x i32>: within each 128-bit lane the four dwords are permuted by a
// compile-time imm8, the SAME imm8 driving both 128-bit lanes).  This is the
// immediate, single-source, dword-granular sibling of the existing 256-bit
// shuffles: vishufb256 (vpshufb) is runtime, byte-granular, in-lane; viperm256
// (vpermd/vpermps) is runtime, dword-granular and CROSS-128-bit-lane; vpshufd is
// compile-time, dword-granular and IN-128-bit-lane -- a distinct decode path
// (0F 70 /r ib) no prior 256-bit shape exercises.  Because the imm8 is applied
// independently to each 128-bit lane (result.d[lane*4 + p] =
// src.d[lane*4 + ((imm >> (2*p)) & 3)]), a decoder that treated vpshufd ymm as a
// flat 256-bit dword permute -- or that applied the low imm bits across the
// whole register -- would mis-route four dwords and change the reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpshufd has no dedicated intrinsic in modern LLVM (it is a pure
// shufflevector), so on x86-64 the constant <8 x i32> in-lane shuffle, anchored
// +avx2 by an idle llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 sentinel, is selected straight to
// vpshufd ymm; every other cell open-codes the identical permute
// (extractelement / insertelement by the same per-lane index, all native i32
// moves, zero libcall).  Two different imm8 patterns (0x4E = swap the two 64-bit
// halves, 0xB1 = swap adjacent dwords) drive two shuffles, reduced with
// ascending / descending per-lane weights so every routed dword is observable,
// while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x3D3D/20231) + a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/
// indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIShufD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vishufd256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <8 x i32> data, runtime-derived from the inputs so each dword spans the full
  // range and the shuffle cannot be folded to a constant.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x131 + 1)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 4)))),
        uint64_t(I));

  // vpshufd applies imm8 per 128-bit lane: result.d[lane*4 + p] =
  // src.d[lane*4 + ((imm >> (2*p)) & 3)].
  auto ShufD = [&](uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    int Lane[4];
    for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
      Lane[P] = (Imm >> (2 * P)) & 3;
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 8> Idx;
      for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
        for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
          Idx.push_back(int(L * 4 + Lane[P]));
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(VD, llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i), Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
      for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(
            R, B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(L * 4 + Lane[P])),
            uint64_t(L * 4 + P));
    return R;
  };

  // +avx2 anchor so the 256-bit YMM shuffle lowers to vpshufd, not split halves.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VA, VS});
  }

  llvm::Value *S1 = ShufD(0x4E);
  llvm::Value *S2 = ShufD(0xB1);

  // Reduce both shuffles with distinct ascending / descending per-lane weights
  // so each routed dword is observable (a mis-route changes S).
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(S1, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(S2, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(8 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x3D3D));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(20231)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed word in-lane immediate shuffle on YMM -- vpshuflw /
// vpshufhw (<16 x i16>: within each 128-bit lane vpshuflw permutes the FOUR LOW
// words by a compile-time imm8 and copies the four high words unchanged, while
// vpshufhw permutes the four HIGH words and copies the four low words unchanged;
// the SAME imm8 drives both 128-bit lanes).  This is the WORD-granular sibling of
// the dword vishufd256 (vpshufd) just added: vpshufd is dword-granular and
// rewrites all four dwords of each lane, whereas vpshuflw/vpshufhw are
// word-granular, touch only HALF the lane and copy the other half verbatim -- and
// they ride a DISTINCT decode path (F2 0F 70 /r ib for vpshuflw, F3 0F 70 /r ib
// for vpshufhw, vs 66 0F 70 for vpshufd).  Because each instruction shuffles only
// its own 64-bit half of every 128-bit lane (the other half is identity) and the
// imm8 indexes within that half, a decoder that let the imm8 address all eight
// words, permuted the wrong half, or crossed the 128-bit lane would mis-route
// four words and change the reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpshuflw/vpshufhw have no dedicated intrinsic in modern LLVM (they
// are pure shufflevectors), so on x86-64 the constant <16 x i16> half-lane
// shuffles, anchored +avx2 by an idle llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 sentinel, are
// selected to vpshuflw ymm / vpshufhw ymm; every other cell open-codes the
// identical permute (extractelement / insertelement by the same per-lane index,
// all native i16 moves, zero libcall).  vpshuflw imm8 0x1B (reverse the four low
// words) and vpshufhw imm8 0x1B (reverse the four high words) drive the two
// shuffles, reduced with ascending zero-extended / descending sign-extended
// per-lane weights so every routed word -- and every identity-copied word -- is
// observable, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x4F4F/22751) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst/const-enc/
// opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIShufW256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vishufw256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <16 x i16> data, runtime-derived from the inputs so each word spans the full
  // range and the shuffles cannot be folded to a constant.
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I)
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x101 + 1)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I16),
        uint64_t(I));

  // vpshuflw: low 4 words of each 128-bit lane permuted by imm8, high 4 identity.
  auto ShufLW = [&](uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    int Lane[4];
    for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
      Lane[P] = (Imm >> (2 * P)) & 3;
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 16> Idx;
      for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L) {
        for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
          Idx.push_back(int(L * 8 + Lane[P]));
        for (unsigned P = 4; P < 8; ++P)
          Idx.push_back(int(L * 8 + P));
      }
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(VD, llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w), Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L) {
      for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(
            R, B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(L * 8 + Lane[P])),
            uint64_t(L * 8 + P));
      for (unsigned P = 4; P < 8; ++P)
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(
            R, B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(L * 8 + P)),
            uint64_t(L * 8 + P));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // vpshufhw: high 4 words of each 128-bit lane permuted by imm8, low 4 identity.
  auto ShufHW = [&](uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    int Lane[4];
    for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
      Lane[P] = (Imm >> (2 * P)) & 3;
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 16> Idx;
      for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L) {
        for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
          Idx.push_back(int(L * 8 + P));
        for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
          Idx.push_back(int(L * 8 + 4 + Lane[P]));
      }
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(VD, llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w), Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L) {
      for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(
            R, B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(L * 8 + P)),
            uint64_t(L * 8 + P));
      for (unsigned P = 0; P < 4; ++P)
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(
            R, B.CreateExtractElement(VD, uint64_t(L * 8 + 4 + Lane[P])),
            uint64_t(L * 8 + 4 + P));
    }
    return R;
  };

  // +avx2 anchor so the 256-bit YMM word shuffles lower to vpshuflw/vpshufhw,
  // not split 128-bit halves.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VA, VS});
  }

  llvm::Value *S1 = ShufLW(0x1B);
  llvm::Value *S2 = ShufHW(0x1B);

  // Reduce both shuffles with distinct ascending zero-extended / descending
  // sign-extended per-lane weights so every routed word is observable.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(S1, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(S2, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x4F4F));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(22751)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed byte in-lane dual-source immediate align on YMM -- vpalignr
// (<32 x i8>: within each 128-bit lane concatenate src1||src2 into a 32-byte
// stream and extract 16 bytes starting at compile-time imm8&0x1F; the SAME imm8
// drives both 128-bit lanes).  This is the first 256-bit shape that is a
// dual-source, compile-time-immediate BYTE boundary rotate between two YMM
// operands -- distinct from vishufb256 (single-source runtime byte gather),
// viblendvb256 (runtime dual-source byte select), and viperm256 (cross-lane
// dword gather).  Because each lane only reads its own src1/src2 halves, a
// decoder that concatenated across the full 256 bits, used the wrong half, or
// failed to mask imm8 to five bits would mis-route bytes and change the
// reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpalignr has no dedicated 256-bit intrinsic in modern LLVM (it is a
// pure shufflevector), so on x86-64 the constant <32 x i8> in-lane align,
// anchored +avx2 by an idle llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 sentinel, is selected to
// vpalignr ymm; every other cell open-codes the identical per-lane concat+extract
// (extractelement / insertelement, all native i8 moves, zero libcall).  imm8 3
// on (VA,VB) and imm8 8 on swapped (VB,VA) drive two aligns, reduced with
// ascending zero-extended / descending sign-extended per-byte weights so every
// routed byte is observable, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x5151/23357) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the
// subst/const-enc/opaque/flatten/bogus/indirect passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIAlignR256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vialignr256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1C3 + 3)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x2A7 + 5)),
                        B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // vpalignr per 128-bit lane: result[lane*16+k] = concat(src1,src2)[imm+k].
  auto AlignR = [&](llvm::Value *S1, llvm::Value *S2,
                    uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    Imm &= 0x1F;
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 32> Idx;
      for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
        for (unsigned K = 0; K < 16; ++K) {
          unsigned Pos = Imm + K;
          if (Pos < 16)
            Idx.push_back(int(L * 16 + Pos));
          else
            Idx.push_back(int(32 + L * 16 + Pos - 16));
        }
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(S1, S2, Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
      for (unsigned K = 0; K < 16; ++K) {
        unsigned Pos = Imm + K;
        llvm::Value *Byte = Pos < 16
                                ? B.CreateExtractElement(S1, uint64_t(L * 16 + Pos))
                                : B.CreateExtractElement(
                                      S2, uint64_t(L * 16 + Pos - 16));
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Byte, uint64_t(L * 16 + K));
      }
    return R;
  };

  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VD = B.CreateInsertElement(VD, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VD, VS});
  }

  llvm::Value *R1 = AlignR(VA, VB, 3);
  llvm::Value *R2 = AlignR(VB, VA, 8);

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(R1, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(R2, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(32 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5151));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(23357)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *Rtn1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *Rtn2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(Rtn1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(Rtn2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 packed byte in-lane immediate left/right byte shift on YMM --
// vpslldq / vpsrldq (<32 x i8>: within each 128-bit lane shift all bytes left
// or right by a compile-time imm8&0x1F count and zero-fill the vacated end;
// the SAME count drives both 128-bit lanes).  This is the first 256-bit shape
// that is an in-lane BYTE shift with zero-fill -- distinct from vvshift256
// (per-dword runtime variable shift), vushift256 (uniform dword shift by xmm
// count), and the shuffle/align family (vishufb/vialignr/vpshuf*).  Because
// each lane shifts only its own 16 bytes, a decoder that shifted across the
// 256-bit boundary or used dword-granular shifts would mis-route bytes.
//
// Cross-ISA: vpslldq/vpsrldq have no dedicated 256-bit intrinsic in LLVM (pure
// shufflevector), so on x86-64 the constant <32 x i8> in-lane byte shifts,
// anchored +avx2 by llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256, lower to vpslldq/vpsrldq ymm;
// every other cell open-codes the identical per-lane shift+zero-fill.  imm8 3
// left + imm8 5 right on the same runtime data drive two shifts, reduced with
// ascending / descending per-byte weights, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// non-folding constants (0x5353/24071) + diamond + PHI drive the seven passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIBShiftDQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vibshiftdq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I)
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1D1 + 7)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
            I8),
        uint64_t(I));

  auto ShiftLDQ = [&](llvm::Value *Src, uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    Imm &= 0x1F;
    if (Imm == 0)
      return Src;
    llvm::Value *Z = llvm::ConstantAggregateZero::get(V32b);
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 32> Idx;
      for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
        for (unsigned K = 0; K < 16; ++K)
          Idx.push_back(K < Imm ? int(32 + L * 16 + K)
                                : int(L * 16 + K - Imm));
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(Src, Z, Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
      for (unsigned K = 0; K < 16; ++K) {
        llvm::Value *Byte =
            K < Imm ? llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, 0)
                    : B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(L * 16 + K - Imm));
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Byte, uint64_t(L * 16 + K));
      }
    return R;
  };

  auto ShiftRDQ = [&](llvm::Value *Src, uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    Imm &= 0x1F;
    if (Imm == 0)
      return Src;
    llvm::Value *Z = llvm::ConstantAggregateZero::get(V32b);
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 32> Idx;
      for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
        for (unsigned K = 0; K < 16; ++K)
          Idx.push_back(K + Imm < 16 ? int(L * 16 + K + Imm)
                                     : int(32 + L * 16 + K));
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(Src, Z, Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
    for (unsigned L = 0; L < 2; ++L)
      for (unsigned K = 0; K < 16; ++K) {
        llvm::Value *Byte =
            K + Imm < 16
                ? B.CreateExtractElement(Src, uint64_t(L * 16 + K + Imm))
                : llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, 0);
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, Byte, uint64_t(L * 16 + K));
      }
    return R;
  };

  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VA, VS});
  }

  llvm::Value *S1 = ShiftLDQ(VD, 3);
  llvm::Value *S2 = ShiftRDQ(VD, 5);

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(S1, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(S2, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(32 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5353));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(24071)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 element broadcast on YMM -- vpbroadcastb / vpbroadcastw /
// vpbroadcastd / vpbroadcastq (replicate the lowest byte/word/dword/qword of the
// source across every lane of the 256-bit destination).  This is the first
// 256-bit integer shape that is a single-source ELEMENT splat from memory/xmm
// low element -- distinct from vdup256 (FP vmovddup/vmovsldup/vmovshdup in-lane
// partial dup) and from shuffle/align/shift families.  Because each broadcast
// reads only element 0 of the source, a decoder that splatted the wrong element
// or crossed 128-bit lanes would change every lane of the reduction.
//
// Cross-ISA: on x86-64 constant-index shufflevectors over runtime-filled vectors
// lower to vpbroadcast* ymm with +avx2 anchored by llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256;
// other cells open-code extractelement+insertelement splat (zero libcall).
// Four element widths are reduced with ascending per-lane weights so every
// replicated lane is observable; integer add/sub/and/or/xor + 0x5757/25211 +
// diamond + PHI drive the seven passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIBroadcast256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                          const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vibroadcast256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VW = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
  llvm::Value *VQ = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    auto *Bval = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1E7 + 11)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 16)))),
        I8);
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Bval, uint64_t(I));
    if (I < 16)
      VW = B.CreateInsertElement(VW, B.CreateZExt(Bval, I16), uint64_t(I));
    if (I < 8)
      VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VD, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateZExt(Bval, I32), I32), uint64_t(I));
    if (I < 4)
      VQ = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VQ,
          B.CreateZExt(B.CreateZExt(B.CreateZExt(Bval, I32), I32), I64),
          uint64_t(I));
  }

  auto Bcast = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) -> llvm::Value * {
    if (IsX64) {
      llvm::SmallVector<int, 32> Idx(N, 0);
      return B.CreateShuffleVector(V, llvm::UndefValue::get(V->getType()), Idx);
    }
    llvm::Value *E = B.CreateExtractElement(V, uint64_t(0));
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V->getType());
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < N; ++I)
      R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, E, uint64_t(I));
    return R;
  };

  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VS = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VS = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VS, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {}, {VA, VS});
  }

  llvm::Value *PB = Bcast(VB, 32);
  llvm::Value *PW = Bcast(VW, 16);
  llvm::Value *PD = Bcast(VD, 8);
  llvm::Value *PQ = Bcast(VQ, 4);

  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 32; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(PB, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(PW, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(PD, uint64_t(L)),
                      B.getInt32((L + 1) * 3)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 4; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateExtractElement(PQ, uint64_t(L)), I32),
                      B.getInt32((L + 1) * 5)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5757));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(25211)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 multiple sum-of-absolute-differences on YMM -- vmpsadbw
// (<32 x i8>, <32 x i8>, imm8 -> <16 x i16>).  Distinct from the plain
// sum-of-abs-diff visad256 (vpsadbw, one 8-byte SAD per 64-bit lane): vmpsadbw
// computes eight overlapping 4-byte SADs per 128-bit lane against a selectable
// 4-byte block, and -- the headline -- the 256-bit form drives the two 128-bit
// lanes with DIFFERENT imm8 sub-fields (the low lane from imm8[2:0], the high
// lane from imm8[5:3]), so a decoder that applies one imm8 to both lanes, or
// fails to decode the YMM form at all, is caught.
//
// Cross-ISA: vmpsadbw has a dedicated x86 intrinsic (llvm.x86.avx2.mpsadbw)
// whose name itself requests +avx2, so the x86-64 cell pins it directly and it
// lowers straight to vmpsadbw ymm; an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn
// baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Every other cell open-codes the identical
// per-lane multiple-SAD (unsigned byte abs-diff windows summed to a word), which
// lowers to plain i32 sub / compare / select / add, libcall-free.  Two calls
// with swapped sources and distinct imm8s (0x27 -> lanes {7,4}, 0x13 ->
// lanes {3,2}) exercise both imm sub-fields; their sixteen unsigned word results
// are reduced with distinct ascending / descending per-lane weights (so a
// mis-routed lane changes the sum).  No L1 pass touches the SAD sub-graph, so
// the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it under
// emulation, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x6B6B/23981) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
//
//   int vimpsad256(int a, int c) {
//     uint8x32 va, vb;                        // both arg-derived
//     uint16x16 r1 = mpsadbw(va, vb, 0x27);   // vmpsadbw ymm (x86-64)
//     uint16x16 r2 = mpsadbw(vb, va, 0x13);
//     int s = sum(r1[i]*(i+1)) + sum(r2[i]*(16-i));
//     ... data-dependent diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMpsadbw256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimpsad256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <32 x i8> operands, every byte arg-derived so the SAD windows vary.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 32; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 7)),
                                  B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 1))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x0D3 + 13)),
                                  B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 2))),
                      I8),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // Open-coded vmpsadbw: per 128-bit lane, eight overlapping 4-byte unsigned
  // SAD windows; the lane's imm8 sub-field picks the src1 window offset
  // (bit 2 -> 0 or 4) and the src2 4-byte block (bits 1:0 -> 0/4/8/12).
  auto OpenMpsad = [&](llvm::Value *S1, llvm::Value *S2,
                       unsigned Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *R = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16w);
    for (unsigned Lane = 0; Lane < 2; ++Lane) {
      unsigned LI = (Lane == 0) ? (Imm & 7) : ((Imm >> 3) & 7);
      unsigned Base1 = (LI & 4) ? 4 : 0;
      unsigned Base2 = (LI & 3) * 4;
      for (unsigned J = 0; J < 8; ++J) {
        llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt32(0);
        for (unsigned K = 0; K < 4; ++K) {
          auto *X = B.CreateZExt(
              B.CreateExtractElement(S1, uint64_t(Lane * 16 + Base1 + J + K)),
              I32);
          auto *Y = B.CreateZExt(
              B.CreateExtractElement(S2, uint64_t(Lane * 16 + Base2 + K)), I32);
          auto *D = B.CreateSub(X, Y);
          Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(D, B.getInt32(0)),
                                                B.CreateNeg(D), D));
        }
        R = B.CreateInsertElement(R, B.CreateTrunc(Acc, I16),
                                  uint64_t(Lane * 8 + J));
      }
    }
    return R;
  };

  llvm::Value *R1v, *R2v;
  if (IsX64) {
    R1v = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_mpsadbw, {},
                            {VA, VB, B.getInt8(0x27)});
    R2v = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_mpsadbw, {},
                            {VB, VA, B.getInt8(0x13)});
  } else {
    R1v = OpenMpsad(VA, VB, 0x27);
    R2v = OpenMpsad(VB, VA, 0x13);
  }

  // SAD words are unsigned [0,1020]; reduce with distinct ascending / descending
  // weights so a mis-routed lane changes the sum.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(R1v, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(
        S, B.CreateMul(
               B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(R2v, uint64_t(L)), I32),
               B.getInt32(16 - L)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x6B6B));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(23981)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 cross-128-bit-lane block permute -- vperm2i128.  Distinct from the
// element-granular cross-lane permute viperm256 (vpermd/vpermps, one dword per
// index lane): this moves whole 128-bit blocks -- each of the two 128-bit dst
// halves is filled from one of the four 128-bit source blocks (src1 low/high,
// src2 low/high), selected by imm8[1:0] / imm8[5:4].  A decoder that applies one
// block selector to both lanes, or fails to decode the YMM form, is caught.
//
// Cross-ISA: llvm.x86.avx2.vperm2i128 was auto-upgraded to native IR in modern
// LLVM, so the permute is expressed as two 2-source 128-bit-block shufflevectors
// (each dst half drawn from a DIFFERENT source so ISel must select vperm2i128,
// not vpermq / vinserti128).  On x86-64 a dead llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors
// +avx2 (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys it off the avx2 intrinsic name)
// so the <8 x i32> block shuffles lower to vperm2i128 ymm with two distinct imm8s
// (0x31: va.hi/vb.hi, 0x02: vb.lo/va.lo) -- an undecoded YMM op faults the
// Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Other cells lower the same shuffles to
// native 128-bit moves (NEON / split SSE), libcall-free.  The sixteen dword
// results are reduced with distinct ascending / descending per-lane weights (so a
// mis-routed 128-bit block changes the sum).  No L1 pass touches the permute
// sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it
// under emulation, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants
// (0x5C5C/26309) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc /
// opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
//
//   int vperm2i256(int a, int c) {
//     int32x8 va, vb;                                      // both arg-derived
//     int32x8 r1 = shuffle(va, vb, {4,5,6,7,12,13,14,15}); // vperm2i128 0x31
//     int32x8 r2 = shuffle(va, vb, {8,9,10,11,0,1,2,3});   // vperm2i128 0x02
//     int s = sum(r1[i]*(i+1)) + sum(r2[i]*(8-i));
//     ... data-dependent diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIVPerm2I256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vperm2i256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <8 x i32> operands, every dword arg-derived so the blocks vary.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 7)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x0D3 + 13)),
                        B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 2))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor (x86-64): a dead psllv keeps the 256-bit YMM domain so the
  // 128-bit-block shuffles below lower to vperm2i128 ymm rather than split SSE
  // (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off the avx2 intrinsic name).
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VAa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VSa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VAa =
          B.CreateInsertElement(VAa, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VSa = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VSa, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {},
                            {VAa, VSa});
  }

  // vperm2i128 as two 2-source 128-bit block shuffles -- each dst half is drawn
  // from a DIFFERENT source so ISel must select vperm2i128 (not vpermq /
  // vinserti128): {4,5,6,7,12,13,14,15} = va.hi:vb.hi (imm 0x31),
  // {8,9,10,11,0,1,2,3} = vb.lo:va.lo (imm 0x02).
  llvm::Value *R1v = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, VB, {4, 5, 6, 7, 12, 13, 14, 15});
  llvm::Value *R2v = B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, VB, {8, 9, 10, 11, 0, 1, 2, 3});

  // Sixteen dword results reduced with ascending / descending weights so a
  // mis-routed 128-bit block changes the sum.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(R1v, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(R2v, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(8 - L)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(26309)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 cross-128-bit-lane quadword permute by immediate -- vpermq.
// Completes the AVX2 cross-lane permute family alongside viperm256
// (vpermd/vpermps -- one dword per *variable* index lane) and vperm2i256
// (vperm2i128 -- whole 128-bit blocks): this moves the four 64-bit qwords
// across the full 256-bit register under an imm8 (two bits per dst qword pick
// one of the four source qwords).  A decoder that treats vpermq as an in-lane
// shuffle (vpermilpd / vpshufd), or applies one selector to both 128-bit
// halves, is caught.
//
// Cross-ISA: llvm.x86.avx2.permq was auto-upgraded to native IR, so the permute
// is a single-source <4 x i64> shufflevector with cross-128-bit-lane constant
// indices (each dst qword is drawn from a qword in the OTHER half, so ISel must
// select vpermq -- not in-lane vpermilpd / vpshufd, nor vperm2i128 which only
// moves 128-bit blocks).  On x86-64 a dead llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors
// +avx2 (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys it off the avx2 intrinsic
// name) so the <4 x i64> cross-lane shuffles lower to vpermq ymm with two
// distinct imm8s ({2,0,3,1} and {1,3,0,2}) -- an undecoded YMM op faults the
// Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Other cells lower the same shuffles
// to native 128-bit moves (NEON / split SSE), libcall-free.  Each 64-bit lane
// carries distinct high and low dwords (both arg-derived) and the eight qword
// results are folded (lo ^ hi) with distinct ascending / descending per-lane
// weights, so a mis-routed qword -- in either half -- changes the sum.  No L1
// pass touches the permute sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies
// stay byte-identical over it under emulation, while integer
// add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x5C5C/26309) + a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus /
// indirect L1 passes.
//
//   int vpermq256(int a, int c) {
//     int64x4 v;                                   // each qword arg-derived
//     int64x4 r1 = shuffle(v, {2,0,3,1});          // vpermq imm
//     int64x4 r2 = shuffle(v, {1,3,0,2});          // vpermq imm
//     int s = sum((lo(r1[i])^hi(r1[i]))*(i+1))
//           + sum((lo(r2[i])^hi(r2[i]))*(8-i));
//     ... data-dependent diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIVPermQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vpermq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Four <4 x i64> lanes, each qword built from both args with distinct high
  // and low dwords so every qword -- and both of its halves -- is unique.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 4; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Lo = B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 7)),
                                  B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 1)));
    llvm::Value *Hi = B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x0D3 + 13)),
                                  B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 2)));
    llvm::Value *Q =
        B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(Hi, I64), B.getInt64(32)),
                   B.CreateZExt(Lo, I64));
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, Q, uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor (x86-64): a dead psllv keeps the 256-bit YMM domain so the
  // cross-lane qword shuffles below lower to vpermq ymm rather than split SSE
  // (CodeGenX86::detectTargetFeaturesX86 keys +avx2 off the avx2 intrinsic
  // name).
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VAa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VSa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VAa =
          B.CreateInsertElement(VAa, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VSa = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VSa, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {},
                            {VAa, VSa});
  }

  // vpermq as two single-source cross-128-bit-lane qword permutes -- each dst
  // qword is drawn from a qword in the OTHER 128-bit half so ISel must select
  // vpermq (not in-lane vpermilpd / vpshufd, nor vperm2i128).
  llvm::Value *R1v =
      B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q), {2, 0, 3, 1});
  llvm::Value *R2v =
      B.CreateShuffleVector(VA, llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q), {1, 3, 0, 2});

  // Eight qword results folded (lo ^ hi) with ascending / descending per-lane
  // weights so a mis-routed qword -- in either half -- changes the sum.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 4; ++L) {
    llvm::Value *E = B.CreateExtractElement(R1v, uint64_t(L));
    llvm::Value *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(E, I32);
    llvm::Value *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(E, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi), B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  }
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 4; ++L) {
    llvm::Value *E = B.CreateExtractElement(R2v, uint64_t(L));
    llvm::Value *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(E, I32);
    llvm::Value *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(E, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi), B.getInt32(8 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5C5C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(26309)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 per-dword blend by immediate on YMM -- vpblendd.  Distinct from
// the two blends already covered: viblendw256 (vpblendw -- per-WORD, imm8
// replicated across each 128-bit lane) and viblendvb256 (vpblendvb -- per-byte,
// blend mask in a VECTOR not an imm).  This is the per-DWORD immediate blend:
// dst.d[i] = imm8[i] ? src2.d[i] : src1.d[i] for the eight dwords (one imm8 bit
// per dword across the full 256, no lane replication).  A decoder that
// replicates the imm across 128-bit lanes (vpblendw-style) or mis-sizes the
// element is caught.
//
// Cross-ISA: llvm.x86.avx2.pblendd.256 was auto-upgraded to native IR, so the
// blend is a two-source <8 x i32> shufflevector whose mask keeps every lane in
// place and only chooses its source (index i or i+8).  On x86-64 a dead
// llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors +avx2 so the in-place dword blend lowers to
// vpblendd ymm with two distinct imm8s (0xA5 and 0x5A) -- an undecoded YMM op
// faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).  Other cells lower the
// same select to native 128-bit moves (NEON bsl / split SSE), libcall-free.
// Every dword is arg-derived and distinct between the two sources, and the
// sixteen blended dwords are reduced with distinct ascending / descending
// per-lane weights, so a dword blended from the wrong source changes the sum.
// No L1 pass touches the blend sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies
// stay byte-identical over it under emulation, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor
// + non-folding constants (0x3C3C/22153) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive
// the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
//
//   int viblendd256(int a, int c) {
//     int32x8 va, vb;                              // both arg-derived
//     int32x8 r1 = blend(va, vb, 0xA5);            // vpblendd imm
//     int32x8 r2 = blend(vb, va, 0x5A);            // vpblendd imm
//     int s = sum(r1[i]*(i+1)) + sum(r2[i]*(8-i));
//     ... data-dependent diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIBlendD256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "viblendd256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Two <8 x i32> operands, every dword arg-derived and distinct between the
  // sources so a dword blended from the wrong source is observable.
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x1B7 + 7)),
                        B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I * 5 + 1))),
        uint64_t(I));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(C, B.getInt32(I * 0x0D3 + 13)),
                        B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I * 3 + 2))),
        uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor (x86-64): a dead psllv keeps the 256-bit YMM domain so the
  // in-place dword blends below lower to vpblendd ymm rather than split SSE.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VAa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VSa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VAa =
          B.CreateInsertElement(VAa, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VSa = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VSa, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {},
                            {VAa, VSa});
  }

  // vpblendd as two two-source per-dword immediate blends: each mask keeps lane
  // i in place and only selects its source (i from src1 or i+8 from src2), so
  // ISel must select vpblendd (not vpblendw / vpshufd).
  auto Blend = [&](llvm::Value *V1, llvm::Value *V2,
                   uint8_t Imm) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::SmallVector<int, 8> Idx;
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I)
      Idx.push_back(((Imm >> I) & 1) ? int(8 + I) : int(I));
    return B.CreateShuffleVector(V1, V2, Idx);
  };
  llvm::Value *R1v = Blend(VA, VB, 0xA5);
  llvm::Value *R2v = Blend(VB, VA, 0x5A);

  // Sixteen blended dwords reduced with ascending / descending weights so a
  // dword taken from the wrong source changes the sum.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(R1v, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(L + 1)));
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 8; ++L)
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(B.CreateExtractElement(R2v, uint64_t(L)),
                                   B.getInt32(8 - L)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x3C3C));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(22153)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 byte->word integer widening on YMM -- vpmovsxbw / vpmovzxbw
// (a 128-bit <16 x i8> source widened to a 256-bit <16 x i16> dest:
// dst.w[i] = ext(src.b[i]) for all sixteen lanes).  This is the first integer
// WIDENING shape in the equivalence suite: every prior integer-YMM form is
// same-width (lane-aligned vertical ops, in-lane shuffles/packs, cross-lane
// permutes/blends), whereas pmovsx/pmovzx consume a narrow 128-bit source and
// expand it across the full 256-bit register -- a decoder that treats it as a
// lane-wise op (not one source byte per dest word) mis-places every word.
//
// Cross-ISA: llvm.x86.avx2.pmovsxbw / pmovzxbw were auto-upgraded to native IR,
// i.e. a plain <16 x i8> sext / zext to <16 x i16>.  On x86-64 a dead
// llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors +avx2 so the widen lowers to vpmovsxbw /
// vpmovzxbw ymm (one xmm source -> ymm dest) rather than two split xmm widens
// -- an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).
// Every other cell lowers the identical sext / zext to native widening moves
// (NEON sshll / ushll, split SSE), libcall-free.  Each source byte is
// arg-derived and sign-mixed so sext (vpmovsxbw) and zext (vpmovzxbw) diverge;
// the sext words are reduced sign-extended with ascending weights and the zext
// words zero-extended with descending weights, so both widens -- and a high-bit
// byte where they differ -- are observable.  No L1 pass touches the widen
// sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay byte-identical over it,
// while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding constants (0x6D6D/18211) + a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst / const-enc / opaque / flatten /
// bogus / indirect L1 passes.
//
//   int vimovextbw256(int a, int c) {
//     int8x16 vb;                                  // 128-bit, byte arg-derived
//     int16x16 sx = (int16x16)vb;                  // vpmovsxbw (sign-extend)
//     uint16x16 zx = (uint16x16)(uint8x16)vb;      // vpmovzxbw (zero-extend)
//     int s = sum(sext(sx[i])*(i+1)) + sum(zext(zx[i])*(16-i));
//     ... data-dependent diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMovExtBW256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                        const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V16w = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimovextbw256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // A 128-bit <16 x i8> source, each byte arg-derived and sign-mixed so the
  // sign-extend (vpmovsxbw) and zero-extend (vpmovzxbw) results diverge.
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16b);
  for (unsigned I = 0; I < 16; ++I) {
    llvm::Value *Bv = B.CreateTrunc(
        B.CreateXor(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(I * 0x95 + 3)),
                    B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32((uint32_t)((int)I - 8)))),
        I8);
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Bv, uint64_t(I));
  }

  // +avx2 anchor (x86-64): keep the 256-bit YMM domain so the byte->word widen
  // lowers to vpmovsxbw / vpmovzxbw ymm rather than two split xmm widens.
  if (IsX64) {
    llvm::Value *VAa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    llvm::Value *VSa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8d);
    for (unsigned I = 0; I < 8; ++I) {
      VAa =
          B.CreateInsertElement(VAa, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(I)), uint64_t(I));
      VSa = B.CreateInsertElement(
          VSa, B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(I)), B.getInt32(7)),
          uint64_t(I));
    }
    (void)B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::x86_avx2_psllv_d_256, {},
                            {VAa, VSa});
  }

  // Byte->word widen: sign-extend (vpmovsxbw) and zero-extend (vpmovzxbw).  The
  // auto-upgraded native form of llvm.x86.avx2.pmovsxbw / pmovzxbw is exactly a
  // <16 x i8> sext / zext to <16 x i16> (dst.w[i] = ext(src.b[i])).
  llvm::Value *SX = B.CreateSExt(VB, V16w);
  llvm::Value *ZX = B.CreateZExt(VB, V16w);

  // Reduce: sext words sign-extended with ascending weights, zext words
  // zero-extended with descending weights, so both widens -- and any byte where
  // they differ -- are observable.
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned L = 0; L < 16; ++L) {
    auto *Sw = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(SX, uint64_t(L)), I32);
    auto *Zw = B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(ZX, uint64_t(L)), I32);
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(Sw, B.getInt32(L + 1)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateMul(Zw, B.getInt32(16 - L)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x6D6D));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(18211)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, U);
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                                B.getInt32(0)),
                 Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *R2 = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Pc = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2);
  Pc->addIncoming(R1, Then);
  Pc->addIncoming(R2, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Pc);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit AVX2 dword->qword integer widening on YMM -- vpmovsxdq / vpmovzxdq
// (a 128-bit <4 x i32> source widened to a 256-bit <4 x i64> dest:
// dst.q[i] = ext(src.d[i]) for the four lanes).  Sibling of vimovextbw256
// (vpmovsxbw/vpmovzxbw, byte->word) at the widest step: a 32->64-bit widen whose
// result lives in the qword/i64 domain.  Like all pmovsx/pmovzx it consumes a
// narrow 128-bit source and expands it across the full 256-bit register, so a
// decoder that treats it as a lane-wise op (not one source dword per dest qword)
// mis-places every qword; treating the high lane's source as dwords 0-1 instead
// of 2-3 is also caught.
//
// Cross-ISA: llvm.x86.avx2.pmovsxdq / pmovzxdq were auto-upgraded to native IR,
// i.e. a plain <4 x i32> sext / zext to <4 x i64>.  On x86-64 a dead
// llvm.x86.avx2.psllv.d.256 anchors +avx2 so the widen lowers to vpmovsxdq /
// vpmovzxdq ymm (one xmm source -> ymm dest) rather than two split xmm widens
// -- an undecoded YMM op faults the Unicorn baseline (UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID).
// Every other cell lowers the identical sext / zext to native widening moves
// (NEON sshll / ushll, split SSE), libcall-free.  Each source dword is
// arg-derived and sign-mixed so sext (vpmovsxdq) and zext (vpmovzxdq) diverge;
// each 64-bit result is folded (lo ^ hi) -- the high dword is the sign fill for
// sext and zero for zext, so a negative source dword makes the two widens
// differ -- and the eight folded results carry distinct ascending / descending
// weights, so both widens and any mis-routed qword are observable.  No L1 pass
// touches the widen sub-graph, so the original and obfuscated copies stay
// byte-identical over it, while integer add/sub/and/or/xor + non-folding
// constants (0x4E4E/29501) + a data-dependent diamond + PHI drive the subst /
// const-enc / opaque / flatten / bogus / indirect L1 passes.
//
//   int vimovextdq256(int a, int c) {
//     int32x4 vd;                                  // 128-bit, dword arg-derived
//     int64x4 sx = (int64x4)vd;                    // vpmovsxdq (sign-extend)
//     uint64x4 zx = (uint64x4)(uint32x4)vd;        // vpmovzxdq (zero-extend)
//     int s = sum((lo(sx[i])^hi(sx[i]))*(i+1))
//           + sum((lo(zx[i])^hi(zx[i]))*(8-i));
//     ... data-dependent diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAvxIMovExtDQ256IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                        const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  llvm::Triple TT(Triple);
  bool IsX64 = TT.getArch() == llvm::Triple::x86_64;
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *V8d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vimovextdq256", M.get());
  F->addFnAttr("min-legal-vector-width", "256");
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
