  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "veccmpsel", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *One = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Mx = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSGT(VA, VB), VA, VB);
  auto *Mn = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpSLT(VA, VB), VA, VB);
  auto *Eq = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(VA, VB), VA, B.CreateAdd(VB, One));
  auto *Ne = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpNE(VA, VB), B.CreateSub(VA, VB), VB);
  auto *Ux = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpUGT(VA, VB), VA, VB);
  // Horizontal reduce a <4 x i32> to a scalar via extract + mixed xor/add fold.
  auto Red = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *E2 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2));
    llvm::Value *E3 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3));
    return B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(E0, E1), B.CreateXor(E2, E3));
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Red(Mx), B.CreateShl(Red(Mn), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Eq));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Ne));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Ux));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector floating-point compare + select — completes the compare+select family
// (scalar FP = fcmpsel, vector int = vcmpsel, vector FP = this).  Drives fcmp
// predicates on <4 x float> feeding a vector `select`, lowering to a distinct
// per-ISA path no prior sample exercises:
//   - x86/x64 (SSE): cmpps/cmpltps + andps/andnps/orps blend (or maxps/minps
//     when the >/< select pattern is matched).
//   - AArch64 (NEON): fcmgt/fcmge/fcmeq + bsl/bit.
//   - ARM32 (NEON): vcgt.f32/vceq.f32 + vbsl.
// All hardware, zero libcall (legal <4 x float>).  Inputs are masked to
// [0,65535] so every fptosi stays in-domain and every compare is NaN-free —
// the orig and obfuscated copies are therefore bit-identical by construction,
// and no obfuscation pass rewrites vector fcmp/select, so any Unicorn mismatch
// is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
//
//   int vecfcmpsel(int a, int c) {
//     <4xf32> va = {fa,fa+1,fa+2,fa+3}, vb = {fc,fc+2,fc+4,fc+6};
//     mx = va  >  vb ? va : vb;        mn = va <  vb ? va : vb;
//     ge = va  >= vb ? va-vb : vb-va;  eq = va == vb ? va : vb+1;
//     base = (int)hsum(mx) ^ (int)hsum(mn)<<1 ^ (int)hsum(ge) ^ (int)hsum(eq)
//          ^ T ^ U;
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ c;   // data-dependent diamond
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFloatCmpSelIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vecfcmpsel", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF)), F32);
  auto *Fc = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF)), F32);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateFAdd(Fa, llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, (double)i)),
        B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateFAdd(Fc, llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, (double)(2 * i))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *One = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 1.0));
  auto *Mx = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOGT(VA, VB), VA, VB);
  auto *Mn = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOLT(VA, VB), VA, VB);
  auto *Ge = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOGE(VA, VB), B.CreateFSub(VA, VB),
                            B.CreateFSub(VB, VA));
  auto *Eq = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateFCmpOEQ(VA, VB), VA, B.CreateFAdd(VB, One));
  // Horizontal sum a <4 x float> to a scalar, then truncate to i32.
  auto Hsum = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *E2 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2));
    llvm::Value *E3 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3));
    return B.CreateFPToSI(
        B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFAdd(E0, E1), B.CreateFAdd(E2, E3)), I32);
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(Hsum(Mx), B.CreateShl(Hsum(Mn), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Hsum(Ge));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Hsum(Eq));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector element-wise integer min/max — the vector sibling of the scalar mnmx
// matrix (which drives smax/smin/umax/umin on i32).  Element-wise
// llvm.smax/smin/umax/umin on <4 x i32> lowers to a *different* per-ISA path no
// prior sample exercises:
//   - x86/x64 (SSE2): SSE2 has NO pmaxsd/pminsd/pmaxud/pminud (those are
//     SSE4.1), so each lane min/max is emulated with pcmpgtd + blend, and the
//     unsigned forms add the sign-bias xor — a distinct multi-instruction
//     expansion (note: this is element-wise min/max, unlike vrdc's *horizontal*
//     llvm.vector.reduce.smax/smin reductions).
//   - AArch64 (NEON): smax/smin/umax/umin vector instructions.
//   - ARM32 (NEON): vmax.s32/vmin.s32/vmax.u32/vmin.u32.
// All hardware/inline, zero libcall (legal <4 x i32>).  No obfuscation pass
// rewrites the min/max intrinsics, so orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically
// and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
//
//   int vecminmax(int a, int c) {
//     <4xi32> va = {a,a+1,a+2,a+3}, vb = {b,b+2,b+4,b+6};
//     sx = smax(va,vb); sn = smin(va,vb); ux = umax(va,vb); un = umin(va,vb);
//     base = red(sx) ^ red(sn)<<1 ^ red(ux) ^ red(un) ^ T ^ U;
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ c;   // data-dependent diamond
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vecminmax", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V4}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Sn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V4}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V4}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Un = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V4}, {VA, VB});
  // Horizontal reduce a <4 x i32> to a scalar via extract + mixed xor/add fold.
  auto Red = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *E2 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2));
    llvm::Value *E3 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3));
    return B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(E0, E1), B.CreateXor(E2, E3));
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Red(Sx), B.CreateShl(Red(Sn), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Ux));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Un));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector bit-count intrinsics — the vector sibling of the scalar bcnt matrix
// (ctpop/ctlz/cttz on i32).  llvm.ctpop/ctlz/cttz on <4 x i32> lowers to a
// *different* per-ISA path no prior sample exercises:
//   - x86/x64 (SSE2): no vector popcount/lzcnt/tzcnt instruction, so each is a
//     SWAR bit-twiddling expansion (shift/mask/add trees, and bit-reverse for
//     cttz) across the 4 lanes — a dense fixup/const-pool stress.
//   - AArch64 (NEON): cnt (per-byte popcount) + uaddlp byte-sum for ctpop;
//     clz for ctlz; rbit+clz for cttz.
//   - ARM32 (NEON): vcnt.8 + vpaddl for ctpop; vclz for ctlz; vrbit+vclz cttz.
// ctlz/cttz use is_zero_poison=false so every lane (incl. 0 → 32) is defined.
// All hardware/inline, zero libcall (legal <4 x i32>).  No obfuscation pass
// rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically and any
// Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
//
//   int vecbitcnt(int a, int c) {
//     <4xi32> va = {a,a+1,a+2,a+3}, vb = {b,b+2,b+4,b+6};
//     pc = ctpop(va); lz = ctlz(va,false); tz = cttz(vb,false);
//     base = red(pc) ^ red(lz)<<1 ^ red(tz) ^ T ^ U;
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ c;   // data-dependent diamond
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecBitCntIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vecbitcnt", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Pc = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {V4}, {VA});
  auto *Lz = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {V4}, {VA, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {V4}, {VB, B.getFalse()});
  // Horizontal reduce a <4 x i32> to a scalar via extract + mixed xor/add fold.
  auto Red = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *E2 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2));
    llvm::Value *E3 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3));
    return B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(E0, E1), B.CreateXor(E2, E3));
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Red(Pc), B.CreateShl(Red(Lz), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Tz));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector byte/halfword bit-count / scan (llvm.ctpop/ctlz/cttz on <16 x i8> and
// <8 x i16>) — the narrow-lane complement of `vbitcnt` (<4 x i32>), completing
// the bit-count lane matrix (scalar i32 `bcnt`, scalar i64 `wbcnt`, vector i32
// `vbitcnt`; the byte/halfword vector form was never covered).  Narrow lanes
// lower through a *different* per-ISA path: AArch64 NEON `cnt.16b` is a single
// native per-byte popcount (the <16 x i8> ctpop is one instruction!), <8 x i16>
// ctpop = cnt + `uaddlp` pairwise-widen; ARM32 NEON `vcnt.8` + `vpaddl`; x86
// SSE2 has NO vector popcount/lzcnt/tzcnt at any width, so every lane is a SWAR
// shift/mask/add tree (and a bit-reverse for cttz) — a dense fixup/const-pool
// stress distinct from the <4 x i32> form.  ctlz/cttz use is_zero_poison=false
// so every lane (incl. 0 → bitwidth) is defined.  All hardware/inline, zero
// libcall.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic, so orig/obfuscated lower
// byte-identically — any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
// Multi-block (diamond + PHI) so it reaches all seven suites; the integer mix +
// 0x5A5A/12345 drive the scalar passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecBitCnt8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vbitcnt8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <16 x i8>: ctpop/ctlz on a-derived lanes, cttz on c-derived lanes mixing
  // near-extreme byte constants (varied leading/trailing zero counts).
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  uint8_t BigB[16] = {0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x01, 0x40, 0xc0, 0x7e, 0x81,
                      0x10, 0xf0, 0x33, 0xcc, 0x55, 0xaa, 0x08, 0x7f};
  auto *BigBV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(BigB, 16));
  llvm::Value *VA8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    VA8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA8, B.CreateAdd(Ab, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 7 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VB8 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(16, Cb), BigBV);
  auto *Pc8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {V16}, {VA8});
  auto *Lz8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {V16}, {VA8, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {V16}, {VB8, B.getFalse()});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <8 x i16>: same, halfword lanes.
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  uint16_t BigH[8] = {0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x0001,
                      0x4000, 0xc000, 0x7ffe, 0x8001};
  auto *BigHV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(BigH, 8));
  llvm::Value *VA16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    VA16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA16, B.CreateAdd(Ah, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 131 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VB16 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Ch), BigHV);
  auto *Pc16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {V8}, {VA16});
  auto *Lz16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {V8}, {VA16, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {V8}, {VB16, B.getFalse()});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *S8 = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(Red8(Pc8), B.CreateShl(Red8(Lz8), B.getInt32(1))), Red8(Tz8));
  llvm::Value *S16 = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(Red16(Pc16), B.CreateShl(Red16(Lz16), B.getInt32(1))),
      Red16(Tz16));
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(S8, S16);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector i64 bit-count / scan (llvm.ctpop/ctlz/cttz on <2 x i64>) — the wide
// 64-bit-lane complement of `vbitcnt` (<4 x i32>) and `vbitcnt8` (<16 x i8> /
// <8 x i16>), completing the bit-count lane matrix (scalar i32 `bcnt`, scalar
// i64 `wbcnt`, vector i8/i16/i32; the 64-bit vector lane was never covered).
// The 64-bit lanes lower through a *distinct* per-ISA path: AArch64 NEON has no
// 64-bit-lane `clz`/`rbit` (only up to `.4s`), so <2 x i64> ctlz/cttz must be
// scalarized or built from 32-bit halves, while ctpop is `cnt.16b` + a chain of
// `uaddlp` pairwise-widens up to the 64-bit lane; x86 SSE2 has no vector
// popcount/lzcnt/tzcnt at any width so every lane is a SWAR shift/mask/add
// tree; the 32-bit ISAs (i386/ARM32) split each i64 lane into a register pair
// and reuse the same inline i64 expansion as `wbcnt`.  ctlz/cttz use
// is_zero_poison=false so every lane (incl. 0 -> 64) is defined; all
// hardware/inline, zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic, so
// original/obfuscated lower byte-identically -- any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Multi-block (diamond + PHI) so it reaches all
// seven suites; the integer mix + 0x5A5A / 12345 drive the scalar passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecBitCnt64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vbitcnt64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  // Spread the arg bits across the full 64-bit width with distinct leading /
  // trailing zero runs, then xor with fixed patterns so ctlz/cttz exercise
  // varied counts.  is_zero_poison=false keeps every lane defined.
  uint64_t BigA[2] = {0x7fff0000000000ffULL, 0x00000000f0f0f0f0ULL};
  uint64_t BigB[2] = {0x0000ffff00000001ULL, 0x8000000000000080ULL};
  auto *BigAV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint64_t>(BigA, 2));
  auto *BigBV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint64_t>(BigB, 2));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VA, B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(11)), C64), B.getInt32(0));
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA,
                             B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(33)),
                                        B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(3))),
                             B.getInt32(1));
  VA = B.CreateXor(VA, BigAV);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VB, B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(17)), A64), B.getInt32(0));
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB,
                             B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(41)),
                                        B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(5))),
                             B.getInt32(1));
  VB = B.CreateXor(VB, BigBV);
  auto *Pc = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {V2}, {VA});
  auto *Lz = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {V2}, {VA, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {V2}, {VB, B.getFalse()});
  // Reduce <2 x i64> to scalar i32 via extract + xor + fold high/low halves.
  auto Red = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *X = B.CreateXor(E0, E1);
    return B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(X, B.CreateLShr(X, B.getInt64(32))), I32);
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Red(Pc), B.CreateShl(Red(Lz), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Red(Tz));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Byte-swap intrinsics (llvm.bswap.i16/i32/i64) — the first coverage of the
// bswap instruction class.  Each width lowers to a *completely different*
// per-ISA sequence with zero libcalls: x86/x86-64 `bswap` (+ `rol r16,8` /
// `xchg` for the i16, and a register-pair swap for the i64 on i386), AArch64
// `rev16`/`rev` (the i64 form is a single `rev` on the 64-bit GPR), ARM
// `rev16`/`rev` (the i64 form is two `rev` + register-half swap on the 32-bit
// register pair).  No obfuscation pass touches a bswap intrinsic, so the
// original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical bswap lowering — any
// divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding
// add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants (0x5A5A / 12345) still drive --subst /
// --const-enc and the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// real structure.
//
//   int byteswap(int a, int b) {
//     uint16_t h = bswap16((uint16_t)a);
//     uint32_t w = bswap32((uint32_t)a);
//     uint64_t q = bswap64(((uint64_t)(uint32_t)a << 32) | (uint32_t)b);
//     int base = (int)(uint32_t)h ^ (int)w ^ (int)(uint32_t)(q ^ (q >> 32))
//              ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (t + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildByteSwapIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "bswp",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // i16 byte swap of the low half of a.
  auto *A16 = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16);
  auto *H = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {I16}, {A16});
  auto *Hx = B.CreateZExt(H, I32);
  // i32 byte swap of a.
  auto *W = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {I32}, {A});
  // i64 byte swap of the packed pair (a:b); fold high ^ low back to i32.
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64);
  auto *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  auto *Q0 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(32)), C64);
  auto *Q = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {I64}, {Q0});
  auto *Qf =
      B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(Q, B.CreateLShr(Q, B.getInt64(32))), I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Hx, W);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Qf);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector byte-swap (llvm.bswap on <8 x i16> / <4 x i32> / <2 x i64>) — the
// vector dual of the scalar `bswp` shape, exercising a per-ISA family the
// scalar GPR byte-reverse never reaches: AArch64 NEON has dedicated element
// byte-reverse ops `rev16.16b` (<8 x i16>), `rev32.16b` (<4 x i32>) and
// `rev64.16b` (<2 x i64>); x86 SSE2 has no in-lane byte shuffle (pshufb is
// SSSE3) so each width lowers to a shift/mask/or SWAR tree (widest for the
// 64-bit lanes); ARM32 NEON uses `vrev16.8`/`vrev32.8`/`vrev64.8`.  All
// hardware/inline, zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass rewrites a bswap
// intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical
// lowering — any Unicorn divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Multi-block (diamond + PHI) so it reaches all seven
// suites; the integer mix + 0x5A5A / 12345 drive the scalar passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecBswapIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8H = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vbswap", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);

  // <8 x i16>: eight distinct halfwords derived from A/C, byte-swapped.
  llvm::Value *VH = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    VH = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VH,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(A, B.CreateShl(C, B.getInt32(i))),
                                  B.getInt32(0x1234 * (i + 1))),
                      I16),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *SwH = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {V8H}, {VH});

  // <4 x i32>: four words, byte-swapped.
  llvm::Value *VW = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    VW = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VW,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(A, B.CreateShl(C, B.getInt32(i + 1))),
                    B.getInt32(0x01020304 + i)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *SwW = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {V4}, {VW});

  // <2 x i64>: two doublewords (packed A:C and C:A), byte-swapped.
  llvm::Value *VQ = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VQ = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VQ, B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(32)), C64), B.getInt32(0));
  VQ = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VQ, B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(32)), A64), B.getInt32(1));
  auto *SwQ = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {V2}, {VQ});

  // Reduce each swapped vector to an i32 via extract + xor.
  llvm::Value *RedH = B.getInt16(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    RedH = B.CreateXor(RedH, B.CreateExtractElement(SwH, B.getInt32(i)));
  llvm::Value *RedW = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    RedW = B.CreateXor(RedW, B.CreateExtractElement(SwW, B.getInt32(i)));
  llvm::Value *Q0 = B.CreateExtractElement(SwQ, B.getInt32(0));
  llvm::Value *Q1 = B.CreateExtractElement(SwQ, B.getInt32(1));
  llvm::Value *RedQ = B.CreateXor(Q0, Q1);
  llvm::Value *RedQ32 =
      B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(RedQ, B.CreateLShr(RedQ, B.getInt64(32))), I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateZExt(RedH, I32), RedW);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, RedQ32);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Bit-reverse intrinsics (llvm.bitreverse.i32/i64) — the first coverage of the
// bitreverse instruction class.  Unlike bswap, x86 has *no* bit-reverse
// instruction, so i32/i64 bitreverse lowers to a large SWAR shift/mask
// expansion (0x55555555 / 0x33333333 / 0x0F0F0F0F masks + a byte swap),
// stressing immediate materialization / the constant pool; AArch64/ARM have a
// dedicated `rbit` (the i64 form is a single `rbit` on the 64-bit GPR for
// AArch64, two `rbit` + register-half swap on the 32-bit register pair).  No
// obfuscation pass touches a bitreverse intrinsic, so the original and
// obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor mix
// + constants drive --subst / --const-enc and the data-dependent diamond + PHI
// give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int bitrev(int a, int b) {
//     uint32_t r = bitreverse32((uint32_t)a);
//     uint64_t q = bitreverse64(((uint64_t)(uint32_t)a << 32) | (uint32_t)b);
//     int base = (int)r ^ (int)(uint32_t)(q ^ (q >> 32))
//              ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (t + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBitRevIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "brev",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // i32 bit reverse of a.
  auto *R = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {I32}, {A});
  // i64 bit reverse of the packed pair (a:b); fold high ^ low back to i32.
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64);
  auto *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  auto *Q0 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(32)), C64);
  auto *Q = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {I64}, {Q0});
  auto *Qf =
      B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(Q, B.CreateLShr(Q, B.getInt64(32))), I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(R, Qf);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Scalar saturating arithmetic (llvm.sadd/ssub/uadd/usub.sat.i32) — the first
// coverage of the *scalar* saturating class (the existing `vsat` only covers
// the <8 x i16> vector forms).  Each lowers to a *completely different* per-ISA
// sequence with zero libcalls: x86/x86-64 add/sub + overflow detection +
// cmov/conditional fixup, AArch64 add/sub + cmp + csel/csinv clamp, ARM32 the
// dedicated DSP `qadd`/`qsub` (signed) and add/sub + clamp (unsigned).  No
// obfuscation pass touches these intrinsics, so the original and obfuscated
// copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor mix
// + constants drive --subst / --const-enc and the data-dependent diamond + PHI
// give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int satarith(int a, int b) {
//     int  sa = sadd_sat(a, b);   uint ua = uadd_sat(a, b);
//     int  ss = ssub_sat(a, b);   uint us = usub_sat(a, b);
//     int base = sa ^ ss ^ (int)ua ^ (int)us
//              ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (t + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildSatArithIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "ssat",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Sa = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sadd_sat, {I32}, {A, C});
  auto *Ss = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ssub_sat, {I32}, {A, C});
  auto *Ua = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::uadd_sat, {I32}, {A, C});
  auto *Us = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::usub_sat, {I32}, {A, C});

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Sa, Ss), B.CreateXor(Ua, Us));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Local stack array with a fill loop + variable-index reads — the first shape
// that forces a real *stack frame* (a 16-element local array addressed at
// runtime-computed offsets) instead of the SSA-value-only bodies of every
// other sample (no other builder uses an alloca).  This is exactly the class
// that previously surfaced the opaque-predicate alloca / Windows `__chkstk`
// bug: the obfuscation passes move allocas around (opaque splits the entry
// block; flatten runs reg2mem, demoting PHIs to fresh stack slots), so a
// mishandled alloca shows up as a dynamic stack allocation / stack-probe call
// (an unresolvable external → caught by the Unresolved assert) or a wrong frame
// offset (caught by the Unicorn value compare).  All indices are masked to
// [0,15] (no OOB) and the loop bound is constant 16.  Zero libcalls.
// add/sub/and/xor drive --subst, the constants drive --const-enc, and the loop
// + diamond give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int stackarr(int a, int b) {
//     int buf[16];
//     for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) buf[i] = (a + i * b) ^ (i * i);
//     int s = buf[a & 15] + buf[b & 15] - buf[(a ^ b) & 15];
//     int base = s ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (s + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildStackArrIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "starr", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Head = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "head", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Done = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "done", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Buf = B.CreateAlloca(ArrTy, nullptr, "buf");
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Head);
  auto *I = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(I, B.getInt32(16)), Body, Done);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Body);
  auto *V = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, B.CreateMul(I, C)), B.CreateMul(I, I));
  B.CreateStore(V, B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Buf, {B.getInt32(0), I}));
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(I, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(Head);
  I->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  I->addIncoming(INext, Body);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Done);
  auto loadAt = [&](llvm::Value *Idx) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateLoad(I32,
                        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Buf, {B.getInt32(0), Idx}));
  };
  auto *Ea = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(15)));
  auto *Eb = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(15)));
  auto *Ex = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(15)));
  auto *S = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(Ea, Eb), Ex);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(S, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Over-aligned stack object - the stack-realignment complement of `starr`
// (natural alignment, no realign), `bigframe` (>4 KiB frame probe) and `vla`
// (dynamic-size alloca).  A fixed-size `int buf[16]` is requested at 32-byte
// alignment (C `alignas(32)`) - strictly greater than the 16-byte ABI stack
// alignment x86-64 / AArch64 / i386 guarantee (and the 8-byte ARM EABI one) -
// so the backend must *dynamically realign* the stack pointer in the prologue:
// x86 `and rsp, -32` + frame pointer, AArch64 `mov x9,sp; and x9,x9,#-32;
// mov sp,x9` with FP-relative addressing, ARM32 `bic sp, sp, #31`.  This is a
// distinct prologue/epilogue shape from every other stack shape (none of which
// over-aligns its slot), so the rewrite backend must preserve the realignment
// masking and FP-relative addressing byte-for-byte.  Dynamic load/store indices
// keep the array in memory (SROA cannot promote it), so the over-aligned slot
// really materialises.  add/sub/and/or/xor drive --subst, the constants drive
// --const-enc, and the fill loop + tail diamond give the CFG passes structure.
// All indices masked to [0,15] so there is no OOB.  Zero libcall.
//
//   int salign(int a, int b) {
//     alignas(32) int buf[16];
//     for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) buf[i] = (a + i * b) ^ (i * i);
//     int s = buf[a & 15] + buf[b & 15] - buf[(a ^ b) & 15];
//     int base = s ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (s + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildStackAlignIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "salign", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Head = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "head", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Done = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "done", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Buf = B.CreateAlloca(ArrTy, nullptr, "buf");
  Buf->setAlignment(llvm::Align(32)); // over-aligned -> forces stack realign
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Head);
  auto *I = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(I, B.getInt32(16)), Body, Done);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Body);
  auto *V = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, B.CreateMul(I, C)), B.CreateMul(I, I));
  B.CreateStore(V, B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Buf, {B.getInt32(0), I}));
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(I, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(Head);
  I->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  I->addIncoming(INext, Body);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Done);
  auto loadAt = [&](llvm::Value *Idx) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateLoad(I32,
                        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Buf, {B.getInt32(0), Idx}));
  };
  auto *Ea = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(15)));
  auto *Eb = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(15)));
  auto *Ex = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(15)));
  auto *S = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(Ea, Eb), Ex);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(S, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Large fixed-size stack frame — the >4 KiB-frame complement of `starr` (whose
// 16-int / 64-byte frame is well under one page).  A local `int buf[1500]`
// (6000 bytes) forces a stack frame larger than one 4 KiB page, which on COFF
// makes the X86 and ARM backends emit a `__chkstk` *frame* probe in the
// prologue (getStackProbeSize / WindowsRequiresStackProbe fire once the frame
// reaches "stack-probe-size", default 4096).  `__chkstk` is not part of the
// rewrite address model — the resolve callback maps nothing for it — so without
// the compileForRewrite stack-probe suppression the COFF i386/x64/ARM32 cells
// fault (i386 branches to a wild VA) or error out of the MC layer (ARM32
// "cannot perform a PC-relative fixup with a non-zero symbol offset", since the
// unresolved __chkstk branch cannot become a COFF relocation).  This shape hits
// that suppression *deterministically at the baseline* (no obfuscation needed)
// on all three COFF cells — until now it was only reached incidentally, when
// flatten's reg2mem spills happened to push `farbr`'s frame past 4 KiB.  ELF
// and Mach-O have no Windows-style frame probe, so the suppression is a no-op
// there (the equivalence still holds).  Dynamic store/load indices keep the
// whole array allocated (SROA cannot promote it), so the 6 KiB frame really
// materialises.  add/sub/and/or/xor drive --subst, the constants drive
// --const-enc, and the fill loop + tail diamond give the control-flow passes
// real structure.  All indices masked to [0,1023] (< 1500) so there is no OOB.
//
//   int bigframe(int a, int b) {
//     int buf[1500];
//     for (int i = 0; i < 1500; i++) buf[i] = (a + i) ^ (b - i);
//     int s = buf[a & 1023] + buf[b & 1023] - buf[(a ^ b) & 1023];
//     int t = (s ^ (a & b)) | (a | b);
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? t + a : t ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBigFrameIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 1500);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "bigframe", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Head = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "head", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Done = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "done", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Buf = B.CreateAlloca(ArrTy, nullptr, "buf");
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Head);
  auto *I = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(I, B.getInt32(1500)), Body, Done);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Body);
  auto *V = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, I), B.CreateSub(C, I));
  B.CreateStore(V, B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Buf, {B.getInt32(0), I}));
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(I, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(Head);
  I->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  I->addIncoming(INext, Body);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Done);
  auto loadAt = [&](llvm::Value *Idx) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateLoad(I32,
                        B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Buf, {B.getInt32(0), Idx}));
  };
  auto *Ea = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(1023)));
  auto *Eb = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(1023)));
  auto *Ex = loadAt(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1023)));
  auto *S = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(Ea, Eb), Ex);
  auto *T = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(S, B.CreateAnd(A, C)), B.CreateOr(A, C));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(T, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(T, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Dynamic (variable-length) alloca — a runtime-sized `alloca i32, i32 n` (a C
// VLA `int p[n];`).  Every other stack shape (starr / bigframe / structstk) is
// a *fixed-size* alloca whose slot the prologue reserves at a constant offset;
// a variable-size alloca is a distinct, fragile lowering: the backend must
// switch the function to a frame pointer, subtract the runtime size from SP at
// the alloca point (x86 `sub rsp,n` + realign, AArch64 `sub sp,sp,x` /
// `mov x29,sp` frame, ARM `sub sp,sp,r`), address the buffer through the frame
// pointer, and restore SP in the epilogue.  On Windows it would normally pull
// in the `__chkstk` / WIN_ALLOCA stack probe — CodeGen.cpp's pre-pass pins
// "stack-probe-size" and sets "no-stack-arg-probe" to suppress it, so this is
// also the first shape that actually exercises that no-probe dynamic-alloca
// path through the rewrite backend.  n is masked to [1,8] (<=32 bytes) so the
// buffer is tiny, every index is in-bounds, and no probe threshold is crossed.
// Two counted loops (fill + reduce) over the VLA give --flatten/--bogus/
// --indirect/--opaque real CFG; add/sub/and/or/xor + constants drive --subst /
// --const-enc.  Zero libcall.
//
//   int vla(int a, int b) {
//     int n = (a & 7) + 1;          // 1..8
//     int p[n];                     // dynamic alloca
//     for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (a + i) ^ (b - i);
//     int s = 0;
//     for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) s = (s + p[j]) ^ (p[j] & j);
//     int base = s ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (s + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildDynAllocaIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vla",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Head = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "head", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *SumHead = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "sumhead", F);
  auto *SumBody = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "sumbody", F);
  auto *Done = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "done", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *N = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7)), B.getInt32(1)); // 1..8
  auto *P = B.CreateAlloca(I32, N, "vla"); // dynamic
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Head);
  auto *I = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(I, N), Body, SumHead);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Body);
  auto *V = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, I), B.CreateSub(C, I));
  B.CreateStore(V, B.CreateInBoundsGEP(I32, P, I));
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(I, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(Head);
  I->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  I->addIncoming(INext, Body);

  B.SetInsertPoint(SumHead);
  auto *J = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "j");
  auto *S = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(J, N), SumBody, Done);

  B.SetInsertPoint(SumBody);
  auto *E = B.CreateLoad(I32, B.CreateInBoundsGEP(I32, P, J));
  auto *S2 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(S, E), B.CreateAnd(E, J));
  auto *JNext = B.CreateAdd(J, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(SumHead);
  J->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Head);
  J->addIncoming(JNext, SumBody);
  S->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Head);
  S->addIncoming(S2, SumBody);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Done);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(S, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Mixed-width struct on the stack — the complement of `starr` (a uniform i32
// array): a local `{ i8, i16, i32, i64 }` aggregate exercises *sub-word* stack
// stores/loads (8/16-bit), natural-alignment padding, and a 64-bit field on the
// stack (a register pair on the 32-bit ISAs).  This is a distinct stack-frame
// stress from the uniform array: truncating stores to i8/i16 slots + sign-
// extending reloads have ISA-specific encodings (x86 movb/movw + movsx,
// AArch64 strb/strh + ldrsb/ldrsh, ARM strb/strh + ldrsb/ldrsh).  No
// obfuscation pass touches the struct layout; any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  Zero libcalls.
//
//   int structstk(int a, int b) {
//     struct { int8 b; int16 h; int32 w; int64 q; } s;
//     s.b = (int8)(a ^ b);  s.h = (int16)(a + b);
//     s.w = a * 3 - b;      s.q = ((int64)a << 20) ^ (uint32)b;
//     int v = (int)s.b + (int)s.h + s.w + (int)(s.q ^ (s.q >> 32));
//     int base = v ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (v + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildStructStkIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *STy = llvm::StructType::get(Ctx, {I8, I16, I32, I64});
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "sstk",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *S = B.CreateAlloca(STy, nullptr, "s");
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, C), I8),
                B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 0));
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(A, C), I16),
                B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 1));
  B.CreateStore(B.CreateSub(B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(3)), C),
                B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 2));
  auto *Q = B.CreateXor(B.CreateShl(B.CreateSExt(A, I64), B.getInt64(20)),
                        B.CreateZExt(C, I64));
  B.CreateStore(Q, B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 3));

  auto *Lb = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateLoad(I8, B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 0)), I32);
  auto *Lh = B.CreateSExt(B.CreateLoad(I16, B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 1)), I32);
  auto *Lw = B.CreateLoad(I32, B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 2));
  auto *Lq = B.CreateLoad(I64, B.CreateStructGEP(STy, S, 3));
  auto *Lqf =
      B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(Lq, B.CreateLShr(Lq, B.getInt64(32))), I32);
  auto *Vv = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Lb, Lh), B.CreateAdd(Lw, Lqf));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(Vv, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Vv, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide funnel-shift / rotate intrinsics (llvm.fshl / llvm.fshr on i32 and i64)
// — the existing `frot` covers only the *narrow* i8/i16 funnel forms; this is
// the first coverage of the wide i32/i64 funnel/rotate class.  Each lowers to a
// completely different per-ISA sequence: x86 `rol`/`ror` (rotate = same
// operand) and `shld`/`shrd` (funnel = two operands); AArch64 `ror`/`extr`;
// ARM `ror`.  The i64 funnel/rotate by a *variable* amount on the 32-bit ISAs
// (i386 / ARM32) is a multi-register double-shift sequence — a path the narrow
// i8/i16 `frot` never reaches — and is all hardware/inline (rotates and funnel
// shifts never become libcalls).  No obfuscation pass touches a funnel-shift
// intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical
// lowering of the funnel ops — any divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or
// fork-Unicorn bug.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive --subst /
// --const-enc; the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// real structure.
//
//   int wfrot(int a, int b) {
//     uint32_t rl = rotl32(a, b & 31);              // fshl.i32(a, a, amt)
//     uint32_t rr = rotr32(b, a & 31);              // fshr.i32(b, b, amt)
//     uint32_t fl = funnel_shl32(a, b, 13);         // fshl.i32(a, b, 13)
//     uint64_t q  = ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)a << 32) | (uint32_t)b;
//     uint64_t qr = rotr64(q, (a + b) & 63);        // fshr.i64(q, q, amt)
//     int base = rl ^ rr ^ fl ^ (uint32_t)(qr ^ (qr >> 32))
//              ^ ((a + b) ^ (a - b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a & b) | (t + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideFunnelIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wfrot", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // i32 rotate-left (fshl with equal operands) by a variable amount.
  auto *AmtL = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(31));
  auto *Rl = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {I32}, {A, A, AmtL});
  // i32 rotate-right (fshr with equal operands) by a variable amount.
  auto *AmtR = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(31));
  auto *Rr = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {I32}, {C, C, AmtR});
  // i32 funnel shift-left of two *distinct* operands by a constant ->
  // shld/extr.
  auto *Fl =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {I32}, {A, C, B.getInt32(13)});
  // i64 rotate-right of the packed pair (a:b) by a variable amount: the wide
  // multi-register funnel path on the 32-bit ISAs.  Fold hi ^ lo back to i32.
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64);
  auto *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  auto *Q0 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(32)), C64);
  auto *Amt64 =
      B.CreateZExt(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(63)), I64);
  auto *Qr = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {I64}, {Q0, Q0, Amt64});
  auto *Qf =
      B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(Qr, B.CreateLShr(Qr, B.getInt64(32))), I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Rl, Rr);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fl);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Qf);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Memory intrinsics (llvm.memcpy / llvm.memset / llvm.memmove) — the first
// coverage of the memory-operation class.  Small fixed-size copies/sets are
// expanded *inline* by every backend (x86 `rep movs`/`rep stos` or unrolled
// mov/movups; AArch64 unrolled ldp/stp; ARM ldm/stm) — no libcall — but they
// read/write *relocated* global addresses, so the rewrite backend must apply
// the data relocation for the memcpy/memmove source/dest correctly (a misplaced
// global shows up as a data-section byte mismatch or a wrong return value).  A
// const global source lands in read-only data; a writable global is the memmove
// target (an overlapping move inside .data, which the harness byte-compares).
// No obfuscation pass touches a mem intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated
// copies share byte-identical lowering of the mem ops — any divergence is a
// genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix +
// constants drive --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   static const int g_msrc[6] = {0x1111,..};   // -> read-only data
//   static int g_mdst[8] = {0xA,..};             // -> .data (byte-compared)
//   int memops(int a, int b) {
//     unsigned char sbuf[32];
//     memset(sbuf, (unsigned char)(a ^ b), 32);
//     memcpy(g_mdst, g_msrc, 24);                 // ro-data -> data
//     memmove(&g_mdst[1], &g_mdst[0], 20);        // overlapping move in .data
//     int mem = g_mdst[0] + g_mdst[3] + g_mdst[6] + sbuf[0] + sbuf[31];
//     ... fold mem with substitutable arith + diamond ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMemOpsIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *ArrSrc = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 6);
  auto *ArrDst = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *Buf32 = llvm::ArrayType::get(I8, 32);
  const uint32_t SrcInit[6] = {0x1111, 0x2222, 0x3333, 0x4444, 0x5555, 0x6666};
  const uint32_t DstInit[8] = {0xA, 0xB, 0xC, 0xD, 0xE, 0xF, 0x10, 0x11};
  auto *GSrc = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrSrc, /*isConstant=*/true, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantDataArray::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint32_t>(SrcInit, 6)),
      "g_msrc");
  auto *GDst = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrDst, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantDataArray::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint32_t>(DstInit, 8)),
      "g_mdst");
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "memops", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *SBuf = B.CreateAlloca(Buf32, nullptr, "sbuf");
  auto *SBuf0 = B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(Buf32, SBuf, 0, 0);
  // memset the stack buffer with a byte derived from a ^ b.
  B.CreateMemSet(SBuf0, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, C), I8), B.getInt64(32),
                 llvm::MaybeAlign(1));
  auto *Dst0 = B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(ArrDst, GDst, 0, 0);
  auto *Src0 = B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(ArrSrc, GSrc, 0, 0);
  // memcpy the const source over the writable global (6 ints = 24 bytes).
  B.CreateMemCpy(Dst0, llvm::MaybeAlign(4), Src0, llvm::MaybeAlign(4),
                 B.getInt64(24));
  // overlapping memmove inside the writable global: shift [0..4] -> [1..5].
  auto *Dst1 = B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(ArrDst, GDst, 0, 1);
  B.CreateMemMove(Dst1, llvm::MaybeAlign(4), Dst0, llvm::MaybeAlign(4),
                  B.getInt64(20));
  auto *D0 =
      B.CreateLoad(I32, B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(ArrDst, GDst, 0, 0));
  auto *D3 =
      B.CreateLoad(I32, B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(ArrDst, GDst, 0, 3));
  auto *D6 =
      B.CreateLoad(I32, B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(ArrDst, GDst, 0, 6));
  auto *Sb0 = B.CreateZExt(
      B.CreateLoad(I8, B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(Buf32, SBuf, 0, 0)), I32);
  auto *Sb31 = B.CreateZExt(
      B.CreateLoad(I8, B.CreateConstInBoundsGEP2_32(Buf32, SBuf, 0, 31)), I32);
  auto *Mem =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(D0, D3), D6), B.CreateAdd(Sb0, Sb31));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Mem, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// FP min/max intrinsics (llvm.minnum / llvm.maxnum on f32+f64, plus IEEE-2019
// llvm.minimum / llvm.maximum on f32) — the existing `fcmpsel` covers FP
// compare
// + branchless select; this is the first coverage of the dedicated min/max
// intrinsics, which lower to a *different* per-ISA path and zero libcall:
// x86 `minss`/`maxss`/`minsd`/`maxsd` (+ NaN/signed-zero blend for the IEEE
// minimum/maximum), AArch64 `fminnm`/`fmaxnm` / `fmin`/`fmax`, ARM `vminnm`/
// `vmaxnm` (ARMv8) or a compare+select sequence (ARMv7).  Inputs are masked to
// [0,65535] so sitofp/fptosi are exact and operands are NaN-free (but can be
// zero, so the signed-zero IS_FPCLASS path of minimum/maximum is still
// emitted). minnum/maxnum (what C fmin/fmax map to) and the IEEE-2019
// minimum/maximum are both exercised on f32 AND f64.  The f64 signed-zero
// handling bitcasts to i64 for a sign-bit test; on 32-bit ISAs (ARM32/i386) i64
// is illegal, so the fork's TargetLowering::expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM rounds the
// operand to f32 for the IS_FPCLASS class test (the isTypeLegal(IntVT) guard
// expandFMINIMUMNUM_FMAXIMUMNUM already had).  No obfuscation pass touches
// these intrinsics, so the original and obfuscated copies are compared *against
// each other* (not a reference) and stay bit-exact — any divergence is a
// genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.
//
//   int fminmax(int a, int b) {
//     float  fa=(u16)a, fb=(u16)b;  double da=(u16)a, db=(u16)b;
//     int base = (int)(fminf(fa,fb)+fmaxf(fa,fb))            // minnum/maxnum
//     f32
//              + (int)(fmin(da,db)+fmax(da,db))              // minnum/maxnum
//              f64
//              + (int)(fminimumf(fa,fb)+fmaximumf(fa,fb))    // IEEE min/max
//              f32
//              + (int)(fminimum(da,db)+fmaximum(da,db))      // IEEE min/max
//              f64 ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a^b)&1) ? base+a : base^b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatMinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fminmax", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32), *Fb = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F32);
  auto *Da = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F64), *Db = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64);
  auto *Mn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minnum, {F32}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Mx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum, {F32}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *MnD = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minnum, {F64}, {Da, Db});
  auto *MxD = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum, {F64}, {Da, Db});
  // IEEE-2019 minimum/maximum on both f32 AND f64.  The signed-zero handling
  // expands (in TargetLowering::expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM → IS_FPCLASS) to a
  // sign-bit test: i32 for f32 (legal everywhere), i64 for f64.  On 32-bit ISAs
  // (ARM32/i386) i64 is illegal, so the fork's expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM rounds
  // the operand to f32 for the class test (FP_ROUND preserves a zero's sign) —
  // the same guard expandFMINIMUMNUM_FMAXIMUMNUM already has.  This shape
  // exercises that fork fix on ARM32/i386.
  auto *Imn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimum, {F32}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Imx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximum, {F32}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *ImnD = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimum, {F64}, {Da, Db});
  auto *ImxD = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximum, {F64}, {Da, Db});
  auto *Sf = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(Mn, Mx), I32);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(MnD, MxD), I32);
  auto *Si = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(Imn, Imx), I32);
  auto *SiD = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(ImnD, ImxD), I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd), Si), SiD);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector funnel-shift / rotate intrinsics (llvm.fshl / llvm.fshr on
// <4 x i32>) — the vector dual of the scalar `wfrot`.  x86 has no per-lane
// vector rotate (pre-AVX512) so it expands to vector shifts + or; AArch64/ARM
// NEON lower to `ushl`/`shl` sequences — all inline, zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches a funnel-shift intrinsic, so the original and
// obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants
// drive --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// real structure.
//
//   int vfunnel(int a, int b) {
//     int4 va={a,a+1,a+2,a+3}, vb={b,b+2,b+4,b+6};
//     int4 rl=vrotl(va, splat(b&31)), rr=vrotr(vb, splat(a&31));
//     int4 fl=vfunnel_shl(va, vb, splat(13));
//     int base = reduce(rl^rr^fl) ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a^b)&1) ? base+a : base^b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFunnelIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfunnel", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *AmtL = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(31)));
  auto *AmtR = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(31)));
  auto *AmtF = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.getInt32(13));
  auto *Rl = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V4}, {VA, VA, AmtL});
  auto *Rr = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {V4}, {VB, VB, AmtR});
  auto *Fl = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V4}, {VA, VB, AmtF});
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Rl, Rr), Fl);
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
