  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Fused multiply-add (llvm.fmuladd on f32 and f64) — the contraction intrinsic
// the optimizer emits for `a*b+c`.  On targets with hardware FMA (AArch64
// `fmadd`) it is a single fused op; elsewhere (x86-64 baseline / i386 / ARMv7)
// it lowers to a plain `mul`+`add` — but *never* a libcall (unlike llvm.fma).
// Inputs are masked to [0,255] so a*b (<= 2^16) is exact in f32 and fptosi
// never overflows, making the result deterministic regardless of single- vs
// double-rounding.  No obfuscation pass touches fmuladd, so the original and
// obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.
//
//   int fmac(int a, int b) {
//     float  fa=(u8)a, fb=(u8)b;  double da=(u8)a, db=(u8)b;
//     int base = (int)fmaf(fa,fb,fa) + (int)fma(da,db,db)
//              ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a^b)&1) ? base+a : base^b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFMulAddIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "fmac",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32), *Fb = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F32);
  auto *Da = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F64), *Db = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64);
  auto *Mf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fmuladd, {F32}, {Fa, Fb, Fa});
  auto *Md = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fmuladd, {F64}, {Da, Db, Db});
  auto *Sf = B.CreateFPToSI(Mf, I32);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateFPToSI(Md, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// True fused multiply-add (llvm.fma on f32 and f64) — distinct from the
// `fmac`/`vfma` shapes' llvm.fmuladd: fma *forces* a single-rounding hardware
// fused multiply-add, so x86 must emit a VEX-encoded vfmadd, which pulls in the
// +fma,+avx feature set and the AVX-capable CPU model — a codegen path the
// fmuladd shapes (which lower to plain mulss/addss on the SSE2 baseline) never
// reach.  AArch64 uses the base-ISA fmadd; ARM32 vfma (+vfp4).  Inputs are
// masked to [0,255] so a*b+c <= 65280 < 2^24 is exactly representable, making
// the single-rounded fma bit-identical to a separate multiply+add and the
// fptosi in range.  No obfuscation pass touches an fma intrinsic, so the
// original and obfuscated copies lower byte-identically — any Unicorn
// divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn (CPU-model) bug.  The
// integer mix
// + 0x5A5A / 12345 drive the scalar passes; the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFmaIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                         const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "ffma",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32), *Fb = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F32);
  auto *Da = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F64), *Db = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64);
  auto *Mf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {F32}, {Fa, Fb, Fa});
  auto *Md = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {F64}, {Da, Db, Db});
  auto *Sf = B.CreateFPToSI(Mf, I32);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateFPToSI(Md, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector fused multiply-add (llvm.fmuladd on <4 x float> and <2 x double>) —
// the vector dual of the scalar `FMulAdd` (fmac), which only exercises *scalar*
// fmuladd.  Vector fmuladd lowers to a *different* per-ISA path: targets with a
// vector FMA unit fuse it into one instruction (AArch64 NEON `fmla.4s` /
// `fmla.2d`), while x86/x64 SSE2 (no FMA in the baseline these tests target)
// and ARM32 NEON (no packed double) expand it to a vector (or scalarized)
// multiply + add — a divergence the scalar `fmac` never reaches. `llvm.fmuladd`
// is contraction-*permitted* but not required, so it never emits a libcall
// (unlike `llvm.fma`, which calls `fmaf`/`fma` when no hardware FMA exists).
// Every operand is a small masked non-negative integer (a,b,c in [0,255]) so
// each lane's a*b+c <= 65280 < 2^24 is exactly representable in binary32 —
// fused (single rounding) and unfused (double rounding) therefore yield the
// *identical* exact integer, so the result is deterministic regardless of
// whether the target fuses.  fptosi targets i32 (not i64 — avoids the ARM32
// d2lz libcall the harness cannot resolve).  No obfuscation pass touches
// fmuladd/sitofp/fptosi, so the orig and obfuscated copies lower
// byte-identically over the FP sub-graph and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor +
// 0x5A5A/12345 drive --subst / --const-enc; the data-dependent diamond + PHI
// give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vfma(int a, int c) {
//     int am = a & 0xFF, cm = c & 0xFF;                          // [0,255]
//     float4 r4 = fmuladd({am, am+1, am^cm, am+2},               // a*b+c <
//     2^24
//                         {cm, cm+7, cm^0x5A, cm+3},             //  per lane
//                         {cm, cm+5, am, am^0x33});  // fmla.4s / mulps+addps
//     double2 r2 = fmuladd({am, am+9}, {cm, cm+3}, {cm+5, am});  // fmla.2d
//     int s = (int)r4 reduced + (int)r2 reduced;
//     int t = ((a + c) ^ (a - c)) ^ 0x5A5A;
//     int u = (a & c) | (t + 12345);
//     int base = (s ^ t) ^ u;
//     return ((a ^ c) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ c;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFMAIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V2d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 2);
  auto *V2i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vfma",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // [0,255]
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // [0,255]
  // Integer lane kept in [0,255] so every a*b+c stays exactly representable.
  auto m8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateAnd(V, B.getInt32(0xFF)); };
  auto siF = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, Flt); };
  auto siD = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, Dbl); };
  auto mkV4f = [&](llvm::Value *L0, llvm::Value *L1, llvm::Value *L2,
                   llvm::Value *L3) {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4f);
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L0), uint64_t(0));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L1), uint64_t(1));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L2), uint64_t(2));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L3), uint64_t(3));
    return V;
  };
  // <4 x float> fmuladd: each lane a*b+c with a,b,c in [0,255] -> < 2^24 exact.
  llvm::Value *Va =
      mkV4f(Am, m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(1))), B.CreateXor(Am, Cm),
            m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(2))));
  llvm::Value *Vb = mkV4f(Cm, m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(7))),
                          B.CreateXor(Cm, B.getInt32(0x5A)),
                          m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(3))));
  llvm::Value *Vc = mkV4f(Cm, m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(5))), Am,
                          B.CreateXor(Am, B.getInt32(0x33)));
  auto *Mf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fmuladd, {V4f}, {Va, Vb, Vc});
  auto *Mi = B.CreateFPToSI(Mf, V4i);
  auto *Sf = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(0)),
                                     B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(1))),
                         B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(2)),
                                     B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(3))));
  // <2 x double> fmuladd (scalarized to vfma.f64 / vmul.f64+vadd.f64 on ARM32).
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2d);
  Da = B.CreateInsertElement(Da, siD(Am), uint64_t(0));
  Da = B.CreateInsertElement(Da, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(9)))),
                             uint64_t(1));
  llvm::Value *Db = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2d);
  Db = B.CreateInsertElement(Db, siD(Cm), uint64_t(0));
  Db = B.CreateInsertElement(Db, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(3)))),
                             uint64_t(1));
  llvm::Value *Dc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2d);
  Dc = B.CreateInsertElement(Dc, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(5)))),
                             uint64_t(0));
  Dc = B.CreateInsertElement(Dc, siD(Am), uint64_t(1));
  auto *Md = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fmuladd, {V2d}, {Da, Db, Dc});
  auto *Mdi = B.CreateFPToSI(Md, V2i);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(Mdi, uint64_t(0)),
                         B.CreateExtractElement(Mdi, uint64_t(1)));
  auto *S = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit floating-point vector arithmetic (<8 x float> and <4 x double> fadd /
// fmul / fsub) — the first 256-bit-wide FP vector coverage.  Existing FP vector
// shapes are all 128-bit (<4 x float> / <2 x double>); the only prior 256-bit
// shape, vw8, is <8 x i32> *integer*.  No target here has native 256-bit FP (no
// AVX in the SSE2 baseline, NEON is 128-bit), so LLVM *splits* each op into two
// 128-bit halves: x86 2x addps/mulps/subps (+ 2x addpd/mulpd/subpd), AArch64 2x
// fadd.4s / fadd.2d, ARM32 2x vadd.f32 (+ scalarized vadd.f64) — the
// split-in-two legalization the 128-bit FP shapes never reach.  Every lane is a
// small masked integer (<= 255) via sitofp, so each fadd/fsub is exact and each
// fmul product
// (<= 255*255 < 2^24) is exact in binary32 — the result is an exact integer,
// the fptosi (to i32, avoiding the ARM32 d2lz libcall) is in range, and the two
// copies agree bit-for-bit.  Zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches an FP
// op, so orig/obf lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// backend/fork-Unicorn bug; the surrounding integer add/sub/and/or/xor +
// 0x5A5A/12345 drive --subst / --const-enc, the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWideFloatIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V8f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 8);
  auto *V8i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfwide", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // [0,255]
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // [0,255]
  auto m8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateAnd(V, B.getInt32(0xFF)); };
  auto siF = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, Flt); };
  auto siD = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, Dbl); };
  // <8 x float>: each lane a small int in [0,255] so a+b, a-b, a*b all exact.
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f),
              *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8f);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, siF(m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)))),
                               B.getInt32(i));
    Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(Vb, siF(m8(B.CreateXor(Cm, B.getInt32(i * 17)))),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Vsum = B.CreateFAdd(Va, Vb);  // 2x addps / fadd.4s / vadd.f32
  auto *Vprod = B.CreateFMul(Va, Vb); // 2x mulps / fmul.4s / vmul.f32
  auto *Vdiff = B.CreateFSub(Vsum, Vprod);
  auto *Si = B.CreateFPToSI(Vsum, V8i);
  auto *Pi = B.CreateFPToSI(Vprod, V8i);
  auto *Di = B.CreateFPToSI(Vdiff, V8i);
  llvm::Value *Sf = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Sf = B.CreateAdd(Sf, B.CreateExtractElement(Si, B.getInt32(i)));
    Sf = B.CreateAdd(Sf, B.CreateExtractElement(Pi, B.getInt32(i)));
    Sf = B.CreateAdd(Sf, B.CreateExtractElement(Di, B.getInt32(i)));
  }
  // <4 x double>.
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d),
              *Db = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4d);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Da = B.CreateInsertElement(Da, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i * 3)))),
                               B.getInt32(i));
    Db = B.CreateInsertElement(Db, siD(m8(B.CreateXor(Cm, B.getInt32(i * 42)))),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Dsum = B.CreateFAdd(Da, Db); // 2x addpd / fadd.2d / scalarized vadd.f64
  auto *Dprod = B.CreateFMul(Da, Db);
  auto *Ddiff = B.CreateFSub(Dsum, Dprod);
  auto *Dsi = B.CreateFPToSI(Dsum, V4i);
  auto *Dpi = B.CreateFPToSI(Dprod, V4i);
  auto *Ddi = B.CreateFPToSI(Ddiff, V4i);
  llvm::Value *Sd = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Sd = B.CreateAdd(Sd, B.CreateExtractElement(Dsi, B.getInt32(i)));
    Sd = B.CreateAdd(Sd, B.CreateExtractElement(Dpi, B.getInt32(i)));
    Sd = B.CreateAdd(Sd, B.CreateExtractElement(Ddi, B.getInt32(i)));
  }
  auto *S = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit integer vector arithmetic on <4 x i64> (add / sub / and / or / xor) —
// the first <4 x i64> coverage.  The prior 256-bit shape vw8 is <8 x i32>, and
// the i64 vector shape vquad is 128-bit <2 x i64>.  <4 x i64> splits into two
// 128-bit halves, and on the 32-bit ISAs (i386 / ARM32) each i64 lane further
// scalarizes into a 32-bit add/adc, sub/sbc or logic pair — a 256-bit split
// path neither vw8 (i32) nor vquad (128-bit) reaches.  Multiply is
// *deliberately excluded*: a <4 x i64> multiply scalarizes to i64 scalar
// multiplies that pull
// __aeabi_lmul / __muldi3 on 32-bit targets (libcalls the freestanding harness
// cannot resolve) — add/sub/and/or/xor and shifts are all inline on every ISA,
// so this shape stays zero-libcall.  The --subst pass rewrites the vector
// add/sub/and/or/xor (MBA over <4 x i64>); the four lanes fold via xor + hi^lo
// to an i32 so every value is well-defined modular arithmetic and the two
// copies agree bit-for-bit.  Any Unicorn mismatch on the wide split is a real
// backend/fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWide64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4q = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vwide64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Aq = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *Cq = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q),
              *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4q);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Va = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va, B.CreateAdd(Aq, B.getInt64((uint64_t)i * 0x1111ULL + 1)),
        B.getInt32(i));
    Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vb, B.CreateXor(Cq, B.getInt64((uint64_t)(i + 1) * 0x0101010101ULL)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Vand = B.CreateAnd(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vor = B.CreateOr(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vxor = B.CreateXor(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vadd = B.CreateAdd(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vsub = B.CreateSub(Va, Vb);
  llvm::Value *Cmb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Vand, Vor), Vxor);
  Cmb = B.CreateAdd(Cmb, Vadd);
  Cmb = B.CreateSub(Cmb, Vsub);
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt64(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(Cmb, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(Acc, I32);
  auto *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Acc, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
  auto *S = B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit *narrow-lane* integer vector arithmetic on <32 x i8> and <16 x i16>
// (add/sub/and/or/xor/mul) — the first 256-bit narrow-lane coverage.  Existing
// 256-bit shapes are <8 x i32> (vw8) and <4 x i64> (vwide64), i.e. word/dword
// lanes; byte/halfword lanes at 256-bit lower differently: every target splits
// into 2x128, and <32 x i8> mul has *no native instruction on any target*
// (x86 SSE2 widens to i16 pmullw + repacks, AArch64/ARM NEON do mul.16b/vmul.i8
// per 128-bit half), while <16 x i16> mul = 2x pmullw / mul.8h.  --subst
// rewrites the add/sub/and/or/xor over both narrow-lane vector types; the mul
// gives backend coverage.  All modular integer arithmetic, zero libcall; the
// lanes fold via xor to an i32 so every value is well-defined and the two
// copies agree bit-for-bit.  Any Unicorn mismatch on a 256-bit narrow-lane
// split is a real backend/fork-Unicorn bug.  Multi-block (diamond + PHI) so it
// reaches all seven suites; the surrounding integer mix + 0x5A5A/12345 drive
// the scalar passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWide256ByteIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V32b = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 32);
  auto *V16h = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vw256b", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <32 x i8>
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b),
              *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V32b);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
    Va = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va, B.CreateAdd(Ab, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 7 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
    Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vb, B.CreateXor(Cb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 3 + 5))), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Bx = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAnd(Va, Vb), B.CreateOr(Va, Vb)),
                         B.CreateXor(Va, Vb));
  auto *Bc = B.CreateMul(B.CreateAdd(Bx, Va), B.CreateSub(Vb, Va));
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt8(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 32; ++i)
    Sb = B.CreateXor(Sb, B.CreateExtractElement(Bc, B.getInt32(i)));

  // <16 x i16>
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  llvm::Value *Ha = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h),
              *Hb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16h);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Ha = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ha, B.CreateAdd(Ah, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 131 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
    Hb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hb, B.CreateXor(Ch, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 17 + 3))), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Hx = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAnd(Ha, Hb), B.CreateOr(Ha, Hb)),
                         B.CreateXor(Ha, Hb));
  auto *Hc = B.CreateMul(B.CreateAdd(Hx, Ha), B.CreateSub(Hb, Ha));
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt16(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    Sh = B.CreateXor(Sh, B.CreateExtractElement(Hc, B.getInt32(i)));

  auto *S = B.CreateXor(B.CreateZExt(Sb, I32), B.CreateZExt(Sh, I32));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) floating-point vector arithmetic on <2 x float> (fadd /
// fmul / fsub) — the first <2 x float> coverage.  Existing FP vector shapes use
// 128-bit Q-register forms (<4 x float> / <2 x double>); <2 x float> is a
// 64-bit vector that lowers to a *distinct* instruction form: AArch64 fadd.2s /
// fmul.2s / fsub.2s (a D-register, 2-lane op) versus the .4s of <4 x float>,
// ARM32 NEON 2-lane D-register vadd.f32, x86 the low 64 bits of an XMM (2
// packed floats). Each lane is a small masked integer (<= 255) via sitofp, so
// each fadd/fsub is exact and each fmul product (<= 255*255 < 2^24) is exact in
// binary32 — the result is an exact integer, the fptosi (to <2 x i32>, avoiding
// i64) is in range, and the two copies agree bit-for-bit.  Zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches an FP op, so orig/obf lower byte-identically and any
// Unicorn mismatch is a real backend/fork-Unicorn bug; the surrounding integer
// mix + 0x5A5A/12345 drive --subst / --const-enc, the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecF2IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                           const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *V2f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 2);
  auto *V2i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vf2",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // [0,255]
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // [0,255]
  auto m8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateAnd(V, B.getInt32(0xFF)); };
  auto siF = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, Flt); };
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2f),
              *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2f);
  Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, siF(Am), uint64_t(0));
  Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, siF(m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(1)))),
                             uint64_t(1));
  Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(Vb, siF(Cm), uint64_t(0));
  Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(Vb, siF(m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(3)))),
                             uint64_t(1));
  auto *Vsum = B.CreateFAdd(Va, Vb);  // fadd.2s / vadd.f32 (D-reg) / XMM-low
  auto *Vprod = B.CreateFMul(Va, Vb); // fmul.2s
  auto *Vdiff = B.CreateFSub(Vsum, Vprod);
  auto *Si = B.CreateFPToSI(Vsum, V2i);
  auto *Pi = B.CreateFPToSI(Vprod, V2i);
  auto *Di = B.CreateFPToSI(Vdiff, V2i);
  llvm::Value *S = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Si, B.getInt32(i)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Pi, B.getInt32(i)));
    S = B.CreateAdd(S, B.CreateExtractElement(Di, B.getInt32(i)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) integer vector arithmetic on <2 x i32> (add / sub / and /
// or / xor / mul) — the first <2 x i32> *arithmetic* coverage (it otherwise
// appears only as an fptosi target).  <2 x i32> is a 64-bit vector that lowers
// to a *distinct* form: AArch64 add.2s / mul.2s (a D-register op) versus the
// .4s of <4 x i32>, ARM32 NEON D-register, x86 the low 64 bits of an XMM (the
// multiply takes the pmuludq expansion on SSE2, which lacks pmulld).  The
// --subst pass rewrites the vector add/sub/and/or/xor (MBA over <2 x i32>); the
// mul gives backend coverage.  All integer modular arithmetic, zero libcall;
// the two lanes fold via xor to an i32 so every value is well-defined and the
// two copies agree bit-for-bit.  Any Unicorn mismatch on the 64-bit-vector form
// is a real backend/fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecI2IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                           const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vi2",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2i),
              *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2i);
  Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, A, uint64_t(0));
  Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(0x55555555)),
                             uint64_t(1));
  Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(Vb, C, uint64_t(0));
  Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(Vb, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(0x11)), uint64_t(1));
  auto *Vand = B.CreateAnd(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vor = B.CreateOr(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vxor = B.CreateXor(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vadd = B.CreateAdd(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vsub = B.CreateSub(Va, Vb);
  auto *Vmul = B.CreateMul(Va, Vb); // mul.2s / pmuludq expansion
  llvm::Value *Cmb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Vand, Vor), Vxor);
  Cmb = B.CreateAdd(Cmb, Vadd);
  Cmb = B.CreateSub(Cmb, Vsub);
  Cmb = B.CreateXor(Cmb, Vmul);
  auto *S = B.CreateXor(B.CreateExtractElement(Cmb, uint64_t(0)),
                        B.CreateExtractElement(Cmb, uint64_t(1)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) *narrow-lane* integer vector arithmetic on <8 x i8> and
// <4 x i16> (add / sub / and / or / xor / mul) — the byte/halfword complement
// to vi2's <2 x i32>.  These 64-bit byte/halfword vectors lower to a *distinct*
// form from both the 64-bit word vi2 (<2 x i32>) and the 128-bit Q-register
// vbyte/vmulnw (<16 x i8>/<8 x i16>): AArch64 add.8b / mul.8b and add.4h /
// mul.4h (D-register), ARM32 NEON D-register vadd.i8 / vmul.i16, x86/i386 SSE2
// the low 64 bits of an XMM (the <8 x i8> multiply takes the unpack->pmullw
// expansion, <4 x i16> the low-half pmullw).  The --subst pass rewrites the
// vector add/sub/and/or/xor (MBA over the narrow lanes); the mul gives backend
// coverage.  All integer modular arithmetic, zero libcall; every lane folds
// (zext to i32) into the return value so any per-lane mislowering is
// observable. Any Unicorn mismatch on the 64-bit narrow-lane form is a real
// backend/ fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrow64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vn64",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: 64-bit byte-lane vector (AArch64 .8b, ARM32 D-reg, x86 low XMM).
  llvm::Value *Ba = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8),
              *Bb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Ba = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ba, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x11 + 3)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
    Bb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Bb, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x07 + 5)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Bcmb =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAnd(Ba, Bb), B.CreateOr(Ba, Bb)),
                  B.CreateXor(Ba, Bb));
  Bcmb =
      B.CreateAdd(Bcmb, B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(Ba, Bb), B.CreateMul(Ba, Bb)));
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Bcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  // <4 x i16>: 64-bit halfword-lane vector (AArch64 .4h, ARM32 D-reg, x86 low
  // XMM, pmullw multiply).
  llvm::Value *Ha = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16),
              *Hb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Ha = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ha, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x1111 + 7)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
    Hb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hb, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x0707 + 9)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Hcmb =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAnd(Ha, Hb), B.CreateOr(Ha, Hb)),
                  B.CreateXor(Ha, Hb));
  Hcmb =
      B.CreateAdd(Hcmb, B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(Ha, Hb), B.CreateMul(Ha, Hb)));
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Hcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  auto *S = B.CreateXor(Sb, Sh);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) *narrow-lane* per-lane *variable* vector shift on
// <8 x i8> and <4 x i16> (shl / lshr / ashr by a per-lane vector amount) — the
// shift complement to vn64's arithmetic and the 64-bit D-register sibling of
// the 128-bit vshift8 (<16 x i8>) / vshift16 (<8 x i16>).  AArch64 lowers to
// ushl/sshl on a .8b / .4h (D-register) with a (possibly negated) shift vector;
// ARM32 NEON uses D-register vshl; x86/i386 SSE2 has no per-element narrow-lane
// variable shift at all, so the backend scalarizes each lane (extract/shift/
// insert) over the low 64 bits of an XMM.  Each per-lane amount is masked below
// the lane width (& 7 for i8, & 15 for i16) so the shift is never poison; ashr
// keeps the sign so signed/unsigned right shifts diverge.  All inline, zero
// libcall; every lane folds (zext) into the i32 return.  No obfuscation pass
// touches a vector shift, so the original and obfuscated copies share
// byte-identical shift lowering (the surrounding scalar add/sub/and/or/xor is
// what --subst rewrites) — any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend/fork-Unicorn
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowShift64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vsh64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: per-lane variable shift, amounts masked to [0,7].
  llvm::Value *Bv = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8),
              *Bs = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Bv = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Bv, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x13 + 1)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
    Bs = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Bs,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateAnd(B.CreateLShr(C, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(7)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Bcmb =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateShl(Bv, Bs),
                  B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(Bv, Bs), B.CreateAShr(Bv, Bs)));
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Bcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  // <4 x i16>: per-lane variable shift, amounts masked to [0,15].
  llvm::Value *Hv = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16),
              *Hs = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Hv = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hv, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x1357 + 1)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
    Hs = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hs,
        B.CreateTrunc(
            B.CreateAnd(B.CreateLShr(C, B.getInt32(i * 3)), B.getInt32(15)),
            I16),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Hcmb =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateShl(Hv, Hs),
                  B.CreateXor(B.CreateLShr(Hv, Hs), B.CreateAShr(Hv, Hs)));
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Hcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  auto *S = B.CreateXor(Sb, Sh);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) *narrow-lane* integer vector min/max on <8 x i8> and
// <4 x i16> (llvm.smax / smin / umax / umin) — completes the 64-bit D-register
// narrow-lane trio (vn64 arithmetic, vsh64 shift, this min/max), the D-register
// sibling of the 128-bit Q-register vminmax8 (<16 x i8> / <8 x i16>).  AArch64
// lowers to smin/smax/umin/umax on a .8b / .4h (D-register); ARM32 NEON uses
// D-register vmin/vmax; x86/i386 SSE2 is asymmetric over the low 64 bits of an
// XMM (pminub/pmaxub native for unsigned i8 but signed i8 is SSE4.1 -> pcmpgtb
// + blend; pminsw/pmaxsw native for signed i16 but unsigned i16 is SSE4.1 ->
// bias-xor + pcmpgtw + blend).  Lanes mix near-extreme values (high bit set
// differently between the two operands) so the signed and unsigned orderings
// genuinely diverge and the expand-vs-native paths must agree.  All integer
// SIMD, zero libcall; every lane folds (zext) into the i32 return.  No
// obfuscation pass touches a min/max intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated
// copies share byte-identical lowering — any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// backend/ fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowMinMax64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmm64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: byte-lane min/max; lanes xor in 0x80-ish constants so the sign
  // bit varies between operands and signed vs unsigned ordering diverges.
  llvm::Value *Ba = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8),
              *Bb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Ba = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ba, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x13 + 0x80)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
    Bb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Bb, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x21 + 0x40)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Bcmb = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb}),
                  B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb})),
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb}),
                  B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb})));
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Bcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  // <4 x i16>: halfword-lane min/max; lanes xor in 0x8000-ish constants.
  llvm::Value *Ha = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16),
              *Hb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Ha = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ha, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x1357 + 0x8000)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
    Hb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hb, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x2461 + 0x4000)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Hcmb = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb}),
                  B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb})),
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb}),
                  B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb})));
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Hcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  auto *S = B.CreateXor(Sb, Sh);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) *narrow-lane* integer vector saturating add/sub on
// <8 x i8> and <4 x i16> (llvm.sadd.sat / ssub.sat / uadd.sat / usub.sat) — the
// 64-bit D-register sibling of the 128-bit Q-register vsat8 (<16 x i8>) and
// vsat (<8 x i16>).  Saturating arithmetic is among the most ISA-specific
// narrow-lane lowerings: x86/i386 SSE2 has *native* paddsb/psubsb/paddusb/
// psubusb (i8) and paddsw/psubsw/paddusw/psubusw (i16) over the low 64 bits of
// an XMM; AArch64 NEON sqadd/sqsub/uqadd/uqsub on .8b/.4h (D-register); ARM32
// NEON vqadd/vqsub on a D-register.  Lanes mix near-extreme values (0x7f/0x80/
// 0xff bytes, 0x7fff/0x8000 halfwords) so the signed/unsigned clamp boundaries
// genuinely fire and the per-ISA implementations must agree.  All integer SIMD,
// zero libcall; every lane folds (zext) into the i32 return.  No obfuscation
// pass touches a saturating intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated copies
// share byte-identical lowering — any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend/
// fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowSat64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vsat64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: byte-lane saturating add/sub; lanes near the signed/unsigned
  // boundary so the clamps fire.
  llvm::Value *Ba = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8),
              *Bb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Ba = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ba, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x13 + 0x7e)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
    Bb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Bb, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x21 + 0x81)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Bcmb = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sadd_sat, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb}),
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ssub_sat, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb})),
      B.CreateXor(
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::uadd_sat, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb}),
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::usub_sat, {V8i8}, {Ba, Bb})));
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Bcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  // <4 x i16>: halfword-lane saturating add/sub.
  llvm::Value *Ha = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16),
              *Hb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Ha = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ha, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x1357 + 0x7ffe)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
    Hb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hb, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x2461 + 0x8001)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Hcmb = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sadd_sat, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb}),
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ssub_sat, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb})),
      B.CreateXor(
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::uadd_sat, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb}),
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::usub_sat, {V4i16}, {Ha, Hb})));
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Hcmb, uint64_t(i)), I32));

  auto *S = B.CreateXor(Sb, Sh);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) narrow-lane vector bit-count / scan (llvm.ctpop/ctlz/cttz
// on <8 x i8> and <4 x i16>) — the bit-count member of the 64-bit D-register
// narrow-lane family (vn64 arithmetic / vsh64 shift / vmm64 min-max / vsat64
// saturating) and the D-register complement of the 128-bit Q-register vbitcnt8
// (<16 x i8> / <8 x i16>), the <4 x i32> vbitcnt and the <2 x i64> vbitcnt64 —
// this 64-bit byte/halfword lane form was never covered.  It lowers through a
// *distinct* per-ISA path: AArch64 NEON ctpop is `cnt.8b` on a D register (vs
// the Q-register `cnt.16b`), the <4 x i16> ctpop adds a `uaddlp.4h`, and
// ctlz/cttz use `clz.8b` / `clz.4h` (D-register, + `rbit` for cttz); ARM32 NEON
// `vcnt.8` / `vclz.i8` / `vclz.i16` on a D register; x86/i386 SSE2 has no
// vector popcount/lzcnt/tzcnt at any width so every lane expands to a SWAR
// shift/mask/add tree over the low 64 bits of an XMM.  ctlz/cttz use
// is_zero_poison=false so every lane (incl. 0 -> bitwidth) is defined.  All
// hardware/inline, zero libcall on every ISA.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an
// intrinsic, so original/obfuscated lower byte-identically -- any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Every lane folds (zext to
// i32) into the return; the surrounding substitutable add/sub/and/or/xor +
// 0x5A5A / 12345 drive the scalar passes and a data-dependent diamond + PHI
// give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vnbc64(int a, int b) {        // per lane width L in {<8 x i8>,<4 x
//   i16>}
//     vL va = a + {lane offsets},  vb = (b broadcast) ^ {near-extreme consts};
//     int rL = reduce.xor(ctpop(va)) ^ (reduce.xor(ctlz(va))<<1)
//            ^ reduce.xor(cttz(vb));                          // all zext->i32
//     int base = r8 ^ r16 ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowBitCnt64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                       const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vnbc64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: ctpop/ctlz on a-derived lanes, cttz on c-derived lanes mixing
  // near-extreme byte constants (varied leading/trailing zero counts).
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  uint8_t BigB[8] = {0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x01, 0x40, 0xc0, 0x08, 0x7e};
  auto *BigBV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(BigB, 8));
  llvm::Value *VA8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    VA8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA8, B.CreateAdd(Ab, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 7 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VB8 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Cb), BigBV);
  auto *Pc8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {V8i8}, {VA8});
  auto *Lz8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {V8i8}, {VA8, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {V8i8}, {VB8, B.getFalse()});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <4 x i16>: same, halfword lanes.
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  uint16_t BigH[4] = {0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x0001};
  auto *BigHV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(BigH, 4));
  llvm::Value *VA16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    VA16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA16, B.CreateAdd(Ah, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 131 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VB16 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(4, Ch), BigHV);
  auto *Pc16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {V4i16}, {VA16});
  auto *Lz16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {V4i16}, {VA16, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {V4i16}, {VB16, B.getFalse()});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *S8 = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(Red8(Pc8), B.CreateShl(Red8(Lz8), B.getInt32(1))), Red8(Tz8));
  llvm::Value *S16 = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(Red16(Pc16), B.CreateShl(Red16(Lz16), B.getInt32(1))),
      Red16(Tz16));
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(S8, S16);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) narrow-lane vector reversal (llvm.bitreverse on <8 x i8>
// and <4 x i16>, llvm.bswap on <4 x i16>) — the reversal member of the 64-bit
// D-register narrow-lane family (vn64 arithmetic / vsh64 shift / vmm64 min-max
// / vsat64 saturating / vnbc64 bit-count) and the D-register complement of the
// 128-bit Q-register vbswap (<8 x i16>/<4 x i32>/<2 x i64>) and VecBitRev
// (<16 x i8>/<8 x i16>/<4 x i32>); this 64-bit byte/halfword lane form was
// never covered.  It lowers through a *distinct* per-ISA path: AArch64 NEON
// `rbit.8b` (D-register, vs the Q-register `rbit.16b`) for the bit-reverse,
// `rev16.8b` for the <4 x i16> byte-swap, plus a `rev16` byte shuffle after
// rbit for the <4 x i16> bit-reverse; ARM32 NEON `vrbit.8` / `vrev16.8` on a D
// register; x86/i386 SSE2 has no in-lane byte shuffle (pshufb is SSSE3) nor any
// vector bit-reverse so every lane expands to a SWAR shift/mask tree over the
// low 64 bits of an XMM.  Note <8 x i8> bswap is invalid (an i8 lane has no
// bytes to swap) so byte-swap is exercised only on <4 x i16>.  All
// hardware/inline, zero libcall on every ISA.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an
// intrinsic, so original/obfuscated lower byte-identically -- any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Every lane folds (zext to
// i32) into the return; the surrounding substitutable add/sub/and/or/xor +
// 0x5A5A / 12345 drive the scalar passes and a data-dependent diamond + PHI
// give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vrev64(int a, int b) {
//     <8 x i8>  va8  = a + {lane offsets};
//     <4 x i16> va16 = a + {lane offsets};
//     int r8  = reduce.xor(bitreverse(va8));
//     int r16 = reduce.xor(bitreverse(va16)) ^ reduce.xor(bswap(va16));
//     int base = r8 ^ r16 ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowRev64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vrev64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: bit-reverse a-derived byte lanes (D-register `rbit.8b`).
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8);
  llvm::Value *VA8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    VA8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA8, B.CreateAdd(Ab, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 37 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *Br8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V8i8}, {VA8});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <4 x i16>: bit-reverse + byte-swap halfword lanes (D-register).
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16);
  llvm::Value *VA16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    VA16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA16, B.CreateAdd(Ah, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 9931 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *Br16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V4i16}, {VA16});
  auto *Bs16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {V4i16}, {VA16});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *S8 = Red8(Br8);
  llvm::Value *S16 = B.CreateXor(Red16(Br16), Red16(Bs16));
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(S8, S16);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 128-bit (Q-register) i64-lane vector bit-reverse (llvm.bitreverse on
// <2 x i64>) — the i64-lane member of the vector bit-reverse lane-width matrix
// (<16 x i8>/<8 x i16>/<4 x i32> covered by VecBitRev, <8 x i8>/<4 x i16> by
// vrev64); the <2 x i64> form was never covered, so this completes the
// bit-reverse matrix across all integer lane widths.  It lowers through a
// *distinct* per-ISA path: AArch64 NEON `rbit.16b` + `rev64.16b` (byte-order
// reversal across the full 64-bit lane, vs the <4 x i32> form's `rev32.16b`);
// ARM32 NEON `vrbit.8` + `vrev64.8`; x86/i386 SSE2 has no vector bit-reverse so
// each 64-bit lane expands to a wide SWAR shift/mask tree over an XMM half.
// Zero libcall on every ISA (i64-lane bit-reverse is pure bit manipulation, no
// helper).  Both 32-bit halves of each reversed lane fold (xor) into the i32
// return so the full 64-bit result is observed.  No obfuscation pass rewrites
// an intrinsic, so original/obfuscated lower byte-identically -- any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding substitutable
// add/sub/and/or/xor + 0x5A5A / 12345 drive the scalar passes and a
// data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vqbr64(int a, int b) {
//     <2 x i64> v = { (a<<32)|b , ((b<<32)|a) ^ const };
//     <2 x i64> r = bitreverse(v);
//     int s = fold each lane's lo32 ^ hi32;
//     int base = s ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWideBitRev64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2i64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vqbr64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <2 x i64>: pack the args into two 64-bit lanes (so every byte of each lane
  // is data-dependent) and bit-reverse the whole vector (Q-register
  // rbit+rev64).
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  auto *Lane0 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(32)), C64);
  auto *Lane1 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(32)), A64),
                            B.getInt64(0x0123456789ABCDEFULL));
  llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2i64);
  V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Lane0, B.getInt32(0));
  V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Lane1, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *R = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V2i64}, {V});
  auto Fold = [&](unsigned i) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(R, B.getInt32(i));
    auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(L, I32);
    auto *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    return B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi);
  };
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(Fold(0), Fold(1));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 128-bit i64-lane vector three-way compare (llvm.scmp / llvm.ucmp on
// <2 x i64>) — the i64-lane member of the vector 3-way-compare matrix (scalar
// i32/i64/i128 covered by tcmp/wtcmp, vector <4 x i32> by vtcmp); the <2 x i64>
// form was never covered.  Each i64 lane compare lowers through a distinct
// path: on 64-bit ISAs a single compare + select/csinc per lane, on 32-bit ISAs
// (i386/ARM32) a two-word i64 compare feeding the {-1,0,1} select.  Pure
// compare
// + select, zero libcall.  scmp/ucmp here produce <2 x i64> results; each lane
// (trunc to i32) folds into the return.  No obfuscation pass touches the
// intrinsic, so original/obfuscated lower byte-identically -- any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecThreeWayCmp64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vtcmp64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    auto *La = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A64, B.getInt64(i * 7 + 1)),
                           B.getInt64((i & 1) ? 0x8000000000000000ULL : 0ULL));
    auto *Lb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(C64, B.getInt64(i * 5 + 2)),
                           B.getInt64((i & 1) ? 0x4000000000000000ULL : 0ULL));
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, La, B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Lb, B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {V2, V2}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {V2, V2}, {VA, VB});
  llvm::Value *Base = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    auto *Sl = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateExtractElement(Sx, B.getInt32(i)), I32);
    auto *Ul = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateExtractElement(Ux, B.getInt32(i)), I32);
    Base = B.CreateAdd(Base, B.CreateShl(Sl, B.getInt32((i * 4 + 1) & 31)));
    Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(Ul, B.getInt32((i * 5 + 2) & 31)));
  }
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Narrow-lane vector *variable* funnel-shift (llvm.fshl / llvm.fshr on
// <16 x i8> and <8 x i16> with a per-lane variable shift amount) — the
// variable-amount complement of vrotnw (splat *constant* amounts) and the
// byte/halfword companion of vfunnelv (<4 x i32> variable).  A variable funnel
// is a distinct ISel path from a constant one: x86/i386 SSE2 has no per-lane
// variable byte/halfword shift so each lane scalarizes to shift/or, while
// AArch64/ARM NEON use a per-lane amount with ushl.  The amount is taken modulo
// the lane width by the intrinsic, so every value is valid (no poison).  All
// inline, zero libcall.  Results reduce (xor) into the i32 return.  No
// obfuscation pass touches a funnel intrinsic, so original/obfuscated lower
// byte-identically -- any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowFunnelVarIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                        const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16B = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8H = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfunvnw", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <16 x i8>: variable funnel of a-/c-derived lanes by an (a^c)-derived
  // amount.
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  auto mk8 = [&](llvm::Value *S, unsigned step) {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16B);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      V = B.CreateInsertElement(
          V, B.CreateAdd(S, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * step + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
    return V;
  };
  auto *Va8 = mk8(Ab, 3), *Vb8 = mk8(Cb, 5),
       *Vamt8 = mk8(B.CreateXor(Ab, Cb), 7);
  auto *R1 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V16B}, {Va8, Vb8, Vamt8});
  auto *R2 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {V16B}, {Va8, Vb8, Vamt8});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <8 x i16>: same, halfword lanes.
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  auto mk16 = [&](llvm::Value *S, unsigned step) {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      V = B.CreateInsertElement(
          V, B.CreateAdd(S, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * step + 3))),
          B.getInt32(i));
    return V;
  };
  auto *Va16 = mk16(Ah, 11), *Vb16 = mk16(Ch, 13),
       *Vamt16 = mk16(B.CreateXor(Ah, Ch), 5);
  auto *R3 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V8H}, {Va16, Vb16, Vamt16});
  auto *R4 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {V8H}, {Va16, Vb16, Vamt16});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red8(R1), Red8(R2)),
                                  B.CreateXor(Red16(R3), Red16(R4)));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit (D-register) narrow-lane vector 3-way compare (llvm.scmp / llvm.ucmp
// on <8 x i8> and <4 x i16>) — the D-register sibling of vtcmp (<4 x i32>) and
// vtcmp64 (<2 x i64>).  Per-lane {-1,0,1}; x86/i386 SSE2 has no native i8/i16
// vector scmp/ucmp so each lane scalarizes to (a sgt b) - (a slt b) with an
// unsigned sign-flip, while AArch64/ARM NEON lower per-lane on .8b/.4h.  Lanes
// mix sign bits so signed vs unsigned ordering diverges.  Zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches scmp/ucmp; any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend/
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor + constants drive --subst /
// --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module>
buildVecNarrowThreeWayCmp64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx, const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vntcmp64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: lanes xor in 0x80-ish constants so signed/unsigned diverge.
  llvm::Value *VA8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8),
              *VB8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    VA8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA8, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x11 + 0x80)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
    VB8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB8, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x19 + 0x40)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  auto *Sx8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {V8i8, V8i8}, {VA8, VB8});
  auto *Ux8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {V8i8, V8i8}, {VA8, VB8});
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Sb = B.CreateAdd(
        Sb,
        B.CreateShl(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Sx8, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                    B.getInt32((i * 2 + 1) & 7)));
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb,
        B.CreateShl(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Ux8, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                    B.getInt32((i * 3 + 2) & 7)));
  }

  // <4 x i16>: halfword lanes with 0x8000-ish sign mixing.
  llvm::Value *VA16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16),
              *VB16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA16,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x1357 + 0x8000)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
    VB16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB16,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x2461 + 0x4000)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  auto *Sx16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {V4i16, V4i16}, {VA16, VB16});
  auto *Ux16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {V4i16, V4i16}, {VA16, VB16});
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Sh = B.CreateAdd(
        Sh, B.CreateShl(
                B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Sx16, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                B.getInt32((i * 4 + 3) & 15)));
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateShl(
