                B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Ux16, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                B.getInt32((i * 5 + 1) & 15)));
  }

  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(Sb, Sh);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 128-bit (Q-register) byte/halfword-lane vector 3-way compare (llvm.scmp /
// llvm.ucmp on <16 x i8> and <8 x i16>) — the Q-register sibling of vntcmp64
// (<8 x i8>/<4 x i16> D-register) and the byte/halfword dual of vtcmp
// (<4 x i32>) / vtcmp64 (<2 x i64>), matching the vminmax8 / vshift8 full-width
// Q-register lane convention.  Per-lane {-1,0,1}; x86/i386 SSE2 has no native
// i8/i16 vector scmp/ucmp so all 16/8 lanes scalarize to (a sgt b) - (a slt b)
// with an unsigned sign-flip, while AArch64/ARM NEON lower per-lane on
// .16b/.8h. Lanes mix sign bits so signed vs unsigned ordering diverges.  Zero
// libcall. No obfuscation pass touches scmp/ucmp; any Unicorn mismatch is a
// real backend/ fork-Unicorn bug.  Surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor + constants
// drive --subst /
// --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWideThreeWayCmp8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                         const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vtcmp8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <16 x i8>: lanes xor in 0x80-ish constants so signed/unsigned diverge.
  llvm::Value *VA8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i8),
              *VB8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    VA8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA8, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x11 + 0x80)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
    VB8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB8, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x19 + 0x40)), I8),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  auto *Sx8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {V16i8, V16i8}, {VA8, VB8});
  auto *Ux8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {V16i8, V16i8}, {VA8, VB8});
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Sb = B.CreateAdd(
        Sb,
        B.CreateShl(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Sx8, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                    B.getInt32((i * 2 + 1) & 7)));
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb,
        B.CreateShl(B.CreateSExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Ux8, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                    B.getInt32((i * 3 + 2) & 7)));
  }

  // <8 x i16>: halfword lanes with 0x8000-ish sign mixing.
  llvm::Value *VA16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i16),
              *VB16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    VA16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA16,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x1357 + 0x8000)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
    VB16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB16,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 0x2461 + 0x4000)), I16),
        uint64_t(i));
  }
  auto *Sx16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {V8i16, V8i16}, {VA16, VB16});
  auto *Ux16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {V8i16, V8i16}, {VA16, VB16});
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Sh = B.CreateAdd(
        Sh, B.CreateShl(
                B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Sx16, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                B.getInt32((i * 4 + 3) & 15)));
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateShl(
                B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Ux16, uint64_t(i)), I32),
                B.getInt32((i * 5 + 1) & 15)));
  }

  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(Sb, Sh);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector bit-reverse (llvm.bitreverse on <16 x i8> / <8 x i16> / <4 x i32>) —
// the first *vector* coverage of the bitreverse class: scalar i32/i64 are
// covered by brev, vector byte-swap by vbswap, but a *vector* bitreverse is a
// distinct ISel path from both.  x86/i386 SSE2 has *no* bit-reverse at any
// width, so every lane width expands to a SWAR shift/mask sequence (swap
// adjacent bits via 0x55.. masks, pairs via 0x33.., nibbles via 0x0F.., then a
// per-lane byte reversal for the i16/i32 widths) — and since SSE2 lacks a byte
// shift the i8 lanes go through word-shift + mask emulation, a heavy constant
// workout.  AArch64 has `rbit v.16b` which reverses bits *within each byte*:
// the <16 x i8> form is a single rbit, <8 x i16> needs `rev16.16b` afterwards
// and <4 x i32> needs `rev32.16b` to reverse the byte order within each lane —
// three distinct lowerings.  ARM32 NEON: vrbit.8 + vrev16/vrev32.  All bit
// manipulation, zero libcall; every lane folds into the i32 return.  No
// obfuscation pass touches a bitreverse intrinsic, so the original and
// obfuscated copies share byte-identical bitreverse lowering — any Unicorn
// mismatch is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding
// add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive --subst / --const-enc and the
// data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecBitRevIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16B = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8H = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vbrev", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <16 x i8>: sixteen distinct bytes derived from A/C, bit-reversed.  SSE2 has
  // no byte shift, so this exercises the word-shift + mask byte-reverse path.
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16B);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(i * 0x11 + 0x3d)),
                                  B.CreateShl(C, B.getInt32(i & 7))),
                      I8),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *RB = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V16B}, {VB});

  // <8 x i16>: eight halfwords, bit-reversed (rbit + rev16 on AArch64).
  llvm::Value *VH = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    VH = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VH,
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(A, B.CreateShl(C, B.getInt32(i))),
                                  B.getInt32(0x1234 * (i + 1))),
                      I16),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *RH = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V8H}, {VH});

  // <4 x i32>: four words, bit-reversed (rbit + rev32 on AArch64).
  llvm::Value *VW = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    VW = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VW,
        B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(A, B.CreateShl(C, B.getInt32(i + 1))),
                    B.getInt32(0x01020304 + i)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *RW = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V4}, {VW});

  // Reduce each reversed vector to an i32 via extract + xor.
  llvm::Value *RedB = B.getInt8(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    RedB = B.CreateXor(RedB, B.CreateExtractElement(RB, B.getInt32(i)));
  llvm::Value *RedH = B.getInt16(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    RedH = B.CreateXor(RedH, B.CreateExtractElement(RH, B.getInt32(i)));
  llvm::Value *RedW = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    RedW = B.CreateXor(RedW, B.CreateExtractElement(RW, B.getInt32(i)));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateZExt(RedB, I32), B.CreateZExt(RedH, I32));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, RedW);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector per-lane *variable* shift (<4 x i32> shl / lshr / ashr by a <4 x i32>
// amount) — x86 SSE2 has no per-lane variable vector shift (psllvd/psrlvd are
// AVX2), so the backend expands each to a scalar extract/shift/insert sequence;
// AArch64/ARM NEON use ushl/sshl with a (possibly negated) shift vector.  All
// inline, zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches a vector shift, so the
// original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence
// is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  Each lane's amount is
// masked to [0,31] so the shift is well-defined.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix +
// constants drive --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecShiftIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vshift", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VAmt = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VAmt = B.CreateInsertElement(VAmt, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(3 * i)),
                                 B.getInt32(i));
  }
  // Mask every lane's amount to [0,31] so each per-lane shift is well-defined.
  auto *Amt = B.CreateAnd(VAmt, B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.getInt32(31)));
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(VA, Amt);
  auto *LShr = B.CreateLShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *AShr = B.CreateAShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Shl, LShr), AShr);
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <8 x i16> variable vector shifts (shl/lshr/ashr) — the halfword-lane dual of
// `vshift` (`<4 x i32>`).  x86 SSE2 uses psllw/psrlw/psraw; AArch64/ARM NEON
// use vshl.i16 / vshr / vshrn.  Amount per lane masked to [0,15] so every shift
// is well-defined.  --subst does not touch shifts; any Unicorn mismatch is a
// real backend/fork-Unicorn bug.  Multi-block (diamond + PHI) so it reaches all
// seven suites; integer mix + 0x5A5A/12345 drive the scalar passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecShift16IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vshift16", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8),
              *VAmt = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateAdd(Ah, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 131 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
    VAmt = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VAmt, B.CreateAdd(Ch, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 5 + 1))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Amt = B.CreateAnd(VAmt, B.CreateVectorSplat(8, B.getInt16(15)));
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(VA, Amt);
  auto *LShr = B.CreateLShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *AShr = B.CreateAShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Shl, LShr), AShr);
  llvm::Value *Red = B.getInt16(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Red = B.CreateXor(Red, B.CreateExtractElement(Acc, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *RedI = B.CreateZExt(Red, I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(RedI, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <2 x i64> variable vector shifts (shl/lshr/ashr) — the i64-lane dual of
// `vshift` (`<4 x i32>`).  x86 SSE2 has no native 64-bit vector shifts (AVX2
// `psllvq` / AArch64 `ushl` on 2×i64 are later); backend typically scalarizes
// per lane on 32-bit ISAs and may split/widen on 64-bit.  Amount per lane
// masked to [0,63].  --subst does not touch shifts.  Multi-block (diamond +
// PHI) so it reaches all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecShift64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vshift64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2),
              *VAmt = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateAdd(A64, B.getInt64(i * 0x1F00000001ULL + 7)),
        B.getInt32(i));
    VAmt = B.CreateInsertElement(VAmt, B.CreateAdd(C64, B.getInt64(i * 5 + 1)),
                                 B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Amt = B.CreateAnd(VAmt, B.CreateVectorSplat(2, B.getInt64(63)));
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(VA, Amt);
  auto *LShr = B.CreateLShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *AShr = B.CreateAShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Shl, LShr), AShr);
  auto fold64 = [&](llvm::Value *V) {
    auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(V, I32);
    auto *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(V, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    return B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi);
  };
  auto *Red = B.CreateXor(fold64(B.CreateExtractElement(Acc, B.getInt32(0))),
                          fold64(B.CreateExtractElement(Acc, B.getInt32(1))));

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <16 x i8> variable vector shifts (shl/lshr/ashr) — the byte-lane dual of
// `vshift16` (`<8 x i16>`).  x86 SSE2 uses psllb/psrlb/psrab; AArch64/ARM
// NEON lower i8 vector shifts via widen/narrow or per-lane scalar paths. Amount
// per lane masked to [0,7].  --subst does not touch shifts.  Multi-block
// (diamond + PHI) so it reaches all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecShift8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vshift8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16),
              *VAmt = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateAdd(Ab, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 7 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
    VAmt = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VAmt, B.CreateAdd(Cb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 3 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Amt = B.CreateAnd(VAmt, B.CreateVectorSplat(16, B.getInt8(7)));
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(VA, Amt);
  auto *LShr = B.CreateLShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *AShr = B.CreateAShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Shl, LShr), AShr);
  llvm::Value *Red = B.getInt8(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    Red = B.CreateXor(Red, B.CreateExtractElement(Acc, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *RedI = B.CreateZExt(Red, I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(RedI, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit <8 x i32> variable vector shifts (shl/lshr/ashr) — the 256-bit
// word-lane dual of `vshift` (`<4 x i32>` 128-bit).  Every target splits into
// 2×128-bit halves; 32-bit ISAs may further scalarize per lane.  Amount per
// lane masked to [0,31].  --subst does not touch shifts.  Multi-block (diamond
// + PHI) so it reaches all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecShiftWideIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vshiftw", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8),
              *VAmt = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 131 + 7)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
    VAmt = B.CreateInsertElement(VAmt, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 5 + 1)),
                                 B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Amt = B.CreateAnd(VAmt, B.CreateVectorSplat(8, B.getInt32(31)));
  auto *Shl = B.CreateShl(VA, Amt);
  auto *LShr = B.CreateLShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *AShr = B.CreateAShr(VA, Amt);
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Shl, LShr), AShr);
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector integer abs (llvm.abs on <4 x i32>) — the vector dual of the scalar
// `mnmx` abs.  x86 SSE2 has no per-lane pabsd (SSSE3), so the backend expands
// to psrad/pxor/psub; AArch64 NEON uses `abs`, ARM `vabs`.  Zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches an abs intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated
// copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  is_int_min_poison=false keeps
// abs(INT_MIN) well-defined.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAbsIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I1 = llvm::Type::getInt1Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vabsi", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *False = llvm::ConstantInt::get(I1, 0);
  auto *Aa = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V4}, {VA, False});
  auto *Ad = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V4},
                               {B.CreateSub(VA, VB), False});
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(Aa, Ad);
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector integer multiply (<4 x i32> mul) — x86 SSE2 has no per-lane 32-bit
// multiply (pmulld is SSE4.1), so the backend expands to a pmuludq even/odd
// shuffle sequence; AArch64 NEON uses `mul`, ARM `vmul.i32`.  Zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches a vector multiply (--subst only rewrites
// add/sub/and/or/xor), so the original and obfuscated copies share
// byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or
// fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive
// --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real
// structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMulIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vmul",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateOr(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(1)),
        B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i + 1)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Prod = B.CreateMul(VA, VB);
  auto *Xv = B.CreateXor(Prod, VA);
  auto *Red = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAddReduce(Prod), B.CreateXorReduce(Xv));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vwmull(int a, int b) {        // WIDENING vector multiply: <4 x i32> ->
// <4 x i64>
//   <4 x i32> va=splat(a)+{1,3,5,7}; vb=splat(b)+{2,4,6,8};   // unsigned
//   operands <4 x i32> wc=splat(a)+{9,11,13,15}; wd=splat(b)+{4,5,6,7};//
//   signed operands <4 x i64> pu = zext(va) * zext(vb);   // umull/umull2 |
//   pmuludq | vmull.u32 <4 x i64> ps = sext(wc) * sext(wd);   // smull/smull2 |
//   (x86 pmuludq) | vmull.s32 <4 x i64> r  = (pu ^ ps) + (pu & ps) - (pu | ps);
//   // substitutable i64-lane i64 acc = reduce.add(r); int red = (int)acc ^
//   (int)(acc>>32); int base = red ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|(t+12345));
//   return ((a^b)&1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
// }
// The *widening* integer multiply (a `mul` whose operands are sext/zext from a
// narrower vector) is a per-ISA-specific instruction that NO existing shape
// covers: AArch64 `smull`/`smull2` + `umull`/`umull2`, ARM32 NEON `vmull.s32`/
// `vmull.u32`, x86/i386 SSE2 `pmuludq`-based v2i64 low-product expansion.  It
// is distinct from buildVecMulIR's *same-width* <4 x i32> mul (`mul.4s` /
// `pmulld`) and from the scalar fixed-point mul.  The operands are kept
// explicitly sext/zext-from-<4 x i32>, which is exactly the pattern ARM's
// `LowerMUL` detects (`isN0ZExt && isN1ZExt` -> VMULLu / `isN0SExt && isN1SExt`
// -> VMULLs): it therefore lowers to a true widening `vmull` instead of
// scalarising a general v2i64 multiply to the `__aeabi_lmul` libcall, so the
// whole shape is zero-libcall on all 4 ISAs (the i32-sized operands make every
// lane product fit in i64, so even x86's pmuludq v2i64-low expansion yields the
// correct full product).  The <4 x i64> results combine with substitutable
// add/sub/and/or/xor (which --subst rewrites and which split to native
// `paddq`/`vadd.i64`), are folded with llvm.vector.reduce.add (a tree of inline
// i64 adds), and a data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// (--opaque/--bogus/
// --flatten/--indirect) real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWMullIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4_32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V4_64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vwmull", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto vecOf = [&](llvm::Value *Base, const int (&Off)[4]) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4_32);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, B.CreateAdd(Base, B.getInt32(Off[i])),
                                B.getInt32(i));
    return V;
  };
  const int Oa[4] = {1, 3, 5, 7}, Ob[4] = {2, 4, 6, 8};
  const int Oc[4] = {9, 11, 13, 15}, Od[4] = {4, 5, 6, 7};
  auto *Va = vecOf(A, Oa), *Vb = vecOf(Bb, Ob);
  auto *Wc = vecOf(A, Oc), *Wd = vecOf(Bb, Od);
  auto *Pu = B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(Va, V4_64), B.CreateZExt(Vb, V4_64));
  auto *Ps = B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(Wc, V4_64), B.CreateSExt(Wd, V4_64));
  auto *R = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(Pu, Ps), B.CreateAnd(Pu, Ps)),
                        B.CreateOr(Pu, Ps));
  auto *Acc = B.CreateAddReduce(R);
  auto *Red =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(Acc, I32),
                  B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Acc, B.getInt64(32)), I32));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, Bb), B.CreateSub(A, Bb)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, Bb), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vmulhi(int a, int b) {       // i16 HIGH-HALF multiply: pmulhw / pmulhuw
//   <8 x i16> va=trunc(a+Oa[i]); vb=trunc(b+Ob[i]);
//   <8 x i16> hs = (i16)((sext(va) * sext(vb)) >> 16);   // signed   high half
//   <8 x i16> hu = (i16)((zext(va) * zext(vb)) >> 16);   // unsigned high half
//   <8 x i16> r  = (hs ^ hu) + (hs & hu) - (hs | hu);    // substitutable
//   i16-lane int acc = reduce.add(sext(r));                       //
//   full-width, every lane int base = acc ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^
//   ((a&b)|(t+12345)); return ((a^b)&1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
// }
// The "high half of a 16-bit multiply" is a canonical ISD::MULHS / ISD::MULHU
// pattern -- trunc(shr(mul(s/zext-i16, s/zext-i16), 16)) -- that NO existing
// shape covers, and it lowers to a *completely different* per-ISA instruction
// from the widening `vwmull`: x86/i386 SSE2 fold the whole pattern to a single
// `pmulhw` (signed) / `pmulhuw` (unsigned); AArch64 emits `smull`/`smull2` +
// `umull`/`umull2` (i16->i32 widen) followed by `shrn`/`shrn2` #16; ARM32 NEON
// `vmull.s16`/`vmull.u16` + `vshrn.i32` #16.  The i16->i32 widening multiply
// (`vmull.s16`) is itself distinct from vwmull's i32->i64 widening
// (`vmull.s32`).  Every lane product fits in i32 so there is NO libcall on any
// ISA (i16 operands keep the SSE2 expansion / NEON widening inline).  The
// <8 x i16> results combine with substitutable add/sub/and/or/xor (which
// --subst rewrites and which split to native `paddw`/`vadd.i16`), are widened
// and folded with llvm.vector.reduce.add so every lane's high half is
// observable in the return value, and a data-dependent diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes (--opaque/--bogus/--flatten/--indirect) real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMulHiIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8_16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V8_32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmulhi", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto vecOf = [&](llvm::Value *Base, const int (&Off)[8]) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8_16);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      V = B.CreateInsertElement(
          V, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(Base, B.getInt32(Off[i])), I16),
          B.getInt32(i));
    return V;
  };
  const int Oa[8] = {0x1234, 0x2345, 0x3456, 0x4567,
                     0x5678, 0x6789, 0x789A, 0x09AB};
  const int Ob[8] = {0x7FED, 0x6EDC, 0x5DCB, 0x4CBA,
                     0x3BA9, 0x2A98, 0x1987, 0x0876};
  auto *Va = vecOf(A, Oa), *Vb = vecOf(Bb, Ob);
  auto *Sh16 = llvm::ConstantVector::getSplat(llvm::ElementCount::getFixed(8),
                                              llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 16));
  auto *Ps = B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(Va, V8_32), B.CreateSExt(Vb, V8_32));
  auto *Hs = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAShr(Ps, Sh16), V8_16);
  auto *Pu = B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(Va, V8_32), B.CreateZExt(Vb, V8_32));
  auto *Hu = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(Pu, Sh16), V8_16);
  auto *R = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(Hs, Hu), B.CreateAnd(Hs, Hu)),
                        B.CreateOr(Hs, Hu));
  auto *Acc = B.CreateAddReduce(B.CreateSExt(R, V8_32));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, Bb), B.CreateSub(A, Bb)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, Bb), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Acc, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Saturating floating-point -> integer conversion intrinsics
// (llvm.fptosi.sat / llvm.fptoui.sat) — the first coverage of the saturating
// FP->int conversion class (the plain `ccast` only exercises non-saturating
// fptosi/fptoui).  These lower through LLVM's generic `expandFP_TO_INT_SAT`
// (the same family of generic legalize-time expansions as the
// `expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM` that just exposed a real 32-bit ISel gap), so this
// is a prime path to surface another illegal-typed-node ISel hole on the 32-bit
// targets (i386 / ARM32) while adding genuinely new coverage on 64-bit.  Each
// form lowers to a *completely different* per-ISA inline clamp sequence with NO
// libcall: x86 cvttss2si/cvttsd2si + range compare + cmov (and a +0x8000'0000
// bias for the unsigned form); AArch64 fcvtzs/fcvtzu (i32 is natively
// saturating, the i16 form adds an explicit smin/smax clamp); ARM vcvt with
// saturation + clamp.  Inputs are scaled up so the boundary values in kPairs
// (INT_MIN / INT_MAX / -1) overflow the i32/u32 range and actually drive the
// saturation, while the small pairs stay in range; the unsigned forms also
// exercise the negative-input -> 0 clamp.  Conversions are NaN-free (every
// float originates from sitofp of an integer).  No obfuscation pass touches a
// conversion intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated copies share
// byte-identical lowering of the saturating ops — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants
// drive --subst / --const-enc; the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int fpsat(int a, int b) {
//     float  fs = (float)a  * 3.0f + 5.0e8f;        // overflows i32 for big a
//     double ds = (double)b * 5.0  - 3.0e8;         // overflows i32 for big b
//     int      s1 = fptosi.sat.i32.f32(fs);         // [INT_MIN, INT_MAX]
//     unsigned u1 = fptoui.sat.i32.f32(fs);         // [0, UINT_MAX], neg -> 0
//     int      s2 = fptosi.sat.i32.f64(ds);
//     unsigned u2 = fptoui.sat.i32.f64(ds);
//     short    n1 = fptosi.sat.i16.f64(ds);         // narrow clamp path
//     int base = s1 ^ u1 ^ s2 ^ u2 ^ (int)n1
//              ^ ((a+b) ^ (a-b) ^ 0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b) | (t + 12345));
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFpToIntSatIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fpsat", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Scale the inputs so the kPairs boundary values overflow the integer range
  // and exercise saturation; small pairs stay in range.
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(A, F32);
  auto *Fs = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(Fa, llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 3.0)),
                          llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 5.0e8));
  auto *Db = B.CreateSIToFP(C, F64);
  auto *Ds = B.CreateFSub(B.CreateFMul(Db, llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 5.0)),
                          llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 3.0e8));
  auto *S1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptosi_sat, {I32, F32}, {Fs});
  auto *U1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptoui_sat, {I32, F32}, {Fs});
  auto *S2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptosi_sat, {I32, F64}, {Ds});
  auto *U2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptoui_sat, {I32, F64}, {Ds});
  // Narrow saturating conversion forces the explicit clamp even on AArch64,
  // where the i32/i64 fcvtzs is already natively saturating.
  auto *N1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptosi_sat, {I16, F64}, {Ds});
  auto *Nx = B.CreateSExt(N1, I32);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(S1, U1);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, S2);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, U2);
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Nx);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector saturating FP->int conversion (llvm.fptosi.sat / llvm.fptoui.sat on
// <4 x float> and <2 x double>) — the *vector* dual of the scalar `fpsat`, and
// the first coverage of packed saturating conversions.  The vector form takes a
// completely different per-ISA path from the scalar clamp: x86 SSE2 has no
// packed saturating convert, so LLVM's vector legalizer expands it to
// cvttps2dq / cvttpd2dq plus a per-lane range compare + blend (and the +2^31
// bias dance for the unsigned form); AArch64 NEON fcvtzs.4s / fcvtzu.4s
// saturate natively (the <2 x double> -> <2 x i32> form adds a narrowing xtn);
// ARM32 NEON vcvt.s32.f32 saturates, while the 32-bit ISAs scalarize the f64
// lanes — a route the scalar `fpsat` never takes.  Lanes are scaled so some
// overflow the i32/u32 range and actually drive the clamp (the unsigned forms
// also hit the negative-input -> 0 clamp), while every float originates from
// sitofp of an integer, so the conversions are NaN-free and fully defined.  No
// obfuscation pass touches a conversion intrinsic, so the original and
// obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering of the saturating ops — any
// divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  Lanes are
// xor-folded to i32; the surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive
// --subst / --const-enc and the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFpToIntSatIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V4I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *V2I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfpsat", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <4 x float> from a, per-lane scaled/biased so some lanes overflow the i32
  // range (driving the signed clamp) and some go negative (driving the unsigned
  // -> 0 clamp).
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(A, F32);
  auto *Sa = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, Fa);
  auto *ScaleF = llvm::ConstantVector::get(
      {llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 3.0), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 1.0e7),
       llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, -5.0), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 9.0)});
  auto *BiasF = llvm::ConstantVector::get(
      {llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 5.0e8), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, -5.0e8),
       llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 1.0e8), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 7.0)});
  auto *Fv = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(Sa, ScaleF), BiasF);
  auto *S4 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptosi_sat, {V4I, V4F}, {Fv});
  auto *U4 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptoui_sat, {V4I, V4F}, {Fv});

  // <2 x double> from b, likewise scaled to overflow on the boundary inputs;
  // the f64 -> i32 narrowing convert is a distinct lowering.
  auto *Db = B.CreateSIToFP(C, F64);
  auto *Sb = B.CreateVectorSplat(2, Db);
  auto *ScaleD = llvm::ConstantVector::get(
      {llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 5.0), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, -7.0)});
  auto *BiasD = llvm::ConstantVector::get(
      {llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, -3.0e8), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 4.0e8)});
  auto *Dv = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFMul(Sb, ScaleD), BiasD);
  auto *S2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptosi_sat, {V2I, V2D}, {Dv});
  auto *U2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fptoui_sat, {V2I, V2D}, {Dv});

  auto xorReduce4 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return Acc;
  };
  auto xorReduce2 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateXor(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0)),
                       B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1)));
  };

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(xorReduce4(S4), xorReduce4(U4));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, xorReduce2(S2));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, xorReduce2(U2));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector FP round-to-integral intrinsics (llvm.floor / ceil / trunc / round /
// roundeven) on <4 x float> AND <2 x double> — the *vector* dual of the scalar
// `fround`, and the first packed round-to-integral coverage.  Each lane carries
// a distinct quarter-step fraction (0 / .25 / .5 / .75) over a bounded integer
// base so the five modes genuinely diverge per lane (floor vs ceil vs trunc on
// the negative f64 operand, round-ties-away vs roundeven exactly at .5), while
// every rounded value lands on an exact small integer the following fptosi
// recovers losslessly.  The vector form takes a different per-ISA path from the
// scalar: x86 SSE4.1 ROUNDPS / ROUNDPD round all lanes with one instruction
// (imm8 selects the mode); AArch64 NEON frintm/p/z/a/n .4s do it natively (the
// <2 x double> form uses the .2d variants); ARM32 ARMv8 NEON VRINTM/P/Z/A/N
// .f32 on the Q register, while the f64 lanes scalarize to VFP VRINT*.f64 — a
// route the scalar `fround` never takes.  detectTargetFeatures{X86,ARM} gate
// the SSE4.1 / ARMv8 FP baseline off the intrinsic-name substring
// (type-agnostic), so the packed forms get native lowering instead of a
// floorf/ceilf library call the rewrite image cannot resolve.  These are
// static-rounding intrinsics (not MXCSR/FPSCR mode dependent), so both copies
// are deterministic.  No obfuscation pass touches a rounding intrinsic, so the
// original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence
// is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.  Lanes are reduced to i32;
// the surrounding add/sub/and/or/ xor mix + constants drive --subst /
// --const-enc and the data-dependent diamond
// + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFloatRoundIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V2I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfround", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // <4 x float>: bounded integer base (0..255) + per-lane quarter-step fraction
  // so floor/ceil/trunc/round/roundeven diverge but every result is exact.
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Fbase = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32));
  auto *FracF = llvm::ConstantVector::get(
      {llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.0), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.25),
       llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.5), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.75)});
  auto *Fv = B.CreateFAdd(Fbase, FracF);

  // <2 x double>: negated base exercises the sign-dependent floor/ceil/trunc.
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Dbase = B.CreateFNeg(B.CreateVectorSplat(2, B.CreateSIToFP(Cm, F64)));
  auto *FracD = llvm::ConstantVector::get(
      {llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.5), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.25)});
  auto *Dv = B.CreateFAdd(Dbase, FracD);

  auto Round4 = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Id, Fv), V4I);
  };
  auto Round2 = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Id, Dv), V2I);
  };
  auto xorReduce4 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return Acc;
  };
  auto xorReduce2 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateXor(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0)),
                       B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1)));
  };

  const llvm::Intrinsic::ID Modes[5] = {
      llvm::Intrinsic::floor, llvm::Intrinsic::ceil, llvm::Intrinsic::trunc,
      llvm::Intrinsic::round, llvm::Intrinsic::roundeven};
  llvm::Value *Base = B.getInt32(0);
  for (auto Id : Modes) {
    Base = B.CreateAdd(Base, xorReduce4(Round4(Id)));
    Base = B.CreateXor(Base, xorReduce2(Round2(Id)));
  }

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector floating-point min/max intrinsics (llvm.minnum / maxnum and the IEEE
// llvm.minimum / maximum) on <4 x float> AND <2 x double> — the vector dual of
// the scalar `fminmax`, and the first floating-point vector min/max coverage
// (the existing `vminmax` is integer smax/smin/umax/umin only).  The IEEE
// minimum/maximum signed-zero handling expands (TargetLowering::
// expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM -> IS_FPCLASS) to a sign-bit test: i32 for the f32
// lanes (legal), i64 for the f64 lanes.  On the 32-bit ISAs (ARM32 / i386) the
// <2 x double> form is scalarized to per-lane f64, reaching the same fork
// expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM fix the scalar fminmax does — but through the vector
// legalization path, a distinct route to that fix.  Inputs are masked to
// [0, 0xFFFF] so every sitofp is exact and NaN-free, while still reaching the
// signed-zero (operand == 0) class-test path.  minnum/maxnum lower to
// vminnm/vmaxnm (ARMv8 AArch32 — detectTargetFeaturesARM adds +fp-armv8 and the
// harness runs UC_CPU_ARM_MAX) / fminnm/fmaxnm / minps+maxps blends, all inline
// with no libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches a min/max intrinsic, so the
// original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence
// is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFloatMinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfminmax", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  llvm::Value *Fa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F),
              *Fb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Fa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fa, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F32), B.getInt32(i));
    Fb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fb, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(2 * i)), F32),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D),
              *Db = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    Da = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Da, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F64), B.getInt32(i));
    Db = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Db, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(2 * i)), F64),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Fmn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minnum, {V4F}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Fmx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum, {V4F}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Fimn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimum, {V4F}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Fimx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximum, {V4F}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Dmn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minnum, {V2D}, {Da, Db});
  auto *Dmx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum, {V2D}, {Da, Db});
  auto *Dimn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimum, {V2D}, {Da, Db});
  auto *Dimx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximum, {V2D}, {Da, Db});
  auto RedF = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *S = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0)),
                                  B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1)));
    S = B.CreateFAdd(S, B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2)),
                                     B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3))));
    return B.CreateFPToSI(S, I32);
  };
  auto RedD = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(
        B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0)),
                     B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1))),
        I32);
  };
  auto *Sf = B.CreateAdd(RedF(Fmn), RedF(Fmx));
  auto *Si = B.CreateAdd(RedF(Fimn), RedF(Fimx));
  auto *Sd = B.CreateAdd(RedD(Dmn), RedD(Dmx));
  auto *SiD = B.CreateAdd(RedD(Dimn), RedD(Dimx));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd), Si), SiD);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Floating-point vector reductions (llvm.vector.reduce.fadd / reduce.fmul,
// strictly *ordered* via a non-undef start operand) on <4 x float> AND
// <2 x double> — the floating-point dual of the integer `vrdc` (which covers
// only the *integer* llvm.vector.reduce.* family).  An ordered FP reduction may
// NOT be reassociated, so it lowers to a *sequential* scalar chain distinct
// from both the integer horizontal reductions and the hand-rolled extract+fadd
// folds used elsewhere: x86 a chain of addss/mulss with pshufd/movhlps lane
// extracts, AArch64 sequential extract + fadd/fmul (no faddp tree, ordering
// forbids it), ARM/NEON lane extract + vadd.f32/vmul.f32 (and scalarized
// vadd.f64/vmul.f64 for the <2 x double> on 32-bit ARM).  Every lane is an
// exact small integer via sitofp and every product is bounded well inside i32
// (the multiplicand lanes are 1..4 / 1..16), so each fptosi is always in range,
// the result is an exact integer, and the two copies agree bit-for-bit
// regardless of rounding.  Ordered fadd/fmul reductions are *always*
// libcall-free (plain VFP vadd/vmul on the base ARM baseline — no fp-armv8
// dependency, unlike the fmin/fmax reductions which could fall back to an fmax
// libcall on ARMv7).  No obfuscation pass touches a reduction intrinsic, so the
// original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering and any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug; the surrounding
// add/sub/and/or/xor mix + 0x5A5A / 12345 constants drive
// --subst / --const-enc, and the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFloatReduceIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfreduce", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  // <4 x float> addend lanes (0..~261, exact) plus small multiplicand lanes
  // (1..4, product <= 256) so every reduction result is an exact in-range int.
  llvm::Value *Fa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F),
              *Fb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F),
              *Fc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Fa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fa, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F32), B.getInt32(i));
    Fb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fb, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(2 * i)), F32),
        B.getInt32(i));
    auto *Sm = B.CreateAdd(
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateLShr(Am, B.getInt32(2 * i)), B.getInt32(3)),
        B.getInt32(1)); // 1..4
    Fc = B.CreateInsertElement(Fc, B.CreateSIToFP(Sm, F32), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  // <2 x double> addend lanes (0..~257) plus small multiplicand lanes (1..16,
  // product <= 256).
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D),
              *Dc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    Da = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Da, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F64), B.getInt32(i));
    auto *Sm = B.CreateAdd(
        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateLShr(Bm, B.getInt32(4 * i)), B.getInt32(0xF)),
        B.getInt32(1)); // 1..16
    Dc = B.CreateInsertElement(Dc, B.CreateSIToFP(Sm, F64), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  // Ordered reductions: start operand 0.0 (fadd) / 1.0 (fmul) forbids reassoc.
  auto *RfaF = B.CreateFAddReduce(llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.0), Fa);
  auto *RfaF2 = B.CreateFAddReduce(llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.0), Fb);
  auto *RfmF = B.CreateFMulReduce(llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 1.0), Fc);
  auto *RfaD = B.CreateFAddReduce(llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.0), Da);
  auto *RfmD = B.CreateFMulReduce(llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 1.0), Dc);
  auto *Sf = B.CreateAdd(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateFPToSI(RfaF, I32), B.CreateFPToSI(RfaF2, I32)),
      B.CreateFPToSI(RfmF, I32));
  auto *Sd = B.CreateXor(B.CreateFPToSI(RfaD, I32), B.CreateFPToSI(RfmD, I32));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector floating-point horizontal MAX / MIN reductions
// (llvm.vector.reduce.fmax / llvm.vector.reduce.fmin on <4 x float> and <2 x
// double>) — completes the FP reduction family: `vfreduce` covers the *ordered*
// fadd/fmul reductions, but the horizontal fmax/fmin reductions were never
// covered, and they lower through a COMPLETELY different per-ISA path with zero
// libcalls:
//   - AArch64 (NEON): dedicated horizontal `fmaxv`/`fminv` (single instruction
//     across all lanes).
//   - x86 (SSE2): NO horizontal FP max/min, so a shuffle + `maxps`/`minps`
//     (or scalar `maxss`/`minss`) log-tree.
//   - ARM32 (NEON): the pairwise `vpmax.f32`/`vpmin.f32` tree + a final scalar
//     `vmax.f32`/`vmin.f32` (and the <2 x double> case scalarises to
//     vcmp+vsel).
// Lanes are distinct in-range integers via sitofp, so each reduction result is
// an exact, in-domain integer (fptosi back never traps), no lane is NaN or an
// opposite-sign zero, and the whole result is fully deterministic.  No
// obfuscation pass touches the reduce intrinsic, so the original and obfuscated
// copies share byte-identical reduction lowering — any Unicorn divergence is a
// real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix + 0x5A5A / 12345
// constants drive --subst / --const-enc and the data-dependent diamond + PHI
// give the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int vfredmm(int a, int b) {
//     <4 x float>  Fa,Fb,Fc = distinct in-range lanes mixing (a&255),(b&255);
//     <2 x double> Da,Dc     = distinct in-range lanes;
//     float  mxf = reduce.fmax(Fa), mnf = reduce.fmin(Fb), mx2 =
//     reduce.fmax(Fc); double mxd = reduce.fmax(Da), mnd = reduce.fmin(Dc); int
//     s = (int)mxf + (int)mnf + (int)mx2,  d = (int)mxd ^ (int)mnd; int base =
//     (s + d) ^ ((a+b)^(a-b)^0x5A5A) ^ ((a&b)|((..)+12345)); return ((a^b)&1) ?
//     base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module>
buildVecFloatReduceMinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx, const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfredmm", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto bump = [&](llvm::Value *X, int K) {
    return B.CreateAdd(X, B.getInt32(K));
  };
  // Three <4 x float> vectors with distinct in-range lanes mixing a and b so
  // the winning (max / min) lane depends on the inputs at run time.
  auto mkF32 = [&](llvm::Value *L0, llvm::Value *L1, llvm::Value *L2,
                   llvm::Value *L3) {
    llvm::Value *Ls[4] = {L0, L1, L2, L3};
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, B.CreateSIToFP(Ls[i], F32), B.getInt32(i));
    return V;
  };
  auto *Fa = mkF32(bump(Am, 1), bump(Bm, 2), bump(Am, 6), bump(Bm, 4));
  auto *Fb = mkF32(bump(Bm, 3), bump(Am, 5), bump(Bm, 7), bump(Am, 8));
  auto *Fc = mkF32(bump(Am, 9), bump(Bm, 6), bump(Am, 2), bump(Bm, 1));
  // Two <2 x double> vectors with distinct in-range lanes.
  auto mkF64 = [&](llvm::Value *L0, llvm::Value *L1) {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, B.CreateSIToFP(L0, F64), B.getInt32(0));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, B.CreateSIToFP(L1, F64), B.getInt32(1));
    return V;
  };
  auto *Da = mkF64(bump(Am, 4), bump(Bm, 10));
  auto *Dc = mkF64(bump(Bm, 8), bump(Am, 11));
  // Horizontal fmax / fmin reductions (strict, no fast-math: the bare
  // intrinsic).
  auto *RmxF = B.CreateFPMaxReduce(Fa);
  auto *RmnF = B.CreateFPMinReduce(Fb);
  auto *Rmx2F = B.CreateFPMaxReduce(Fc);
  auto *RmxD = B.CreateFPMaxReduce(Da);
  auto *RmnD = B.CreateFPMinReduce(Dc);
  auto *Sf = B.CreateAdd(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateFPToSI(RmxF, I32), B.CreateFPToSI(RmnF, I32)),
      B.CreateFPToSI(Rmx2F, I32));
  auto *Sd = B.CreateXor(B.CreateFPToSI(RmxD, I32), B.CreateFPToSI(RmnD, I32));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Floating-point integral-rounding intrinsics (llvm.floor / ceil / trunc /
// round / roundeven on float AND double) — the first coverage of the
// round-to-integral lowering class, distinct from the sqrt / min-max /
// reduction FP shapes already covered.  These are exactly the intrinsics
// NeverD's own target-feature detection special-cases: on x86 any of
// llvm.round/floor/ceil/ trunc forces +sse4.1, so floor/ceil/trunc/roundeven
// each lower to a *single* roundss/roundsd (imm: floor=9, ceil=10, trunc=11,
// nearest-even=8) and round (ties-away, X86 ISD::FROUND = Custom) to a short
// inline roundss sequence — never a roundf/floorf libcall; on ARM32 the same
// set forces +v8,+fp-armv8 so they lower to the VRINT family (vrintm/p/z/n +
// the round-half-away sequence) instead of a round*/floor/ceil libcall the
// Unicorn harness can neither resolve nor execute; AArch64 always has
// frintm/p/z/n.  So this shape simultaneously exercises the rounding lowering
// AND the +sse4.1 / +fp-armv8 feature-detection paths, and stays libcall-free
// on all four ISAs.  Every operand has a fractional part that is an exact
// quarter (0 / .25 / .5 / .75 — exactly representable in binary FP) added to a
// bounded integer base (|v| <= 256), so each rounded value is an exact small
// integer and every fptosi is always in i32 range and well-defined; the .5 ties
// make round (ties-away) and roundeven (ties-to-even) genuinely diverge, and
// the negated double operand exercises the sign handling of
// floor/ceil/trunc/round.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an FP intrinsic call
// (--subst only touches integer add/sub/and/or/xor, --const-enc only
// ConstantInt operands — the FP quarter is not a ConstantInt — and the CFG
// passes leave the calls intact), so the original and obfuscated copies share
// byte-identical rounding lowering and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor mix +
// 0x5A5A / 12345 constants drive --subst / --const-enc and the data-dependent
// diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatRoundIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fround", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  // Quarter-step fractional parts (0 / .25 / .5 / .75 — exact in binary FP)
  // added to a bounded integer base so every rounded value is an exact small
  // integer.
  auto *Qa = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Qb = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32),
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Qa, F32), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.25)));
  // Negative double operand exercises the sign handling of trunc / round.
  auto *Db = B.CreateFNeg(B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64),
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Qb, F64), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.25))));

  auto Round32 = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Id, Fa), I32);
  };
  auto Round64 = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Id, Db), I32);
  };
  llvm::Value *Sf =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::floor),
                                          Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::ceil)),
                              B.CreateAdd(Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::trunc),
                                          Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::round))),
                  Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::roundeven));
  llvm::Value *Sd =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::floor),
                                          Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::ceil)),
                              B.CreateAdd(Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::trunc),
                                          Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::round))),
                  Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::roundeven));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Scalar FP round-to-integral via llvm.rint / llvm.nearbyint (current rounding
// mode) — the two rounding intrinsics no shape exercised.  FloatRound covers
// floor/ceil/trunc/round/roundeven, every one of which detectTargetFeatures
// {X86,ARM} independently gates (+sse4.1 / +v8,+fp-armv8); but llvm.rint /
// llvm.nearbyint were *missing* from both gates, so on x86 (SSE2 baseline, no
// SSE4.1 roundss) and ARM (VFPv3 baseline, no ARMv8 VRINTX) they fell back to
// rintf / nearbyintf library calls the rewrite image cannot resolve — the
// unobfuscated baseline itself failed to compile/run.  This shape isolates them
// (NO floor/ceil/trunc/round, which would mask the gap by independently
// triggering the feature) to expose+close it.  No obfuscation pass touches FP
// intrinsics, so orig/obf share rint/nearbyint lowering byte-for-byte and any
// Unicorn difference is a real backend/fork bug.  AArch64 has frintx/frinti in
// its base ISA (no feature) so it passed all along.  Default round-to-nearest-
// ties-to-even (Unicorn reset MXCSR/FPSCR) makes both copies deterministic.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatRintIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "frint", M.get());
