  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Qa = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Qb = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32),
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Qa, F32), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.25)));
  // Negative double operand exercises rounding sign handling.
  auto *Db = B.CreateFNeg(B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64),
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Qb, F64), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.25))));
  auto Round32 = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Id, Fa), I32);
  };
  auto Round64 = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Id, Db), I32);
  };
  llvm::Value *Sf = B.CreateAdd(Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::rint),
                                Round32(llvm::Intrinsic::nearbyint));
  llvm::Value *Sd = B.CreateAdd(Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::rint),
                                Round64(llvm::Intrinsic::nearbyint));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Scalar FP truncation (round-toward-zero) via llvm.trunc in isolation.  x86's
// SSE4.1 gate already lists llvm.trunc, but ARM's rounding gate covered
// floor/ceil/round and *not* llvm.trunc — the existing FloatRound shape only
// passed on ARM because its floor/ceil independently triggered +v8.  Standalone
// trunc on ARM (VFPv3 baseline) fell back to a truncf library call (unresolved
// in the rewrite image).  This shape isolates trunc to expose+close the ARM gap
// (x86 passes via its existing llvm.trunc detection, AArch64 via base-ISA
// frintz).  Positive and negated operands exercise round-toward-zero on both
// signs.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatTruncRIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "ftruncr", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF)); // 0..255
  auto *Qa = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Qb = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32),
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Qa, F32), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.25)));
  auto *Db = B.CreateFAdd(
      B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64),
      B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Qb, F64), llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.25)));
  auto Trunc = llvm::Intrinsic::trunc;
  auto *Sf = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Trunc, Fa), I32);
  auto *Sfn = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Trunc, B.CreateFNeg(Fa)),
                             I32); // toward-zero on a negative value
  auto *Sd = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateUnaryIntrinsic(Trunc, Db), I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sfn), Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Floating-point division (fdiv) — the one scalar FP arithmetic operator no
// shape exercised yet: FloatArith covers fadd/fmul/fsub, FloatSqrt covers sqrt,
// FloatRound covers floor/ceil/trunc/round, but plain division was zero.  fdiv
// lowers to a *dedicated hardware divide* on every ISA — x86/x64 divss/divsd,
// AArch64 fdiv, ARM VFP vdiv.f32/vdiv.f64 — with **zero libcall** (unlike frem,
// which would call fmod/fmodf).  Headline: a *variable*-divisor fdiv (register
// operands) for both f32 and f64, plus a constant-divisor fdiv (reciprocal
// materialized in a constant pool entry).  Every divisor is provably nonzero
// (so no NaN/inf) and every fptosi stays inside the i32 domain (inputs masked,
// and fptosi targets i32 not i64 to avoid the ARM32 d2lz libcall the harness
// cannot resolve), so the result is finite and deterministic.  No obfuscation
// pass touches fdiv/fadd/sitofp/fptosi, so the orig and obfuscated copies lower
// byte-identically over the FP sub-graph and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  add/sub/and/or/xor + 0x5A5A/12345 drive
// --subst / --const-enc; the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow
// passes (opaque/bogus/flatten/indirect) real structure.
//
//   int fdivp(int a, int c) {
//     unsigned am = a & 0xFFFF, cm = c & 0xFFFF;
//     float  qf = (float)am  / (float)(cm | 1);          // var divisor, f32
//     double qd = (double)am / (double)((cm & 7) + 1);   // var divisor, f64
//     double qc = (double)am / 7.0;                       // const divisor
//     int    s  = (int)((double)qf + qd + qc);           // |s| < 2^31
//     int    t  = ((a + c) ^ (a - c)) ^ 0x5A5A;
//     int    u  = (a & c) | (t + 12345);
//     int  base = (s ^ t) ^ u;
//     return ((a ^ c) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ c;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatDivIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fdivp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF)); // [0,65535]
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF)); // [0,65535]
  // float variable divisor (nonzero) -> divss / fdiv / vdiv.f32
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32);
  auto *Fc = B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateOr(Cm, B.getInt32(1)), F32); // [1,65535]
  auto *Qf = B.CreateFDiv(Fa, Fc);                               // [0,65535]
  // double variable divisor (nonzero) -> divsd / fdiv / vdiv.f64
  auto *Da = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F64);
  auto *Dc = B.CreateSIToFP(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(Cm, B.getInt32(7)), B.getInt32(1)), F64); // [1,8]
  auto *Qd = B.CreateFDiv(Da, Dc); // [0,65535]
  // constant divisor (reciprocal in a constant pool entry)
  auto *Qc = B.CreateFDiv(Da, llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 7.0)); // [0,~9362]
  auto *Sum = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateFPExt(Qf, F64), B.CreateFAdd(Qd, Qc));
  auto *S = B.CreateFPToSI(Sum, I32); // 0 <= Sum < 2^31

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide (i64) bit-count / scan / reverse intrinsics (ctpop / ctlz / cttz / bswap
// / bitreverse on i64) — the wide dual of the scalar `bcnt` (which is i32
// only). On the 64-bit ISAs these are single instructions (or short sequences);
// on the 32-bit ISAs (i386 / ARM32) i64 is split into a register pair, so each
// becomes a *distinct* multi-register sequence the i32 `bcnt` never reaches:
// ctpop.i64 = SWAR over both halves + add, ctlz.i64 / cttz.i64 = scan one half
// then conditionally the other, bswap.i64 = two bswap + half swap,
// bitreverse.i64 = rbit/SWAR per half + swap.  All hardware/inline, zero
// libcall.  ctlz/cttz use is_zero_poison=false so every input (incl. 0) is
// defined.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated
// lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  The add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive --subst /
// --const-enc; the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideBitCntIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wbcnt", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  auto *X = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(32)), C64);
  auto *Y = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(32)),
                       B.CreateZExt(B.CreateXor(A, C), I64));
  auto *Pc = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {I64}, {X});
  auto *Lz = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {I64},
                               {B.CreateOr(X, B.getInt64(1)), B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz = B.CreateIntrinsic(
      llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {I64},
      {B.CreateOr(Y, B.getInt64(0x100000000ULL)), B.getFalse()});
  auto *Bs =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {I64}, {B.CreateAdd(X, C64)});
  auto *Br = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {I64},
                               {B.CreateSub(Y, A64)});
  auto Fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(V, B.CreateLShr(V, B.getInt64(32))), I32);
  };
  auto *PcI = B.CreateTrunc(Pc, I32);
  auto *LzI = B.CreateTrunc(Lz, I32);
  auto *TzI = B.CreateTrunc(Tz, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(PcI, B.CreateShl(LzI, B.getInt32(8)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(TzI, B.getInt32(4)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Bs));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Br));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide (i128) bit-count / scan / byte- / bit-reverse intrinsics (ctpop / ctlz /
// cttz / bswap / bitreverse on i128) — the i128 dual of the scalar `bcnt` (i32)
// and `wbcnt` (i64).  i128 is an illegal type on every target, so each
// intrinsic lowers to a *two-i64-half* sequence on the 64-bit ISAs (ctpop =
// two CNT/popcnt summed, ctlz/cttz = high/low-half-zero test + half count,
// bswap = two rev + half swap, bitreverse = two rbit/SWAR + half swap) and a
// *four-i32-word* sequence on the 32-bit ISAs (i386 / ARM32) — neither the i32
// `bcnt` nor the i64 `wbcnt` ever reaches these multi-word paths.  All
// hardware/inline, ZERO libcall: the i128 carrier is built only with constant
// shifts + add/sub/and/or/xor (the exact primitives `wide128` already proves
// lower inline on all 4 ISAs), and ctlz/cttz pass is_zero_poison=false (+ the
// operands are OR-ed non-zero) so every lane is defined.  No obfuscation pass
// rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated lower the i128 bit-ops
// byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  The substitutable i32 arith + constants (0x5A5A / 12345)
// drive --subst / --const-enc and make the .text differ; a data-dependent
// diamond + PHI gives the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int w128bits(int a, int b) {
//     u128 x = ((u128)a<<96)|((u128)b<<64)|((u128)a<<32)|b;
//     u128 y = ((u128)b<<96)|((u128)a<<64)|(a^b);
//     int pc = popcount128(x), lz = clz128(x|1), tz = ctz128(y|(1<<70));
//     u128 bs = bswap128(x+b),  br = bitreverse128(y-a);
//     ... fold each i128 to i32, mix with substitutable arith ...
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWide128BitsIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I128 = llvm::IntegerType::get(Ctx, 128);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "w128bits", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto sh = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) {
    return B.CreateShl(V, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, N));
  };
  auto lsr = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) {
    return B.CreateLShr(V, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, N));
  };
  auto *A128 = B.CreateZExt(A, I128), *C128 = B.CreateZExt(C, I128);
  // Spread a/c across all four 32-bit words so the i128 bit-ops exercise both
  // i64 halves (64-bit ISAs) and all four words (32-bit ISAs).
  llvm::Value *X = B.CreateOr(B.CreateOr(sh(A128, 96), sh(C128, 64)),
                              B.CreateOr(sh(A128, 32), C128));
  llvm::Value *Y = B.CreateOr(B.CreateOr(sh(C128, 96), sh(A128, 64)),
                              B.CreateZExt(B.CreateXor(A, C), I128));
  auto *Pc = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop, {I128}, {X});
  auto *Lz = B.CreateIntrinsic(
      llvm::Intrinsic::ctlz, {I128},
      {B.CreateOr(X, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, 1)), B.getFalse()});
  auto *Tz = B.CreateIntrinsic(
      llvm::Intrinsic::cttz, {I128},
      {B.CreateOr(Y, sh(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, 1), 70)), B.getFalse()});
  auto *Bs =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {I128}, {B.CreateAdd(X, C128)});
  auto *Br = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {I128},
                               {B.CreateSub(Y, A128)});
  // Collapse each i128 result's four 32-bit words into one i32.
  auto Fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *W0 = B.CreateTrunc(V, I32);
    auto *W1 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 32), I32);
    auto *W2 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 64), I32);
    auto *W3 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 96), I32);
    return B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(W0, W1), B.CreateXor(W2, W3));
  };
  auto *PcI = B.CreateTrunc(Pc, I32);
  auto *LzI = B.CreateTrunc(Lz, I32);
  auto *TzI = B.CreateTrunc(Tz, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(PcI, B.CreateShl(LzI, B.getInt32(8)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(TzI, B.getInt32(4)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Bs));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Br));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide (i64) min/max/abs intrinsics (smax / smin / umax / umin / abs on i64) —
// the wide dual of the scalar `mnmx` (i32 only).  On the 64-bit ISAs these are
// cmp + csel/cmov pairs; on the 32-bit ISAs (i386 / ARM32) an i64 compare is a
// two-word sequence (high word compare, then low word on equal) feeding the
// select, plus i64 abs = a conditional negate of a register pair — a distinct
// multi-register path the i32 `mnmx` never reaches.  All hardware/inline, zero
// libcall (abs uses is_int_min_poison=false so abs(INT64_MIN) is defined).  No
// obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated lower
// byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.  The substitutable arith + constants drive --subst /
// --const-enc; the data-dependent diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideMinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wmnmx", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // sext to i64 and scale into the high word so the i64 compares are genuinely
  // wide (the result depends on both halves).
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  auto *X = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(21)), C64);
  auto *Y = B.CreateSub(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(17)), A64);
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Sn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Un = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Ag = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {I64},
                               {B.CreateSub(X, Y), B.getFalse()});
  auto Fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(V, B.CreateLShr(V, B.getInt64(32))), I32);
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(Fold(Sx), B.CreateShl(Fold(Sn), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Ux));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Un));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Ag));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide (i64) saturating arithmetic intrinsics (sadd/ssub/uadd/usub.sat.i64) —
// the wide dual of the scalar `ssat` (i32 only).  On the 64-bit ISAs each is an
// add/sub + overflow detect + conditional clamp; on the 32-bit ISAs (i386 /
// ARM32) i64 is a register pair, so the carry/borrow chain spans two words and
// the saturate-to-INT64_MIN/MAX (or 0 / UINT64_MAX) clamp is a multi-register
// select sequence the i32 `ssat` never reaches.  All hardware/inline, zero
// libcall.  Operands are scaled into the high word so the saturation boundaries
// are actually crossed.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic call, so
// orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideSatIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "wsat",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  // Scale into the high word so add/sub actually overflow i64 and saturate.
  auto *X = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(40)), C64);
  auto *Y = B.CreateSub(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(39)), A64);
  auto *Sa = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::sadd_sat, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Ss = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ssub_sat, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Ua = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::uadd_sat, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto *Us = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::usub_sat, {I64}, {X, Y});
  auto Fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateXor(V, B.CreateLShr(V, B.getInt64(32))), I32);
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Fold(Sa), Fold(Ss));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Ua));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Us));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide (i128) min/max/abs intrinsics (smax / smin / umax / umin / abs on i128)
// — the i128 dual of the scalar `mnmx` (i32) and `wmnmx` (i64).  i128 is
// illegal on every target, so each compare is a *multi-word* compare (high word
// first, then lower words on equal) feeding a word-pair/quad select, and i128
// abs is a conditional negate of the whole register quad — a 2-word path on the
// 64-bit ISAs and a 4-word path on the 32-bit ISAs (i386 / ARM32) that neither
// the i32 `mnmx` nor the i64 `wmnmx` ever reaches.  Operands are sext + scaled
// into the high words so the wide compares genuinely depend on all words.  All
// hardware/inline, ZERO libcall (abs uses is_int_min_poison=false).  No
// obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated lower
// byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWide128MinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I128 = llvm::IntegerType::get(Ctx, 128);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "w128mm", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto sh = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) {
    return B.CreateShl(V, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, N));
  };
  auto lsr = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) {
    return B.CreateLShr(V, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, N));
  };
  // sext to i128 and scale into the high words so the i128 compares are
  // genuinely wide (the result depends on all four words).
  auto *A128 = B.CreateSExt(A, I128), *C128 = B.CreateSExt(C, I128);
  auto *X = B.CreateAdd(sh(A128, 80), C128);
  auto *Y = B.CreateSub(sh(C128, 67), A128);
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {I128}, {X, Y});
  auto *Sn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {I128}, {X, Y});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {I128}, {X, Y});
  auto *Un = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {I128}, {X, Y});
  auto *Ag = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {I128},
                               {B.CreateSub(X, Y), B.getFalse()});
  auto Fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *W0 = B.CreateTrunc(V, I32);
    auto *W1 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 32), I32);
    auto *W2 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 64), I32);
    auto *W3 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 96), I32);
    return B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(W0, W1), B.CreateXor(W2, W3));
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(Fold(Sx), B.CreateShl(Fold(Sn), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Ux));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Un));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(Ag));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Wide (i128) saturating arithmetic intrinsics (sadd/ssub/uadd/usub.sat.i128) —
// the i128 dual of the scalar `ssat` (i32) and `wsat` (i64).  i128 is illegal
// on every target so the carry/borrow chain + overflow detect + clamp to
// INT128_MIN/MAX (or 0 / UINT128_MAX) spans two register words on the 64-bit
// ISAs and four on the 32-bit ISAs — a multi-register select sequence neither
// `ssat` nor `wsat` reaches.  Operands are sext + scaled into the high words so
// the saturation boundaries are actually crossed.  All hardware/inline, ZERO
// libcall.  No obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated
// lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWide128SatIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,

// llvm.powi with a *constant* integer exponent — repeated-squaring multiply
// expansion, a never-tested FP lowering path (no existing FP shape uses powi).
// SelectionDAGBuilder::ExpandPowI turns a constant small exponent into a
// multiply tree (x86 mulss/mulsd, AArch64 fmul, ARM vmul.f32/f64) *before*
// legalization regardless of opt level, so it is zero libcall — a *variable*
// exponent would call __powisf2/__powidf2 which the freestanding harness can't
// resolve.  Bases are masked to <=7 so every power is exact (7^5=16807 < 2^24,
// 7^6=117649 < 2^24) and fptosi stays in the i32 domain.  No obfuscation pass
// touches powi/sitofp/fptosi, so orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically and any
// Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFloatPowiIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "powic", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Keep bases small so every power is exactly representable.
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(7));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32);
  auto *Da = B.CreateSIToFP(Cm, F64);
  auto powi = [&](llvm::Value *X, int N) {
    return B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::powi, {X->getType(), I32},
                             {X, B.getInt32(N)});
  };
  // f32: a^2 + a^3 ; f64: c^5 — odd and even exponents exercise distinct
  // multiply-tree shapes (square-and-multiply vs pure squaring).
  auto *P2 = powi(Fa, 2);
  auto *P3 = powi(Fa, 3);
  auto *P5 = powi(Da, 5);
  auto *I2 = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(P2, P3), I32);
  auto *I5 = B.CreateFPToSI(P5, I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(I2, I5);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector llvm.powi with a *constant* exponent — the vector dual of `powic`.
// Per-lane repeated-squaring multiply tree (x86 mulps + scalar tail, AArch64 /
// ARM NEON fmul, narrow targets scalarize); constant exponent so zero libcall.
// Bases are kept tiny (<=6) so every lane power is exact and fptosi stays in
// the i32 domain.  No obfuscation pass touches powi/sitofp/fptosi, so orig and
// obfuscated lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecPowiIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vpowi", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3)); // lanes <=6 -> 6^3=216 exact (f32)
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(3)); // lanes <=4 -> 4^4=256 exact (f64)
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F32), B.getInt32(i));
  llvm::Value *VD = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    VD = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VD, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(i)), F64), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VP =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::powi, {V4F, I32}, {VA, B.getInt32(3)});
  auto *VPD =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::powi, {V2D, I32}, {VD, B.getInt32(4)});
  llvm::Value *SF = llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    SF = B.CreateFAdd(SF, B.CreateExtractElement(VP, B.getInt32(i)));
  llvm::Value *SD = llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    SD = B.CreateFAdd(SD, B.CreateExtractElement(VPD, B.getInt32(i)));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateFPToSI(SF, I32), B.CreateFPToSI(SD, I32));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// i128 funnel-shift / rotate (llvm.fshl / llvm.fshr) with *constant* amounts —
// the i128 width dual of `wfrot` (i32/i64).  Amounts are constant (and one
// crosses the 64-bit word boundary) so the multi-word shift/or chain stays
// inline on every ISA, including the 4-word i386/ARM32 lowering — zero libcall.
// No obfuscation pass touches funnel intrinsics, so orig/obfuscated lower
// byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideFunnel128IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                   const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I128 = llvm::IntegerType::get(Ctx, 128);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wfunnel128", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A128 = B.CreateSExt(A, I128), *C128 = B.CreateSExt(C, I128);
  auto *La =
      B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A128, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, 64)),
                 B.CreateAnd(C128, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, 0xFFFFFFFFu)));
  auto *Lb =
      B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C128, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, 96)), A128);
  auto funnel = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id, llvm::Value *X, llvm::Value *Y,
                    unsigned Amt) {
    return B.CreateIntrinsic(Id, {I128},
                             {X, Y, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, Amt)});
  };
  auto *R1 = funnel(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, La, La, 40); // rotate-left
  auto *R2 = funnel(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, Lb, Lb, 24); // rotate-right
  auto *R3 = funnel(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, La, Lb, 70); // funnel across word
  auto Fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto lsr = [&](llvm::Value *X, unsigned N) {
      return B.CreateLShr(X, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, N));
    };
    auto *W0 = B.CreateTrunc(V, I32);
    auto *W1 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 32), I32);
    auto *W2 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 64), I32);
    auto *W3 = B.CreateTrunc(lsr(V, 96), I32);
    return B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(W0, W1), B.CreateXor(W2, W3));
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Fold(R1), Fold(R2));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, Fold(R3));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <2 x i64> funnel-shift / rotate (llvm.fshl / llvm.fshr, splat constant
// amount) — the i64-lane dual of `vfunnel` (<4 x i32>) and the vector dual of
// `wfrot`. On 32-bit ISAs each i64 lane scalarizes to a multi-word
// double-shift; zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches funnel intrinsics,
// so orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFunnel64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfunnel64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, A64, B.getInt32(0));
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VA, B.CreateAdd(A64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 0x100000001ULL)),
      B.getInt32(1));
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, C64, B.getInt32(0));
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VB, B.CreateXor(C64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 0xABCDEF)),
      B.getInt32(1));
  auto fn = [&](llvm::Intrinsic::ID Id, llvm::Value *X, llvm::Value *Y,
                unsigned Amt) {
    return B.CreateIntrinsic(Id, {V2}, {X, Y, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V2, Amt)});
  };
  auto *R1 = fn(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, VA, VA, 40); // rotate-left
  auto *R2 = fn(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, VB, VB, 24); // rotate-right
  auto *R3 = fn(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, VA, VB, 17); // two-operand funnel
  auto fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
      auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i));
      auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(L, I32);
      auto *Hi =
          B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)), I32);
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi));
    }
    return Acc;
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(fold(R1), fold(R2));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, fold(R3));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector *true* fused multiply-add (llvm.fma on <4 x float> and <2 x double>) —
// the vector dual of the scalar `Fma` (ffma).  Unlike `vfma` (llvm.fmuladd,
// contraction-permitted, lowers to mul+add on the SSE2 baseline), llvm.fma
// *forces* a single-rounding hardware FMA: x86 must emit VEX-encoded packed
// vfmadd...ps/pd (pulling in +fma,+avx and an AVX-capable CPU model — a codegen
// path the scalar ffma reaches only on scalars), AArch64 NEON fmla.4s/.2d,
// ARM32 NEON vfma.  Inputs masked to [0,255] so each lane a*b+c <= 65280 < 2^24
// is exactly representable -> fused (single rounding) == unfused mul+add,
// deterministic across targets.  fptosi targets i32 (avoids the ARM32 d2lz
// libcall).  No obfuscation pass touches fma/sitofp/fptosi, so orig/obfuscated
// lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend / fork-
// Unicorn(CPU-model) bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFFMAIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V4I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *V2I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vffma", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto *Cm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFF));
  auto m8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateAnd(V, B.getInt32(0xFF)); };
  auto siF = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, F32); };
  auto siD = [&](llvm::Value *V) { return B.CreateSIToFP(V, F64); };
  auto mkV4f = [&](llvm::Value *L0, llvm::Value *L1, llvm::Value *L2,
                   llvm::Value *L3) {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L0), uint64_t(0));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L1), uint64_t(1));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L2), uint64_t(2));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, siF(L3), uint64_t(3));
    return V;
  };
  llvm::Value *Va =
      mkV4f(Am, m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(1))), B.CreateXor(Am, Cm),
            m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(2))));
  llvm::Value *Vb = mkV4f(Cm, m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(7))),
                          B.CreateXor(Cm, B.getInt32(0x5A)),
                          m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(3))));
  llvm::Value *Vc = mkV4f(Cm, m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(5))), Am,
                          B.CreateXor(Am, B.getInt32(0x33)));
  auto *Mf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V4F}, {Va, Vb, Vc});
  auto *Mi = B.CreateFPToSI(Mf, V4I);
  auto *Sf = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(0)),
                                     B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(1))),
                         B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(2)),
                                     B.CreateExtractElement(Mi, uint64_t(3))));
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  Da = B.CreateInsertElement(Da, siD(Am), uint64_t(0));
  Da = B.CreateInsertElement(Da, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(9)))),
                             uint64_t(1));
  llvm::Value *Db = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  Db = B.CreateInsertElement(Db, siD(Cm), uint64_t(0));
  Db = B.CreateInsertElement(Db, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(3)))),
                             uint64_t(1));
  llvm::Value *Dc = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  Dc = B.CreateInsertElement(Dc, siD(m8(B.CreateAdd(Cm, B.getInt32(5)))),
                             uint64_t(0));
  Dc = B.CreateInsertElement(Dc, siD(Am), uint64_t(1));
  auto *Md = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fma, {V2D}, {Da, Db, Dc});
  auto *Mdi = B.CreateFPToSI(Md, V2I);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(Mdi, uint64_t(0)),
                         B.CreateExtractElement(Mdi, uint64_t(1)));
  auto *S = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 128-bit narrow-lane integer multiply (<8 x i16> + <16 x i8>) — fills the gap
// between `vmul` (<4 x i32>, 128-bit word lane) and `vw256b` (256-bit narrow
// lanes): the 128-bit <8 x i16>/<16 x i8> multiply has its own per-ISA
// lowering. x86 SSE2: <8 x i16> is native `pmullw`, but <16 x i8> has NO native
// multiply
// -> unpack to i16, pmullw, repack; AArch64/ARM NEON `mul.8h`/`mul.16b` native.
// All inline, zero libcall.  --subst rewrites the surrounding
// add/sub/and/or/xor (it never touches vector mul); the per-lane mul is given
// to the backend.  Any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMulNarrowIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8H = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V16B = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmulnw", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
  llvm::Value *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Va = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va, B.CreateAdd(Ah, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, i * 3 + 1)),
        B.getInt32(i));
    Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vb, B.CreateAdd(Ch, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, i * 5 + 2)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Ph = B.CreateMul(Va, Vb);
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Ph, B.getInt32(i)), I32));
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  llvm::Value *Wa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16B);
  llvm::Value *Wb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16B);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Wa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Wa, B.CreateAdd(Ab, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, i + 1)), B.getInt32(i));
    Wb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Wb, B.CreateAdd(Cb, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, i * 2 + 3)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Pb = B.CreateMul(Wa, Wb);
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    Sb = B.CreateAdd(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Pb, B.getInt32(i)), I32));
  auto *S = B.CreateAdd(Sh, Sb);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector fixed-point multiply (llvm.smul.fix / umul.fix / .sat on <4 x i32>) —
// the vector dual of the scalar `fixp`.  Each lane computes the full
// double-width product then shifts right by the (scalar) scale immarg, so the
// backend emits a per-lane widening multiply + shift (x86 expands via pmuludq
// even/odd shuffles, AArch64 smull/umull + shrn, ARM NEON vmull); the .sat
// variants add a per-lane range clamp.  All legal <4 x i32>, zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches the intrinsic (the scale stays an immarg), so
// orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFixedMulIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfixp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Va =
        B.CreateInsertElement(Va, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(Vb, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(i * 2)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto fixMul = [&](unsigned IID, unsigned Scale) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateIntrinsic(IID, {V4}, {Va, Vb, B.getInt32(Scale)});
  };
  auto *Sm = fixMul(llvm::Intrinsic::smul_fix, 15);
  auto *Um = fixMul(llvm::Intrinsic::umul_fix, 7);
  auto *Sms = fixMul(llvm::Intrinsic::smul_fix_sat, 1);
  auto *Ums = fixMul(llvm::Intrinsic::umul_fix_sat, 1);
  auto reduce = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return Acc;
  };
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(reduce(Sm), B.CreateShl(reduce(Um), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, reduce(Sms));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(reduce(Ums), B.getInt32(2)));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <4 x i32> funnel-shift / rotate with *variable per-lane* amounts (llvm.fshl /
// fshr, amount is a per-lane vector) — distinct from `vfunnel`/`vfunnel64`
// (splat *constant* amount).  Per-lane variable shift has its own lowering: x86
// SSE2 has no per-lane variable shift (psllvd is AVX2) so it scalarizes to
// extract/shift/insert; AArch64/ARM NEON use ushl with a per-lane amount
// vector. Amounts are taken mod 32 by fshl/fshr so any value is in range; zero
// libcall. No obfuscation pass touches funnel intrinsics, so orig/obfuscated
// lower byte-identically and any Unicorn mismatch is a real bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFunnelVarIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfunnelv", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto mkV = [&](llvm::Value *S, unsigned step) {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, B.CreateAdd(S, B.getInt32(i * step + 1)),
                                B.getInt32(i));
    return V;
  };
  auto *Va = mkV(A, 3), *Vb = mkV(C, 5), *Vamt = mkV(B.CreateXor(A, C), 7);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V4}, {Va, Va, Vamt});
  auto *R2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {V4}, {Vb, Vb, Vamt});
  auto *R3 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V4}, {Va, Vb, Vamt});
  auto reduce = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return Acc;
  };
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(reduce(R1), reduce(R2)), reduce(R3));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Narrow-lane vector funnel/rotate (<8 x i16> + <16 x i8>, llvm.fshl/fshr with
// a splat *constant* amount) — the narrow-lane dual of `vfunnel`(<4 x i32>) /
// `vfunnel64`(<2 x i64>).  x86 SSE2 has no narrow per-element rotate ->
// shift+or expand; AArch64/ARM NEON ushl/shl + or.  Zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches funnel intrinsics; any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecRotNarrowIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8H = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V16B = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vrotnw", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
  llvm::Value *Vb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8H);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Va = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va, B.CreateAdd(Ah, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, i * 7 + 1)),
        B.getInt32(i));
    Vb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vb, B.CreateAdd(Ch, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I16, i * 3 + 2)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Rl = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V8H},
                               {Va, Va, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V8H, 5)});
  auto *Rf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {V8H},
                               {Va, Vb, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V8H, 3)});
  llvm::Value *Sh = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Sh = B.CreateXor(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Rl, B.getInt32(i)), I32));
    Sh = B.CreateAdd(
        Sh, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Rf, B.getInt32(i)), I32));
  }
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  llvm::Value *Wa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16B);
  llvm::Value *Wb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16B);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Wa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Wa, B.CreateAdd(Ab, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, i + 1)), B.getInt32(i));
    Wb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Wb, B.CreateAdd(Cb, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I8, i * 2 + 1)),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Wr = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshr, {V16B},
                               {Wa, Wa, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V16B, 3)});
  auto *Wf = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::fshl, {V16B},
                               {Wa, Wb, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V16B, 2)});
  llvm::Value *Sb = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Sb = B.CreateXor(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Wr, B.getInt32(i)), I32));
    Sb = B.CreateAdd(
        Sb, B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(Wf, B.getInt32(i)), I32));
  }
  auto *S = B.CreateAdd(Sh, Sb);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <2 x i64> integer abs (llvm.abs.v2i64, is_int_min_poison=false) — the
// i64-lane dual of `vabsi`(<4 x i32>).  AArch64 NEON `abs.2d` is native; x86
// SSE2 has no i64 vector abs so it expands (sign-shift + xor + sub per lane);
// 32-bit ISAs scalarize each i64 lane.  Zero libcall.  Lanes are built with
// mixed signs so abs is exercised.  No obfuscation pass touches abs; any
// Unicorn mismatch is a real bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAbs64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vabs64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  auto *L0 = B.CreateSub(B.CreateShl(A64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 8)),
                         llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 0x12345678));
  auto *L1 = B.CreateSub(llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 0x7654321),
                         B.CreateShl(C64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 8)));
  llvm::Value *Va = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, L0, B.getInt32(0));
  Va = B.CreateInsertElement(Va, L1, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Ab =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V2}, {Va, B.getInt1(false)});
  llvm::Value *Base = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(Ab, B.getInt32(i));
    auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(L, I32);
    auto *Hi =
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(L, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)), I32);
    Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi));
  }
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector byte-swap / bit-reverse intrinsics (llvm.bswap / llvm.bitreverse on
// <4 x i32>) — the vector dual of the scalar `bswp` / `brev`.  x86 SSE2 has no
// vector pshufb (SSSE3) so bswap is a shift/mask/or SWAR per lane and
// bitreverse a nibble/byte SWAR tree — a dense fixup/const-pool stress; AArch64
// NEON uses rev32 (bswap) and rbit + rev (bitreverse); ARM32 NEON vrev32 /
// vrbit.  All hardware/inline, zero libcall (legal <4 x i32>).  No obfuscation
// pass rewrites an intrinsic call, so orig/obfuscated lower byte-identically
// and any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecByteRevIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vbrev", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Bs = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bswap, {V4}, {VA});
  auto *Br = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::bitreverse, {V4}, {VB});
  auto Red = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *E0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *E1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *E2 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2));
    llvm::Value *E3 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3));
    return B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(E0, E1), B.CreateXor(E2, E3));
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(Red(Bs), B.CreateShl(Red(Br), B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Variable-index vector lane access (extractelement / insertelement with a
// *runtime* index) — every existing vector sample uses constant lane indices,
// so this is the first to exercise variable-index lane access.  A runtime lane
// index has no per-lane instruction on most ISAs, so the backend spills the
// vector to the stack and addresses it with a variable offset (x86 pre-AVX has
// no variable-index pextrd/pinsrd; AArch64/ARM also round-trip through memory).
// Indices are masked to [0,3] so every access is in-bounds (out-of-bounds
// extract/insert is poison).  No obfuscation pass touches extractelement /
// insertelement, so the original and obfuscated copies share byte-identical
// lane-access lowering — any divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or
// fork-Unicorn bug.  The surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive
// --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real
// structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecLaneIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vlane", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA =
        B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(2 * i)),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  }
  // Runtime lane indices, masked to [0,3] so every access is in-bounds.
  auto *I = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(3));
  auto *J = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(3));
  // Variable-index extract from both vectors.
  auto *X =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(VA, I), B.CreateExtractElement(VB, J));
  // Variable-index insert, then variable-index extract: reads the inserted
  // value when I==J, the original lane otherwise.
  auto *VA2 = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, B.CreateXor(X, C), J);
  auto *Y = B.CreateExtractElement(VA2, I);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(X, Y);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector 64-bit integer min/max (llvm.smax/smin/umax/umin on <2 x i64>) — the
// 64-bit-lane sibling of `vminmax` (<4 x i32>).  No mainstream baseline has a
// native 64-bit vector compare (x86 pcmpgtq is SSE4.2; AArch64/ARM NEON integer
// smax/umax stop at 32-bit lanes), so the backend *scalarizes* each lane to a
// scalar i64 compare+select — and on 32-bit ISAs each i64 compare is itself a
// multi-register sequence.  Second lane is shifted high so the sign bits differ
// (signed vs unsigned min/max pick genuinely different lanes).  Zero libcall.
// No obfuscation pass touches a min/max intrinsic, so the original and
// obfuscated copies share byte-identical lowering — any divergence is a genuine
// rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMinMax64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vminmax64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64);
  auto *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, A64, B.getInt32(0));
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VA, B.CreateXor(A64, B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(33))), B.getInt32(1));
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, C64, B.getInt32(0));
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
      VB, B.CreateXor(C64, B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(29))), B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V2}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Sn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V2}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V2}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Un = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V2}, {VA, VB});
  auto Red = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *L0 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0));
    llvm::Value *L1 = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *X = B.CreateXor(L0, L1);
    llvm::Value *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(X, I32);
    llvm::Value *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(X, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
    return B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi);
  };
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red(Sx), Red(Sn)), B.CreateXor(Red(Ux), Red(Un)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector byte/halfword integer min/max (llvm.smax/smin/umax/umin on <16 x i8>
// and <8 x i16>) — the narrow-lane complement of `vminmax` (<4 x i32>) and
// `vminmax64` (<2 x i64>), completing the integer min/max lane matrix down to
// byte/halfword.  The narrow lanes split *asymmetrically* on the x86 SSE2
// baseline: <16 x i8> *unsigned* min/max are native (pminub/pmaxub) but the
// *signed* i8 forms are SSE4.1 (pminsb/pmaxsb) → SSE2 expands signed-i8 min/max
// to pcmpgtb + blend; symmetrically <8 x i16> *signed* min/max are native
// (pminsw/pmaxsw) but the *unsigned* i16 forms are SSE4.1 (pminuw/pmaxuw) →
// SSE2 expands unsigned-i16 to a bias-xor + pcmpgtw + blend.  AArch64/ARM NEON
// have all four at .16b/.8h natively (smin/smax/umin/umax, vmin.s8/u8 …). Lanes
// mix arg-derived values with near-extreme constants (0x7f/0x80/0xff bytes,
// 0x7fff/0x8000 halfwords) so the signed-vs-unsigned ordering genuinely
// diverges and the expanded vs native paths must agree.  All integer SIMD, zero
// libcall. No obfuscation pass rewrites a min/max intrinsic, so orig/obfuscated
// lower byte-identically — any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend /
// fork-Unicorn bug. Multi-block (diamond + PHI) so it reaches all seven suites;
// the integer mix + 0x5A5A/12345 drive the scalar passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMinMax8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vminmax8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <16 x i8>: arg-derived lanes vs near-extreme byte constants.
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  uint8_t BigB[16] = {0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x01, 0x40, 0xc0, 0x7e, 0x81,
                      0x10, 0xf0, 0x33, 0xcc, 0x55, 0xaa, 0x08, 0x7f};
  auto *BigBV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(BigB, 16));
  llvm::Value *VA8 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    VA8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA8, B.CreateAdd(Ab, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 7 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VB8 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(16, Cb), BigBV);
  auto *Sx8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V16}, {VA8, VB8});
  auto *Sn8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V16}, {VA8, VB8});
  auto *Ux8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V16}, {VA8, VB8});
  auto *Un8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V16}, {VA8, VB8});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <8 x i16>: arg-derived lanes vs near-extreme halfword constants.
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  uint16_t BigH[8] = {0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x0001,
                      0x4000, 0xc000, 0x7ffe, 0x8001};
  auto *BigHV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(BigH, 8));
  llvm::Value *VA16 = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8);
