  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    VA16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA16, B.CreateAdd(Ah, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 131 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *VB16 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Ch), BigHV);
  auto *Sx16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V8}, {VA16, VB16});
  auto *Sn16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V8}, {VA16, VB16});
  auto *Ux16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V8}, {VA16, VB16});
  auto *Un16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V8}, {VA16, VB16});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *S8 =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red8(Sx8), B.CreateShl(Red8(Sn8), B.getInt32(1))),
                  B.CreateXor(Red8(Ux8), Red8(Un8)));
  llvm::Value *S16 = B.CreateXor(
      B.CreateXor(Red16(Sx16), B.CreateShl(Red16(Sn16), B.getInt32(1))),
      B.CreateXor(Red16(Ux16), Red16(Un16)));
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(S8, S16);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 2-D global array with two *independent* runtime indices (g[r][c]) — every
// existing global-memory sample uses a single variable index (daccum/srec/bzrmw
// are 1-D), so this is the first with two independent variable indices into one
// global: the address has two runtime scaled terms (base + r*rowstride +
// c*elemsize) plus the global relocation.  A fill loop seeds the array; the
// read/RMW phase derives indices independently from the two args.  The data
// section is byte-compared.  No obfuscation pass touches GEP indexing, so any
// divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildGrid2DIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *RowTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *GridTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(RowTy, 4); // [4 x [4 x i32]]
  auto *G = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, GridTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantAggregateZero::get(GridTy), "g_grid");
  G->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "grid2d", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Loop = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "loop", F);
  auto *After = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "after", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  auto gep = [&](llvm::IRBuilder<> &BB, llvm::Value *R, llvm::Value *Cc) {
    llvm::Value *Idx[] = {BB.getInt32(0), R, Cc};
    return BB.CreateInBoundsGEP(GridTy, G, Idx);
  };

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  B.CreateBr(Loop);

  // Fill: for (k=0;k<16;k++) g_grid[k>>2][k&3] = (a+k) ^ (b * (k&3));
  B.SetInsertPoint(Loop);
  auto *K = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "k");
  auto *Ri = B.CreateLShr(K, B.getInt32(2));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateAnd(K, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Val = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, K), B.CreateMul(Bb, Ci));
  B.CreateStore(Val, gep(B, Ri, Ci));
  auto *NextK = B.CreateAdd(K, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(NextK, B.getInt32(16)), Loop, After);
  K->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  K->addIncoming(NextK, Loop);

  B.SetInsertPoint(After);
  auto *R = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Cc = B.CreateAnd(Bb, B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Rx = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Cx = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(A, Bb), B.getInt32(3));
  auto *P1 = B.CreateLoad(I32, gep(B, R, Cc));
  auto *P2 = B.CreateLoad(I32, gep(B, Cc, R));
  auto *P3 = B.CreateLoad(I32, gep(B, Rx, Cx));
  auto *S = B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(P1, P2), P3);
  // RMW with the 2-D variable index: g_grid[r][c] ^= (s + a).
  auto *Slot = gep(B, R, Cc);
  auto *Old = B.CreateLoad(I32, Slot);
  auto *NewV = B.CreateXor(Old, B.CreateAdd(S, A));
  B.CreateStore(NewV, Slot);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, Bb), B.CreateSub(A, Bb)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, Bb), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(S, NewV);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Large 64-bit immediate materialization — every existing constant is small/
// medium (0x5A5A / 12345 / masks); this is the first to force full 64-bit
// immediate materialization (AArch64 movz/movk chains, x86-64 movabs, 32-bit
// ISAs literal pools / register-pair builds).  i64 add/sub/and/or/xor against
// large constants drive both --subst (MBA carry/borrow on i64) and --const-enc
// (the encryption key path on a 64-bit constant).  Folds to i32 so the 32-bit
// return capture observes the full result; diamond + PHI give the control-flow
// passes structure.  Zero libcall (i64 logic ops are inline on every ISA).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBigImmIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "bigimm", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *X = B.CreateSExt(A, I64);
  auto *Y = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  auto *T1 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(X, B.getInt64(0x0123456789ABCDEFULL)),
                         B.CreateAnd(Y, B.getInt64(0xFEDCBA9876543210ULL)));
  auto *T2 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(X, B.getInt64(0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL)),
                        B.CreateXor(Y, B.getInt64(0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEULL)));
  auto *R64 =
      B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(T1, T2), B.getInt64(0x1122334455667788ULL));
  auto *Lo = B.CreateTrunc(R64, I32);
  auto *Hi = B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(R64, B.getInt64(32)), I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Lo, Hi), B.CreateXor(T, U));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// First-class aggregate SSA value (insertvalue / extractvalue on {i32,i32,i32})
// — every existing struct sample goes through memory (srec/sstk) or the call
// ABI (fnptr); this is the first to build and pick apart a first-class
// aggregate value with no backing memory.  The aggregate flows through the
// rewrite pipeline as an SSA value (typically SROA'd to scalars).
// add/sub/and/or/xor mix + constants drive --subst / --const-enc; the diamond +
// PHI give the control-flow passes structure.  Zero libcall.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildAggValIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *STy = llvm::StructType::get(I32, I32, I32);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "aggval", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *S = llvm::UndefValue::get(STy);
  S = B.CreateInsertValue(S, A, {0});
  S = B.CreateInsertValue(S, C, {1});
  S = B.CreateInsertValue(S, B.CreateXor(A, C), {2});
  // Overwrite field 1 from extracted fields, then read all three back.
  auto *F0 = B.CreateExtractValue(S, {0});
  auto *F2 = B.CreateExtractValue(S, {2});
  S = B.CreateInsertValue(
      S, B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(F0, C), B.CreateOr(F0, F2)), {1});
  auto *X = B.CreateExtractValue(S, {0});
  auto *Y = B.CreateExtractValue(S, {1});
  auto *Z = B.CreateExtractValue(S, {2});
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(B.CreateAdd(X, Z), Y), B.CreateXor(T, U));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector integer widening (sext/zext of <4 x i16> -> <4 x i32>) — every
// existing vector sample preserves the lane width; this is the first to *widen*
// lanes. Signed vs unsigned widening differ on high-bit-set lanes, so both the
// sext and zext lowering paths are exercised: x86 punpck/pmovsx-style expansion
// (no SSE4.1 pmovsx at SSE2 baseline -> shift/unpack), AArch64 NEON
// sshll/ushll, ARM NEON vmovl.  Zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches
// sext/zext casts, so any divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or
// fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecExtIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4_16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *V4_32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vext",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4_16);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4_16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VA, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)), I16), B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(
        VB, B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(C, B.getInt32(3 * i)), I16),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Se = B.CreateSExt(VA, V4_32); // sign-extend widening
  auto *Ze = B.CreateZExt(VB, V4_32); // zero-extend widening
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(Se, Ze);
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector integer narrowing (trunc of <4 x i32> -> <4 x i16> and -> <4 x i8>) —
// the dual of `vext`: the first sample to *narrow* lanes.  x86 lowers vector
// truncation to pack (packssdw/packuswb) + mask shuffles; AArch64/ARM NEON use
// xtn/vmovn.  The narrowed lanes are zero-extended back so the i32 reduction
// observes the low bytes/halves.  Zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches
// trunc casts, so any divergence is a genuine rewrite-backend or fork-Unicorn
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecTruncIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4_8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 4);
  auto *V4_16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *V4_32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vtrunc", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4_32);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA,
                               B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i)),
                                           B.CreateShl(C, B.getInt32(i))),
                               B.getInt32(i));
  auto *T16 = B.CreateTrunc(VA, V4_16); // narrow to i16 lanes
  auto *T8 = B.CreateTrunc(VA, V4_8);   // narrow to i8 lanes
  auto *Z16 = B.CreateZExt(T16, V4_32);
  auto *Z8 = B.CreateZExt(T8, V4_32);
  auto *Acc =
      B.CreateXor(Z16, B.CreateShl(Z8, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V4_32, 1)));
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int mwbr(int a, int b) {  // wide N-way decision cascade
//   A deep, branch-dense CFG: 16 test blocks + 16 leaf blocks + a default leaf
//   merging through one 17-way PHI, built as a hand-lowered if/else cascade
//   (NOT a SwitchInst, so the flattening and indirect-branch passes apply
//   rather than bail).  This produces far more basic blocks and conditional
//   edges than any other shape in the matrix (diamond/loop/switch), so it is
//   the strongest stress for every control-flow obfuscation pass's block
//   handling — opaque block-split, bogus subgraph injection, flatten reg2mem
//   over a wide PHI, indirect-branch PIC computed-goto over 16 conditional
//   edges — and for the rewrite backend's relocation of many intra-function
//   branches at once.  Each leaf mixes all five substitutable operators
//   (add/sub/and/or/xor) with distinct constants so --subst and --const-enc
//   both fire. int sel = (a ^ b) & 31;        // 0..31; 16..31 fall to the
//   default leaf switch(sel) { case 0: ...; case 1: ...; ...; case 15: ...;
//   default: ...; }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMultiWayBranchIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "mwbr",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Done = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "done", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(31)); // 0..31

  const unsigned N = 16; // explicit cases 0..15; 16..31 take the default leaf
  auto emitOp = [](llvm::IRBuilder<> &BB, unsigned op, llvm::Value *x,
                   llvm::Value *y) -> llvm::Value * {
    switch (op % 5) {
    case 0:
      return BB.CreateAdd(x, y);
    case 1:
      return BB.CreateSub(x, y);
    case 2:
      return BB.CreateAnd(x, y);
    case 3:
      return BB.CreateOr(x, y);
    default:
      return BB.CreateXor(x, y);
    }
  };

  // Create the merge PHI up front so each leaf can register its incoming value.
  llvm::IRBuilder<> DB(Done);
  auto *Phi = DB.CreatePHI(I32, N + 1, "r");

  std::vector<llvm::BasicBlock *> Tests(N), Leaves(N);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
    Tests[i] = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F, Done);
    Leaves[i] = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F, Done);
  }
  auto *Def = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F, Done);
  B.CreateBr(Tests[0]);

  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> TB(Tests[i]);
    auto *Eq = TB.CreateICmpEQ(Sel, TB.getInt32(i));
    TB.CreateCondBr(Eq, Leaves[i], (i + 1 < N) ? Tests[i + 1] : Def);

    llvm::IRBuilder<> LB(Leaves[i]);
    llvm::Value *t = emitOp(LB, i, A, LB.getInt32(0x1000u + i * 7u + 1u));
    t = emitOp(LB, i + 1, t, C);
    t = emitOp(LB, i + 2, t, LB.getInt32(0xA5u ^ (i * 13u)));
    LB.CreateBr(Done);
    Phi->addIncoming(t, Leaves[i]);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> DfB(Def);
    llvm::Value *t = DfB.CreateXor(A, C);
    t = DfB.CreateAdd(t, DfB.getInt32(0x777));
    t = DfB.CreateOr(t, DfB.getInt32(1));
    DfB.CreateBr(Done);
    Phi->addIncoming(t, Def);
  }
  DB.CreateRet(Phi);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int mping/mpong(int n, int acc) — mutually recursive; int mrec(int a,int b)
// is
//   the entry.  Depth is bounded by n = a & 7 (<=7) so kPairs' huge values
//   cannot blow the recursion.  This is a cross-function *call-graph* topology
//   (f <-> g mutual recursion) no other shape covers: every obfuscation pass
//   transforms BOTH mutually recursive callees, and the rewrite backend must
//   resolve the cross-function call relocations between two heavily rewritten
//   functions.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMutualRecursionIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F2 = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *Ping = llvm::Function::Create(F2, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                      "mping", M.get());
  auto *Pong = llvm::Function::Create(F2, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                      "mpong", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::Function::Create(F2, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                       "mrec", M.get());

  auto buildLeg = [&](llvm::Function *Self, llvm::Function *Other,
                      bool IsPing) {
    auto *N = Self->getArg(0), *Acc = Self->getArg(1);
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Self);
    auto *Base = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "base", Self);
    auto *Rec = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "rec", Self);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
    B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpEQ(N, B.getInt32(0)), Base, Rec);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> BaseB(Base);
    BaseB.CreateRet(IsPing ? BaseB.CreateXor(Acc, BaseB.getInt32(0x55))
                           : BaseB.CreateOr(Acc, BaseB.getInt32(1)));
    llvm::IRBuilder<> RB(Rec);
    auto *N1 = RB.CreateSub(N, RB.getInt32(1));
    llvm::Value *NAcc =
        IsPing ? RB.CreateXor(RB.CreateAdd(Acc, N), RB.CreateAnd(Acc, N))
               : RB.CreateOr(RB.CreateSub(Acc, N), RB.CreateXor(Acc, N));
    RB.CreateRet(RB.CreateCall(Other, {N1, NAcc}));
  };
  buildLeg(Ping, Pong, true);
  buildLeg(Pong, Ping, false);

  auto *EB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Entry);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> EBd(EB);
  auto *Depth = EBd.CreateAnd(Entry->getArg(0), EBd.getInt32(7));
  EBd.CreateRet(EBd.CreateCall(Ping, {Depth, Entry->getArg(1)}));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int lbreak(int a,int b) — counted loop with an early break (multi-exit loop).
//   Trip count is bounded by a & 31 (<=31).  Existing loop shapes are all
//   single-exit; this adds a second edge into the exit block (the break), so
//   the exit PHI merges two loop-carried values from different blocks — a
//   genuinely different loop CFG for the control-flow passes and the backend's
//   back-edge plus early-exit relocation.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildLoopBreakIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "lbreak", M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Head = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "head", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Brk = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "brk", F);
  auto *Cont = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "cont", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Limit = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(31));
  B.CreateBr(Head);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> HB(Head);
  auto *I = HB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *Acc = HB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "acc");
  I->addIncoming(HB.getInt32(0), Entry);
  Acc->addIncoming(C, Entry);
  HB.CreateCondBr(HB.CreateICmpSLT(I, Limit), Body, Exit);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> BB(Body);
  auto *A1 = BB.CreateXor(BB.CreateAdd(Acc, I), BB.CreateAnd(Acc, C));
  auto *BrkCond =
      BB.CreateICmpNE(BB.CreateAnd(A1, BB.getInt32(0x100)), BB.getInt32(0));
  BB.CreateCondBr(BrkCond, Brk, Cont);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> KB(Brk);
  auto *Abrk = KB.CreateSub(A1, KB.CreateOr(I, KB.getInt32(7)));
  KB.CreateBr(Exit);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> CB(Cont);
  auto *A2 = CB.CreateOr(A1, CB.CreateAdd(I, CB.getInt32(1)));
  auto *INext = CB.CreateAdd(I, CB.getInt32(1));
  CB.CreateBr(Head);
  I->addIncoming(INext, Cont);
  Acc->addIncoming(A2, Cont);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> XB(Exit);
  auto *R = XB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(Acc, Head); // normal exit: loop condition went false
  R->addIncoming(Abrk, Brk); // early break
  XB.CreateRet(XB.CreateXor(R, XB.getInt32(0x3C3C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int regpress(int a,int b) — many simultaneously-live values to force register
//   spills (especially i386's 8 GPRs), all kept live across a branch.  Stresses
//   spill/reload correctness and stack-frame relocation under obfuscation,
//   where const-encryption (volatile stack slots) and flattening (reg2mem) pile
//   their own stack traffic on top of an already register-starved function.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildRegPressureIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "regpress", M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  std::vector<llvm::Value *> V;
  V.push_back(B.CreateAdd(A, C));
  V.push_back(B.CreateSub(A, C));
  V.push_back(B.CreateAnd(A, C));
  V.push_back(B.CreateOr(A, C));
  V.push_back(B.CreateXor(A, C));
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
    auto *x = V[i % 5], *y = V[(i + 3) % 5];
    switch (i % 5) {
    case 0:
      V.push_back(B.CreateAdd(x, y));
      break;
    case 1:
      V.push_back(B.CreateSub(x, y));
      break;
    case 2:
      V.push_back(B.CreateAnd(x, B.CreateOr(y, B.getInt32(0x101u + i))));
      break;
    case 3:
      V.push_back(B.CreateOr(x, y));
      break;
    default:
      V.push_back(B.CreateXor(x, B.CreateAdd(y, B.getInt32(0x5Au + i))));
      break;
    }
  }
  auto *Sel = B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                             B.getInt32(0));
  B.CreateCondBr(Sel, Then, Else);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> TB(Then);
  llvm::Value *St = TB.getInt32(0);
  for (auto *e : V)
    St = TB.CreateAdd(St, e);
  TB.CreateBr(Merge);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> EB(Else);
  llvm::Value *Se = EB.getInt32(0);
  for (auto *e : V)
    Se = EB.CreateXor(Se, e);
  EB.CreateBr(Merge);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> MB(Merge);
  auto *Phi = MB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  Phi->addIncoming(St, Then);
  Phi->addIncoming(Se, Else);
  MB.CreateRet(Phi);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int wmul64(int a,int b) — 64x64 -> 64 *variable* multiply.  Existing wide
//   shapes cover i64 add/sub/and/or/xor (warith) and i128 (wide128) but none do
//   a variable i64 multiply, which on 32-bit ISAs (i386/ARM32) lowers to a
//   multi-register inline sequence (mul + imul-hi adds / umull + mla) with NO
//   libcall.  MBA-able ops around the product keep --subst/--const-enc firing;
//   a data-dependent branch keeps the control-flow passes firing.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideMul64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wmul64", M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  auto *X = B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, B.getInt64(21)), C64);
  auto *Y = B.CreateXor(B.CreateShl(C64, B.getInt64(13)), A64);
  auto *P = B.CreateMul(X, Y); // 64x64 -> 64 variable multiply (the new path)
  auto *Q = B.CreateSub(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(P, B.CreateAnd(X, Y)), B.CreateOr(P, Y)),
      B.CreateXor(X, Y));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                             B.getInt32(0));
  B.CreateCondBr(Sel, Then, Else);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> TB(Then);
  auto *RT = TB.CreateAdd(Q, X);
  TB.CreateBr(Merge);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> EB(Else);
  auto *RE = EB.CreateXor(Q, Y);
  EB.CreateBr(Merge);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> MB(Merge);
  auto *R = MB.CreatePHI(I64, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  auto *Lo = MB.CreateTrunc(R, I32);
  auto *Hi = MB.CreateTrunc(MB.CreateLShr(R, MB.getInt64(32)), I32);
  MB.CreateRet(MB.CreateXor(Lo, Hi));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int fnptrsel(int a,int b) — indirect call through a *selected* function
//   pointer (PHI of two function addresses), as opposed to fptab's table load.
//   Exercises function-address materialization (lea rip-rel / adrp+add, which
//   on x86 ELF only stays direct because the callees are dso_local) plus an
//   indirect call.  fa/fb are ExternalLinkage and deliberately NOT manually
//   dso_local, so this also guards the compileForRewrite dso_local pre-pass
//   covering defs.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFnPtrSelIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *PTy = llvm::PointerType::get(Ctx, 0);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);

  auto makeLeaf = [&](const char *Name, bool Variant) {
    auto *Fn = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                      Name, M.get());
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Fn);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
    auto *X = Fn->getArg(0), *Y = Fn->getArg(1);
    B.CreateRet(Variant ? B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(X, Y), B.CreateXor(X, Y))
                        : B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(X, Y), B.CreateAnd(X, Y)));
    return Fn;
  };
  auto *Fa = makeLeaf("fa", false);
  auto *Fb = makeLeaf("fb", true);

  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fnptrsel", M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Call = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "call", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1)),
                             B.getInt32(0));
  B.CreateCondBr(Sel, Then, Else);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> TB(Then);
  TB.CreateBr(Call);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> EB(Else);
  EB.CreateBr(Call);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> CB(Call);
  auto *FP = CB.CreatePHI(PTy, 2, "fp");
  FP->addIncoming(Fb, Then);
  FP->addIncoming(Fa, Else);
  auto *R = CB.CreateCall(FnTy, FP, {A, C});
  CB.CreateRet(
      CB.CreateXor(CB.CreateAdd(R, A), CB.CreateAnd(C, CB.getInt32(0x33))));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Virtual-dispatch table: a const array of { i32 tag, fnptr } structs, indexed
// at run time.  Unlike fptab (a flat [N x ptr] array), each element is a
// struct, so the dispatch GEP's scaled index uses a stride of sizeof(struct)
// (not sizeof(ptr)) and the function-pointer field sits past the i32 tag's slot
// — which on 64-bit targets introduces 4 bytes of *internal padding* between
// the tag and the pointer.  That padding stresses the const-aggregate emitter's
// fill/alignment bytes (the same FT_Fill materialization path) on top of the
// code-pointer relocation parked in read-only data.  We load both the tag (i32
// field 0) and the function pointer (field 1) and use the tag in the result, so
// the field-offset addressing for both the scalar and the pointer is exercised.
// The table is `const` -> rodata, so its code-pointer entries (which
// legitimately differ between the original and obfuscated builds) are excluded
// from the data-section comparison.  A 2-way branch lets the flatten / indirect
// passes fire too.
//   typedef int (*Fn)(int,int);
//   struct E { int tag; Fn fn; };
//   static const struct E vt[4] = {{0xA0,m0},{0xA1,m1},{0xA2,m2},{0xA3,m3}};
//   int vtdisp(int a, int b) {
//     int i = a & 3;
//     int t = vt[i].tag;
//     int r = vt[i].fn(a, b);
//     if ((a ^ b) & 1) r = (r + t) ^ b; else r = (r - b) | (t & a);
//     return r;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVtDispIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *PtrTy = llvm::PointerType::get(Ctx, 0);
  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);

  // Four leaf methods, each a distinct substitutable expression.
  llvm::Function *Leaf[4];
  static const char *LN[4] = {"m0", "m1", "m2", "m3"};
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Leaf[i] = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::InternalLinkage,
                                     LN[i], M.get());
    Leaf[i]->setDSOLocal(true);
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Leaf[i]);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> B(BB);
    auto *X = Leaf[i]->getArg(0), *Y = Leaf[i]->getArg(1);
    llvm::Value *R = nullptr;
    switch (i) {
    case 0:
      R = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(X, Y), B.CreateAnd(X, Y));
      break;
    case 1:
      R = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(X, Y), B.CreateXor(X, Y));
      break;
    case 2:
      R = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(X, Y), B.CreateOr(X, Y));
      break;
    default:
      R = B.CreateSub(B.CreateXor(X, Y), B.CreateAnd(X, Y));
      break;
    }
    B.CreateRet(R);
  }

  // struct E { i32 tag; ptr fn; }  -> internal padding on 64-bit targets.
  auto *ETy = llvm::StructType::get(Ctx, {I32, PtrTy});
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(ETy, 4);
  std::vector<llvm::Constant *> Elems;
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Elems.push_back(llvm::ConstantStruct::get(
        ETy, {llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 0xA0 + i), Leaf[i]}));
  auto *Tab = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/true, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantArray::get(ArrTy, Elems), "vt_tab");
  Tab->setDSOLocal(true);

  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vtdisp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Idx = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  // &vt[Idx].tag  (struct field 0)
  llvm::Value *TagGep[] = {B.getInt32(0), Idx, B.getInt32(0)};
  auto *TagP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, TagGep);
  auto *Tag = B.CreateLoad(I32, TagP);
  // &vt[Idx].fn   (struct field 1)
  llvm::Value *FnGep[] = {B.getInt32(0), Idx, B.getInt32(1)};
  auto *FnP = B.CreateInBoundsGEP(ArrTy, Tab, FnGep);
  auto *Fn = B.CreateLoad(PtrTy, FnP);
  auto *R1 = B.CreateCall(FnTy, Fn, {A, Bb});
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(R1, Tag), Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(R1, Bb), B.CreateAnd(Tag, A));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// In-code computed goto.  Unlike badisp (a block-address *table* parked in
// rodata and loaded at run time), basel materialises the four block addresses
// *directly in code* via a nested select, then transfers with a single
// indirectbr.  On COFF ARM32 each label address is built with a MOVW/MOVT
// immediate pair (IMAGE_REL_ARM_MOV32T) rather than a data relocation, so this
// exercises the in-code block-address materialisation + Thumb interworking path
// — distinct from badisp's data-relocation path (and from fnptrsel, whose
// MOVW/MOVT target is a real Thumb *function*, not a block label).  Like badisp
// it carries an indirectbr, so the flatten / indirect passes intentionally bail
// on it; it therefore joins the same five suites badisp does (Subst / ConstEnc
// / Opaque / Bogus / All), not flatten / indirect.
//   int basel(int a, int b) {
//     void *t = ((a&3)==0) ? &&L0 : ((a&3)==1) ? &&L1
//             : ((a&3)==2) ? &&L2 : &&L3;
//     goto *t;
//     L0: return (a + b) ^ (a & b);  L1: return (a - b) | (a ^ b);
//     L2: return (a & b) + (a | b);  L3: return (a ^ b) - (a & b);
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildBaselIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                           const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "basel", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  llvm::BasicBlock *L[4];
  static const char *LN[4] = {"L0", "L1", "L2", "L3"};
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    L[i] = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, LN[i], F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Idx = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(3));
  llvm::Constant *BA[4];
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    BA[i] = llvm::BlockAddress::get(F, L[i]);
  // Nested select: build from the tail so each block address is materialised.
  llvm::Value *Sel = BA[3];
  Sel = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(Idx, B.getInt32(2)), BA[2], Sel);
  Sel = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(Idx, B.getInt32(1)), BA[1], Sel);
  Sel = B.CreateSelect(B.CreateICmpEQ(Idx, B.getInt32(0)), BA[0], Sel);
  auto *IBR = B.CreateIndirectBr(Sel, 4);
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    IBR->addDestination(L[i]);

  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(L[0]);
    b.CreateRet(b.CreateXor(b.CreateAdd(A, Bb), b.CreateAnd(A, Bb)));
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(L[1]);
    b.CreateRet(b.CreateOr(b.CreateSub(A, Bb), b.CreateXor(A, Bb)));
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(L[2]);
    b.CreateRet(b.CreateAdd(b.CreateAnd(A, Bb), b.CreateOr(A, Bb)));
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(L[3]);
    b.CreateRet(b.CreateSub(b.CreateXor(A, Bb), b.CreateAnd(A, Bb)));
  }
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Far branch / branch relaxation.  Every other sample is a small function whose
// branches reach their targets with the shortest encoding; none exercises the
// MC layer's *branch relaxation* (e.g. Thumb `b.n` -> `b.w`, `cbz` ->
// `cmp;b.w`) nor B2's evaluation of the relaxed, wider PC-relative branch
// fixup.  farbr puts a long straight-line dependent chain (~800 integer ops,
// all five substitutable operators, distinct non-folding constants so the chain
// stays a function of the argument and survives -O<Less>) between a forward
// conditional branch and its target, forcing the span to exceed the
// short-branch range — most pronounced on COFF ARM32 (the only Thumb cell),
// where the assembler must widen the branch. Multi-block (entry / body / tail /
// merge), no switch/indirectbr, so it joins all seven suites; the obfuscation
// passes grow the body further, pushing more branches into the wide-encoding
// regime.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFarBrIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                           const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "farbr", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Tail = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "tail", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Cond = B.CreateICmpNE(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1)),
                              B.getInt32(0));
  // Forward branch that jumps over the huge body to the short tail.
  B.CreateCondBr(Cond, Tail, Body);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> BB(Body);
  llvm::Value *Acc = A;
  for (int i = 0; i < 800; ++i) {
    uint32_t K = 0x9E3779B9u * (uint32_t)(i + 1) + 0x7F4A7C15u;
    switch (i % 5) {
    case 0:
      Acc = BB.CreateAdd(Acc, BB.getInt32(K));
      break;
    case 1:
      Acc = BB.CreateSub(Acc, BB.getInt32(K));
      break;
    case 2:
      Acc = BB.CreateXor(Acc, BB.getInt32(K));
      break;
    case 3:
      Acc = BB.CreateOr(Acc, BB.getInt32(K | 0x101u));
      break;
    default:
      Acc = BB.CreateAnd(Acc, BB.getInt32(K | 0xFFFFu));
      break;
    }
  }
  BB.CreateBr(Merge);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> TB(Tail);
  auto *Acc2 = TB.CreateXor(A, Bb);
  TB.CreateBr(Merge);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> MB(Merge);
  auto *R = MB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(Acc, Body);
  R->addIncoming(Acc2, Tail);
  MB.CreateRet(MB.CreateXor(R, Bb));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Backward far branch / loop back-edge relaxation — the dual of farbr (which is
// a *forward* branch over a huge body).  farloop wraps a ~800-op dependent
// chain as a loop body, so the loop's back-edge (latch -> header) spans the
// whole huge body and the header's exit test (a forward branch skipping the
// body) does too. On the only Thumb cell (COFF ARM32) both exceed the `b.n`
// (+/-2 KB) range, so the assembler must widen the *backward* branch to `b.w`
// with a negative displacement — a distinct B2 fixup path (negative-offset wide
// PC-relative branch) that farbr's forward branch never exercises.  Small trip
// count keeps emulation cheap while still taking the back-edge several times.
// Multi-block, no switch/indirectbr -> joins all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFarLoopIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "farloop", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Header = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "header", F);
  auto *Body = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "body", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *N = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(Bb, B.getInt32(3)), B.getInt32(1)); // 1..4
  B.CreateBr(Header);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> HB(Header);
  auto *I = HB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *Acc = HB.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "acc");
  I->addIncoming(HB.getInt32(0), Entry);
  Acc->addIncoming(A, Entry);
  auto *Cond = HB.CreateICmpSLT(I, N);
  HB.CreateCondBr(Cond, Body, Exit); // forward branch skips the huge body

  llvm::IRBuilder<> BB(Body);
  llvm::Value *acc = Acc;
  for (int k = 0; k < 800; ++k) {
    uint32_t K = 0x9E3779B9u * (uint32_t)(k + 1) + 0x7F4A7C15u;
    switch (k % 5) {
    case 0:
      acc = BB.CreateAdd(acc, BB.getInt32(K));
      break;
    case 1:
      acc = BB.CreateSub(acc, BB.getInt32(K));
      break;
    case 2:
      acc = BB.CreateXor(acc, BB.getInt32(K));
      break;
    case 3:
      acc = BB.CreateOr(acc, BB.getInt32(K | 0x101u));
      break;
    default:
      acc = BB.CreateAnd(acc, BB.getInt32(K | 0xFFFFu));
      break;
    }
  }
  auto *INext = BB.CreateAdd(I, BB.getInt32(1));
  BB.CreateBr(Header); // backward edge spans the huge body
  I->addIncoming(INext, Body);
  Acc->addIncoming(acc, Body);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> EB(Exit);
  EB.CreateRet(EB.CreateXor(Acc, EB.CreateAdd(A, Bb)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// --- Input batteries -------------------------------------------------------
const std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> kPairs = {
    {0, 0},
    {1, 0},
    {0, 1},
    {1, 1},
    {17, 25},
    {0xFFFFFFFFu, 1},
    {0x80000000u, 0x7FFFFFFFu},
    {123456u, 654321u},
    {0xDEADBEEFu, 0xCAFEBABEu},
    {0x7FFFFFFFu, 0x7FFFFFFFu},
};
const std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> kCounts = {
    {0}, {1}, {2}, {5}, {8}, {16}, {37}, {64},
};
const std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> kNoArg = {{}};
// Signed single-argument inputs (negatives / zero / positives) for samples with
// sign-dependent control flow such as the multiple-return sample.
const std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> kSigned = {
    {0u},      {1u},        {2u},     {7u},          {0u - 1u},
    {0u - 5u}, {0u - 123u}, {12345u}, {0x80000000u}, {0x7FFFFFFFu},
};
// Small bounded (n, m) bounds for the nested-loop sample: large/huge values
// (as in kPairs) would blow up the iteration count and the emulation budget, so
// keep the product tiny while still covering zero-trip / one-trip / asymmetric
// nests.  Max inner work here is 7*9 = 63 iterations.
const std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> kLoopPairs = {
    {0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}, {2, 3},
    {3, 2}, {4, 4}, {6, 5}, {8, 7}, {7, 9},
};
// Bounded recursion depths for the self-recursive sample: kept small (<=12) so
// even the fully-obfuscated copy's nested frames stay well inside the
// emulator's 64 KiB stack and 5s budget, while still covering base / shallow /
// medium.
const std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> kRecDepths = {
    {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {6}, {9}, {12},
};

// int unaln(int a, int b) — UNALIGNED (align 1) i16/i32/i64 load/store over a
// global byte buffer.  Every prior memory/struct sample
// (daccum/srec/sstk/starr/ bigframe/grid2d/bzrmw) uses NATURALLY ALIGNED
// access; this is the first to force the per-ISA *unaligned* load/store
// lowering — x86 native unaligned mov, AArch64 unaligned ldr/str, ARM a single
// ldr (the hardware handles the misalignment when SCTLR.A=0) or a byte/halfword
// sequence — and equally the fork-Unicorn engine's unaligned-access model.  No
// libcalls (plain typed loads/stores at align 1).  Multi-block (data-dependent
// diamond + PHI) so all six obfuscation passes fire; mutates the data segment
// (compared byte-for-byte).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildUnalignedIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  const unsigned N = 24;
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I8, N);
  // Initialised byte pattern -> lands in .data (bytes present in the object so
  // the unaligned loads read meaningful values).
  llvm::SmallVector<uint8_t, 24> Init;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    Init.push_back((uint8_t)(0x11u * (i + 1) + i * i));
  auto *G = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantDataArray::get(Ctx, Init), "g_unaln");
  G->setDSOLocal(true);
  G->setAlignment(llvm::Align(1)); // byte array: keep odd offsets genuinely

  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "unaln", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto gep = [&](unsigned Off) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateInBoundsGEP(I8, G, B.getInt32(Off));
  };
  auto uload = [&](llvm::Type *Ty, unsigned Off) -> llvm::LoadInst * {
    auto *L = B.CreateLoad(Ty, gep(Off));
    L->setAlignment(llvm::Align(1));
    return L;
  };
  // Unaligned loads at byte offsets 1, 7 (i32), 3 (i64), 13 (i16).
  auto *W1 = uload(I32, 1);
  auto *W2 = uload(I32, 7);
  auto *Q = uload(I64, 3);
  auto *H = uload(I16, 13);
  auto *Qx = B.CreateXor(Q, B.CreateLShr(Q, B.getInt64(32)));
  auto *Qlo = B.CreateTrunc(Qx, I32);
  auto *Hz = B.CreateZExt(H, I32);
  auto *Base0 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(W1, W2), B.CreateXor(Qlo, Hz));
  // Replaceable arithmetic + non-folded constants (subst / const-enc fire).
  auto *Base = B.CreateOr(
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(Base0, A), B.CreateAnd(Bb, B.getInt32(0x5A5A))),
      B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(Base0, Bb), B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(12345))));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, Bb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  R->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  // Unaligned stores back into the same buffer (data segment mutated +
  // compared).
  auto storeU = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned Off) {
    auto *S = B.CreateStore(V, gep(Off));
    S->setAlignment(llvm::Align(1));
  };
  storeU(B.CreateXor(R, A), 1);                                  // i32 @ +1
  storeU(B.CreateXor(B.CreateZExt(R, I64), Q), 3);               // i64 @ +3
  storeU(B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateAdd(R, B.getInt32(1)), I16), 13); // i16 @ +13
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vunaln(int a, int b) — UNALIGNED (align 1) *vector* load/store over a
// global byte buffer.  unaln (above) covers unaligned *scalar* i16/i32/i64;
// this is the first sample to force the per-ISA unaligned *SIMD* load/store
// lowering, a classic miscompile source: x86 must use movups/movdqu (NOT the
// alignment-faulting movaps/movdqa), AArch64 an unaligned `ldr q`, ARM NEON
// vld1/vst1 with no alignment hint — and it equally exercises the fork-Unicorn
// engine's unaligned vector-access model.  Loads a <4 x i32>, an <8 x i16> and
// a <2 x i64> at odd byte offsets (1/21/41), runs vector MBA arithmetic (the
// substitution pass rewrites integer-vector add/sub/and/or/xor too) plus scalar
// arithmetic on the args, takes a data-dependent diamond (vector PHI), then
// stores three unaligned vectors back (data segment mutated + compared
// byte-for-byte).  All three vectors are 128-bit so the cross-shape bitcasts
// are free.  No libcalls.  Multi-block, no switch/indirectbr -> joins all seven
// suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecUnalignedIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4I32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V8I16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V2I64 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  const unsigned N = 64;
  auto *ArrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(I8, N);
  // Initialised byte pattern -> lands in .data (meaningful unaligned loads).
  llvm::SmallVector<uint8_t, 64> Init;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
    Init.push_back((uint8_t)(0x13u * (i + 1) + i * i + 7u));
  auto *G = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
      *M, ArrTy, /*isConstant=*/false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
      llvm::ConstantDataArray::get(Ctx, Init), "g_vunaln");
  G->setDSOLocal(true);
  G->setAlignment(llvm::Align(1));

  auto *FnTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FnTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vunaln", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto gep = [&](unsigned Off) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateInBoundsGEP(I8, G, B.getInt32(Off));
  };
  auto uload = [&](llvm::Type *Ty, unsigned Off) -> llvm::LoadInst * {
    auto *L = B.CreateLoad(Ty, gep(Off));
    L->setAlignment(llvm::Align(1));
    return L;
  };
  // Unaligned vector loads at odd byte offsets (non-overlapping in [0,64)).
  auto *V4 = uload(V4I32, 1);  // <4 x i32> @ +1  (bytes 1..17)
  auto *V8 = uload(V8I16, 21); // <8 x i16> @ +21 (bytes 21..37)
  auto *V2 = uload(V2I64, 41); // <2 x i64> @ +41 (bytes 41..57)
  auto *Va = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, A);
  auto *Vb = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, Bb);
  // Vector MBA arithmetic (subst rewrites integer-vector add/sub/and/or/xor).
  auto *T0 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(V4, Va), B.CreateAnd(V4, Vb)),
                        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(V4, Vb), B.CreateXor(V4, Va)));
  // Fold the other two vectors in (all 128-bit, so the bitcasts are free).
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(T0, B.CreateBitCast(V8, V4I32)),
                        B.CreateBitCast(V2, V4I32));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *TT = B.CreateAdd(T, Va);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *TE = B.CreateXor(T, Vb);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *RV = B.CreatePHI(V4I32, 2, "rv");
  RV->addIncoming(TT, Then);
  RV->addIncoming(TE, Else);
  // Unaligned vector stores back into the same buffer (data segment compared).
  auto storeU = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned Off) {
    auto *S = B.CreateStore(V, gep(Off));
    S->setAlignment(llvm::Align(1));
  };
  storeU(B.CreateXor(RV, Va), 1);                          // <4 x i32> @ +1
  storeU(B.CreateBitCast(B.CreateAdd(RV, Vb), V8I16), 21); // <8 x i16> @ +21
  storeU(B.CreateBitCast(RV, V2I64), 41);                  // <2 x i64> @ +41
  // Reduce to scalar (xor the four lanes) + scalar int mix so subst / const-enc
  // also have scalar material and the result depends on both args.
  llvm::Value *R = B.CreateExtractElement(RV, uint64_t(0));
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
    R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateExtractElement(RV, uint64_t(i)));
  R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateAdd(A, Bb));
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int tcall(int a, int b) — TAIL CALL to another internal function.  Every
// existing call shape (ccaller / recur / mrec / chained) uses an ordinary
// bl/call; none exercises tail-call lowering, where the backend tears the
// caller frame down and transfers with a *jump* (AArch64 `b`, x86 `jmp`, ARM
// `b`) to the callee rather than a call.  That is both a distinct encoding and
// a distinct rewrite-backend relocation: a tail *branch* to another function,
// not a call fixup, with the callee returning straight to tcall's caller. tcall
// runs a data-dependent diamond (so all six passes fire and the merge keeps a
// real CFG), then tail-calls tcallee from the merge block (tail position) — the
// backend TCOs it in the CFG-preserving suites.  Both functions carry
// substitutable arithmetic + non-folding constants.  Multi-block, no
// switch/indirectbr -> joins all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildTailCallIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                              const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  // Callee: plain arithmetic on its two args.
  auto *Callee = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                        "tcallee", M.get());
  {
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Callee);
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(BB);
    auto *X = Callee->getArg(0), *Y = Callee->getArg(1);
    auto *R = b.CreateOr(
        b.CreateXor(b.CreateAdd(X, b.getInt32(0x51ED)), b.CreateAnd(X, Y)),
        b.CreateXor(b.CreateSub(Y, b.getInt32(0x2C9F)), b.CreateOr(X, Y)));
    b.CreateRet(R);
  }
  // Caller: data-dependent diamond, then a tail call from the merge block.
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "tcall", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *U1 = B.CreateAdd(A, Bb);
  auto *V1 = B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(0x1357));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *U2 = B.CreateSub(A, Bb);
  auto *V2 = B.CreateOr(Bb, B.getInt32(0x2468));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *U = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "u");
  U->addIncoming(U1, Then);
  U->addIncoming(U2, Else);
  auto *V = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "v");
  V->addIncoming(V1, Then);
  V->addIncoming(V2, Else);
  auto *Call = B.CreateCall(FTy, Callee, {U, V});
  Call->setTailCallKind(llvm::CallInst::TCK_Tail);
  B.CreateRet(Call);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// int vodd(int a, int b) — NON-power-of-two vector <3 x i32>.  Every existing
// vector shape uses a power-of-two lane count (2/4/8/16); none exercises the
// vector *legalization* of an odd-width vector, which the backend must widen to
// <4 x i32> (with a dead lane) or scalarize — a distinct lowering path with its
// own dead-lane / partial-op handling.  vodd builds two <3 x i32> from the
// args, takes a data-dependent diamond (vector PHI of <3 x i32>) whose arms are
// vector MBA expressions (so --subst rewrites the <3 x i32> add/sub/and/or/xor)
// and a splat constant (so --const-enc has material), then reduces the three
// lanes to a scalar and mixes in scalar arithmetic.  No data section (avoids
// odd-width store-width subtleties); no libcalls.  Multi-block, no
// switch/indirectbr -> joins all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecOddIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                            const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V3 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 3);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "vodd",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto mk3 = [&](llvm::Value *X, llvm::Value *Y,
                 llvm::Value *Z) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V3);
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, X, uint64_t(0));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Y, uint64_t(1));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Z, uint64_t(2));
    return V;
  };
  auto *Va = mk3(A, Bb, B.CreateXor(A, Bb));
  auto *Vb = mk3(B.CreateXor(Bb, A), B.CreateAdd(A, Bb), A);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *T1 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(Va, Vb), B.CreateAnd(Va, Vb)),
                        B.CreateAnd(B.CreateSub(Va, Vb), B.CreateXor(Va, Vb)));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *K = B.CreateVectorSplat(3, B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *T2 = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateSub(B.CreateOr(Va, Vb), B.CreateXor(Va, Vb)),
                         B.CreateAnd(Va, K));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *T = B.CreatePHI(V3, 2, "t");
  T->addIncoming(T1, Then);
  T->addIncoming(T2, Else);
  llvm::Value *R = B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(0));
  R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(1)));
  R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(2)));
  R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateAdd(A, Bb));
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <4 x i32> vector integer division / remainder by *constant* vectors — the
// vector magic-number legalization path no existing shape covers: cdivr is
// *scalar* const div/rem, and every vector shape (vred/vmul/vminmax/...) does
// add/sub/mul/min/max/shift but never sdiv/udiv/srem/urem.  Per-lane
// divide-by-constant lowers to vector (or, on i386/ARM32, scalarized)
// magic-number multiply + shift + bias — distinct from cdivr's scalar magic
// number and from every other vector op.  Constant divisors are mandatory: a
// *variable* divide would emit __aeabi_idiv / __divsi3 (ARM32) or scalarized
// idiv that the freestanding harness cannot link/run — exactly why
// buildConstDivRemIR uses constants and buildConvCastIR avoids i64 conversions.
// Divisors mix non-power-of-two, power-of-two (shift/bias) and a negative lane;
// -1 is avoided (INT_MIN/-1 is UB); the unsigned arm masks the dividend
// non-negative so every udiv/urem is well-defined for any arg sign.  Two
// <4 x i32> from the args feed a data-dependent diamond (vector PHI) whose arms
// divide/remainder by distinct constant vectors and combine with the five
// substitutable operators (so --subst rewrites the vector add/sub/and/or/xor),
// then the four lanes reduce to a scalar mixed with scalar arithmetic; the
// scalar `&1` / `!=0` selector and final mix give --const-enc material and the
// control-flow passes structure.  Multi-block, no switch/indirectbr -> joins
// all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecDivRemIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vdivr", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *Bb = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto cst4 = [&](int x, int y, int z, int w) -> llvm::Value * {
    uint32_t E[4] = {static_cast<uint32_t>(x), static_cast<uint32_t>(y),
                     static_cast<uint32_t>(z), static_cast<uint32_t>(w)};
    return llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint32_t>(E, 4));
  };
  auto mk4 = [&](llvm::Value *X, llvm::Value *Y, llvm::Value *Z,
                 llvm::Value *W) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V4);
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, X, uint64_t(0));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Y, uint64_t(1));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Z, uint64_t(2));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, W, uint64_t(3));
    return V;
  };
  // Runtime dividend lanes from the args (substitutable ops -> --subst fires).
  auto *Va = mk4(A, B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.CreateAdd(A, Bb), B.CreateSub(A, Bb));
  // Non-negative dividend for the unsigned arm (well-defined for any sign).
  auto *Vu =
      B.CreateAnd(Va, cst4(0x7fffffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x7fffffff));
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, Bb), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  // Then: signed divide + remainder by constant vectors (non-pow2 / pow2 /
  // negative lanes; -1 avoided).
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *Q = B.CreateSDiv(Va, cst4(7, 8, -3, 9));
  auto *Rr = B.CreateSRem(Va, cst4(5, 16, 11, 13));
  auto *T1 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(Q, Rr), B.CreateAnd(Q, Rr));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  // Else: unsigned divide + remainder by constant vectors.
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *U = B.CreateUDiv(Vu, cst4(10, 255, 6, 32));
  auto *Ur = B.CreateURem(Vu, cst4(100, 7, 17, 64));
  auto *T2 = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(U, Ur), B.CreateXor(U, Ur));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *T = B.CreatePHI(V4, 2, "t");
  T->addIncoming(T1, Then);
  T->addIncoming(T2, Else);
  llvm::Value *R = B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(0));
  R = B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(1)));
  R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(2)));
  R = B.CreateSub(R, B.CreateExtractElement(T, uint64_t(3)));
  R = B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateAdd(A, Bb));
  B.CreateRet(R);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector *unsigned* float<->int conversion + vector fpext/fptrunc — the vector
// dual of the scalar `ccast`.  fvec/dvec2 only use the *signed* vector
// sitofp/fptosi; ccast covers the *unsigned* fptoui/uitofp and the
// double<->float fptrunc/fpext but only for *scalars*.  The <4 x i32> unsigned
// conversions are a distinct lowering: x86 SSE2 has no unsigned packed convert
// (the +2^31 bit-trick / compare-and-fixup sequence), while AArch64/ARM use the
// hardware ucvtf / fcvtzu vector ops; vector fpext/fptrunc are cvtps2pd /
// cvtpd2ps (x86), fcvtl / fcvtn (AArch64), vcvt (ARM).  Each lane is masked to
// a multiple of 4096 (low 12 bits clear, top bit free) so it is an *exact*
// float that can exceed 2^31 — exercising the unsigned path on x86 — and every
// FP product stays inside [0, 2^32) so fptoui never leaves its domain; the
// 0.5/0.75/0.9 multipliers make the round-trip non-foldable (the conversions
// survive to machine code).  Zero libcall (all i32 / f32 / f64; no i64
// conversion).  No pass touches a conversion, so both copies share
// byte-identical lowering and any divergence is a real backend/fork-Unicorn
// bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecConvCastIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *Flt = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *Dbl = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4i = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V4f = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Flt, 4);
  auto *V4d = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(Dbl, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vconv", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto mk4 = [&](llvm::Value *X, llvm::Value *Y, llvm::Value *Z,
                 llvm::Value *W) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *V = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V4i);
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, X, uint64_t(0));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Y, uint64_t(1));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, Z, uint64_t(2));
    V = B.CreateInsertElement(V, W, uint64_t(3));
    return V;
  };
  float Ff[4] = {0.5f, 0.25f, 0.75f, 0.125f};
  double Fd[4] = {0.3, 0.6, 0.1, 0.9};
  auto *KF = llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<float>(Ff, 4));
  auto *KD = llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<double>(Fd, 4));
  // Lanes are multiples of 4096 with the top bit free: exact as f32, possibly
  // >= 2^31 (forces the unsigned-convert path), and uitofp stays < 2^32.
  auto *Mask = B.CreateVectorSplat(4, B.getInt32(0xFFFFF000u));
  auto *Base = B.CreateAnd(
      mk4(A, B.CreateXor(A, C), B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)), Mask);
  auto *Vf = B.CreateUIToFP(Base, V4f);                 // unsigned int -> float
  auto *Vu = B.CreateFPToUI(B.CreateFMul(Vf, KF), V4i); // float -> unsigned int
  auto *Vd = B.CreateFPExt(Vf, V4d);                    // float -> double
  auto *Vf3 = B.CreateFPTrunc(B.CreateFMul(Vd, KD), V4f); // double -> float
  auto *Vu2 = B.CreateFPToUI(Vf3, V4i); // float -> unsigned int
  auto *Acc = B.CreateXor(Vu, Vu2);
  auto *Red = B.CreateAddReduce(Acc);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *BaseV = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(BaseV, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(BaseV, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Branchless nested-`select` cascade.  Every existing conditional shape is
// branch-based — bsel is a condbr+PHI diamond, mwbr a long icmp/condbr if-else
// cascade, the loop shapes use condbr back-edges — so none exercises a deep
// chain of `select` instructions, which the backend lowers with NO branches at
// all: AArch64 `csel`, x86 `cmov`, ARM predicated/`movcc`, i386 `cmov` (or
// setcc+and on SSE-only).  selcasc chains ten nested selects, each guarded by
// an `icmp eq` on x=(a^b)&15, so the function stays a single straight-line
// block of conditional moves; every arm is a distinct expression mixing the
// five substitutable operators with non-folding constants so --subst /
// --const-enc have material and the result stays a function of both args.
// Because it is a single branchless block there is no CFG to flatten and no
// conditional branch to make indirect, so (like the switch shapes, for a
// different reason) it joins the five non-CFG-rewriting suites only:
// Subst / ConstEnc / Opaque / Bogus / All.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildSelCascadeIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "selcasc", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *X = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(15)); // x in [0,15]
  llvm::Value *R = B.CreateAdd(A, C); // x==0 / x>10 default
  // Ten candidate arms; keys 1..10 map onto x's [1,10] sub-range so varied
  // inputs reach different arms while the cascade remains branchless.
  llvm::Value *Cands[10] = {
      B.CreateSub(A, C),
      B.CreateAnd(A, C),
      B.CreateOr(A, C),
      B.CreateXor(A, B.getInt32(0x5a5a5a5a)),
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(0x1234)),
      B.CreateSub(B.CreateOr(A, C), B.getInt32(99)),
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.getInt32(0x0f0f0f0f)),
      B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(A, C), C),
      B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.getInt32(0x7fff)),
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(C, A), A),
  };
  for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
    auto *Cond = B.CreateICmpEQ(X, B.getInt32(i + 1));
    R = B.CreateSelect(Cond, Cands[i], R);
  }
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateXor(A, C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Sparse / non-contiguous switch.  swdisp ([0,7]) and swbig ([0,63]) are dense,
// so the backend always emits a jump table.  swsparse switches on
// sel = ((a^b)&7)*7919 + 3, whose eight possible values {3, 7922, 15841, ...,
// 55436} are widely spaced (spacing = 7919, a prime), so the cases are
// non-contiguous over a ~55 K range — far too sparse for a jump table, forcing
// the SelectionDAG switch lowering down its comparison-tree / range-bisection
// path (a distinct lowering no dense-switch shape reaches).  The affine
// selector guarantees every input lands on exactly one case (all eight cases
// reachable for varied inputs) while the SwitchInst still carries explicit
// sparse case values straight to ISel.  Each case mixes the five substitutable
// operators with distinct non-folding constants.  Contains a SwitchInst, so
// flatten / indirect bail; swsparse joins the same five suites as swdisp/swbig.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildSwitchSparseIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "swsparse", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  static const int Keys[8] = {3,     7922,  15841, 23760,
                              31679, 39598, 47517, 55436};
  llvm::BasicBlock *Cs[8];
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Cs[i] = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "c" + std::to_string(i), F);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // sel = ((a^b)&7)*7919 + 3  → always one of the eight sparse Keys.
  auto *Sel =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateMul(B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(7)),
                              B.getInt32(7919)),
                  B.getInt32(3));
  auto *SW = B.CreateSwitch(Sel, Cs[7], 7); // last key handled by the default
  for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i)
    SW->addCase(B.getInt32(Keys[i]), Cs[i]);

  llvm::Value *V[8];
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[0]);
    V[0] = b.CreateAdd(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[1]);
    V[1] = b.CreateSub(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[2]);
    V[2] = b.CreateXor(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[3]);
    V[3] = b.CreateOr(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[4]);
    V[4] = b.CreateAnd(A, C);
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[5]);
    V[5] = b.CreateXor(b.CreateAdd(A, C), b.getInt32(0x1234));
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[6]);
    V[6] = b.CreateOr(b.CreateSub(A, C), b.getInt32(99));
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }
  {
    llvm::IRBuilder<> b(Cs[7]);
    V[7] = b.CreateXor(C, b.getInt32(0x5a5a5a5a));
    b.CreateBr(Merge);
  }

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 8, "r");
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    R->addIncoming(V[i], Cs[i]);
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateXor(A, C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// High-density data-symbol relocation.  Every existing data-global shape
// touches only 1-3 globals (mostly arrays = a single symbol); manyglob
// references SIXTEEN distinct scalar globals — eight in .data (distinct
// initializers) and eight in .bss (zero-init) — reading all of them and writing
// the eight .bss results back.  Each distinct global is its own __nd_data_*
// symbol + relocation in the rewrite path, so this is by far the densest
// data-relocation sample in the suite, and the obfuscation passes (const-enc
// volatile slots, opaque/bogus extra blocks) pile on still more fixups.  It
// directly stresses the B2 AddressModelBackend resolving and applying many data
// relocations within one function (the core of the patch thesis).  A
// data-dependent diamond keeps it multi-block, so it joins all seven suites.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildManyGlobalsIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  const int Seed[8] = {3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23};
  llvm::GlobalVariable *GD[8], *GB[8];
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    GD[i] = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
        *M, I32, false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, Seed[i] * 100 + 1),
        "gd" + std::to_string(i));
    GD[i]->setDSOLocal(true);
    GB[i] = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
        *M, I32, false, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
        llvm::ConstantInt::get(I32, 0), "gb" + std::to_string(i));
    GB[i]->setDSOLocal(true);
  }
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
