                                   "manyglob", M.get());
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // Read all eight .data globals, fold with substitutable operators + args.
  llvm::Value *Acc = B.CreateAdd(A, C);
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    auto *V = B.CreateLoad(I32, GD[i]);
    switch (i % 5) {
    case 0:
      Acc = B.CreateAdd(Acc, B.CreateXor(V, A));
      break;
    case 1:
      Acc = B.CreateSub(Acc, B.CreateAnd(V, C));
      break;
    case 2:
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateOr(V, A));
      break;
    case 3:
      Acc = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(Acc, V), B.getInt32(0x7fffffff));
      break;
    default:
      Acc = B.CreateOr(Acc, B.CreateSub(V, C));
      break;
    }
  }
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSGT(Acc, C), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  llvm::Value *T = Acc;
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    T = B.CreateAdd(T, B.CreateXor(B.getInt32(Seed[i]), A));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  llvm::Value *E = Acc;
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    E = B.CreateXor(E, B.CreateAnd(B.getInt32(Seed[i] * 7), C));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *R = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "r");
  R->addIncoming(T, Then);
  R->addIncoming(E, Else);
  // Write results back into the eight .bss globals (data segment mutated +
  // compared byte-for-byte by the harness).
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    auto *W =
        B.CreateXor(R, B.CreateAdd(B.CreateLoad(I32, GD[i]), B.getInt32(i)));
    B.CreateStore(W, GB[i]);
  }
  B.CreateRet(B.CreateAdd(R, B.CreateXor(A, C)));
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Triple-nested loop.  nloop is only two levels; nloop3 adds a third (inner)
// loop with a variable trip count and accumulators carried across all three
// levels, so it is the hardest CFG in the suite for control-flow flattening's
// reg2mem (every level's live PHI must be demoted to a stack slot and reloaded
// through the dispatcher) and for the bogus/opaque block splits + indirect
// branch rewrite to weave through three back-edges.  Trip counts are bounded
// (outer/middle from kLoopPairs <=9, inner = (m&3)+1 <=4) so even the
// fully-obfuscated copy stays well inside the emulator's budget.  Mirrors
// nloop's six-suite registration (ConstEnc excluded, as for nloop).
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildNestedLoop3IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "nloop3", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *OHead = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "ohead", F);
  auto *OBody = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "obody", F);
  auto *MHead = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "mhead", F);
  auto *MBody = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "mbody", F);
  auto *IHead = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "ihead", F);
  auto *IBody = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "ibody", F);
  auto *MLatch = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "mlatch", F);
  auto *OLatch = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "olatch", F);
  auto *Exit = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "exit", F);
  auto *N = F->getArg(0), *Mm = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *KBound = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAnd(Mm, B.getInt32(3)), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(OHead);

  B.SetInsertPoint(OHead);
  auto *IPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "i");
  auto *SOuter = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "souter");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(IPhi, N), OBody, Exit);

  B.SetInsertPoint(OBody);
  B.CreateBr(MHead);

  B.SetInsertPoint(MHead);
  auto *JPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "j");
  auto *SMid = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "smid");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(JPhi, Mm), MBody, OLatch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(MBody);
  B.CreateBr(IHead);

  B.SetInsertPoint(IHead);
  auto *KPhi = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "k");
  auto *SInner = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "sinner");
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpSLT(KPhi, KBound), IBody, MLatch);

  B.SetInsertPoint(IBody);
  auto *Mix = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(IPhi, KPhi), JPhi);
  auto *SInnerNext =
      B.CreateAnd(B.CreateAdd(SInner, Mix), B.getInt32(0x3fffffff));
  auto *KNext = B.CreateAdd(KPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(IHead);

  // SInner (innermost PHI) live at MLatch (IHead is MLatch's sole pred).
  B.SetInsertPoint(MLatch);
  auto *SMidNext = B.CreateOr(B.CreateSub(SInner, JPhi), B.getInt32(1));
  auto *JNext = B.CreateAdd(JPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(MHead);

  // SMid (middle PHI) live at OLatch (MHead is OLatch's sole pred).
  B.SetInsertPoint(OLatch);
  auto *SOuterNext = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateXor(SMid, IPhi), B.getInt32(1));
  auto *INext = B.CreateAdd(IPhi, B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateBr(OHead);

  IPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  IPhi->addIncoming(INext, OLatch);
  SOuter->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), Entry);
  SOuter->addIncoming(SOuterNext, OLatch);
  JPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), OBody);
  JPhi->addIncoming(JNext, MLatch);
  SMid->addIncoming(SOuter, OBody);
  SMid->addIncoming(SMidNext, MLatch);
  KPhi->addIncoming(B.getInt32(0), MBody);
  KPhi->addIncoming(KNext, IBody);
  SInner->addIncoming(SMid, MBody);
  SInner->addIncoming(SInnerNext, IBody);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Exit);
  B.CreateRet(SOuter);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// llvm.is.fpclass — the lowering behind __builtin_isnan / isinf / isfinite /
// isnormal / issubnormal / iszero.  Args are bit-cast from the integer inputs
// so the class is genuinely runtime-unknown (defeats constant folding); every
// class outcome (nan/inf/normal/subnormal/zero) is reachable across the input
// battery. is.fpclass returns a well-defined i1 for ALL inputs (incl. nan/inf)
// and is NEVER converted back to FP, so there is no poison/UB regardless of
// bits. Lowered by TargetLowering::expandIS_FPCLASS to integer bit extraction
// (exponent/mantissa masks) mixed with `fcmp uno` / inf-compare against a
// const-pool constant — distinct from every existing FP shape, zero libcall. On
// 32-bit ISAs the f64 path extracts the i64 bit pattern (register pair) and
// exercises wide bit-test lowering (the same class of legalization that once
// surfaced the expandFMINIMUM f64 32-bit ISel gap).  No obfuscation pass
// touches is.fpclass (it is a CallInst, not add/sub/and/or/xor or a ConstantInt
// operand) so orig/obfuscated lower the class tests byte-identically; any
// Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildFpClassIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "fpclass", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  // Bit-cast args -> arbitrary float/double (class genuinely runtime).
  auto *Fa = B.CreateBitCast(A, F32);
  auto *Da =
      B.CreateBitCast(B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(A, I64),
                                             llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)),
                                 B.CreateZExt(C, I64)),
                      F64);
  // FPClassTest masks (llvm/ADT/FloatingPointMode.h): fcNan=0x3, fcInf=0x204,
  // fcNormal=0x108, fcSubnormal=0x90, fcZero=0x60, fcFinite=0x1f8.
  auto cls = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned Mask,
                 unsigned Shift) -> llvm::Value * {
    auto *T = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::is_fpclass, {V->getType()},
                                {V, B.getInt32(Mask)});
    return B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(T, I32), B.getInt32(Shift));
  };
  unsigned Masks[] = {0x3, 0x204, 0x108, 0x90, 0x60, 0x1f8};
  llvm::Value *Base = B.getInt32(0);
  unsigned Sh = 0;
  for (unsigned Mk : Masks)
    Base = B.CreateXor(Base, cls(Fa, Mk, Sh++));
  for (unsigned Mk : Masks)
    Base = B.CreateXor(Base, cls(Da, Mk, Sh++));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector llvm.is.fpclass (<4 x float> + <2 x double>) — the vector dual of the
// scalar `fpclass`.  Per-lane class test -> <N x i1>; lanes are bit-cast from
// arbitrary integers so every class is runtime-reachable, and the i1 results
// are never converted back to FP (no poison).  expandIS_FPCLASS lowers per lane
// to vector integer bit tests + vector fcmp — distinct from the scalar path,
// zero libcall; on 32-bit ISAs the <2 x double> path stresses i64-lane bit
// tests.  No obfuscation pass touches is.fpclass; any Unicorn mismatch is a
// real bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFpClassIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4I = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2L = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfpclass", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *Vi = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4I);
  Vi = B.CreateInsertElement(Vi, A, B.getInt32(0));
  Vi = B.CreateInsertElement(Vi, B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(0x10000)),
                             B.getInt32(1));
  Vi = B.CreateInsertElement(Vi, B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(2));
  Vi = B.CreateInsertElement(Vi, B.CreateMul(A, B.getInt32(7)), B.getInt32(3));
  auto *Vf = B.CreateBitCast(Vi, V4F);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateZExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateZExt(C, I64);
  llvm::Value *Vl = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2L);
  Vl = B.CreateInsertElement(
      Vl, B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(A64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)), C64),
      B.getInt32(0));
  Vl = B.CreateInsertElement(
      Vl, B.CreateOr(B.CreateShl(C64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)), A64),
      B.getInt32(1));
  auto *Vd = B.CreateBitCast(Vl, V2D);
  unsigned Masks[] = {0x3, 0x204, 0x108, 0x90, 0x60, 0x1f8};
  llvm::Value *Base = B.getInt32(0);
  unsigned Sh = 0;
  for (unsigned Mk : Masks) {
    auto *T = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::is_fpclass, {V4F},
                                {Vf, B.getInt32(Mk)});
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Base = B.CreateXor(
          Base, B.CreateShl(
                    B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(T, B.getInt32(i)), I32),
                    B.getInt32((Sh + i) & 31)));
    ++Sh;
  }
  for (unsigned Mk : Masks) {
    auto *T = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::is_fpclass, {V2D},
                                {Vd, B.getInt32(Mk)});
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
      Base = B.CreateXor(
          Base, B.CreateShl(
                    B.CreateZExt(B.CreateExtractElement(T, B.getInt32(i)), I32),
                    B.getInt32((Sh + i) & 31)));
    ++Sh;
  }
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 256-bit <8 x i32> integer min/max (smax/smin/umax/umin) — the 256-bit dual of
// `vminmax`(<4 x i32>) and the min/max sibling of `vw8`(<8 x i32> arith).  No
// target has native 256-bit int min/max (SSE2 baseline / NEON 128-bit) so it
// splits 2x128 + per-half min/max (x86 SSE2 even lacks pmaxsd/pminud ->
// pcmpgtd+blend).  Lanes mix signs so signed/unsigned paths differ.  Zero
// libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches min/max intrinsics; any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWide256MinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vw256mm", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    // Mixed signs: flip the high bit on odd lanes so signed != unsigned.
    auto *La = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 5 + 1)),
                           B.getInt32((i & 1) ? 0x80000000u : 0u));
    auto *Lb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(C, B.getInt32(i * 3 + 2)),
                           B.getInt32((i & 2) ? 0x80000000u : 0u));
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, La, B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Lb, B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smax, {V8}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Sn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::smin, {V8}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V8}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Un = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V8}, {VA, VB});
  auto red = [&](llvm::Value *V, bool UseXor) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
      auto *L = B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i));
      Acc = UseXor ? B.CreateXor(Acc, L) : B.CreateAdd(Acc, L);
    }
    return Acc;
  };
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(red(Sx, true), red(Sn, false));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateXor(red(Ux, true), red(Un, false)));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <2 x i64> integer horizontal reductions (vector.reduce.add/and/or/xor/smax/
// smin/umax/umin) — the i64-lane dual of `vrdc`(<4 x i32>) /
// `vreduce8`(i8/i16). 2-lane i64 reduce = a single cross-lane op; 32-bit ISAs
// scalarize each i64 lane into a register pair.  reduce.mul is deliberately
// omitted (i64 mul lowers to
// __aeabi_lmul/__muldi3 on 32-bit ISAs — the freestanding harness cannot link
// it).  Zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches reduce intrinsics; any
// Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork-Unicorn bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecReduceI64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V2 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vredi64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A64 = B.CreateSExt(A, I64), *C64 = B.CreateSExt(C, I64);
  auto *L0 =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateShl(A64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 20)), C64);
  auto *L1 =
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(C64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 16)), A64);
  auto *L2 = B.CreateSub(C64, B.CreateShl(A64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 8)));
  auto *L3 =
      B.CreateXor(A64, B.CreateShl(C64, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 24)));
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, L0, B.getInt32(0));
  VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, L1, B.getInt32(1));
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2);
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, L2, B.getInt32(0));
  VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, L3, B.getInt32(1));
  auto *S = B.CreateAdd(VA, VB);
  auto *X = B.CreateXor(VA, VB);
  auto *N = B.CreateAnd(VA, VB);
  auto *O = B.CreateOr(VA, VB);
  auto *Ra = B.CreateAddReduce(S);
  auto *Rx = B.CreateXorReduce(X);
  auto *Rn = B.CreateAndReduce(O);
  auto *Ro = B.CreateOrReduce(N);
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntMaxReduce(S, /*IsSigned=*/true);
  auto *Sn = B.CreateIntMinReduce(S, /*IsSigned=*/true);
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntMaxReduce(X, /*IsSigned=*/false);
  auto *Un = B.CreateIntMinReduce(O, /*IsSigned=*/false);
  auto fold = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateXor(
        B.CreateTrunc(V, I32),
        B.CreateTrunc(B.CreateLShr(V, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)), I32));
  };
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(fold(Ra), fold(Rx));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateXor(fold(Rn), fold(Ro)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateXor(fold(Sx), fold(Sn)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateXor(fold(Ux), fold(Un)));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Scalar 3-way comparison llvm.scmp / llvm.ucmp (LLVM 19+) — first coverage of
// the TargetLowering::expandCMP lowering path (the same expand* family that
// surfaced the expandFMINIMUM fork gap).  scmp/ucmp return {-1,0,1}; we
// exercise i32 operands (signed vs unsigned diverge on high-bit args), i64
// operands -> i32 result (32-bit ISAs: register-pair compare) and an i8 narrow
// result (sext back).  All integer, zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches
// scmp/ucmp; any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildThreeWayCmpIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I64 = llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "tcmp",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *S32 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {I32, I32}, {A, C});
  auto *U32 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {I32, I32}, {A, C});
  auto *A64 = B.CreateOr(
      B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(A, I64), llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)),
      B.CreateZExt(C, I64));
  auto *C64 = B.CreateOr(
      B.CreateShl(B.CreateZExt(C, I64), llvm::ConstantInt::get(I64, 32)),
      B.CreateZExt(A, I64));
  auto *S64 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {I32, I64}, {A64, C64});
  auto *U64 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {I32, I64}, {A64, C64});
  auto *S8 = B.CreateSExt(
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {I8, I32}, {A, C}), I32);
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(S32, B.getInt32(3)),
                  B.CreateShl(U32, B.getInt32(6))),
      B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(S64, B.getInt32(9)),
                  B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(U64, B.getInt32(12)), S8)));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector 3-way comparison <4 x i32> llvm.scmp / llvm.ucmp — the vector dual of
// scalar `tcmp`.  Per-lane {-1,0,1}; expandCMP either scalarizes or lowers to
// per-lane (a sgt b) - (a slt b) vector compares (x86 SSE2 has pcmpgtd; the
// unsigned form needs a sign-flip).  Lanes mix signs so signed/unsigned
// diverge. Zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches scmp/ucmp; any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecThreeWayCmpIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V4 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vtcmp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  llvm::Value *VA = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  llvm::Value *VB = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    auto *La = B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, B.getInt32(i * 7 + 1)),
                           B.getInt32((i & 1) ? 0x80000000u : 0u));
    auto *Lb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateSub(C, B.getInt32(i * 5 + 2)),
                           B.getInt32((i & 2) ? 0x80000000u : 0u));
    VA = B.CreateInsertElement(VA, La, B.getInt32(i));
    VB = B.CreateInsertElement(VB, Lb, B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {V4, V4}, {VA, VB});
  auto *Ux = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {V4, V4}, {VA, VB});
  llvm::Value *Base = B.getInt32(0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Base =
        B.CreateAdd(Base, B.CreateShl(B.CreateExtractElement(Sx, B.getInt32(i)),
                                      B.getInt32((i * 2) & 31)));
    Base =
        B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(B.CreateExtractElement(Ux, B.getInt32(i)),
                                      B.getInt32((i * 3) & 31)));
  }
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// i128-operand 3-way comparison llvm.scmp.i32.i128 / llvm.ucmp.i32.i128 — the
// wide multi-word dual of scalar `tcmp`.  Operands are assembled so the
// difference lands in the high word (signed/unsigned sign-bit divergence) and,
// separately, only in the low word (compare across word boundaries).  All 4
// ISAs expand to multi-word compare chains (i386/ARM32: 4 words); comparison
// needs no libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches scmp/ucmp; any Unicorn
// mismatch is a real rewrite-backend / fork bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildWideThreeWayCmpIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                     const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I128 = llvm::Type::getInt128Ty(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "wtcmp", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *A128 = B.CreateZExt(A, I128);
  auto *C128 = B.CreateZExt(C, I128);
  auto sh = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateShl(V, llvm::ConstantInt::get(I128, N));
  };
  // High-word difference: A/C drive bits 96-127 (the i128 sign bit).
  auto *Ai = B.CreateOr(sh(A128, 96), sh(C128, 32));
  auto *Ci = B.CreateOr(sh(C128, 96), sh(A128, 32));
  auto *S1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {I32, I128}, {Ai, Ci});
  auto *U1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {I32, I128}, {Ai, Ci});
  // Low-word-only difference: identical high 64 bits, differ in the low word.
  auto *Aj = B.CreateOr(sh(A128, 64), C128);
  auto *Cj = B.CreateOr(sh(A128, 64), A128);
  auto *S2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::scmp, {I32, I128}, {Aj, Cj});
  auto *U2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::ucmp, {I32, I128}, {Aj, Cj});
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(S1, B.getInt32(3)),
                                              B.CreateShl(U1, B.getInt32(6))),
                                  B.CreateAdd(B.CreateShl(S2, B.getInt32(9)),
                                              B.CreateShl(U2, B.getInt32(12))));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// IEEE 754-2019 minimumNumber / maximumNumber: llvm.minimumnum /
// llvm.maximumnum (f32 AND f64) — zero prior coverage.  Distinct from
// minNum/maxNum (`fminmax`'s minnum/maxnum) and from IEEE-2008 minimum/maximum
// (`fminmax`, which propagate NaN): the *num* variants combine
// number-preference with signed-zero ordering and lower through the SEPARATE
// TargetLowering::expandFMINIMUMNUM_FMAXIMUMNUM path.  That path's signed-zero
// correction also builds an IS_FPCLASS sign test (i64 for f64) — the exact
// 32-bit-ISA configuration where the sibling expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM had its
// fork gap; the num path's isTypeLegal guard was added but never exercised
// until this shape.  Operands are masked to [0,65535] and sitofp'd so every
// result is finite and in i32 range (fptosi well-defined), zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches min/max intrinsics; any Unicorn divergence is a real
// rewrite-backend / fork bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildMinMaxNumIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "mmnum", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Fa = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32), *Fb = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F32);
  auto *Da = B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F64), *Db = B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F64);
  auto *Mn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimumnum, {F32}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Mx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximumnum, {F32}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *MnD = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimumnum, {F64}, {Da, Db});
  auto *MxD = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximumnum, {F64}, {Da, Db});
  auto *Sf = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(Mn, Mx), I32);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(MnD, MxD), I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Vector IEEE 754-2019 minimumNumber / maximumNumber: <4 x float> + <2 x
// double> llvm.minimumnum / llvm.maximumnum — the vector dual of `mmnum`, zero
// prior coverage.  Lowers through the vector expandFMINIMUMNUM_FMAXIMUMNUM
// path; the <2 x double> lanes on 32-bit ISAs (i386/ARM32) exercise the
// i64-lane signed- zero class test the scalar f64 path also hits.  Operands
// masked to [0,65535], finite, fptosi well-defined; zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass touches min/max intrinsics; any Unicorn divergence is a real
// rewrite-backend / fork bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecMinMaxNumIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                  const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vmmnum", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  llvm::Value *Fa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F),
              *Fb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    Fa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fa, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F32), B.getInt32(i));
    Fb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fb, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(2 * i)), F32),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D),
              *Db = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    Da = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Da, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(i)), F64), B.getInt32(i));
    Db = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Db, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(2 * i)), F64),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Fmn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimumnum, {V4F}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Fmx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximumnum, {V4F}, {Fa, Fb});
  auto *Dmn = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::minimumnum, {V2D}, {Da, Db});
  auto *Dmx = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::maximumnum, {V2D}, {Da, Db});
  auto RedF = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *S = B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0)),
                                  B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1)));
    S = B.CreateFAdd(S, B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(2)),
                                     B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(3))));
    return B.CreateFPToSI(S, I32);
  };
  auto RedD = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    return B.CreateFPToSI(
        B.CreateFAdd(B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(0)),
                     B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(1))),
        I32);
  };
  auto *Sf = B.CreateAdd(RedF(Fmn), RedF(Fmx));
  auto *Sd = B.CreateAdd(RedD(Dmn), RedD(Dmx));
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// IEEE 754-2019 NaN-propagating FP min/max HORIZONTAL REDUCTIONS:
// llvm.vector.reduce.fmaximum / llvm.vector.reduce.fminimum on <4 x float> +
// <2 x double> — zero prior coverage, the reduction DUAL of the scalar `mmnum`
// shape.  Distinct from the already-covered CreateFPMaxReduce/CreateFPMinReduce
// (which emit the fmaxnum/fminnum-based llvm.vector.reduce.fmax/fmin): the
// .fmaximum/.fminimum reductions carry IEEE-2019 minimum/maximum (NaN- and
// signed-zero-propagating) semantics and have no native horizontal form on any
// target, so they expand to a shuffle-reduction TREE of scalar/vector
// llvm.maximum/minimum, each lowering through TargetLowering::
// expandFMINIMUM_FMAXIMUM — the EXACT path that had the 32-bit-f64 fork gap
// (fminmax-f64-arm32-note, since fixed).  The <2 x double> lanes on i386/ARM32
// are therefore a regression probe for that fork fix in a reduction context.
// Operands are masked to [0,65535] and sitofp'd so every lane is finite and the
// fadd/fptosi are well-defined; zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass touches
// reduce/min/max intrinsics; any Unicorn divergence is a real rewrite-backend /
// fork bug.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecFReduceMinMaxIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *V4F = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F32, 4);
  auto *V2D = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(F64, 2);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vfrmm", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0xFFFF));
  llvm::Value *Fa = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Fa = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fa, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(3 * i + 1)), F32),
        B.getInt32(i));
  llvm::Value *Fb = llvm::UndefValue::get(V4F);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Fb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Fb, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(2 * i)), F32),
        B.getInt32(i));
  llvm::Value *Da = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    Da = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Da, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, B.getInt32(5 * i + 2)), F64),
        B.getInt32(i));
  llvm::Value *Db = llvm::UndefValue::get(V2D);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    Db = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Db, B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Bm, B.getInt32(7 * i)), F64),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *RmxF =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::vector_reduce_fmaximum, {V4F}, {Fa});
  auto *RmnF =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::vector_reduce_fminimum, {V4F}, {Fb});
  auto *RmxD =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::vector_reduce_fmaximum, {V2D}, {Da});
  auto *RmnD =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::vector_reduce_fminimum, {V2D}, {Db});
  auto *Sf = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(RmxF, RmnF), I32);
  auto *Sd = B.CreateFPToSI(B.CreateFAdd(RmxD, RmnD), I32);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateAdd(Sf, Sd);
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// FP->integer rounding intrinsic llvm.lrint (round a float to an integer using
// the *current* rounding mode) — the first coverage of the FP->int rounding
// family, the integer-returning sibling of the already-covered FP->FP rounding
// (rint/nearbyint/round/...) and FP->int saturation (fptosi.sat).  Every result
// is kept at i32 ("long" on a 32-bit target) so each ISA lowers to a native
// current-mode convert with ZERO libcall: x86 cvtss2si/cvtsd2si (MXCSR defaults
// to round-to-nearest-even), AArch64 frintx+fcvtzs, ARM vcvtr.s32.f32/f64 +
// vmov.  llrint is deliberately NOT used: its idiomatic i64 result has no
// native f->i64 rounding on a 32-bit ISA (would pull __aeabi_*/llrint), and an
// i32-result llrint has no X86 ISel pattern (matching upstream — llrint is
// long-long by definition) — so lrint kept at i32 is the only zero-libcall
// FP->int rounding form across all four ISAs.  Inputs are scaled to exact
// halves/quarters so round-to-nearest-even genuinely fires (X.5 -> even),
// making the result deterministic across targets and bit-identical between the
// original and substituted copies (no obfuscation pass touches an lrint
// intrinsic). Substitutable add/sub/and/or/xor + integer constants (0x5A5A /
// 12345) drive --subst / --const-enc, and a data-dependent diamond + PHI gives
// the control-flow passes real structure.
//
//   int lrnd(int a, int b) {
//     int   am = a & 0x7fff, bm = b & 0x7fff;
//     float fa =  (float)am * 0.5f;          // 0,0.5,1,1.5 ...  ties-to-even
//     float fb = -(float)bm * 0.5f;          // negative halves
//     double da = (double)(am ^ bm) * 0.25;  // quarters
//     double db = (double)(am + bm) * 0.5;   // halves (f64)
//     int r1 = lrint.i32.f32(fa),  r2 = lrint.i32.f32(fb);
//     int r3 = lrint.i32.f64(da),  r4 = lrint.i32.f64(db);
//     int t  = ((a + b) ^ (a - b)) ^ 0x5A5A;
//     int u  = (a & b) | (t + 12345);
//     int base = r1 ^ (r2<<1) ^ (r3<<2) ^ (r4<<3) ^ t ^ u;
//     return ((a ^ b) & 1) ? base + a : base ^ b;
//   }
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildLRIntIR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                           const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *F32 = llvm::Type::getFloatTy(Ctx);
  auto *F64 = llvm::Type::getDoubleTy(Ctx);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage, "lrnd",
                                   M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto *Am = B.CreateAnd(A, B.getInt32(0x7fff));
  auto *Bm = B.CreateAnd(C, B.getInt32(0x7fff));
  auto *Half32 = llvm::ConstantFP::get(F32, 0.5);
  auto *Fa = B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Am, F32), Half32);
  auto *Fb = B.CreateFNeg(B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(Bm, F32), Half32));
  auto *Da = B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateXor(Am, Bm), F64),
                          llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.25));
  auto *Db = B.CreateFMul(B.CreateSIToFP(B.CreateAdd(Am, Bm), F64),
                          llvm::ConstantFP::get(F64, 0.5));
  auto *R1 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::lrint, {I32, F32}, {Fa});
  auto *R2 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::lrint, {I32, F32}, {Fb});
  auto *R3 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::lrint, {I32, F64}, {Da});
  auto *R4 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::lrint, {I32, F64}, {Db});
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(R1, B.CreateShl(R2, B.getInt32(1)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(R3, B.getInt32(2)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(Base, B.CreateShl(R4, B.getInt32(3)));
  Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Base, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// <16 x i8> / <8 x i16> integer abs (llvm.abs, is_int_min_poison=false) — the
// narrow-lane complement of `vabsi`(<4 x i32>) and `vabs64`(<2 x i64>),
// completing the vector-abs lane-width matrix (i8/i16 were never covered).  The
// narrow lanes lower through a *distinct* per-ISA path: AArch64/ARM NEON have a
// native byte/halfword `abs.16b`/`abs.8h` (`vabs.s8`/`vabs.s16`), but x86 SSE2
// has no byte/halfword vector abs (`pabsb`/`pabsw` are SSSE3) so it expands to
// a sign-shift + xor + sub SWAR per lane — a path neither `vabsi`(i32) nor
// `vabs64`(i64) reaches.  is_int_min_poison=false keeps abs(INT8_MIN) /
// abs(INT16_MIN) defined (returns the wrapped min), so every lane is
// well-defined and deterministic across targets.  Lanes mix positive and
// negative values (input XOR'd / subtracted with near-extreme constants incl.
// the sign bit) so abs genuinely fires.  All hardware/inline, zero libcall.  No
// obfuscation pass rewrites an intrinsic call (--subst only touches plain
// add/sub/and/or/xor), so the original and obfuscated copies lower
// byte-identically — any Unicorn mismatch is a real rewrite-backend or
// fork-Unicorn bug.  Multi-block (data-dependent diamond + PHI) so it reaches
// all seven suites; the integer mix + 0x5A5A / 12345 drive --subst /
// --const-enc and the control-flow passes.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAbs8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                             const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vabs8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <16 x i8>: abs of a-derived lanes (input XOR'd / subtracted with
  // near-extreme byte constants incl. the sign bit, so lanes carry mixed
  // signs).
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  uint8_t BigB[16] = {0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x01, 0x40, 0xc0, 0x7e, 0x81,
                      0x10, 0xf0, 0x33, 0xcc, 0x55, 0xaa, 0x08, 0x7f};
  auto *BigBV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(BigB, 16));
  auto *VA8 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(16, Ab), BigBV);
  auto *VB8 = B.CreateSub(B.CreateVectorSplat(16, Cb), BigBV);
  auto *Aa8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V16}, {VA8, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Ad8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V16},
                                {B.CreateSub(VA8, VB8), B.getFalse()});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <8 x i16>: same, halfword lanes.
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  uint16_t BigH[8] = {0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x0001,
                      0x4000, 0xc000, 0x7ffe, 0x8001};
  auto *BigHV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(BigH, 8));
  auto *VA16 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Ah), BigHV);
  auto *VB16 = B.CreateSub(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Ch), BigHV);
  auto *Aa16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8}, {VA16, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Ad16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8},
                                 {B.CreateSub(VA16, VB16), B.getFalse()});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *S8 =
      B.CreateXor(Red8(Aa8), B.CreateShl(Red8(Ad8), B.getInt32(1)));
  llvm::Value *S16 =
      B.CreateXor(Red16(Aa16), B.CreateShl(Red16(Ad16), B.getInt32(1)));
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(S8, S16);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit D-register narrow byte/halfword-lane vector abs (llvm.abs on
// <8 x i8> / <4 x i16>) — the D-register sibling of vabs8 (<16 x i8>/<8 x i16>
// Q-register) and the byte/halfword dual of the <4 x i32> / <2 x i64> / i64 /
// i128 abs forms, completing the abs lane-width matrix (i8/i16 x D/Q + i32 +
// i64 + i128).  AArch64 lowers per-lane on .8b/.4h (D-register, distinct from
// the .16b/.8h Q-register of vabs8); ARM32 NEON uses vabs.s8/.s16 on a D
// register; x86/i386 SSE2 has no pabsb/pabsw (SSSE3) so abs scalarizes to a
// compare-against-zero / xor / sub mask in the low 64 bits of an XMM.  Lanes
// mix the sign bit (0x80/0x8000 near-extremes) so the abs of INT_MIN-adjacent
// lanes exercises the overflow corner.  Zero libcall.  No obfuscation pass
// touches llvm.abs; any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend/fork-Unicorn bug.
// Surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor + constants drive --subst / --const-enc; the
// diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowAbs64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                    const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vnabs64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);

  // <8 x i8>: abs of a-derived lanes XOR'd / subtracted with near-extreme byte
  // constants (incl. the sign bit) so lanes carry mixed signs and hit INT_MIN.
  auto *Ab = B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), *Cb = B.CreateTrunc(C, I8);
  uint8_t BigB[8] = {0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x01, 0x40, 0xc0, 0x7e, 0x81};
  auto *BigBV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(BigB, 8));
  auto *VA8 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Ab), BigBV);
  auto *VB8 = B.CreateSub(B.CreateVectorSplat(8, Cb), BigBV);
  auto *Aa8 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8i8}, {VA8, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Ad8 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8i8},
                                {B.CreateSub(VA8, VB8), B.getFalse()});
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // <4 x i16>: same, halfword lanes.
  auto *Ah = B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), *Ch = B.CreateTrunc(C, I16);
  uint16_t BigH[4] = {0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x0001};
  auto *BigHV =
      llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(BigH, 4));
  auto *VA16 = B.CreateXor(B.CreateVectorSplat(4, Ah), BigHV);
  auto *VB16 = B.CreateSub(B.CreateVectorSplat(4, Ch), BigHV);
  auto *Aa16 =
      B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V4i16}, {VA16, B.getFalse()});
  auto *Ad16 = B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V4i16},
                                 {B.CreateSub(VA16, VB16), B.getFalse()});
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  llvm::Value *S8 =
      B.CreateXor(Red8(Aa8), B.CreateShl(Red8(Ad8), B.getInt32(1)));
  llvm::Value *S16 =
      B.CreateXor(Red16(Aa16), B.CreateShl(Red16(Ad16), B.getInt32(1)));
  llvm::Value *S = B.CreateXor(S8, S16);

  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  llvm::Value *Base = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *RT = B.CreateAdd(Base, A);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  auto *RE = B.CreateXor(Base, C);
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *Res = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "res");
  Res->addIncoming(RT, Then);
  Res->addIncoming(RE, Else);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 64-bit D-register narrow byte/halfword-lane vector integer divide/remainder
// by *constant* divisors (sdiv/udiv/srem/urem on <8 x i8> / <4 x i16>) — the
// narrow-lane sibling of vdivr (<4 x i32> constant-divisor div/rem) and the
// only member of the 64-bit D-register narrow-lane family still missing
// (arith/shift/min-max/sat/abs/3-way-cmp/bit-count/reverse all exist; divide
// did not).  Constant divisors are deliberate: they lower to per-lane
// magic-number multiply-high + shift, NOT a runtime idiv, so there is zero
// libcall (a *variable* divisor would scalarize to __aeabi_idiv / __divdi3 on
// ARM32/i386 and break the freestanding harness — which is exactly why every
// vector-divide shape here uses constant divisors).  The narrow-lane magic
// multiply is a distinct lowering from <4 x i32>: bytes/halfwords widen (x86
// SSE2 pmullw / unpack, AArch64/ARM NEON vmull-style) for the high-half
// product, then truncate back.  Divisors mix non-power-of-two / power-of-two /
// negative lanes (0 and -1 avoided so no UB); the unsigned arm masks the
// dividend non-negative.  No obfuscation pass touches div/rem, so the original
// and obfuscated functions lower identically — any Unicorn mismatch is a real
// backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor + constants drive
// --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real
// structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecNarrowDivConst64IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                         const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V8i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 8);
  auto *V4i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 4);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vndiv64", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto dv8 = [&](const uint8_t (&E)[8]) -> llvm::Value * {
    return llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(E, 8));
  };
  auto dv16 = [&](const uint16_t (&E)[4]) -> llvm::Value * {
    return llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(E, 4));
  };
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // Runtime dividend lanes from the args (substitutable ops -> --subst fires).
  auto *Sb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), B.CreateTrunc(C, I8));
  llvm::Value *Va8 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Va8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va8, B.CreateAdd(Sb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 17 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *Vu8 = B.CreateAnd(Va8, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V8i8, 0x7f));

  auto *Sh = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), B.CreateTrunc(C, I16));
  llvm::Value *Va16 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V4i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    Va16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va16, B.CreateAdd(Sh, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 211 + 1))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *Vu16 = B.CreateAnd(Va16, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V4i16, 0x7fff));

  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  // Then: signed divide + remainder by constant lanes (non-pow2 / pow2 /
  // negative; 0xFD = -3, 0xF0 = -16, 0xFFF8 = -8; 0 and -1 avoided).
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  const uint8_t SD8[8] = {7, 8, 0xFD, 9, 5, 0xF0, 11, 13};
  const uint8_t SR8[8] = {5, 16, 11, 13, 7, 23, 3, 25};
  const uint16_t SD16[4] = {7, 0xFFF8, 11, 100};
  const uint16_t SR16[4] = {13, 16, 5, 99};
  llvm::Value *TS =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red8(B.CreateSDiv(Va8, dv8(SD8))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red8(B.CreateSRem(Va8, dv8(SR8))),
                                          B.getInt32(1))),
                  B.CreateXor(Red16(B.CreateSDiv(Va16, dv16(SD16))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red16(B.CreateSRem(Va16, dv16(SR16))),
                                          B.getInt32(2))));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  // Else: unsigned divide + remainder by constant lanes.
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  const uint8_t UD8[8] = {3, 7, 10, 16, 5, 9, 11, 13};
  const uint8_t UR8[8] = {6, 255, 17, 4, 100, 7, 13, 9};
  const uint16_t UD16[4] = {10, 255, 6, 1000};
  const uint16_t UR16[4] = {100, 7, 17, 64};
  llvm::Value *TU =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red8(B.CreateUDiv(Vu8, dv8(UD8))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red8(B.CreateURem(Vu8, dv8(UR8))),
                                          B.getInt32(1))),
                  B.CreateXor(Red16(B.CreateUDiv(Vu16, dv16(UD16))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red16(B.CreateURem(Vu16, dv16(UR16))),
                                          B.getInt32(2))));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *S = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  S->addIncoming(TS, Then);
  S->addIncoming(TU, Else);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Res = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// 128-bit Q-register byte/halfword-lane vector integer divide/remainder by
// *constant* divisors (sdiv/udiv/srem/urem on <16 x i8> / <8 x i16>) — the
// 128-bit Q-register sibling of vndiv64 (<8 x i8> / <4 x i16> D-register
// div/rem) and the byte/halfword dual of vdivr (<4 x i32>), completing the
// vector divide/remainder lane-width matrix (i8/i16 D + i8/i16 Q + i32) just as
// vtcmp8 (Q) is the sibling of vntcmp64 (D).  Constant divisors are deliberate:
// they lower to per-lane magic-number multiply-high + shift, NOT a runtime
// idiv, so there is zero libcall (a *variable* divisor would scalarize to
// __aeabi_idiv / __divdi3 on ARM32/i386 and break the freestanding harness).
// The full 128-bit byte/halfword magic multiply is a distinct lowering from
// both the D-register narrow form and <4 x i32>: x86 SSE2 widens each half via
// unpacklo/hi + pmullw/pmulhw (16xi8 -> two i16 halves, 8xi16 -> two i32
// halves), AArch64/ARM NEON use smull/smull2 / umull/umull2 over .16b/.8h.
// Divisors mix non-power-of-two / power-of-two / negative lanes (0 and -1
// avoided so no UB); the unsigned arm masks the dividend non-negative.  No
// obfuscation pass touches div/rem, so the original and obfuscated functions
// lower identically — any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn
// bug.  Surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor + constants drive --subst / --const-enc;
// the diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWideDivConst8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                      const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vdiv8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto dv8 = [&](const uint8_t (&E)[16]) -> llvm::Value * {
    return llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(E, 16));
  };
  auto dv16 = [&](const uint16_t (&E)[8]) -> llvm::Value * {
    return llvm::ConstantDataVector::get(Ctx, llvm::ArrayRef<uint16_t>(E, 8));
  };
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // Runtime dividend lanes from the args (substitutable ops -> --subst fires).
  auto *Sb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), B.CreateTrunc(C, I8));
  llvm::Value *Va8 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V16i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
    Va8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va8, B.CreateAdd(Sb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 17 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
  auto *Vu8 = B.CreateAnd(Va8, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V16i8, 0x7f));

  auto *Sh = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), B.CreateTrunc(C, I16));
  llvm::Value *Va16 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    Va16 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va16, B.CreateAdd(Sh, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 211 + 1))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  auto *Vu16 = B.CreateAnd(Va16, llvm::ConstantInt::get(V8i16, 0x7fff));

  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  // Then: signed divide + remainder by constant lanes (non-pow2 / pow2 /
  // negative; 0 and -1 avoided so no overflow/UB).
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  const uint8_t SD8[16] = {7,    8, 0xFD, 9,    5,  0xF0, 11, 13,
                           0xFB, 3, 6,    0xFE, 25, 0xF4, 17, 2};
  const uint8_t SR8[16] = {5, 16, 11, 13,   7,  23, 3,    25,
                           9, 4,  19, 0x80, 15, 33, 0xFC, 6};
  const uint16_t SD16[8] = {7, 0xFFF8, 11, 100, 0xFFFD, 64, 23, 0xFFF0};
  const uint16_t SR16[8] = {13, 16, 5, 99, 7, 0x8000, 41, 3};
  llvm::Value *TS =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red8(B.CreateSDiv(Va8, dv8(SD8))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red8(B.CreateSRem(Va8, dv8(SR8))),
                                          B.getInt32(1))),
                  B.CreateXor(Red16(B.CreateSDiv(Va16, dv16(SD16))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red16(B.CreateSRem(Va16, dv16(SR16))),
                                          B.getInt32(2))));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  // Else: unsigned divide + remainder by constant lanes.
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  const uint8_t UD8[16] = {3, 7,   10, 16, 5,   9,  11, 13,
                           2, 255, 6,  17, 100, 33, 4,  21};
  const uint8_t UR8[16] = {6,   255, 17, 4,  100, 7,  13, 9,
                           128, 3,   11, 50, 19,  64, 5,  10};
  const uint16_t UD16[8] = {10, 255, 6, 1000, 3, 0x8000, 50, 17};
  const uint16_t UR16[8] = {100, 7, 17, 64, 9, 1000, 0xFFFF, 3};
  llvm::Value *TU =
      B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(Red8(B.CreateUDiv(Vu8, dv8(UD8))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red8(B.CreateURem(Vu8, dv8(UR8))),
                                          B.getInt32(1))),
                  B.CreateXor(Red16(B.CreateUDiv(Vu16, dv16(UD16))),
                              B.CreateShl(Red16(B.CreateURem(Vu16, dv16(UR16))),
                                          B.getInt32(2))));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *S = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  S->addIncoming(TS, Then);
  S->addIncoming(TU, Else);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Res = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Byte/halfword-lane vector *widening* multiply (sext/zext <16 x i8> ->
// <16 x i16> and <8 x i16> -> <8 x i32>, then the full product) — completes the
// widening-multiply family, which until now had only vwmull (<4 x i32> ->
// <4 x i64>); the i8->i16 and i16->i32 widenings are a distinct lowering
// (AArch64/ARM NEON smull/smull2 / umull/umull2 .8h<-.8b / .4s<-.4h; x86 SSE2
// unpacklo/hi widen + pmullw, or pmullw+pmulhw assembled into the 32-bit
// product).  A widening multiply keeps the FULL product, unlike vmulnw (which
// truncates to the low half) or vmulhi (which keeps only the high half), so it
// is a genuinely different shape.  Integer multiply never libcalls on any
// target (zero libcall), so both the signed (smull) and unsigned (umull) arms
// are freestanding-safe; high-bit lanes make the two arms diverge.  No
// obfuscation pass touches mul, so original and obfuscated lower identically —
// any Unicorn mismatch is a real backend / fork-Unicorn bug.  Surrounding
// add/sub/and/or/xor
// + constants drive --subst / --const-enc; the diamond + PHI give the
// control-flow passes real structure.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecWMull8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                               const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V16i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 16);
  auto *V8i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *V8i32 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I32, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vwmul8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };
  auto Red32 = [&](llvm::Value *V, unsigned N) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt32(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < N; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return Acc;
  };

  // Byte operands (<16 x i8>) and halfword operands (<8 x i16>) from the args
  // (substitutable ops -> --subst fires); high-bit lanes make sext != zext.
  auto *Sb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), B.CreateTrunc(C, I8));
  auto *Tb = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), B.CreateTrunc(C, I8));
  llvm::Value *Va8 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V16i8);
  llvm::Value *Vb8 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V16i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Va8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va8, B.CreateAdd(Sb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 17 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
    Vb8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vb8, B.CreateAdd(Tb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 13 + 3))), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sh = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), B.CreateTrunc(C, I16));
  auto *Th = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), B.CreateTrunc(C, I16));
  llvm::Value *Ha = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8i16);
  llvm::Value *Hb = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Ha = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ha, B.CreateAdd(Sh, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 211 + 1))),
        B.getInt32(i));
    Hb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hb, B.CreateAdd(Th, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 151 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }

  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  // Then: signed widening multiply (smull): sext to the wide lane, then mul.
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  llvm::Value *TS = B.CreateXor(
      Red16(B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(Va8, V16i16), B.CreateSExt(Vb8, V16i16)),
            16),
      B.CreateShl(
          Red32(B.CreateMul(B.CreateSExt(Ha, V8i32), B.CreateSExt(Hb, V8i32)),
                8),
          B.getInt32(1)));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  // Else: unsigned widening multiply (umull): zext to the wide lane, then mul.
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  llvm::Value *TU = B.CreateXor(
      Red16(B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(Va8, V16i16), B.CreateZExt(Vb8, V16i16)),
            16),
      B.CreateShl(
          Red32(B.CreateMul(B.CreateZExt(Ha, V8i32), B.CreateZExt(Hb, V8i32)),
                8),
          B.getInt32(1)));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  B.SetInsertPoint(Merge);
  auto *S = B.CreatePHI(I32, 2, "s");
  S->addIncoming(TS, Then);
  S->addIncoming(TU, Else);
  auto *T = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(B.CreateAdd(A, C), B.CreateSub(A, C)),
                        B.getInt32(0x5A5A));
  auto *U = B.CreateOr(B.CreateAnd(A, C), B.CreateAdd(T, B.getInt32(12345)));
  auto *Res = B.CreateXor(B.CreateXor(S, T), U);
  B.CreateRet(Res);
  assert(!llvm::verifyModule(*M, &llvm::errs()));
  return M;
}

// Byte/halfword-lane vector *absolute difference* (signed |a-b| via abs(sub)
// -> sabd, and unsigned via sub(umax,umin) -> uabd, on <16 x i8> and
// <8 x i16>) — the abs-difference family was previously zero-coverage.
// Abs-diff is a *fused* lowering: AArch64/ARM NEON have dedicated sabd/uabd
// (.16b/.8h) that the backend pattern-matches from abs(sub) / sub(umax,umin);
// x86/i386 SSE2 has no per-lane abs-diff so the signed arm becomes psub + pabs
// (SSSE3) or compare/xor/sub scalarization, and the unsigned arm becomes
// pmaxub/pmaxuw + pminub/pminuw + psub.  It reuses already-proven zero-libcall
// primitives (llvm.abs / llvm.umax / llvm.umin) but fuses them into a distinct
// op; integer-only, zero libcall.  --subst rewrites the inner/surrounding sub
// into borrow-MBA (semantics preserved) so the obfuscated arm may lose the
// sabd/uabd match and lower to generic sub+abs — both must still produce the
// identical result, which is exactly the equivalence under test.  abs/umax/umin
// are untouched by any pass.  High-bit lanes (sign bit set) make the signed and
// unsigned arms genuinely diverge.  Diamond + PHI give the control-flow passes
// real structure; surrounding add/sub/and/or/xor + the 0x5A5A / 12345 constants
// drive --subst / --const-enc.
std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> buildVecAbsDiff8IR(llvm::LLVMContext &Ctx,
                                                 const char *Triple) {
  auto M = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("substtest", Ctx);
  M->setTargetTriple(llvm::Triple(Triple));
  auto *I8 = llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I16 = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(Ctx);
  auto *I32 = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx);
  auto *V16i8 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I8, 16);
  auto *V8i16 = llvm::FixedVectorType::get(I16, 8);
  auto *FTy = llvm::FunctionType::get(I32, {I32, I32}, false);
  auto *F = llvm::Function::Create(FTy, llvm::Function::ExternalLinkage,
                                   "vabd8", M.get());
  auto *Entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);
  auto *Then = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "then", F);
  auto *Else = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "else", F);
  auto *Merge = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "merge", F);
  auto *A = F->getArg(0), *C = F->getArg(1);

  llvm::IRBuilder<> B(Entry);
  auto Red8 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt8(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };
  auto Red16 = [&](llvm::Value *V) -> llvm::Value * {
    llvm::Value *Acc = B.getInt16(0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
      Acc = B.CreateXor(Acc, B.CreateExtractElement(V, B.getInt32(i)));
    return B.CreateZExt(Acc, I32);
  };

  // Byte operands (<16 x i8>) and halfword operands (<8 x i16>) from the args
  // (substitutable ops -> --subst fires); high-bit lanes make sabd != uabd.
  auto *Sb = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), B.CreateTrunc(C, I8));
  auto *Tb = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateTrunc(A, I8), B.CreateTrunc(C, I8));
  llvm::Value *Va8 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V16i8);
  llvm::Value *Vb8 = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V16i8);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
    Va8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Va8, B.CreateAdd(Sb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 17 + 1))), B.getInt32(i));
    Vb8 = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Vb8, B.CreateAdd(Tb, B.getInt8((uint8_t)(i * 13 + 3))), B.getInt32(i));
  }
  auto *Sh = B.CreateXor(B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), B.CreateTrunc(C, I16));
  auto *Th = B.CreateAdd(B.CreateTrunc(A, I16), B.CreateTrunc(C, I16));
  llvm::Value *Ha = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8i16);
  llvm::Value *Hb = llvm::PoisonValue::get(V8i16);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
    Ha = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Ha, B.CreateAdd(Sh, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 211 + 1))),
        B.getInt32(i));
    Hb = B.CreateInsertElement(
        Hb, B.CreateAdd(Th, B.getInt16((uint16_t)(i * 151 + 7))),
        B.getInt32(i));
  }

  auto *Sel = B.CreateAnd(B.CreateXor(A, C), B.getInt32(1));
  B.CreateCondBr(B.CreateICmpNE(Sel, B.getInt32(0)), Then, Else);

  // Then: signed abs-diff (sabd): abs(a - b).
  B.SetInsertPoint(Then);
  auto *False = B.getFalse();
  llvm::Value *TS = B.CreateXor(
      Red8(B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V16i8},
                             {B.CreateSub(Va8, Vb8), False})),
      B.CreateShl(Red16(B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::abs, {V8i16},
                                          {B.CreateSub(Ha, Hb), False})),
                  B.getInt32(1)));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);

  // Else: unsigned abs-diff (uabd): umax(a,b) - umin(a,b).
  B.SetInsertPoint(Else);
  llvm::Value *TU = B.CreateXor(
      Red8(B.CreateSub(
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V16i8}, {Va8, Vb8}),
          B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V16i8}, {Va8, Vb8}))),
      B.CreateShl(
          Red16(B.CreateSub(
              B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umax, {V8i16}, {Ha, Hb}),
              B.CreateIntrinsic(llvm::Intrinsic::umin, {V8i16}, {Ha, Hb}))),
          B.getInt32(1)));
  B.CreateBr(Merge);
